# Chapter 581: (1): Another School in a Small Alley

Sword of Coming

When Ning Yao and Die Zhang returned to the shop, Die Zhang suddenly
stopped in her tracks, not daring to take another step forward.

This was because she felt respect and fear toward the man who had
suddenly appeared at the entrance of her shop.

He was none other than Great Sword Immortal Zuo You, someone who was
renowned for his coldness.

Regardless of how poor one\'s temper was in their hometown, ordinary
sword cultivators from other continents all needed to rein in their
tempers when they arrived at the Sword Qi Great Wall.

However, Senior Zuo You was different. An indigenous Immortal Tier sword
immortal guarding the city wall had attempted to challenge Zuo You ---
who was widely recognized as possessing the greatest sword skills in the
world --- when he had just arrived at the Sword Qi Great Wall, yet Zuo
You had simply said, \"You\'re not able to learn my sword skills, but
there is one thing you can learn from me: It\'s better to avoid a fight
that you can\'t win.\"

The Lord Hidden Official had been standing nearby at the time, and she
had concurred, \"That seems to make sense.\"

And thus, the highly anticipated sparring session hadn\'t taken place
atop the city wall.

Die Zhang was filled with curiosity following her shock. Why was Zuo You
suppressing his sword qi so much? Everyone at the Sword Qi Great Wall
knew that Sword Immortal Zuo You was always surrounded by sword qi,
using this to forge a path forward during the big battles and venturing
deep into the ranks of the demon tribe\'s large army. He would also be
surrounded by sword qi when he tempered his sword intent alone atop the
parapet.

Today, however, the most skillful sword immortal in the Majestic World
was surprisingly suppressing his sword qi, not displaying a single wisp.

Seeing this, Ning Yao dragged Die Zhang off to stroll around again.

Only when Ning Yao learned that the Scholarly Sage had already left did
she return to the shop. Unexpectedly, Zuo You was still yet to leave.

Before leaving, the old scholar had especially reached out to bid
farewell and thank her. Ning Yao was slightly puzzled at this moment,
not knowing why she deserved the Scholarly Sage\'s thanks.

Regarding the interesting relationship between Chen Ping\'an and Zuo
You, it wasn\'t difficult for Ning Yao to understand the thoughts of the
two people. Thus, she hadn\'t made any comments about Zuo You to Chen
Ping\'an.

It wouldn\'t be appropriate for her to say anything, and in any case,
Chen Ping\'an had his own views and beliefs regarding these important
matters in life. There was no need for Ning Yao to interfere, and there
wasn\'t even a need for her to provide suggestions and strategies.

Die Zhang truly couldn\'t contain her curiosity, so after walking far
away, she used her mind\'s lake to ask Ning Yao, \"Is Chen Ping\'an
acquainted with Great Sword Immortal Zuo?\"

\"They\'ve been acquainted for a long time,\" Ning Yao confirmed with a
nod.

Chen Ping\'an had written about this in his travel journal, and he had
actually dedicated quite a number of paragraphs to describing his
experiences with Zuo You.

\"Can you tell me a bit more?\" Die Zhang asked with a smile.

\"No, I can\'t,\" Ning Yao replied with a shake of her head.

Die Zhang tugged at Ning Yao\'s sleeve, gently swaying it back and forth
as she put on a pout and said in a pitiful voice, \"Just tell me
anything, Big Sister Ning. There has to be something you can say.\"

Ning Yao pondered for a moment before replying, \"You should ask Chen
Ping\'an yourself when we return. He\'s planning to partner with you to
open a shop, so you can use this as a condition for forming the
partnership. Don\'t agree to his proposal too early.\"

Die Zhang quickly understood the implications of Ning Yao\'s words, with
the latter clearly laying a trap for her to walk into. Die Zhang
chuckled in anger and huffed, \"I\'m not planning to become business
partners with him. Don\'t push your luck, Ning Yao.\"

Ning Yao smiled and said, \"I\'m truly not siding with Chen Ping\'an
over you, but the reality is that he was correct --- you aren\'t clever
enough when it comes to doing business. With his help, it\'s guaranteed
that you can enjoy a large and steady income.\"

Die Zhang furrowed her brows, wanting to say something but ultimately
deciding against it.

Ning Yao glanced at Die Zhang and immediately read her mind, explaining,
\"Chen Ping\'an is carrying one pocket treasure and two minimization
treasures, but apart from some ordinary wine from his hometown and a
large pile of bamboo leaves, they\'re filled with nothing but empty
space. He has almost nothing on him. If Chen Ping\'an truly wanted to
travel to the Sword Qi Great Wall as a merchant like many on the
intercontinental ships and rely on selling a bunch of miscellaneous
items to earn money from us sword cultivators, then would he have wasted
his treasures like this? He would have stuffed his pocket treasure and
minimization treasures full of goods.

\"Which is to say, Chen Ping\'an only wants to earn ethical money by
forming a business partnership with you. This is out of habit, and Chen
Ping\'an has always liked to earn money from a young age. However, this
isn\'t due to a pure desire for wealth. I have to speak up and defend
him in this regard.\"

Die Zhang felt a huge sense of relief, and a smile returned to her face
as she said, \"That\'s good then. Otherwise, I would have scolded him
for being greedy and scummy to his face, and so be it if our friendship
ended as soon as it began.\"

Soon after the old scholar left, Zuo You lightly placed his pot of wine
on the chair. He didn\'t like to drink wine, and suppressing his
abundant sword qi was also very troublesome. Perhaps he was the only
person in the world who complained about having too much sword qi.

Chen Ping\'an was still taking small sips of wine, appearing quite
carefree and relaxed.

Zuo You chuckled coldly and asked, \"Is it hard to feign calm and
composure now that Master isn\'t here to help you anymore?\"

Chen Ping\'an firmly refused to speak.

\"You weren\'t aware that Master would come to the Sword Qi Great Wall
before, so there was no issue with you asking Chen Qingdu for
assistance,\" Zuo You said. \"However, since Master visited just now,
why didn\'t you take the opportunity to ask for his agreement? Whether
Master agreed or not would have been his problem, but whether to ask or
not is a matter of respect and etiquette for a disciple.\"

Chen Ping\'an also placed his wine pot on the chair, placing his hands
inside his opposite sleeves before leaning forward and gazing at the
street that was currently being repaired. \"I\'m aware of Master\'s
current state, so could I still open my mouth to ask this question? What
would that achieve apart from making Master feel troubled? Even if
Master doesn\'t feel troubled, will my conscience not feel uneasy? Even
if I don\'t feel uneasy, what happens when this matter causes trouble
for the entire Sword Qi Great Wall, becoming the spark that directly
triggers an all-out battle between the two sides? If that were the case,
would Master truly not feel troubled when he departed?\"

Zuo You nodded in response, approving Chen Ping\'an\'s answer.

Master had many things to worry about, so it was only appropriate that
his disciples should shoulder some of the burdens and responsibilities.

Zuo You recalled the tall and sturdy Mao Xiaodong, though his
recollection of this unofficial disciple was slightly hazy. He only
remembered Mao Xiaodong as a young man who had earnestly studied and
sought knowledge all year round. He wasn\'t part of the brightest group
of unofficial disciples, with his understanding and comprehension
abilities being relatively slow. Mao Xiaodong always liked to ask for
clarification regarding scholarly questions, and Cui Chan often joked
that he was a dimwitted blockhead. Cui Chan would only give the final
answer, and he would never be willing to go into more detail. Only
Little Qi would be patient enough to entertain Mao Xiaodong.

\"Mao Xiaodong was unwilling to enter the School of Rites to shelter
from trouble in the beginning, insisting on tying himself to the
scholarly lineage. He also wanted to accompany Little Qi to the Eastern
Treasured Vial Continent to establish Mountain Cliff Academy,\" Zuo You
recounted slowly. \"Master actually said something very harsh back then,
saying that Mao Xiaodong shouldn\'t have such selfish thoughts, seeking
only to appease his own conscience. Why couldn\'t he elevate his
ambitions to the next level? There was no need to stubbornly cling to
one lineage, and if he could use a greater knowledge to benefit the
world, it mattered little whether he belonged to the scholarly lineage
or not.

\"After hearing this, Mao Xiaodong, whom I never really held in high
regard, said something that impressed me greatly. He screamed at the top
of his lungs, saying to Master that he was slow and untalented, but he
knew that only by respecting his master could he uphold Dao and be free
from guilt. The sequential order of these matters couldn\'t be swapped.
Master was both happy and sad to hear this, but he no longer forced Mao
Xiaodong to leave the scholarly lineage and join the etiquette
lineage.\"

Chen Ping\'an grabbed his pot of wine and took a sip, saying, \"Senior
Brother Mao was extremely hospitable both times I visited the Great Sui
Nation\'s Mountain Cliff Academy. He was afraid that I would venture
down the wrong paths, so he appeared much like a Confucian sage and
teacher when he explained some principles to me.\"

Zuo You smiled and remarked, \"Well, that\'s because you didn\'t see his
speechless expression when I put him in a chokehold. Regardless of how
reasonable his response was, he shouldn\'t have sent spittle flying all
over Master\'s face, should he? What do you say, Junior Brother?!\"

Chen Ping\'an quietly put his pot of wine back on the chair, simply
responding with a nod and stubbornly refusing to say anything extra.

Zuo You stood up, grabbing his pot of wine from the chair before
shooting a glance at the food container beside his feet.

Chen Ping\'an stood up and said, \"I\'ll pay for this.\"

Zuo You shot another glance at Chen Ping\'an.

Chen Ping\'an had no option but to add, \"And I\'ll continue to do so in
the future.\"

Only after hearing this did Zuo You prepare to leave.

\"I hope I didn\'t disappoint you, Senior Brother Zuo,\" Chen Ping\'an
suddenly said.

Zuo You remained silent for a moment before saying slowly, \"You did
okay.\"

Chen Ping\'an breathed a sigh of relief and chuckled. \"That\'s good
then.\"

Zuo You hesitated for a moment and eventually said, \"From today onward,
if anyone speaks to you in a taunting manner and accuses you of
receiving protection and enjoying today\'s success simply because you
belong to the scholarly lineage, then there\'s no need to speak nonsense
with them. You can directly send a messenger flying sword to the city
wall, and I\'ll teach them what respect means.\"

Chen Ping\'an was rendered speechless. He was truly quite unaccustomed
to this.

Zuo You paused briefly and added, \"I\'ll teach their parents and
seniors the meaning of respect as well.\"

Seeing that Zuo You was becoming slightly impatient and seemingly
wanting to teach him sword techniques, Chen Ping\'an was reminded of a
saying popular among vagrant cultivators: better to sacrifice someone
else than to sacrifice oneself. With this in mind, he hurriedly nodded
and replied, \"I\'ll keep this in mind.\"

Zuo You didn\'t go to great pains to suppress his sword qi any longer,
transforming into a streak of brilliant light as he returned to the
distant city wall.

As Zuo You soared from the city to the city wall, his abundant sword qi
caused the primordial sword intent that suffused heaven and earth to
briefly move aside and create a path.

After arriving at the city wall, Zuo You lightly raised his hand holding
the wine pot, lifting his sleeve, which held a bound book. This was a
book that Chen Ping\'an had given to the Scholarly Sage just then, yet
the Scholarly Sage had secretly passed it onto him for some unknown
reason. In fact, the Scholarly Sage had even hidden this from Chen
Ping\'an, his most favored final disciple.

Zuo You used his sword qi to create an isolated small world, after which
he started to drink wine and read. He placed the book on the parapet in
front of him, relying on his sword qi to flip the pages when required.

Before he knew it, Zuo You had already finished the entire pot of wine.
He gazed up at the sky, turning toward the direction where the Scholarly
Sage had left.

Master\'s smile remained the same even after becoming the most
impoverished Confucian sage in the world, but Zuo You knew that his
master wasn\'t truly carefree and happy. Rather, the Scholarly Sage was
feeling guilty about his disciples having to disperse and drift around
the world.

Things were only different when Master saw his junior brother, someone
whose ego was higher than the heavens, and who was finally willing to
acknowledge the Scholarly Sage as his master. Even though Master had
spoken little and smiled little, having already departed from the Sword
Qi Great Wall as well, he was definitely beaming from ear to ear right
now.

Perhaps Chen Ping\'an wasn\'t aware that if he had hurriedly rushed to
the city wall to greet his senior brother upon arriving at the Sword Qi
Great Wall and hearing that Zuo You was there, then Zuo You would have
indeed felt disappointed.

How could Little Qi choose such a junior brother?

If Chen Ping\'an had secretly constructed an ancestral hall at home and
hung up Master\'s portrait, yet he actively sought praise from Zuo You
because of this, then Zuo You would have felt even more disappointed.

How could Master choose such a closing disciple?

If Chen Ping\'an wanted to learn sword techniques because he felt like
Zuo You was a skilled swordsman, then Zuo You would have felt most
disappointed.

Why should he accept such a junior brother?

However, Chen Ping\'an didn\'t do any of these things. This was the
junior brother that Zuo You had waited one hundred years for.

In fact, he was even better than the ideal junior brother that had
existed in Zuo You\'s mind.

When parting ways at the Flood Dragon Trench back then, there was one
thing that Zuo You hadn\'t said. He had hoped that Chen Ping\'an could
do one thing.

To his surprise, Chen Ping\'an had not only done this thing, but he had
even done it very well. He had traveled across three continents and
witnessed their mountains and waters.

Thus, Zuo You finally realized why Master had purposely given the book
to him after reading its contents.

At this moment, Zuo You wondered to himself whether his hesitant
response of, \"You did okay,\" to Chen Ping\'an at the shop entrance
back then had hurt his junior brother\'s feelings.

Perhaps Master would have smacked him across the head again if he were
present.

Zuo You\'s gaze lingered on the sky for a long time.

The Dao of heaven and earth was vast, substantial, lofty, brilliant,
far-reaching, and long-lasting.\[1\]

*A pity! Worry weighs on my heart, yet I can feel it flowing away with
time, with no chance to address it.*\[2\]

1\. This is a line from the *Doctrine of the Mean* (中庸), one of the
Four Books of classical Chinese philosophy and a central doctrine of
Confucianism. ☜

2\. This is a line from *The Oath of Qin* (秦誓), a chapter from the
*Book of Documents* (尚书). ☜

[]{#chapter-42.xhtml}

# Chapter 581: (2): Another School in a Small Alley

Sword of Coming

Chen Ping\'an breathed a sigh of relief after Zuo You left without
drawing his sword. He would be lying to himself if he said he wasn\'t
nervous, and he hurriedly placed the chair and stools back inside the
shop before sitting down on the door threshold, waiting for Ning Yao and
Die Zhang to return.

Zuo You had come silently, but he hadn\'t concealed his sword qi on
purpose when leaving.

Thus, more than half of the sword immortals at the Sword Qi Great Wall
were most likely able to detect Zuo You\'s trip away from the city wall.

In any case, Zuo You\'s act of openly sitting at the entrance of the
shop just then was a silent message in and of itself.

Before Zuo You\'s arrival at the shop, the old scholar had actually
activated a mystical ability and created a barrier, allowing only those
at the shop to detect his presence. He had then retracted this barrier
following Zuo You\'s arrival.

Those in the scholarly lineage always worried about many things, but
when they decided to act, they would always be extremely resolute. As a
result, they would appear as unreasonable as could be.

When Ning Yao and Die Zhang returned, Chen Ping\'an stood up and said
with a smile, \"Sorry for inconveniencing you, Miss Die Zhang. I had to
host some guests here.\"

Die Zhang smiled. \"I won\'t ask about the old mister\'s identity, but
why did Great Sword Immortal Zuo voluntarily come over to drink wine
with you? I need to ask about this, lest all of the items in my shop
mysteriously disappear in the future. Who would I complain to at that
time?\"

\"Zuo You is my senior brother, and the person sitting in the middle
just then was our master, Majestic World\'s Scholarly Sage,\" Chen
Ping\'an revealed.

His background and identity wouldn\'t help him much at the Sword Qi
Great Wall, as they would not help him avoid a single battle. He still
had to fight those necessary battles, no matter what.

In any case, what Cui Dongshan had said was correct. He had won over his
master and his senior brother through his own abilities, so there was no
need to purposely keep their relationships hidden.

Die Zhang silently walked into the shop.

There was no way to continue this conversation.

Ning Yao sat beside Chen Ping\'an on the door threshold and said in a
soft voice, \"Thankfully, the old great sword immortal was personally
keeping an eye on the city wall just then, not allowing a single person
to travel south for whatever reason. Otherwise, you would have faced
immense danger in the next battle. The demon tribe has many schemes.\"

\"Master and Senior Brother Zuo are both aware of this,\" Chen Ping\'an
reassured with a smile.

Ning Yao nodded and asked, \"What are you planning to do next?\"

\"Cultivate in earnest, refine more Qi, strive to advance to the Abode
Tier as soon as possible, perform advanced refinement on First and
Fifteenth and transform them into bonded items, and temper my Vajra Body
Tier at the same time,\" Chen Ping\'an replied. \"Things will be much
easier in battle after I advance to the Far Roaming Tier. However, my
last two goals are very difficult to achieve at the moment, and just
focusing on gathering bonded items of the Five Elements alone, this task
already poses monumental difficulty.

\"Bonded items of the metal element and fire element are exceptionally
rare and can only be obtained through fortune, so if things truly don\'t
work out, I won\'t try to purposely look for bonded items of superior
grade. I need to build my bridge of immortality to face the next great
battle first, after all.

\"Ning Yao, you don\'t need to persuade me one way or another regarding
this matter. I\'ve already gone over the pros and cons very carefully,
and disregarding the other matters of cultivation and only focusing on
bonded items, the grades of my three current bonded items are already
enough to help me advance to the level of earth immortal and perhaps the
Unpolished Jade Tier. I can\'t have overly high ideals and expectations
regarding this matter, since one indeed can\'t walk too slowly on the
path of cultivation.

\"Otherwise, my spiritual energy will inevitably become scattered if
I\'m unable to advance to the Middle Five Tiers for a long time, yet my
martial arts cultivation base has already reached the seventh tier. When
I circulate my True Qi, it will, to a greater or smaller extent, collide
with my spiritual energy and affect my combat power. So, in the
meantime\...\"

Chen Ping\'an frowned in worry as he said this, and he heaved a sigh
before continuing, \"I still need to learn sword techniques from Senior
Brother\...\"

\"Isn\'t that quite good?\" Ning Yao replied. \"Senior Zuo is the most
suitable and the most qualified person to teach you sword techniques.
Don\'t forget that your senior brother isn\'t an innate sword talent
either.\"

\"I can\'t lie in the sickbed and drink medicine at the Ning Residence
every few days, can I?\" Chen Ping\'an replied in helplessness.

Ning Yao chuckled and said, \"That\'s okay. I learned how to brew
medicine from you back in the Jewel Small World, but I\'ve never had the
opportunity to use this skill.\"

Chen Ping\'an tried to restrain himself once, twice, and three times,
but he eventually couldn\'t help but say, \"It\'s not like I haven\'t
seen you brew medicine before. I wouldn\'t dare to drink the medicine
even if you dare to brew it.\"

Ning Yao clicked her tongue and remarked, \"Tsk, you\'re speaking quite
tough after acknowledging your senior brother.\"

Chen Ping\'an immediately put on a pitiful expression and relented,
\"I\'ll drink it. I\'ll pretend it\'s wine and drink it.\"

Die Zhang shook her head in envy as she looked at the couple in the
doorway.

Chen Ping\'an recalled something, and he turned around and proposed with
a smile, \"Miss Die Zhang, how about we split the profits forty-sixty if
I help the shop bring in money?\"

\"Will that be too little for you?\" Die Zhang asked with a smile.

\"Then how about thirty-seventy?\" Chen Ping\'an replied. \"Miss Die
Zhang, you truly like to take big risks when it comes to doing business.
It\'s no wonder that your shop is doing so\... well\...\"

Die Zhang was rendered speechless with anger.

There was a look of amused schadenfreude on Ning Yao\'s face.

Chen Ping\'an smiled and said, \"Even immortals will struggle to make
money at this miscellaneous shop.\"

He chuckled. \"I knew that I would be staying at the Sword Qi Great Wall
for an extended period this time, so I brought some extra wine of the
ordinary ilk from my hometown. How about we open a small wine shop
together? We don\'t need to be afraid of customers having nowhere to sit
as long as we place a few additional chairs and tables outside. If the
wine is good, then it will taste good even if they drink it while
squatting down.\"

\"You already admitted that it\'s ordinary wine from the markets, so
even if there are a lot of alcoholics here, there will ultimately come a
time when the wine runs out, even if they\'re willing to buy this
wine,\" Die Zhang said in curiosity. \"In any case, selling the wine for
a high price can easily ruin the shop\'s reputation. I\'m not shameless
enough to scam other people.\"

Chen Ping\'an retrieved a verdant green bamboo leaf that was lush and
filled with spiritual energy, replying, \"The price of the wine will
rise astronomically after I put this in the wine pot. Of course, this
will be the first-grade wine sold by our wine shop. For the second-grade
wine, we\'ll put a few bamboo leaves in a large wine vat. In addition, I
also have this.\"

He opened his hands, revealing a wine insect that he had \"borrowed\"
from Wei Bo because talking about his transactions with a friend like
Wei Bo would hurt their feelings. Wine insects were extremely rare and
precious creatures, even in Majestic World. It was only thanks to
hosting three Night Travel Banquets and giving some subtle hints that
some mountain or water god had finally parted ways with the wine insect
with great reluctance. In fact, this deity had only been willing to
offer up the wine insect after Wei Bo subtly hinted that they wouldn\'t
need to attend the fourth Night Travel Banquet as compensation.

Chen Ping\'an was brimming with confidence as he continued, \"I\'ve
already done some tests, and wine improved with wine insect alone still
can\'t be regarded as a very good wine --- it\'s still very lacking
compared to those exorbitantly expensive immortal wines. However, adding
the bamboo leaves will completely transform the wine\'s flavor.

\"So, we need to purchase as much cheap and ordinary wine as possible
before we open our wine shop. The more we buy, the better, and we can
store them away and only open our doors for business when we have enough
wine. We probably can\'t get a bargain if we go and purchase wine
ourselves, and we\'ll likely draw suspicion if we buy too much. This
being the case, we can give Yan Zhuo and Chen Sanqiu a cut of the
profits. A small percentage will do, and there\'s no need to give them
too much. They\'re already rich enough as it is, unlike us two poor
people.\"

Ning Yao leaned against the doorframe of the shop as she looked at Chen
Ping\'an, who was especially spirited and energetic as he talked about
business.

Die Zhang felt slightly hesitant. This wasn\'t about whether or not they
should purchase cheap wine --- she no longer had any doubts about this,
and she was confident that they could make money. It was simply a
question of how much money they could make. Moreover, they would be
earning money from those wealthy sword cultivators and sword immortals,
and Die Zhang didn\'t feel an iota of guilt about this. These
cultivators and immortals would be drinking wine regardless.

What Die Zhang was hesitant about right now was the same thing as before
--- dragging Fatty Yan and Chen Sanqiu into this business venture.
According to her original intentions, she would rather earn less money
and face a higher cost price than ask her friends for help. If it
weren\'t for Chen Ping\'an mentioning that they could take a cut of the
profits, Die Zhang would have rejected his suggestion outright.

Chen Ping\'an was in no hurry, and he placed the wine insect inside his
sleeve and returned the bamboo leaf to his minimization treasure. There
was a large pile of bamboo leaves and bamboo branches inside, with Chen
Ping\'an having brought all of them to the Sword Qi Great Wall. He
smiled faintly and said, \"Miss Die Zhang, please excuse me for being
blunt, but you truly need to fix your attitude when it comes to doing
business. Speaking business, it\'s correct not to involve your friends
if you feel like the profits and losses of the venture are uncertain.
However, it will be inconsiderate of us not to involve our friends if
we\'re certain that the business venture is definitely going to profit.

\"Anyhow, it\'s also okay if Miss Die Zhang genuinely feels like my
suggestion is inappropriate. In that case, we can simply open a smaller
wine shop, meaning slightly higher cost, less stock, and less profit. We
can discuss this matter again once we\'ve earned enough money, and
there\'s no need to feel concerned about pushing things back.\"

Die Zhang was seemingly facing a new dilemma now, worried that Chen
Ping\'an would hold a grudge against her if she turned down his
genuinely good idea.

Chen Ping\'an smiled and asked, \"Then it\'s a deal? A thirty-seventy
split in my favor?\"

Die Zhang smiled and replied, \"Fifty-fifty. Both the wine and the shop
are equally as important.\"

\"Isn\'t it also a wine shop if I grab a few tables and chairs and
casually place them in some empty space on the street?\" Chen Ping\'an
retorted.

\"I refuse to believe that Ning Yao can stand losing face like this.
Even if Ning Yao doesn\'t mind, can you, Chen Ping\'an, truly bring
yourself to embarrass her?\" Die Zhang interrogated.

Chen Ping\'an was left slightly speechless.

Ning Yao was just about to say something.

\"Ning Yao!\" Die Zhang hurriedly exclaimed. \"We\'ve been friends for
so many years, so you can\'t forget about your friend after finding
yourself a partner!\"

Ning Yao had initially wanted to say that she wouldn\'t even mind
helping out and hollering to sell wine, so would she mind setting up a
wine shop on the streets using some random tables and chairs?

However, Ning Yao didn\'t have the heart to say this after hearing Die
Zhang\'s frantic remark.

And thus, she eventually haggled with Chen Ping\'an to get a forty-sixty
split in Chen Ping\'an\'s favor.

Chen Ping\'an\'s reason was that he had won four battles in a row,
allowing this street to become renowned throughout the Sword Qi Great
Wall. As such, his selling wine would bring great repute to the wine
shop at no cost, allowing them to attract more customers.

Die Zhang was truly quite impressed by his shamelessness and his ability
to make money.

In the end, however, she still asked, \"Chen Ping\'an, are you really
not worried about losing face for the Ning Residence and the Yao Clan\'s
elders by selling wine and making some small money like this?\"

Chen Ping\'an smiled and shot back with a question of his own, asking,
\"Have you forgotten about my background, Miss Die Zhang? I don\'t
steal, don\'t rob, don\'t cheat, and don\'t scam, so each copper coin I
earn is a result of my ability.\"

Ning Yao held back a smile.

Chen Ping\'an was in love with money, so if the shop opened but failed
to attract customers in the beginning, he would go as far as to sell
wine to the old great sword immortal.

Die Zhang fell silent for a long time before whispering, \"I feel like
our wine shop will be cheating people.\"

Chen Ping\'an waved a hand and boasted without shame, \"We\'ll clearly
display the price, and the customers can either take it or leave it.
There won\'t be any need to worry about the sales avenues in the future,
and to be blunt, it will be completely up to our mood whether we want to
sell wine or not.\"

Die Zhang felt slightly more at ease after hearing this.

It had always been Die Zhang\'s dream to become rich and buy a big
house, but she had enough self-awareness to realize that finding the
right business opportunity to earn money truly wasn\'t her strong suit.

Die Zhang initially thought that Chen Ping\'an and Ning Yao would return
to the Ning Residence after they finished the negotiations and reached a
deal, but Chen Ping\'an unexpectedly stood behind the counter and
grabbed an abacus. This puzzled Die Zhang greatly, and she asked,
\"Aren\'t we just purchasing some wine to build stock? This is a very
simple task that I\'ll be capable of handling.\"

There was a genuinely stunned expression on Chen Ping\'an\'s face. He
wasn\'t feigning shock this time, and he asked with a frustrated
chuckle, \"Do there exist such simple business transactions in the
world?! Miss Die, I\'m already starting to question my decision to
partner with you! Just think for a moment. We first need to choose a
restaurant or a wine shop with relatively poor business to purchase wine
from, right? At that time, how should we haggle for a better price, and
how can we get a discount if we purchase in bulk? How can we say the
right things to the right people? Do we not need to think over these
matters first?

\"How can we lock in a contract to prevent our supplier from going back
on the agreement and refusing to sell us wine after they see the success
of our wine shop? Even if they back out, there needs to be a clause in
the contract detailing the compensation they owe us if they choose to go
down this path. There are many different considerations and a great deal
of fine details to iron out, and I surmise that you definitely won\'t be
able to discuss these details and close out a deal by yourself.

\"So be it. I\'ll put on a face mask afterward and have you sit beside
me to observe --- I\'ll demonstrate the process to you first. In any
case, what I mentioned was only the rough outline regarding how to
purchase wine from other people. The other aspect is opening a new shop.
We need to invite some wine drinkers to act like so-called passers-by to
create some atmosphere and excitement, so what kind of sword cultivators
at what cultivation base should we invite? Do we not need to work
through this and privately promise them a certain number of pots of
high-grade bamboo leaf wine, wine that will be incredibly difficult to
purchase in the future?

\"And which sword immortal should we ask to make loud and nonsensical
proclamations about purchasing all of our wine? Who would be more
suitable for this, and who can do this without appearing suspicious and
clearly in cahoots with us? Do we not need to mull over these matters?
Thinking a bit further, how should we clearly and fairly split the
profits with our alcoholic friends in Fatty Yan and Chen Sanqiu after we
make money? We\'re doing small business here, so we definitely can\'t
sell wine on credit. We need to plan everything out as early as
possible, don\'t you think\...?\"

Die Zhang became completely deflated, feeling increasingly uncertain as
she listened to Chen Ping\'an go on and on from behind the counter. In
the end, Die Zhang started to feel like\... maybe she truly wasn\'t cut
out for doing business?

Why did she suddenly feel like doing business was even more difficult
than practicing sword techniques?

Ning Yao smiled faintly and snacked on roasted seeds as she stood beside
the counter.

When Chen Ping\'an finished, Die Zhang said in a meek voice, \"Chen
Ping\'an, how about we split the profits thirty-seventy in your favor?
I\'m fine with just thirty percent.\"

Chen Ping\'an was just about to nod and accept Die Zhang\'s offer.

However, he was immediately struck by Ning Yao\'s elbow, causing him to
immediately smile and reply, \"There\'s no need. We can split the
profits fifty-fifty as we discussed in the beginning. There needs to be
sincerity when doing business.\"

Chen Ping\'an turned to his side and signaled to Die Zhang with his
eyes. He had already shown sincerity, so it was only right for Miss Die
Zhang to show some sincerity as well, right? They should each take a
backward step and settle at a forty-sixty split in Chen Ping\'an\'s
favor again.

Die Zhang nodded before turning to Ning Yao with an innocent expression
and saying, \"Ning Yao, Chen Ping\'an is secretly winking at me. I\'m
not sure what this means.\"

Chen Ping\'an suffered another blow from Ning Yao\'s elbow, causing him
to grimace in pain as he raised a thumb at Die Zhang and remarked,
\"Miss Die Zhang is indeed a quick learner when it comes to doing
business.\"

They discussed many more details.

Die Zhang carefully committed everything to memory.

Chen Ping\'an and Ning Yao left the small miscellaneous shop, and as
they walked along the street and passed by the wine shops, Chen Ping\'an
smiled and said, \"These shops will all be our competitors in the
future.\"

\"Thank you,\" Ning Yao said in a soft voice.

\"I was doing what I needed to,\" Chen Ping\'an replied with a smile.

Ning Yao hesitated for a moment before asking, \"Die Zhang likes a noble
scholar from a Confucian school in the Middle Earth Divine Continent ---
are you able to straighten her out?\"

Chen Ping\'an smiled wryly and said, \"There are some things I can help
with, but I truly can\'t help with this kind of matter.\"

Ning Yao clasped her hands behind her back and praised slowly, \"Don\'t
you have a very good understanding of romantic relationships?\"

\"O\' great conscience of heaven and earth! I don\'t understand this at
all!\" Chen Ping\'an replied in a resolute voice.

\*\*\*

Die Zhang\'s small residence, which was hidden inside a small alley, was
already filled with a great number of large wine vats. She didn\'t have
enough money left to purchase more wine, and even though Chen Ping\'an
still had ten grain rain coins in his possession, he naturally couldn\'t
use a grain rain coin to purchase goods like a fool. Doing so would be
encouraging the wine sellers to raise their prices as much as possible.
This being the case, he asked Ning Yao for a large pile of snowflake
coins.

Chen Ping\'an and Die Zhang visited all of the restaurants and wine
shops that sold poor quality wine at the Sword Qi Great Wall, and this
was wine that wouldn\'t sell very well in the streets and alleys here.
This was one strange aspect of the Sword Qi Great Wall. The sword
cultivators who could afford wine weren\'t willing to drink this
poor-quality wine, and only those drunkard sword cultivators who owed
too much wine money would pinch their noses and drink this inferior
wine.

Meanwhile, the proper immortal wine sold by the restaurants and wine
shops was truly as expensive as flying swords. Immortal wine here was
far more expensive than immortal wine at Stalactite Mountain, which was
only a single gate away, and this caused even sword immortals to feel
extremely vexed. This was especially the case since travel between
Stalactite Mountain and the Sword Qi Great Wall had become subject to
stricter control. It was becoming increasingly difficult for the
alcoholics of the Sword Qi Great Wall to enjoy life.

Chen Ping\'an bent down and opened up a wine vat, inside of which the
wine insect was currently soaking. It was leisurely swimming around like
a small fish, appearing drunk as it enjoyed itself to the fullest.

Each vat of wine needed to host the wine insect for three days to
transform into fine wine, and inside these vats were also a few bamboo
leaves as well as a single bamboo segment. The wine wasn\'t named
Verdant Bamboo Leaf as Die Zhang had suggested, nor was it named Bamboo
Branch Wine as Ning Yao had suggested. Instead, Chen Ping\'an had named
it Bamboo Sea Small World Wine, also known as Azure Divine Mountain
Wine, and wouldn\'t take no for an answer.

He even caused Die Zhang, who was accustomed to doing business with a
clear conscience, to gasp with absolute shock.

Seeing this, Chen Ping\'an had spoken in a meaningful and heartfelt
manner, saying that the bamboo leaves and bamboo branches were truly
from the Bamboo Sea Small World. As for whether they were from Azure
Divine Mountain, he could enquire about this when the opportunity arose
in the future. In the off chance that they weren\'t, they could simply
drop the alternate name of Azure Divine Mountain Wine.

Apart from preparing to open a wine shop to earn some money, Chen
Ping\'an would also make sure to refine Qi for twelve hours at the Ning
Residence every single day. He would occasionally refine Qi for upwards
of fourteen to eighteen hours.

Ning Yao vacated the pavilion at Dragon Slaying Cliff, spending more of
her time practicing sword techniques at the training ground in the
Minute Small World instead.

When Chen Ping\'an rested, he would hold Sword Immortal and squat at the
foot of the small mountain, earnestly tempering the blade of the sword.

Fatty Yan and Dong Huafu would occasionally come over to visit, and
whenever the former got the chance, he would insist that Chen Ping\'an
spectate his Deranged Demon Fist Technique. Fatty Yan would muse whether
practicing the sword had inhibited his extraordinary martial arts
talent, and Chen Ping\'an would naturally nod and reply in the
affirmative. Not only that, but Chen Ping\'an\'s reasons for his
agreement would always be new and fresh, something that Chen Sanqiu
found even more unbearable than Fatty Yan\'s fist technique.

One time, Dong Huafu truly couldn\'t stand it anymore, and as he watched
Fatty Yan\'s repulsive performance on the training ground, he had asked
Chen Ping\'an whether the latter was speaking sincerely when he provided
affirmation to Fatty Yan. Perhaps Fatty Yan was truly a martial arts
prodigy? Chen Ping\'an had smiled and replied that Fatty Yan was, of
course, not a martial arts prodigy. Only after hearing this had Dong
Huafu felt slightly more at ease. Listening to their conversation, Chen
Sanqiu had heaved a long sigh and slapped his forehead, lying down on
the long bench.

Meanwhile, a young girl whose sleeves were filled with desserts would
arrive at the entrance of the Ning Residence almost every single day,
shouting that she wanted to become a disciple and learn martial arts.

One time, she was dragged into the residence by Ning Yao and given a
stern beating, and only then did she give it a rest for a single day.
Unexpectedly, however, the young girl visited the following day again,
though she had learned her lesson and immediately ran away after
shouting that she wanted to become Chen Ping\'an\'s disciple and learn
martial arts. She could sprint back and forth several times a day, and
this wasn\'t an issue for her since she had nothing better to do anyway.

Ning Yao eventually lay in waiting and blocked her path, twisting her
ear and dragging her into the Ning Residence. She let the young girl
enjoy Fatty Yan\'s fist technique performance on the training ground,
saying that this was the martial arts taught by Chen Ping\'an. This
being the case, did she still want to become Chen Ping\'an\'s disciple
and learn martial arts from him?

Tears brimmed in the young girl\'s eyes, with her lips trembling as she
replied that she still wanted to learn fist techniques even if this was
the situation.

She quietly wiped away her tears, choking back sobs as she commented in
realization that this was the principle her mother had talked about.
Only those who could endure the most difficult hardships would rise to
become the most extraordinary people.

Ning Yao was out of ideas, so she dragged Chen Ping\'an over to
personally deal with this situation. Chen Ping\'an was discussing a
matter of great significance with Grandma Bai and Grandpa Nalan, but
Ning Yao didn\'t explain the situation at all as she led the confused
Chen Ping\'an to the training ground. When he arrived, he was greeted by
the sight of the young girl kneeling down to become his disciple.

She wasn\'t an unfamiliar face, seeing that she had been the loudest and
made the most fuss during his four battles on the street before. It had
been impossible for Chen Ping\'an not to notice her.

It wouldn\'t be appropriate for Chen Ping\'an to casually help the young
girl up, so he hurriedly stepped to the side and avoided her bow before
asking in helplessness, \"Don\'t kowtow just yet. What\'s your name?\"

The young girl hurriedly stood up and replied in a loud voice, \"Guo
Zhujiu!\"\[1\]

Chen Ping\'an nodded in response before raising his left hand and
performing some calculations. He then heaved a long sigh and remarked,
\"How unfortunate. Your name isn\'t suitable, so I\'m temporarily unable
to take you as a disciple. We can discuss this again in the future.\"

There was a look of sincerity on Guo Zhujiu\'s face as she replied,
\"Master, how about I go home and ask my parents to change my name? I
also don\'t like this name very much, and I\'ve already tolerated it for
many years.\"

Chen Ping\'an shook his head and said, \"That won\'t do. I look at fate
when I take disciples, and the first aspect is to look at someone\'s
name. If a person\'s name isn\'t suitable, then I\'ll need to wait for
three years before looking at whether the timing is suitable. You\'ll
still have an opportunity at that time.\"

Guo Zhujiu felt extremely annoyed and disappointed, stomping her foot
hard before running away. As she ran, she hollered that she was going to
flip through the lunar almanac to pick an auspicious date three years in
the future.

Yan Zhuo and Chen Sanqiu were transfixed with shock as they stood there,
with their eyes almost popping out of their sockets.

Guo Zhujiu was a strange child, and she had acted weirdly ever since she
was little. She definitely couldn\'t be dismissed as stupid, and she was
actually an extremely talented innate sword talent, one who was regarded
as a future pillar of the Guo Clan. However, she most definitely
couldn\'t be praised as smart, seeing that the young girl had made a
joke of herself too many times to even keep count. She was very
literally the source of good laughs for those on the same street as Chen
Sanqiu and the others.

When she was little, Guo Zhujiu liked to run around with a bed sheet
draped over herself, and she would never enter through the main door
when she barged into people\'s houses. She liked to wander across the
roof ridges and wall perimeters, and if it weren\'t for Dong Bude
beating her enough times and forcing her to change, Guo Zhujiu would
have most likely still been acting the same way now. There was also a
rumor that the Lord Hidden Official had actually chosen two potential
candidates, Pang Yuanji and Guo Zhujiu.

Chen Ping\'an was clearly in disbelief as he murmured, \"Is she for
real?\"

Chen Sanqiu smiled wryly and replied, \"That depends on whether or not
Guo Zhujiu shows up again tomorrow.\"

Chen Ping\'an looked at Ning Yao.

\"It\'s difficult to say,\" Ning Yao said.

Chen Ping\'an didn\'t think much about this matter, and he continued to
discuss the important matters with his elders.

Chen Ping\'an naturally wouldn\'t rush the old great sword immortal
regarding the latter acting as a matchmaker and visiting the Yao Clan to
propose a marriage.

Inside the wing room where Chen Ping\'an was staying, Grandma Bai smiled
and asked, \"What was the matter?\"

Chen Ping\'an smiled and replied, \"It was that young girl, Guo Zhujiu,
again. She wants to become my disciple and learn martial arts, but I
made up some excuses and turned her down.\"

\"Taking an unofficial disciple with no effort would have actually been
quite good,\" Nalan Yexing said in amusement.

Chen Ping\'an smiled bitterly and shook his head, saying, \"I can\'t be
too casual about such a major matter.\"

\"The Guo Clan has always been friends with the Ning Residence, and
there has never been a break in our relationship,\" Grandma Bai said.

Chen Ping\'an faltered for a moment before turning to Grandma Bai with
an inquiring look in his eyes.

Grandma Bai nodded and replied, \"They\'re the only ones. Following the
clan leader\'s passing, the entire Guo Clan visited the Ning Residence
to pay their respects. Afterward, the clan leader of the Guo Clan
bluntly disagreed with the Qi Clan\'s sword immortal regarding the
matter pertaining to Dragon Slaying Cliff. Otherwise, if it were a young
girl from any other clan causing a ruckus like this, Young Mistress
wouldn\'t have dragged her into the Ning Residence two times. In saying
this, you don\'t need to treat the young girl\'s request to become your
disciple and learn martial arts too seriously.\"

\"I\'ll give some serious thought to this matter related to Guo
Zhujiu,\" Chen Ping\'an said in a solemn voice.

Nalan Yexing smiled and said, \"There\'s no hurry. Why don\'t we talk
about Young Master Chen\'s fourth bonded item? Young Master Chen will
truly understand the concept of cultivation once his bridge of
immortality is erected. Before that, you can just barely become a sword
cultivator even though you don\'t possess the aptitude of an innate
sword talent. You shouldn\'t underestimate this notion of \'just
barely,\' as there exists a huge gulf between Qi refiners who are sword
cultivators and Qi refiners who aren\'t. Young Master Chen can feel free
to discuss this matter privately with the old great sword immortal.\"

1\. Zhujiu (竹酒) literally means bamboo wine. ☜

[]{#chapter-43.xhtml}

# Chapter 581: (3): Another School in a Small Alley

Sword of Coming

One morning, a shabby-looking wine shop opened its doors for the first
time in the Sword Qi Great Wall, and the shopkeeper at this wine shop
was none other than Die Zhang, the young sword cultivator with a single
arm.

Standing beside her was a young man in azure, and after he personally
set off a huge string of explosively loud firecrackers, he cupped his
fists at everyone in the surroundings with a dazzling smile.

If it weren\'t for the fact that Die Zhang was already the owner of this
wine shop --- she had already invested everything, and there was no
backing out anymore --- she would have actually liked to sit inside the
wine shop and pretend that this business had absolutely nothing to do
with her.

There were many tables placed in front of them.

Ning Yao, Yan Zhuo, and the others were hiding inside the wine shop that
was filled with wine vats and wine pots of varying sizes. As shameless
as Fatty Yan was, and even for someone who didn\'t understand shame like
Dong Huafu, they still didn\'t have the face to walk outside and show
themselves at this moment.

The repairs on the street had just finished, and the shopkeepers and
shop attendants of the other restaurants and wine shops were all
standing at the entrances of their businesses and cursing in
displeasure.

This was because hanging beside the entrance of the shabby little wine
shop was a couplet supposedly written by that young martial artist.

*\"Three feet sword in hand, the sword immortal looks around, lost; for
where are the opponents, to quell this hero\'s loneliness?*\"

*\"A small cup of wine, together we dispel eternal sorrow; till we
become drunk, for what does money matter?*\"

*Very well\... How impressive of you, Pure Martial Artist Chen Ping\'an!
Can you please have some shame, outsider?!*

Not only that, but the wine being sold by this shabby little shop was
apparently related to the Bamboo Sea Small World\'s Azure Divine
Mountain or whatnot!

What does money matter?

If money didn\'t matter, then why the hell was he opening a shop to make
money?

There was the sound of whistling and cheering along the street.

Die Zhang was an easily embarrassed person, so her expression had
already become tense as beads of sweat formed on her forehead. She tried
her best to remain composed, and she couldn\'t help but ask, \"Chen
Ping\'an, can we truly sell half a vat of wine?\"

Chen Ping\'an smiled faintly and responded, \"Even if no one comes to
support us, following the plan I laid out beforehand will ensure that
everything goes smoothly and money continues to flow in. Of course, it
will naturally be better if someone visits to purchase wine. In any
case, it\'s very normal for business to be slow during the early
morning.\"

Fifteen minutes later, Die Zhang started to feel increasingly anxious as
not a single customer visited the wine shop.

\"Fifty percent off the first pot of wine sold! First come, first serve,
and this offer is only available for a single pot of wine!\" Chen
Ping\'an shouted at the top of his lungs.

And thus, a customer truly visited the wine shop.

\"Is he also someone you invited over?\" Die Zhang asked in puzzlement.

Chen Ping\'an was also slightly surprised, and he shook his head and
replied, \"Of course not.\"

The first customer was Pang Yuanji.

He sat down on a bench before smiling widely and saying, \"Give me a pot
of the cheapest wine. Don\'t forget to give me the fifty percent
discount.\"

Chen Ping\'an turned around and glanced at the dazed Die Zhang,
chuckling softly and saying, \"What are you standing there in a daze
for? The shopkeeper should personally serve this pot of wine.\"

Die Zhang hurriedly grabbed a pot of Bamboo Sea Small World Wine and a
large white bowl, placing them on the table in front of Pang Yuanji.
Guilt weighed on her conscience as she cracked open the recently
packaged wine and poured out a bowl, so she forced a smile and said in
an extremely quiet voice, \"Please enjoy the wine.\"

Chen Ping\'an grabbed an extra bowl and sat down at Pang Yuanji\'s
table, pouring himself a bowl of wine without asking before smiling and
saying, \"Thank you for the support, Brother Yuanji. I have to thank you
with a toast. Looking at your generosity, Brother Yuanji, there\'s no
doubt that you\'ll become a sword immortal in the future. I\'ll drink
first to show my respect!\"

Die Zhang felt a strong urge to dig a hole and disappear into the ground
as she watched on. After all, what kind of shopkeeper would drink their
customer\'s wine?

After Chen Ping\'an finished the bowl of wine, Pang Yuanji surprisingly
poured him another bowl. However, this wasn\'t a full bowl, seeing that
the pot of wine wasn\'t very big to begin with. How many bowls of wine
did it contain? Thankfully, the white bowls meticulously chosen by this
wine shop weren\'t very big, and it was because of this that a pot of
wine appeared to be big enough.

Pang Yuanji was starting to feel slight regret about coming here to
support the wine shop. So be it if business was poor in the future, but
what if business started to boom? Would he not scold himself to death at
that time? He lowered his head and smelled the wine, discovering that it
genuinely smelled a little like immortal wine. It was better than he had
imagined. However, a pot only cost a single snowflake coin, so wasn\'t
this pricing a bit too low? Wine of this caliber would be sold for at
least a few snowflake coins in the other restaurants and wine shops in
the Sword Qi Great Wall. However, there was one thing that Pang Yuanji
knew for sure. To say nothing of the Sword Qi Great Wall, no one in the
entire world would sell wine for a loss.

Chen Ping\'an and Pang Yuanji touched bowls before downing the wine.

Afterward, Chen Ping\'an went inside to grab another pot of wine,
placing it on the table and saying with a smile, \"It\'s half price, so
I\'ll only charge Brother Yuanji one snowflake coin for two pots of
wine.\"

The wine tasted decent, so Pang Yuanji decided to tolerate Chen
Ping\'an\'s behavior.

After finishing one pot of wine, Pang Yuanji grabbed the other pot that
Chen Ping\'an was just about to \"help\" him open, slapping one
snowflake coin on the table and standing up to leave, saying that he
would visit again in the future.

Die Zhang wiped away the sweat on her forehead and accepted the
snowflake coin from Chen Ping\'an, a beaming smile on her face.

Approximately one hour later, just when Die Zhang was starting to worry
about the business of the wine shop again, another customer arrived on
the wind and gracefully landed in front of the shop. Die Zhang couldn\'t
help but turn around and look at Chen Ping\'an.

After Chen Ping\'an clarified that this was still an unexpected
surprise, Die Zhang was surprised to see that he appeared a
little\...nervous?

The customer was the Wind Snow Temple\'s Sword Immortal Wei Jin, someone
who also hailed from the Eastern Treasured Vial Continent like Chen
Ping\'an.

Wei Jin asked for a pot of the most expensive wine, which came in at a
cost of five snowflake coins. There was a bamboo leaf inside this wine
pot.

Wei Jin was in no hurry to start drinking, and he asked with a chuckle,
\"Is she still well?\"

Chen Ping\'an felt like he was sitting on a bed of needles at this
moment, yet he couldn\'t play stupid and act dumb in front of someone
like Wei Jin. Thus, he could only smile wryly and reply, \"She\'s most
likely doing very well, seeing that she\'s already become a sect leader.
However, I was almost killed by her at Malicious Ghost Alley.\"

Was Wei Jin here to cause trouble?

Chen Ping\'an hadn\'t hidden anything from Ning Yao about He Xiaoliang,
who had initially been a Daoist nun at the Divine Edict Sect and was now
a sect leader at the Refreshing Sect. He had explained everything to her
in detail.

Fortunately, Ning Yao hadn\'t displayed any anger about this, instead
saying that He Xiaoliang had taken things slightly too far. She wanted
to meet this sect leader in the future.

Wei Jin insisted on opening Chen Ping\'an\'s old wounds today, causing
Chen Ping\'an to feel a cold chill down his spine. He felt like the
entire wine shop was flooded with eerie sword qi.

After finishing a bowl of wine, Wei Jin asked, \"Does she truly like
you?\"

\"I\'m not sure,\" Chen Ping\'an replied with a shake of his head.

Wei Jin nodded and poured himself another bowl of wine, downing it in a
single gulp before chuckling, \"There\'s no need to accompany me,
Shopkeeper. You can deal with your other matters.\"

In the end, Wei Jin sat by himself and continued to drink wine, slowly
but not stopping.

Men who were strongly attracted to a particular woman often liked to
drink so-called heartbreak wine. However, the person holding the blade
and breaking their hearts would always be the person whom they loved but
was never beside them.

Chen Ping\'an squatted down beside the shop entrance with his back
facing the shop, unable to smile even though he was making money.
Instead, he was feeling as worried as could be.

This was because Wei Jin had slapped a lesser heat coin onto the table
after drinking the third bowl of wine, saying that they could deduct
payment from this immortal coin when he came here to drink wine in the
future.

Fatty Yan and Chen Sanqiu tactfully kept their mouths shut.

However, the slightly dim Dong Huafu stupidly commented, \"I feel like
there\'s a story to be told here.\"

Chen Ping\'an finally understood why Fatty Yan and Chen Sanqiu were
sometimes very afraid of Dong Huafu opening his mouth to speak. His
words were like flying swords, truly sharp enough to stab someone to
death.

Wei Jin was yet to stand up and piss off, but Chen Ping\'an felt hugely
relieved as he hurriedly stood up.

As it turned out, Guo Zhujiu had dragged a bunch of other children over,
noisily making their way over to support the newly opened wine shop.

Guo Zhujiu didn\'t beat around the bush, directly revealing her
intentions to Chen Ping\'an as she respectfully referred to him as
\"future master in three years.\" She continued, \"My friends and I just
learned about this new wine shop opening here, so we\'ve come here to
buy some wine as presents for our parents and elders! Future master in
three years, I truly didn\'t force them to come here!\"

Guo Zhujiu then signaled to the other children with her eyes.

The young girls, whom Guo Zhujiu had especially visited late last night
to give a reminder to, appeared listless as they obediently handed over
the money and accepted the wine. They then waited for Guo Zhujiu\'s
instructions.

They truly didn\'t care about the three snowflake coins they were
earning from Guo Zhujiu.

Guo Zhujiu had already pestered them for many days.

Some of them had wanted to directly hand Guo Zhujiu six snowflake coins
instead, but Guo Zhujiu had turned down this offer, insisting that they
needed to gather enough people.

In the end, Guo Zhujiu also retrieved three snowflake coins to purchase
a pot of wine, not forgetting to explain once again, \"Future master in
three years, they\'re all voluntarily here to purchase wine!\"

\"I performed some calculations, and the three years can be halved to
one and a half years. I can reconsider your request again at that
time,\" Chen Ping\'an replied in earnest.

Guo Zhujiu held the pot of wine in one hand and fist-pumped with the
other, exclaiming in delight, \"Sure enough, today is an auspicious day
to buy wine! I didn\'t memorize that old lunar almanac for nothing!\"

With Pang Yuanji and Wei Jin\'s patronage, as well as the support from
this group of young girls, the wine shop slowly saw some business.

By the looks of it, it wouldn\'t be difficult to break even.

This was already enough to have Die Zhang feel overjoyed.

She slowly became busier and busier.

When it came to selling wine, they had agreed beforehand that Die Zhang
would need to do the bulk of the work. Chen Ping\'an couldn\'t keep an
eye on the wine shop every single day.

The extremely dumbfounded Dong Huafu had already been carried away by
Chen Sanqiu and Fatty Yan.

Ning Yao leaned against the counter in the wine shop, snacking on
roasted seeds as she looked at Chen Ping\'an.

\"You\'re not angry, are you?\" Chen Ping\'an asked in an uncertain
voice.

\"How could I possibly be angry?\" Ning Yao replied.

There was a look of grief on Chen Ping\'an\'s face as he asked, \"How
could you possibly be angry, or how could you possibly not be angry?\"

\"Guess,\" Ning Yao responded with a wink.

Chen Ping\'an sighed in grief and lamented, \"I\'m going to open a pot
of wine for myself. Keep it on my tab.\"

\"Is He Xiaoliang worth my anger?\" Ning Yao suddenly said with a smile.

Standing in front of her, Chen Ping\'an asked in a quiet voice, \"Do you
know why I didn\'t feel frustrated after losing three battles in a row
to Cao Ci?\"

\"Why?\" Ning Yao asked.

Chen Ping\'an smiled and revealed, \"Because you couldn\'t be bothered
remembering who Cao Ci was.\"

Chen Ping\'an also leaned against the counter, gazing at the customers
sitting outside as he continued, \"After seeing you, that impoverished
child who grew up at Clay Vase Alley has never been short on money
again.\"

Ning Yao stopped snacking on roasted seeds as she looked at Chen
Ping\'an\'s smile, which could no longer be hidden, and she asked, \"Are
you laughing at me for being scatterbrained?\"

Chen Ping\'an immediately wiped the smile from his face. In the next
moment, he came to the realization that he was no smarter than the
little girl, Guo Zhujiu. He was also making his intentions as evident as
could be.

However, Ning Yao extended her hand and offered Chen Ping\'an some
roasted seeds. She continued to snack on roasted seeds as she said, \"I
won\'t get angry about other women liking you.\"

After pausing for a moment, she continued, \"However, I\'ll feel very
sad if you like a woman other than me in the future. If such a day truly
comes, then you don\'t need to apologize to me, much less visit me to
personally tell me the situation. I don\'t want to hear it.\"

Chen Ping\'an reached over and placed a hand on Ning Yao\'s head, gently
swaying it and saying, \"Stop imagining things. It might be very
difficult for me to become a lofty cultivator in my lifetime, especially
since there are always taller mountains and more talented individuals. I
can only try harder and put in more effort, striving to fulfill my
promise one bit at a time. However, Chen Ping\'an will forever be the
person who loves Ning Yao the most. There\'s no need to work on this
anymore.\"

------------

Business was steadily improving at the new wine shop.

However, Chen Ping\'an started to shirk his responsibilities as an
owner.

Whenever he was at the wine shop, he would surprisingly spend more of
his time chatting with that group of children, sitting on a small stool
outside, and even borrowing children\'s books from them.

He would occasionally teach them how to read.

Afterward, the young man in azure didn\'t try to make money in his spare
time, nor did he take advantage of the nearby Dragon Slaying Platform in
the Ning Residence to hurriedly temper his spiritual energy. Instead, he
insisted on making rubbings of the stone tablets in the streets and
alleys, collecting a large stack. Following this, he would often bask in
the sun and become a storyteller, recounting some fantastical stories
about mountain spirits and water ghosts of the Majestic World to the
group of children.

After that, the young man would retrieve a bamboo branch and write on
the ground whenever a child asked about a character they didn\'t know.
He would roughly explain the character but not expand any further, only
smiling and nodding even if the children peppered him with additional
questions. After teaching them characters, the young man would talk
about the mystical and wondrous matters of his home world.

One day, the young man in azure who wore a jade hairpin taught the
children some characters under the warm sun, after which he told some
stories. He then placed the bamboo branch across his knees and recited
in a quiet voice, \"Lustrous is the sheepskin coat, dazzling golden in
the sun.\"\[1\]

Seeing the young man stop, a child asked in curiosity, \"And then? Is
there more?\"

The young man placed his hands on his knees, gazing forward as he
continued slowly, \"Insects awaken during spring, vitality fills heaven
and earth, all matter flourishes. Sleeping late and waking early,
striding leisurely through courtyards, easing one\'s mind\...\"\[2\]

None of the children surrounding the young man understood what he was
saying, but they were willing to quietly listen to him recite these
texts in a soft voice.

In a relatively remote alley of the Sword Qi Great Wall, it was as if a
small private school had sprung into existence, one without a genuine
teacher and without genuine students.

1\. This is a line from the poem *Sheepskin Coat*, written by an
anonymous person in the pre-Qin period. ☜

2\. This is a line from the *Esoteric Scripture of the Yellow Emperor*
(黄帝内经), an ancient Chinese medical text and a fundamental doctrinal
source for Chinese medicine. ☜
