potential act of disrespect, where he simply nodded and chose to remain
silent. If he couldn\'t even tolerate the pride and haughtiness of Zuo
You, then just how many sword immortals on the city wall and in the city
to the north could survive the fury of his sword?

Meanwhile, Zuo You wasn\'t surprised by Chen Qingdu\'s knowledge of this
matter.

Chen Qingdu was essentially peerless on this city wall, and he was
perhaps only slightly weaker than the Paramount Sage in the scholarly
temple, the Dao Ancestor at the White Jade Capital, and Buddha on his
lotus platform.

This was what caused Zuo You to feel the most exasperated.

At the same time, however, this was also what Zuo You admired most about
the old man.

The Savage World had assaulted the Sword Qi Great Wall for ten thousand
years, so how was the city wall still standing strong?

All of the great demons in the Savage World were keenly aware that as
long as Chen Qingdu was still alive, then they wouldn\'t be able to
reach Stalactite Mountain or the Majestic World even if the entire Sword
Qi Great Wall were destroyed.

Only Chen Qingdu was able to suppress the unruly sword cultivators to
the north of the Sword Qi Great Wall for ten thousand years.

Only this old man could say to the Hidden Official, \"I\'m only
tolerating you because of your young age.\"

\"When all of the big and small troubles in the city are resolved, tell
Chen Ping\'an to come here and settle down near the thatched cottage,\"
Chen Qingdu said. \"One needs to be focused when practicing the sword,
and whenever he becomes a legitimate sword cultivator is when I\'ll
leave the city wall to help him ask for marriage. Otherwise, I don\'t
have the face to make such a request. This is asking an old great sword
immortal to make an exception, so all of the wine in a wine shop and a
small private school won\'t suffice as payment.\"

\"This is up to him. If you won\'t go to the Yao Clan at that time, then
I\'ll go,\" Zuo You said.

Chen Qingdu smiled and said, \"That\'s not very good. Neither your
master nor your junior brother would say something like this if they
were present.\"

Zuo You frowned and asked, \"You\'re also keeping an eye on those
children near the wine shop? There are so many things that Chen Qingdu
doesn\'t care about, but you actually care about this?\"

\"Otherwise?\" Chen Qingdu asked in response. \"My sword skills are
superior to yours, my sword intent is loftier than yours, and my
knowledge is also greater than yours. Even you\'re able to care about
them, so why can\'t I take a few extra glances?\"

\"I\'ve already put up with you two times,\" Zuo You said without
expression.

\"Your greatest strength, your sword qi, is still inferior to others, so
just obediently put up with things,\" Chen Qingdu said with a faint
smile.

\"That\'s the third time,\" Zuo You said with a cold chuckle.

\"Do you know why I\'m willing to look at those children learning
characters?\" Chen Qingdu asked.

Zuo You appeared indifferent as he replied, \"This pertains to one of
the biggest problems of the Sword Qi Great Wall. The sword cultivators
here have wielded their swords and slain enemies for ten thousand years,
and an increasing number of people no longer understand the purpose of
their lives and the reason for their deaths.\"

Chen Qingdu nodded and looked toward the lights illuminating the city to
the north. The lights at the wealthy clans were dazzling and as bright
as day, while the lights at the impoverished alleys were extremely dim
and sparse, with large swathes of the alleys being covered in darkness.

\"It\'s still relatively easy to explain the purpose and reason for life
and death, especially given the selfish nature of people. It\'s very
difficult to have people truly think any deeper.\"

Chen Qingdu\'s expression was forlorn as he continued, \"I always hoped
that someone over there would act themself, think themself, and feel for
themself. I hoped that they would understand the cause and the effects,
all of the history, as well as the sacrifices made by those past and
present. I hoped that despite this knowledge, they could still galvanize
the sword cultivators and have them wield their swords and charge south,
willing to lay down their lives even if they felt resentment, grief, and
fury.\"

The old man slowly raised a hand and said, \"There was first a single
speck of light in the human world. From one came two, from two came
three, and from three came the dazzling expanse of stars.\"

\"It\'s too late. It\'s already a lost cause,\" Zuo You said with a
shake of his head.

Chen Qingdu smiled and said, \"Zuo You, you can\'t compare to your
junior brother in this regard. He\'s able to remain calm despite knowing
that he can\'t do much and will find it very difficult to change the
established fate.\"

Zuo You fell silent.

\"That was the fourth time?\" Chen Qingdu asked with a smile.

\"No,\" Zuo You replied.

\"Then I won\'t hit you anymore,\" Chen Qingdu said with a nod. \"I\'ll
let you keep some face, lest you feel uncomfortable when teaching your
junior brother sword techniques in the future.\"

\"Now it\'s four times,\" Zuo You said.

Chen Qingdu clasped his hands behind his back and walked away, saying,
\"Compared to chatting with you, I still prefer listening to Chen
Ping\'an speak.\"

------------

Chen Ping\'an took a stroll to the Dragon Slaying Platform at night, but
he saw that Ning Yao was still cultivating. He then made his way to the
training ground, deciding to walk around its perimeter. Just as he was
about to finish the first lap, he changed direction slightly and walked
in a bigger circle.

Ning Yao arrived beside him at some unknown time, and Chen Ping\'an
wasn\'t surprised at all. She had already learned Nalan Yexing\'s
stealth abilities a long time ago.

Ning Yao hadn\'t been refining her extremely high-grade innate bonded
flying sword these past years, and she had instead been refining
something else. Nonetheless, she was capable of easily killing Pang
Yuanji, Qi Shou, and the others even if she only summoned her bonded
flying sword.

This was what she had casually told Chen Ping\'an when chatting with him
before, her tone calm and natural. However, she had been looking at him
intently.

Chen Ping\'an had just been about to reach over and place his hand on
top of hers at the time, but he had silently retracted it before
chuckling and using his hand as a fan.

The two of them walked into the pavilion, and Chen Ping\'an sat
cross-legged beside Ning Yao.

She continued on the topic from earlier in the morning, saying, \"In the
very beginning, around ten prodigies were identified in Wang Zongping\'s
generation. Compared to us, however, they were far inferior in both
number and cultivation aptitude. Among them, Mi Quan\'s Great Dao should
have been the most impressive, but it was a pity that he died in the
first battle beyond the city wall that he participated in.

\"Only three people remain from that generation, with one of them being
Wang Zongping. However, he was caught up in an intense battle between
two Immortal Tier cultivators, one friend and one foe, and this left him
severely wounded and trapped at the barrier of the Nascent Tier, unable
to make any progress for many years.

\"Apart from him, there\'s also Wang Wei and Su Yong. Su Yong\'s innate
aptitude was actually better than that of Wang Zongping\'s, who lagged
at the bottom of the group, but his sword heart wasn\'t resolute and
pure enough. He participated in a large-scale battle, yet he purposely
held back and only engaged in small skirmishes, not daring to abandon
his sense of self and fight with his life on the line. He always thought
that cultivating in peace and quiet and living to one hundred years old
would allow him to slowly but steadily advance to the Upper Five Tiers.
At that time, he could then unleash his full strength in battle.

\"However, breaking through the barrier of the Nascent Tier is one of
the most dangerous battles at the Sword Qi Great Wall, and not only did
Su Yong fail to advance to the Unpolished Jade Tier, but he was even
rejected by the sword intent of heaven and earth, causing his
cultivation base to fall instead. In the end, he was reduced to a Golden
Core Tier sword cultivator with a mangled and leaky core abode.

\"Su Yong kept a low profile for many years, wandering around the mortal
streets and alleys and eventually became an alcoholic and a gambling
addict, racking up countless debts and living a life even worse than
that of rodents on the streets. When they were still young, Qi Shou and
the others loved to invite Su Yong over for a drink, with the latter not
caring about becoming the butt of jokes and ridicule as long as he could
drink. He lived a very undignified life.

\"As Qi Shou and the others gradually advanced and became stronger, they
slowly grew bored of picking on Su Yong. Thus, Su Yong started to run
errands between the city and Mirage Market, drinking wine if he earned a
small sum of money and indulging in gambling if he earned a large sum of
money.\"

Ning Yao had done some last-minute cramming and learned this information
from Grandma Bai.

\"Will Su Yong harbor resentment toward the entire Sword Qi Great
Wall?\" Chen Ping\'an asked bluntly.

Ning Yao thought for a moment before shaking her head and replying,
\"Most probably not. A few years before A\'Liang left the Sword Qi Great
Wall, Su Yong would often accompany him regardless of whether he was
drinking wine or acting as the dealer of a gambling game.\"

Chen Ping\'an nodded and said, \"Only Wang Wei has become a sword
immortal, and he had already become a low-level guest elder of the Qi
Clan when he was still a Golden Core Tier sword cultivator. He
successfully advanced to the Upper Five Tiers twenty years ago,
following which he established his own residence and became Dao partners
with a woman from a large clan. It can be said that he\'s living a happy
and fulfilled life. Listening to the casual chatter at the wine shop, it
seems like many people are surprised about Wang Wei overtaking the
others and becoming a sword immortal.\"

\"Wang Wei was indeed very unassuming and unremarkable, and it\'s
naturally very rare for people in the Majestic World to advance to the
Upper Five Tiers at ninety-odd years old,\" Ning Yao said in agreement.

\"However, as an Unpolished Jade Tier sword cultivator who was able to
survive those large-scale battles, it was only natural that Wang Wei
eventually became the leader of that generation. Because of this, it\'s
no surprise that Wang Wei is often compared to those from the previous
generation, making him appear very mediocre as a result. If he\'s
compared to our generation, then not only do Pang Yuanji, Qi Shou, and
Gao Yehou look down on Wang Wei, someone who likes to act obsequiously
despite being a sword immortal, but even Sanqiu, Fatty Yan, and the
others look down on him.\"

Ning Yao\'s voice was quiet as she continued, \"In saying this, being
able to survive as a sword cultivator at the Sword Qi Great Wall is
already the greatest achievement, regardless of one\'s cultivation base.
Once someone dies, what does it matter whether they were a prodigy or a
sword immortal? Young sword cultivators like us might be drinking and
making jokes about the abject Su Yong and the obsequious Wang Wei today,
but after the next large-scale battle, perhaps Wang Wei might drink with
his friends and chat about some young sword cultivators who are no
longer in the world.\"

After arriving at the pavilion atop Dragon Slaying Cliff, Ning Yao
suddenly stopped and said, \"Give me a pot of wine.\"

[]{#chapter-52.xhtml}

# Chapter 585: (3): Please Drink With Me

Sword of Coming

Chen Ping\'an removed his hands from his sleeve and handed Ning Yao a
pot of Bamboo Sea Small World Wine from his wine shop.

As she drank, Ning Yao said, \"Grandpa Little Dong is a true prodigy,
ascending the city wall as an Abode Tier cultivator and descending the
city wall as a Sea Observation Tier cultivator. When he was at the
Dragon Gate Tier, he was already able to kill more than a dozen demons
at the same cultivation base as well as three demons at the Golden Core
Tier, earning him the nickname of Sword Maniac.

\"Afterward, Grandpa Little Dong left the Sword Qi Great Wall by himself
and ventured through the Savage World to temper his sword intent, having
already advanced to the Upper Five Tiers when he eventually returned. He
killed countless demons in the subsequent battles, and he was regarded
as a young sword cultivator who had the greatest chance of becoming an
Ascension Tier sword immortal.\"

Dong Guanpu\'s collusion with the demon tribe had caused widespread
outrage at the Sword Qi Great Wall, and he was ultimately killed by Old
Great Sword Immortal Chen Qingdu before the Lord Hidden Official could
even act.

Back then, Chen Ping\'an had personally witnessed this scene while
standing on the city wall.

Ning Yao continued to drink wine as she said, \"Not long after Grandpa
Little Dong died, some people started to speculate that he was the one
who personally organized the assassination attempt on me at Mirage
Market all those years back.\"

Ning Yao smiled and continued, \"I don\'t believe this, but I can\'t
stop other people from running their mouths.\"

\"Disregarding the truth of the matter, do these speculations make you
feel sad?\" Chen Ping\'an asked.

\"There\'s nothing to be sad about,\" Ning Yao replied with a shake of
her head.

\"That\'s good to hear. Otherwise, for the next while, I wouldn\'t have
left the Ning Residence apart from going to the city wall to practice
sword techniques,\" Chen Ping\'an said with a nod.

\"Something else is going to happen apart from Little Lü Duan facing an
assassination attempt?\" Ning Yao asked in puzzlement.

\"Definitely,\" Chen Ping\'an replied with a smile. \"Someone wants to
test my mettle, and at the same time, they\'re also trying their best to
isolate the Ning Residence. At the end of the day, their true purpose is
to distract you as much as possible and hinder your ability to advance.
They didn\'t have an opportunity in the past, and no one dared to openly
target the Ning Residence after the incident at Mirage Market, the
matter relating to Dong Guanpu, and the old great sword immortal
personally unleashing a sword strike. However, my arrival has given them
a new avenue to target you.\"

\"Why don\'t you seem annoyed at all about these matters?\" Ning Yao
asked. \"I actually feel annoyed, but I choose to ignore these matters
because I understand that feeling annoyed won\'t help. In fact, I don\'t
even think about these matters at all.\"

Chen Ping\'an reached over to grab the wine pot, and Ning Yao was just
about to subconsciously hand it over. However, she quickly shot a glare
at him instead.

Having failed to achieve his goal, Chen Ping\'an placed his hands inside
his opposite sleeves and said, \"Just how capable is this outsider Chen
Ping\'an? This naturally comes down to two attributes: his cultivation
base and his heart. Regarding my fist techniques as a pure martial
artist, this has already been proven thanks to the help from Ren Yi, Pu
Yu, Qi Shou, and Pang Yuanji. As for my heart, there are some things I
deem very important and others I consider less important. If our
opponents are shrewd and calculating, they\'ll test every aspect of my
heart.

\"For example, the Ning Residence and the Guo Clan will comprehensively
grow distant if Guo Zhujiu is successfully assassinated, and this will
be the case regardless of how reasonable and righteous Sword Immortal
Guo Jia is. The members of the Guo Clan have already had thorns in their
hearts for a very long time. Of course, things have naturally taken a
different turn given that the assassination attempt on Guo Zhujiu was
foiled.

\"Regarding how to examine my stance on what I think is less important,
the process is actually very simple. If a child from one of those
impoverished alleys is killed, then business at Die Zhang\'s wine shop
will quickly dry up, and I\'ll no longer play the role of a teacher
either. Even if I go, there\'s no doubt that no one will turn up to
listen to those fantastical stories anymore. They need to pay a
significant price to kill Guo Zhujiu, but to kill an ordinary child from
an impoverished alley? Who would care? But if I don\'t care, how will
the many sword cultivators at the Sword Qi Great Wall view me? And if I
care, what level of care counts as caring?\"

Ning Yao\'s brows were knitted in worry as she listened on.

See? Grandma Bai was clearly incorrect. Chen Ping\'an was evidently able
to figure everything out.

\"What are you worried about?\" Chen Ping\'an asked with a smile.
\"I\'ve already thought of this possibility, so their chance of
succeeding won\'t be very big. However, there are some matters where we
can only wait for others to act first, even if we\'ve already thought of
the possibility.\"

\"For example?\" Ning Yao asked.

\"For example, announcing to the world that I\'m the Scholarly Sage\'s
disciple and Zuo You\'s junior brother. This won\'t be too bad, and it
will only be like a tickle. After all, sword cultivators at the Sword Qi
Great Wall care more about a person\'s cultivation base.\"

Chen Ping\'an paused for a moment before continuing, \"And for example,
some young sword cultivator without any background of note becoming
drunk and bringing up the past matters of the Ning Residence in front of
me. Their words most likely won\'t be too extreme, lest they appear
unreasonable and spark public outrage. At that time, some of the
customers at the wine shop might even step forward to help me.

\"Thus, they\'ll definitely plan their words very carefully, striking a
good balance where they can provoke me to the point of lashing out in
anger, yet not take things too far that they appear to be causing
trouble on purpose. Rather, they\'ll be speaking with genuine emotion
and righteousness. That being the case, I\'ll definitely stand to lose
regardless of whether my punch kills them or not. Youthful vigor is
fleeting, and a cunning mind isn\'t the mark of a sword cultivator.\"

Ning Yao thought for a moment before suggesting, \"Then we\'ll visit Die
Zhang\'s wine shop less in the future? People won\'t go out of their way
to block you if you only travel between the city wall and the Ning
Residence, right? That would be far too obvious. There are many sword
cultivators at the Sword Qi Great Wall, but there aren\'t many fools.\"

Chen Ping\'an shook his head and replied, \"We still need to go.\"

Ning Yao couldn\'t wrap her head around this.

\"Bookkeepers like to perform calculations on their abacuses, but they
also have their own lives to live. They won\'t sit behind the counter
all day and all night to calculate profits and losses. Just who am I?
Just how many years have I lived with nothing to my name? Will I still
be afraid of these matters?\"

Chen Ping\'an stood up and gazed at the training ground as he continued
slowly, \"You\'ve listened to their nonsensical bullshit for so many
years, so I want to listen with my own ears. So be it if you weren\'t
willing to acknowledge them before, but now that I\'m by your side,
I\'ll directly launch a punch if anyone dares to run over with ill
intentions. Otherwise, should I treat them to some wine instead?\"

Upon saying this, Chen Ping\'an smiled and remarked, \"It will most
definitely just be a casual punch, as their cultivation base won\'t be
very high. They\'ll definitely be even weaker than Ren Yi. Otherwise, no
one will feel sympathy for them if their cultivation base is too high.\"

\"Then, when should we visit the wine shop?\" Ning Yao asked.

This was her temperament.

Chen Ping\'an wasn\'t surprised at all.

Disregarding his feelings for her, Ning Yao\'s temperament and manner of
doing things at the small town all those years ago had actually had a
huge effect on Chen Ping\'an.

Ning Yao\'s remark that the Great Dao shouldn\'t be so small was one
aspect, and this had caused Chen Ping\'an to never truly crane his head
to look up at those immortals in the mountains after he left the Jewel
Small World and came into contact with cultivation.

At the same time, Ning Yao\'s straightforward and decisive manner of
doing things also left a deep impression on Chen Ping\'an, especially
her attitude of accepting the reality of the situation and focusing on
how to respond.

It was thanks to this clarity in his mind that Chen Ping\'an could truly
become fearless in the face of the many unexpected troubles. He would
simply deal with whatever came his way.

Chen Ping\'an turned around and replied with a smile, \"We\'ll visit
after I recover from my wounds. In the meantime, we can give them some
time to plan and prepare. Truth be told, I often feel anxious for my
enemies, and I almost feel the urge to teach them what to do to maximize
their benefits and repulse others to the greatest degree.\"

Ning Yao remained silent.

Chen Ping\'an sat down beside her and said in a soft voice, \"Don\'t
feel like I\'m unfamiliar. I\'ve always been like this, but as I told
you before, there\'s only one matter that I never overthink. I\'m not
saying this to please you, and it\'s simply the sincere truth.\"

\"Things wouldn\'t have been so troublesome for you if you didn\'t like
me and if you didn\'t come here, and you would have been able to enjoy a
better life. In fact, you could have even waited until you became a
sword immortal in the future to come here to look for me. I would have
still waited for you all the same,\" Ning Yao replied in a soft voice.

Grandma Bai was right. She had to be herself, and she also had to trust
Chen Ping\'an. She needed to voice the feelings accumulated in her heart
to him, not caring about whether they were reasonable or not. In any
case, he was a most reasonable person, so she didn\'t need to worry
about the two of them running out of things to talk about.

Chen Ping\'an didn\'t respond to this, and he instead retrieved the
small Dragon Slaying Platform that Ning Yao had given him when they had
parted ways at Stalactite Mountain back then, the one inscribed with the
characters \"Ning Yao\" and \"Innocent\" on the two sides.

Chen Ping\'an looked down at the characters \"Ning Yao,\" gently tapping
them with his fingers as he opened his eyes wide and scolded, \"Who are
you? How are you so daring and capable? You\'re making me feel so sad
and heartbroken. If you continue to act so insensibly, then I\'ll
pretend to ignore you in the future\...\"

Ning Yao turned to her side and rested her arms and head on the railing,
with her eyelashes quivering slightly as she smiled widely.

The radiant moonlight accentuated her slender eyebrows.

------------

On this day, the second shopkeeper, who had already been absent for a
long time, finally appeared at the wine shop to drink. He didn\'t fight
for a seat with the other customers, and he instead squatted to the side
and accompanied some familiar sword cultivators. He held a wine bowl in
one hand, and a pair of chopsticks in his other, and on the ground in
front of him was a small plate of pickled vegetables from the Yan
Clan\'s shop. There was nothing embarrassing about this, as everyone was
doing the same thing.

According to the second shopkeeper, sword immortals served as pillars
between heaven and earth, so what did it matter that some dishes were
placed on the ground? This was a sign of the sword cultivators being
down-to-earth and approachable, and the sword immortals not getting hung
up on small details.

Would this be possible at the large restaurants with extremely expensive
wine? Perhaps the waiters wouldn\'t stop someone from placing dishes on
the ground, and maybe the nearby customers wouldn\'t say anything
either. However, they would definitely roll their eyes at the culprit,
no? But what about here? Could such an upsetting reaction take place at
this wine shop? Most definitely not.

The sword cultivators who came here to buy wine and drink wine,
especially those alcoholics with few immortal coins in their pockets,
all found this to be extremely reasonable.

Today, no sword immortal had graced the wine shop yet, and Chen Ping\'an
was smiling and sipping wine as he casually chatted with the familiar
sword cultivators around him.

An unfamiliar young man suddenly stood up, inebriated and holding a wine
bowl as he staggered over to Chen Ping\'an\'s location. He burped and
asked with clouded eyes, \"Are you Chen Ping\'an, the Ning Residence\'s
son-in-law?\"

Chen Ping\'an smiled and nodded in response.

The young man was just about to say something, but Chen Ping\'an raised
his hand and lightly tapped his chopsticks together. Seeing this, Die
Zhang ran inside the shop with a stern expression and retrieved a piece
of paper.

The young man paid no heed to this, and he continued, \"Are you worthy
of Ning Yao? I don\'t think so. You\'re unworthy of Ning Yao even if you
managed to defeat Pang Yuanji and the others. Fortunately for you,
however, you are indeed worthy of the Ning Residence. Do you know why?\"

Chen Ping\'an ate some picked vegetables before raising his wine pot and
pointing behind himself.

Die Zhang unfurled the piece of paper, revealing the words: Those who
mention the historical matters of the Ning Residence to me today can
drink punishment wine free of charge.

There were dozens of customers at the wine shop, and they all became
alert and guarded at this moment, with some of them no longer drinking
and eating. Of course, there were also those who reacted more slowly and
were still drinking and eating pickled vegetables.

The young man couldn\'t care less about this, and he took a large swig
of wine. A decent amount of wine spilled from the white bowl, and his
eyes were bloodshot as he exclaimed in rage, \"The Sword Qi Great Wall
was almost destroyed, but the Lord Hidden Official stepped forward to
participate in the first life-and-death battle against the demon tribe.
Her opponent immediately surrendered without even entering the
battlefield, and following that, we won many life-and-death battles in
succession. In the end, we were only one battle away from rendering
those despicable great demons from the Savage World helpless --- just a
single battle away!

\"Yet, just how helpful was that immortal couple from the Ning
Residence? Those two sword immortals were truly gifting those despicable
great demons whatever they needed\... The Savage World is shameless, and
they would have launched an assault on the Sword Qi Great Wall even if
they lost the life-and-death battles. However, the Sword Qi Great Wall
understands shame and honor!

\"If we hadn\'t won the final battle, would you, Chen Ping\'an, have
been able to come to the Sword Qi Great Wall? Would you have been able
to act all high and mighty here? You\'re quite the impressive one,
aren\'t you? You\'re the Scholarly Sage\'s disciple and Zuo You\'s
junior brother, correct? Do you know why Stalactite Mountain\'s Sword
Reverence Pagoda specifically didn\'t hang up the portraits of the Ning
Residence\'s two sword immortals a few years ago? You\'re the Ning
Residence\'s son-in-law and a top-notch prodigy, so why don\'t you tell
me, hmm?\"

Chen Ping\'an took a sip of wine and lightly put down his chopsticks.

Die Zhang tossed away the piece of paper and retrieved another piece
from her sleeve, furiously unfurling it to reveal the words: Those who
mention Ning Yao\'s parents can eat my fist. Begging for mercy is
useless.

The young man shot a sideways glance at the piece of paper and burst
into laughter, remarking, \"As expected of a scholar from the Scholarly
Sage\'s lineage. Such impressive knowledge --- you were even able to
guess this. What are you going to do? Kill me with a single punch?\"

He raised his arm and furiously threw the wine bowl to the ground,
shattering it into smithereens as he spat, \"It\'s revolting to drink
wine from the Ning Residence!\"

Chen Ping\'an slowly stood up, still holding the wine bowl that was more
than half full.

The young man stuck his neck out and pointed at his head, saying in
provocation, \"Come on, I\'m waiting for your fist. You can punch me
here if you\'re so capable.\"

He sneered and continued, \"You\'ve coincidentally come to the Sword Qi
Great Wall during a break in battle both times, so perhaps this was all
planned by the disciple of the Scholarly Sage rather than a coincidence?
In any case, that\'s a reflection of your ability, as was your feat of
winning those four battles. So, you punching me, a Sea Observation Tier
sword cultivator, to death will also be a reflection of your ability,
no?

\"You often go to the city wall to practice fist techniques and put on a
show, and it\'s not that you don\'t want to kill some demons, but rather
that they don\'t dare to attack the Sword Qi Great Wall after seeing
you, right? If you ask me, I\'d say that your ability is almost greater
than all of the sword immortals combined. What do you say, Chen
Ping\'an?!\"

Chen Ping\'an glanced at the shattered wine bowl on the ground.

The young sword cultivator glared at him with wide eyes and huffed,
\"You want wine money? I have wine money! I\'ve been to the city wall
once and to the south once, and even though I didn\'t earn much money, I
still earned enough to purchase a few bowls of your crappy wine!\"

He was just about to retrieve some immortal coins from his sleeve when
Chen Ping\'an suddenly said, \"You don\'t need to pay for this bowl of
wine.\"

The Sea Observation Tier sword cultivator roared with laughter, certain
that Chen Ping\'an wouldn\'t dare to punch him. He was just about to
mock him further.

At this instant, however, a fist slammed into the young sword
cultivator\'s head and sent him spinning through the air, with his head
smashing into the ground and his legs kicking up. He died on the spot,
collapsing limply to the ground. Not only that, but his soul was
shattered as well, leaving him as dead as could be.

Holding a wine bowl in his right hand and pointing at the corpse with
his left hand, Chen Ping\'an smiled faintly and said, \"The demon tribe
now owes me money for a bowl of wine thanks to you, and the Savage World
will need to repay this the next time a battle breaks out in the
south!\"

After saying this, Chen Ping\'an raised the wine bowl in his hand and
looked around, saying with loud laughter, \"A few ounces of wine in
small cups and large bowls, washing away the ugly filth of the world!
Sword immortals of the future, who\'s willing to share a drink with me
before we travel south beyond the city wall?!\"

Among the customers in the wine shop and the sword cultivators squatting
on the ground, a few people stood up, after which everyone stood up.

They topped up their wine cups and wine bowls.

Chen Ping\'an gazed into the distance and announced loudly, \"Those at
the Sword Qi Great Wall! Those sword immortals who yearn to kill more
enemies! You\'re all invited to share a drink with me!\"

On this day, an especially large number of sword cultivators and sword
immortals at the Sword Qi Great Wall raised their cups and bowls to
enjoy a drink.

[]{#chapter-53.xhtml}

# Chapter 586: (1): Drinking Away the Ugly Filth of the World

Sword of Coming

Chen Ping\'an visited the wine shop ten days after the incident, and
even though it was close to New Year, there was no festive atmosphere at
the Sword Qi Great Wall. This was in stark contrast to the Majestic
World.

Thanks to the second shopkeeper, Shopkeeper Die Zhang was becoming
increasingly renowned at the Sword Qi Great Wall. She also learned much
about doing business from Chen Ping\'an and became increasingly adept at
dealing with customers. Put simply, Die Zhang was more confident and
able to act more shamelessly now.

If someone asked, \"Shopkeeper, you\'re not going to treat the customers
to some free wine today? You\'ve earned so many immortal coins from us,
so you need to treat us at least once, right?\"

Die Zhang would respond, \"Do sword immortals like you need assistance
or handouts when killing demons or drinking wine?\"

Boos would ring out from all of the tables, but Die Zhang was able to
remain completely unfazed now.

After greeting Die Zhang and some customers he was familiar with, Chen
Ping\'an grabbed a small stool and went over to sit at the intersection
of the small alley and the street. However, no one walked over to listen
to his fantastical stories today, as many children hesitated and took a
detour when they saw the young man in azure.

Apart from the little boy carrying the ceramic money pot being locked at
home by his parents and Zhang Jiazhen needing to work elsewhere to earn
money, the remaining children didn\'t dare to come.

They didn\'t necessarily think that Chen Ping\'an was a bad person, but
he had ultimately punched someone to death at the wine shop. Some of the
children and some of their elders had personally witnessed this.

This was human nature, and Chen Ping\'an wasn\'t surprised at all, much
less disappointed. After sitting there for a while and basking in the
warm sunshine of late winter while snacking on roasted seeds, he picked
up the small stool and returned to the wine shop. He didn\'t help serve
customers; instead, he sat behind the counter and worked the abacus as
he went over the accounts book. Finding a moment of spare time between
serving wine and snacks, Die Zhang walked over and hesitated for a
moment before saying, \"Business hasn\'t been impacted.\"

Chen Ping\'an closed the accounts book and lightly ran his hand across
the abacus, looking up and asking with a smile, \"Have you been itching
to ask me whether that person was truly a spy for the demon tribe? And
regardless of the truth, you want to hear a clear answer from me, seeing
that you\'re Ning Yao\'s and my friend?\"

Die Zhang shook her head without hesitation and replied, \"No, I don\'t
want to ask this. I already have an answer in my mind.\"

Chen Ping\'an deftly worked the abacus and said slowly, \"If the
difference in strength is immense, or if the opponent is profoundly
calculating, then one can only accept the outcome even if one loses. The
heart will have to accept the outcome even if the mouth doesn\'t. I\'ve
lost under these circumstances before, and more than once. Those were
miserable losses, but I benefited greatly from reviewing them afterward.

\"What\'s frightening is those schemes that can be seen through with a
single glance, yet are still able to succeed and genuinely repulse
people. The culprits aren\'t striving to achieve any sort of victory,
and they\'re instead just toying around with others.\"

There was something else that Chen Ping\'an didn\'t say. The Savage
World was going to unleash its full strength to attack the Sword Qi
Great Wall very soon, and this assault wouldn\'t be too far away, even
if it wasn\'t the next battle. That being the case, they could wantonly
burn some of their insignificant pawns in the city to the north.

This would also serve as a reminder to some of the critical pawns that
were hidden even deeper.

Chen Ping\'an glanced outside the wine shop and continued, \"Someone is
making preparations behind the scenes, so if I become careless and think
that the schemes at the Sword Qi Great Wall are completely inferior to
the schemes at the Majestic World, I\'ll eventually get wounded if not
killed, perhaps even affecting those around me. The mastermind behind
the scenes is taking my personality into account when targeting me, and
they\'ve realized that I like to avoid mistakes when doing things. As
such, they\'re purposely allowing me to enjoy small win after small
win.\"

Die Zhang smiled and commented, \"Small wins? Pang Yuanji and Qi Shou
would stomp their feet and curse if they heard this. Ignoring Qi Shou,
Pang Yuanji definitely wouldn\'t come here to drink anymore. He
wouldn\'t even want to purchase the cheapest drink.\"

Chen Ping\'an chuckled and replied, \"That was indeed just a small win.
Pang Yuanji and Qi Shou know this, the spectating sword immortals know
this, and those who need to know this also know this. Even though that
young man was purposely provoking me, many of his points were actually
fair, seeing that I\'m not a genuine sword cultivator and not native to
the Sword Qi Great Wall.

\"However, it was a shame for him that his words were completely
predictable, making it very difficult for him to defeat me. I was able
to defeat Qi Shou and Pang Yuanji before because I was more
unpredictable.\"

Die Zhang sighed and said, \"Chen Ping\'an, do you know that you\'re
terrifying?\"

It was as if two people were playing a game of Go, yet one player was
always able to guess the other player\'s moves. How would the other
player feel?

Some things had already taken place, but there were still some matters
that Chen Sanqiu, Fatty Yan, and the others weren\'t aware of. For
example, when asking Die Zhang to retrieve a piece of paper for him to
write on, Chen Ping\'an had smiled and said that the person who walked
into his trap would definitely be a young person without a high
cultivation base, yet had definitely traveled to the battlefield to the
south before.

As such, this person could garner more empathy from the many sword
cultivators at the Sword Qi Great Wall, causing them to feel a sense of
sympathy and pity. At the same time, this person could also incite
shared hostility toward him.

Perhaps this person would even be a so-called ordinary person with an
amazing reputation in their hometown, kindly helping their neighbors all
year round. The mastermind wouldn\'t need to fan the flames following
the death of this person, and they simply needed to sit back and watch
things unfold. Otherwise, they would be completely looking down on the
inspectors appointed by the Hidden Official of the Sword Qi Great Wall.

Whispers would naturally form at the base level of society before slowly
spreading through the streets and alleys, restaurants and wine shops,
all kinds of other shops, and eventually the large and wealthy clans, as
well as the many sword immortals. Some people would ignore this, while
some people would quietly commit it to memory. Of course, Chen Ping\'an
had described this as the worst-case scenario, one that wouldn\'t
necessarily play out. In any case, things wouldn\'t become too bad,
given that the mastermind behind the scenes was only treating this as a
small test.

Die Zhang had initially been worried that Chen Ping\'an would get angry
at her words, but he surprisingly continued to smile in a natural and
relaxed manner, almost as if he had anticipated this comment from her as
well.

This was the second time that Chen Ping\'an had received a comment like
this.

\"The fact that you\'re saying this to my face means that you genuinely
view me as a friend.\" Chen Ping\'an nodded and continued, \"Also, it\'s
only right that my enemies should feel terrified.\"

\"I feel slightly more at ease with you by Ning Yao\'s side,\" Die Zhang
said.

\"I\'ll also feel more at ease if you\'re still willing to say the same
thing after the next large-scale battle in the south,\" Chen Ping\'an
replied with a smile.

Die Zhang\'s expression suddenly became solemn.

Chen Ping\'an nodded and continued in a quiet voice, \"Indeed, this is
also an intentional act from those masterminds behind the scenes.
Firstly, they wanted to confirm whether the new arrival, Chen Ping\'an,
the disciple of the Scholarly Sage and the son-in-law of the Ning
Residence, would truly ascend the city wall to fight alongside the sword
cultivators.

\"Secondly, would he dare to leave the city and venture to the
battlefield in the south to fight against the demons? And thirdly, what
kind of balance would he strike between fighting conservatively to stay
alive and fighting ferociously with all his power?

\"Would he choose to stay safe above all else, or would he be willing to
die for his honor and the honor of the Ning Residence? Of course, the
best-case scenario for the masterminds would have been me dying as a
brave martyr on the battlefield to the south. If they were in a good
mood, they might have even instructed some people to praise me.\"

There was a look of amusement on Chen Ping\'an\'s face as he asked,
\"You\'re treating the chair that my master sat on as a family heirloom,
keeping it safe in the wing room of your small residence, so do you
think any random person can sit on the small stools that were on either
side of the Scholarly Sage?\"

Heavy emotions weighed on Die Zhang\'s mind as she grabbed a pot of
wine, cracked open the clay seal, poured out two bowls, and then took a
large swig. She appeared despondent and silent.

Chen Ping\'an raised his wine bowl and took a sip of wine, saying with a
smile, \"Don\'t drink too much. We might be the shopkeepers, but we
still need to pay for the wine.\"

Still holding the wine bowl, Die Zhang wanted to say something, but she
couldn\'t help but hesitate.

\"You still have questions? Feel free to ask,\" Chen Ping\'an said.

\"Was the person who stood up first a paid actor?\" Die Zhang asked in a
quiet voice.

A wide smile stretched across Chen Ping\'an\'s face as he shook his hand
and replied, \"No, he wasn\'t.\"

He then pointed at Die Zhang and continued, \"Shopkeeper, you can feel
at ease and continue to do business. You\'re genuinely not cut out for
scheming and plotting. If I hired a paid actor, would I not be treating
all of the sword cultivators at the Sword Qi Great Wall as naive fools
who know nothing more than practicing sword techniques, especially those
sword immortals who were observing from afar?

\"There are some matters where it seemingly looks like we can attain
perfection and reap more benefits, but in reality, we definitely can\'t
act too deliberately. Doing so would instead be a blemish. Take me, for
example. My initial objective was simply to avoid defeat, so killing
that person was already a form of breaking even. However, I would have
drawn needless ire and condescension from others if I had pushed further
and tried to gild the lily.\"

Die Zhang heaved a heavy sigh, raising her wine bowl with a complicated
expression and repeating what Chen Ping\'an had said earlier. \"Let us
drink away the ugly filth of the world!\"

Chen Ping\'an smiled and raised his wine bowl, touching it with Die
Zhang\'s as he said, \"Thanks for the treat, Shopkeeper Die Zhang.\"

------------

There was a winter palace in the west of the city, used by the Hidden
Official to shelter from the cold. There was a summer palace in the east
of the city as well, and both palaces weren\'t very big. However, the
expenditure for maintaining them was colossal.

The Hidden Official was hiding in the winter palace and standing on an
exquisite royal chair in the main hall, an immortal item from the
Majestic World\'s Flowing Dawn Continent. The grains of the red wood
were like flowing water and drifting clouds.

There were two other native sword immortals in the main hall, both of
whom served the Hidden Official. The man was called Zhu An, and the
woman was called Luo Shan; both were relatively old Unpolished Jade Tier
cultivators.

Apart from them, there was also a Nascent Tier cultivator responsible
for summarizing and reporting intelligence, and right now, he was giving
a detailed account of the commotion at the wine shop. Everything about
the deceased Sea Observation Tier sword cultivator had been
investigated, from his ancestry to his cultivation lineage, friends,
senior acquaintances, and so on. Everything was reported in detail to
Sword Immortal Zhu An. As for the Hidden Official, she had never been
interested in these matters.

Also present in the main hall was Pang Yuanji, as well as a noble
scholar from the Confucian Sect. The noble scholar was called Wang Zhai,
and he had some ties to the previous Confucian sage who had overseen the
Sword Qi Great Wall.

The Hidden Official paced around the chair with her eyes closed, and it
looked as if she were sleepwalking as her body swayed around and her
hands tugged on her twin braids.

Sword Immortal Zhu An flipped through the intelligence report in his
hands as he listened to his subordinate\'s report. Fine details were
extremely important, so the intelligence report was naturally very wordy
and long. This was also the reason why the Hidden Official never touched
these intelligence reports.

Sword Immortal Luo Shan was wearing a round-collar brocade robe and a
resplendent red flower hairpin.

Noble Scholar Wang Zhai was similar to an imperial censor in an imperial
court of the Majestic World, so he didn\'t have the right to explicitly
become involved in these intelligence matters. However, he could provide
suggestions and counsel if it were absolutely necessary.

In the words of Lord Hidden Official, they needed to at least give these
outsiders holding a royal sword the opportunity to say a few words. As
for whether she listened, however, that would be completely up to her
mood.

After listening to the intelligence reports, Wang Zhai said, \"The fact
of the matter is that no concrete evidence exists to prove that Huang
Zhou was a spy for the demon tribe. That being the case, might Chen
Ping\'an be accused of killing an innocent person? Taking a step back,
this matter should have been handled by us even if Huang Zhou were truly
a spy for the demon tribe. And if he wasn\'t a spy, and if the conflict
was simply one of ego between young people, then is this not a case of
disregarding human life?\"

Pang Yuanji frowned and didn\'t say anything, keeping his head down to
drink instead.

As the only direct disciple of the Hidden Official, there were many
times when his words were even more effective than those of Zhu An and
Luo Shan, two senior sword immortals. However, Pang Yuanji wasn\'t fond
of becoming involved in these troublesome matters, and he preferred to
focus his full attention on cultivation.

\"Bad people need to be punished by other bad people, made to suffer
until they regret doing bad,\" Luo Shan said indifferently. \"There\'s
indeed no need to worry about any taboo when speaking at the Sword Qi
Great Wall, and even Lower Five Tier cultivators can scold Dong Sangeng
with no issues, given that Dong Sangeng himself doesn\'t mind. Of
course, they\'ll simply be asking for death if Dong Sangeng lashes out
in anger.

\"That Chen Ping\'an was clearly waiting for others to run over and
challenge him, so if Huang Zhou were smarter, he should have relented
after seeing the first piece of paper held up behind Chen Ping\'an. Is
it important whether he was a spy for the demon tribe or not? He died
because of his own stupidity, so he can\'t blame Chen Ping\'an for
reacting too severely.

\"As for Chen Ping\'an, does he genuinely think he\'s a sword cultivator
at the Sword Qi Great Wall? How impudent! I\'ll instruct someone to
especially keep track of Chen Ping\'an\'s performance in the next
large-scale battle in the south.\"

\"You can afford to speak less regarding this matter, Luo Shan,\" Zhu An
said with a stern expression.

Sword Immortal Luo Shan had experienced some conflicts with the couple
from the Ning Residence in the past, leaving both parties unhappy.

Regarding Luo Shan\'s assessment of the situation, it couldn\'t be said
that she was speaking for Chen Ping\'an. At most, she was suggesting
fifty canes for each person, although half of these canes would land on
the body of a deceased person.

Wang Zhai had participated in one large-scale battle during his seven to
eight years at the Sword Qi Great Wall, but he hadn\'t been involved in
much of the action, and he had instead acted like more of a military
supervisor and battlefield recorder.

The Hidden Official had said that since he was a noble scholar, he was
definitely someone who had read many scriptures and books. At the same
time, he was definitely soft and frail, so he shouldn\'t become involved
in those violent battles. Wang Zhai had been incensed upon hearing this,
and he had even reported the matter to a Confucian sage. This was to no
avail.

Luo Shan smiled and asked, \"Then what do you suggest, Sword Immortal
Zhu An? Should we call Chen Ping\'an over to ask for his opinion? He\'s
a disciple of the Scholarly Sage, and he also has a senior brother
who\'s divinely skilled at swordsmanship watching over him from the city
wall.\"

There was a cloudy expression on Zhu An\'s face.

According to the rules, he naturally needed to ask Chen Ping\'an for his
opinion.

However, that young man was too skilled at speaking and interacting with
others, and his backers were also far too powerful.

\"The Scholarly Sage is no longer the Scholarly Sage, and Chen Ping\'an
should also act in adherence with the rules and etiquette since he\'s a
disciple of the Confucian Sect. He shouldn\'t kill people on a whim. I
would say the same thing even if that old man, who no longer has a
position in the scholarly temple, were present. This junior is able to
question Chen Ping\'an if it\'s troublesome for my two seniors,\" Wang
Zhai said.

\"Where should we question him? Here? Or at the Ning Residence?\" Zhu An
asked.

Wang Zhai understood the sword immortal\'s insinuation, so he relented
and said, \"I can visit the Ning Residence, lest we make things too
embarrassing for Chen Ping\'an.\"

Luo Shan pursed her lips before saying, \"That sounds better. Otherwise,
I would need to worry about Great Sword Immortal Zuo hurrying over
immediately after Chen Ping\'an.\"

Pang Yuanji sighed and put away his wine pot, saying with a faint smile,
\"Ordinary sword cultivators might ponder about whether Huang Zhou was a
pawn of the demon tribe or not, but are we not aware?\"

\"I\'m only sticking to the facts,\" Wang Zhai said. \"Huang Zhou was
widely praised in the Sword Qi Great Wall\'s Dayu Ridge Alley, and I
carefully went over his performance on the battlefield as well. It can
be said that he fought with his full strength. Let me be very frank.
Sword cultivators like Huang Zhou might not possess a high cultivation
base and might not kill many enemies on the battlefield, but they make
up the foundation of the Sword Qi Great Wall.

\"I dare say that many ordinary sword cultivators will feel
disillusioned if this matter isn\'t properly addressed and is simply
glossed over. Being fair in reward and punishment is an ironclad rule of
the Sword Qi Great Wall, but are we going to dismiss this fact because
Chen Ping\'an is a sage\'s disciple and a great sword immortal\'s junior
brother?\"

After saying this, Wang Zhai looked toward Zhu An and Luo Shan with a
resolute expression, with the noble scholar\'s demeanor seeming like he
would refuse to back down even if he were opposed by tens of thousands
of people.

The Hidden Official opened her eyes and stood on the edge of the chair,
rocking back and forth like a roly-poly toy. She didn\'t spare the noble
scholar so much as a single glance as she said in a lazy voice, \"If
there are ten thousand people like Huang Zhou in the city, then the old
great sword immortal would scold me for failing my duty if I only
managed to kill nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine. He would
punish me by forbidding me to drink wine for however many years again.\"

Zhu An and Luo Shan immediately stood up after she spoke.

The Nascent Tier sword cultivator appeared even more solemn, as if he
were listening to an imperial edict.

The Hidden Official covered her mouth and yawned, remarking, \"Have your
brains all been scrambled after a few large-scale battles in a row? If
that\'s the case, then drink more water and eat more rice, and stop
focusing on nothing but sword practice, sword practice, and more sword
practice. That\'s a surefire way to fry your brain. Things are still
okay for you, but some people have broken their brains from reading too
many books. I can\'t save them.\"

Noble Scholar Wang Zhai was unfazed.

The Hidden Official nodded to herself and continued, \"Even though I\'ve
never liked Chen Ping\'an, I feel like he\'s comparatively much more
pleasant to the eye. Sigh, I wonder why this is? Why?\"

She pointed at Luo Shan and said, \"Why don\'t you tell me?\"

\"The moon tonight is beautiful,\" Luo Shan replied with a smile.

\"Fair point,\" the Hidden Official said with a nod.

Wang Zhai stood there without moving.

The Hidden Official was quite impressed with this scholar\'s
shamelessness, and she signaled to Zhu An with her eyes, following which
the latter immediately came up with an excuse to lead Wang Zhai away
from the main hall.

Luo Shan also left with the Nascent Tier sword cultivator.

Only the Hidden Official and her disciple remained in the main hall.

Pang Yuanji smiled and asked, \"Master, does the Second Sage\'s lineage
detest the Scholarly Sage\'s lineage this much?\"

The Hidden Official waved her hand and beckoned Pang Yuanji over to the
royal chair, and when he walked over, she immediately grabbed his cheek
and gave it a solid twist, scolding, \"Yuanji, you\'ve scrambled your
brain the most from practicing sword techniques!\"

Pang Yuanji didn\'t need to act too properly in front of his master, so
he broke free from her small hand and massaged his cheek as he said in
helplessness, \"Please enlighten me, Master.\"

The Hidden Official rolled her eyes and lamented, \"How did I find
myself such a stupid disciple? Did you really think that Wang Zhai was
targeting Chen Ping\'an? He was trying to tie us together to vouch for
Chen Ping\'an\'s innocence. How did you not see through such a simple
ploy? In any case, I insist on opposing him, and a smarty-pants like
Chen Ping\'an won\'t be affected at all.\"

Pang Yuanji carefully mulled over this for a moment before nodding in
response. He also felt slightly angry, what with Wang Zhai actually
daring to scheme against his master.

However, the Hidden Official waved a hand and said, \"This is nothing.
Wang Zhai is clearly suspicious of the Dong Clan and suspicious of us as
well. To be more precise, Wang Zhai is suspicious of everyone apart from
Chen Qingdu and the three sages overseeing the Great Wall. For example,
Wang Zhai is also suspicious of me, the Hidden Official. Do you think
the Confucian sage who lost to me is a pushover who would leave with his
tail between his legs and appoint an utter fool to the Sword Qi Great
Wall to lose face again?\"

Pang Yuanji smiled bitterly and replied, \"I\'m not good with these
types of things.\"

The Hidden Official formed a sword seal with her hands, nonsensically
waving it around as she said, \"Why would you need to be good at these
things? You\'re destined to become the next Hidden Official, someone
whose sword can whoosh out and kill many people.\"

\"But Master, you are very good at these things,\" Pang Yuanji remarked.

\"Because I\'m your master,\" she replied.

\"Fair point,\" Pang Yuanji conceded with a nod.

The Hidden Official jumped up in irritation and scolded, \"How
shameless! Are you copying my words? Pay up! Wine will also suffice as
payment!\"

Pang Yuanji tossed his master a pot of Bamboo Sea Small World Wine,
which the Hidden Official placed in the miniature small world inside her
sleeve. Like ants moving nests, she was secretly accumulating a stock of
wine. She couldn\'t drink any now, but she could store them for later,
no?

[]{#chapter-54.xhtml}

# Chapter 586: (2): Drinking Away the Ugly Filth of the World

Sword of Coming

The New Year was around the corner, and Ning Yao asked Chen Ping\'an why
he wasn\'t preparing any couplets and door gods. She had wandered around
the small town in the Jewel Small World back then, and she had found the
New Year\'s atmosphere quite festive and enjoyable, a feeling that she
missed.

Chen Ping\'an smiled and asked if the Sword Qi Great Wall even sold
these goods, to which Ning Yao replied that he could write and draw his
own.

However, Chen Ping\'an stated that he needed to adhere to local
traditions and customs and shouldn\'t go out of his way to put up
couplets and door gods.

Ning Yao was slightly angry, not understanding why they needed to care
about other people\'s opinions.

Chen Ping\'an once again stressed that they did need to care.

Ning Yao truly became a little angry, so Chen Ping\'an explained in
detail the reasons behind his decision and, in the end, told Ning Yao to
be patient regarding this matter. He was going to stay at the Sword Qi
Great Wall for a very long time, so perhaps he would still have
opportunities to do business pertaining to couplets and door gods in the
future, just like how the restaurants and wine shops in the city all put
up couplets and horizontal scrolls now.

Only after hearing this did Ning Yao relent.

Chen Ping\'an visited the city wall again after recovering from his
wounds, looking for Senior Brother Zuo You to continue his sword
training.

He learned his lesson this time, and he directly took a bottle of
ointment with him, intending to treat his wounds on the city wall before
returning. That way, no one else would need to see his scary-looking
wounds, especially so close to the New Year. However, plans would often
go awry, and Ning Yao made her way to the city wall at midnight after
completing her cultivation at the Dragon Slaying Platform and not seeing
Chen Ping\'an return for a long time.

When Ning Yao arrived, she saw Chen Ping\'an lying on the ground ten
paces away from Zuo You and bandaging his own wounds. He had most likely
suffered serious wounds during the training session, or else, with his
habit of tempering his physique until he was half dead, he would have
already summoned his talismanic boat and returned to the Ning Residence
as if nothing had happened at all.

Ning Yao sat beside Chen Ping\'an before turning around to glare at Zuo
You and grumble, \"It\'s almost New Year!\"

Zuo You tried to find the right words for half a day before finally
nodding and saying, \"I\'ll be careful in the future.\"

Chen Ping\'an was secretly amused by this.

In the end, Zuo You said, \"A sage in the past once stood on a riverbank
and posed questions to the heavens, eventually leaving one hundred and
seventy-three questions for the later generations. Afterward, a scholar
of some future generation composed a heavenly response to the one
hundred and seventy-three questions. You can look into this matter if
you want.\[1\]\"

Chen Ping\'an nodded in response. He could ask Chen Sanqiu to help him
purchase the relevant books, since he also enjoyed reading and
collecting books.

He retrieved his talismanic boat, which Ning Yao steered as they
returned to the Ning Residence.

There was no tradition of having a New Year\'s Eve family dinner at the
Sword Qi Great Wall, but at the Ning Residence, Chen Ping\'an personally
went to the kitchen to cook up a sumptuous dinner, letting Grandma Bai
rest for the day.

Their friends would also have their own friends.

Apart from Dong Huafu being relatively unsociable and not having many
friends, Yan Zhuo had his own friendship groups, while Chen Sanqiu had
even more friends.

The New Year arrived, and Chen Sanqiu visited Die Zhang\'s wine shop
with three of his good friends to enjoy a drink.

The four of them shared one table, and Fan Dache, a descendant of a
large clan, was so inebriated that tears and snot were flowing down his
face. Chen Sanqiu was helpless about this, and the young man and young
woman who had similar backgrounds to Fan Dache were also at a loss.
Moreover, the two of them were Dao partners, so they were in even less
of a position to say anything.

This was because Fan Dache liked a young woman with a mismatched social
status, but even though the Fan Clan was very well off, the young woman
had surprisingly turned her back on him and found herself a descendant
of another large clan. Not only that, but they were even starting to
discuss marriage now. Chen Sanqiu and Fan Dache\'s other friends were
caught off guard as well, unable to comprehend why Yu Qia, the Sea
Observation Tier young woman, had abandoned Fan Dache for someone else.

Fan Dache was even more confused, so he drank until he became drunk and
muttered absolute nonsense.

Upon seeing Chen Ping\'an, Fan Dache yelled, \"Oh my, if it isn\'t the
second shopkeeper! It\'s rare for you to show up, so why don\'t you come
over for a drink? Yes, a drink!\"

Chen Ping\'an had coincidentally come here by himself to check the
accounts book with Die Zhang, yet Chen Sanqiu gestured to him with his
eyes, calling Chen Ping\'an over to help them deal with the situation.
Chen Ping\'an felt slightly exasperated. He had only seen Fan Dache and
Yu Qia twice, and he had seldom interacted with them, so what could they
possibly talk about?

Thus, he only brought two pots of wine over and sat beside Chen Sanqiu,
opening one pot to quietly drink by himself. Fan Dache was completely
wasted and wallowing in sorrow, with his eyes hazy and his tears
glistening, making him appear as heartbroken as could be.

The most pitiful thing was that he still maintained some cognition
despite drinking so much, unable to forget his pains and sorrows.

This couldn\'t be helped. Drinking wine wouldn\'t always wash away
one\'s sorrows, and it might instead cause one\'s wounds to burn even
more painfully. If one felt increasingly heartbroken and more craving
for wine, yearning to dull the pain in one\'s heart, then one could
simply drink oneself to death and piss off.

Chen Sanqiu didn\'t truly want Chen Ping\'an to do anything, and he
simply wanted an extra person to drink with.

Chen Ping\'an listened to their conversation, allowing him to roughly
gauge the situation. Even so, their relationship was very shallow, so
Chen Ping\'an wasn\'t willing to offer his opinion.

Despite becoming drunk and extremely heartbroken, Fan Dache was still
unwilling to criticize Yu Qia. Chen Ping\'an had paid a small amount of
attention to Yu Qia before. She was a young woman who would never drink
until she was drunk, and who possessed a very good disposition. Even
though she came from humble beginnings, she exuded a bookish aura, which
was very rare among women at the Sword Qi Great Wall. At the same time,
she also had a sense of boldness.

As for why Chen Ping\'an had paid attention to Yu Qia, this was due to a
small action from her that had stuck in his mind. Back then, Chen
Sanqiu, Fan Dache, and a few others had been sitting together and
drinking wine, and they had coincidentally met a sword immortal with
whom Yu Qia was familiar.

Yu Qia had stood up to respectfully raise a toast to the sword immortal,
and while doing so, she had very naturally reached over to touch the
sword immortal\'s arm, a very brief and normal motion that even Chen
Ping\'an didn\'t find disrespectful. The male sword immortal hadn\'t
thought anything of the contact either.

However, Chen Ping\'an remembered this interaction very clearly for some
reason, most likely because of his experiences in the Majestic World,
where young women with elegant dispositions and eloquent speech were
greatly appreciated by men as they sat on wine tables of varying sizes.
This definitely wasn\'t to say that Yu Qia was some kind of promiscuous
person, and quite the contrary, Chen Ping\'an felt like she struck a
very good balance when it came to dealing with these social
interactions.

Disregarding whether Chen Ping\'an accepted this or not, he could
ultimately understand it. The path of cultivation encompassed all
aspects of life, and each person had their own method of establishing
themself and finding purpose.

Many words and actions, and a lot of hard work that others couldn\'t
see, would become a multitude of life-saving shields that some people
quietly earned for themselves.

However, Fan Dache clearly didn\'t understand this, and perhaps he had
never given this proper thought either. In his eyes, perhaps the girl
whom he liked had always been this sensible and mindful.

At the end of the day, Fan Dache was undoubtedly head over heels for Yu
Qia, but he didn\'t necessarily understand what she liked, nor did he
understand her challenges in life.

Listening to Fan Dache\'s drunken words, he had been utterly confused
when hearing that Yu Qia wanted to break up with him. He had asked her
what he had done wrong, promising that he could change in the future.

Yu Qia hadn\'t budged, adamantly stating that the two of them weren\'t
suitable for each other. Thus, of Fan Dache\'s many drunken words today,
one line was repeated again and again: How are we not suitable for each
other? Why have you only discovered today that we\'re not suitable for
each other?

\"Chen Ping\'an, you\'re not allowed to think that Yu Qia is a bad
person. You\'re definitely not allowed to think that!\" Fan Dache
suddenly shouted.

\"Alright,\" Chen Ping\'an replied with a nod.

Fan Dache raised his wine bowl and downed half of its contents in a
single gulp, with the other half spilling out of the bowl. His eyes
appeared lifeless as he looked at Chen Ping\'an, who was sitting beside
Chen Sanqiu, and he asked in a shaky voice, \"Tell me, what did I do
wrong? Why has Yu Qia decided to marry someone else so quickly? Are nice
people truly destined to suffer when it comes to love and relationships?
Is it simply because that bastard is better at flattering her and
pleasing her?

\"I treated her with absolute sincerity, completely opening my heart up
to her, so how was I any worse? My clan is stricter and relatively
poorer, but every time she took a fancy to something, did I not buy it
for her even if I needed to borrow money from Sanqiu?\"

Fan Dache paused for a moment before asking, \"Chen Ping\'an, you\'re an
outsider, and those unrelated to the situation can see things more
clearly. Where in the world did I go wrong?\"

\"Was she aware of you borrowing money from Chen Sanqiu?\" Chen Ping\'an
asked.

Fan Dache faltered for a moment before fuming, \"How the fuck would I
know whether she was aware of this or not?! If I knew, then Yu Qia
should still be sitting beside me right now. Anyway, what difference
does it make whether I knew this or not? Yu Qia should be sitting beside
me and drinking together with me\... She should be drinking together
with me\...\"

His voice grew weaker and weaker, carrying nothing but grief and sorrow
in the end.

Chen Ping\'an took a sip of wine and put down his wine bowl, asking in a
quiet voice, \"Does it truly not make a difference whether she knew
about this or not?\"

Fan Dache suddenly raised his voice and snapped, \"Stop rubbing it in,
Chen Ping\'an! It\'s easy for you to sit there and judge me. You like
Ning Yao, and Ning Yao also likes you, so immortal couples like you are
completely oblivious to the challenges of normal relationships!\"

Chen Sanqiu was just about to warn Fan Dache against speaking in such an
uncouth manner, but Chen Ping\'an lightly placed a hand on his elbow and
shook his head, signaling to Chen Sanqiu that it was okay.

Chen Ping\'an didn\'t say anything else as he continued to drink in
silence.

However, as if finally finding a way to ease his anguish, Fan Dache
started to target Chen Ping\'an with his nonsensical insults.
Thankfully, he only focused on matters relating to love and
relationships.

Chen Sanqiu\'s expression was livid, and even Die Zhang\'s brows were
knitted in a deep frown, with the latter considering whether she should
knock Fan Dache unconscious with a single punch and be done with it.

Chen Ping\'an remained calm and unfazed the entire time. Fan Dache
finally finished blabbering the insults that even he knew were
unreasonable, after which he started to loudly bawl his eyes out.

Only at this moment did Chen Ping\'an say, \"It was your own fault that
she left, so stop finding excuses for yourself, blaming yourself for
being too nice, lamenting that it\'s wrong to be deeply in love, and
complaining that being gentle and kind is inferior to having a glib
tongue or whatnot. Just admit it if your judgment was poor.

\"When it comes to liking other people, many people also like themselves
at the same time, drunk with narcissism and shedding tears for their own
sake. These people are oblivious to their own blindness, having no clue
what their lovers are thinking and not even knowing whether these lovers
are worthy of their time and sacrifice. Indeed, these people are so
blind that they would rather move themselves to tears first.\"

Fan Dache slammed his palm onto the table and roared, \"Shut the fuck
up!\"

\"And after these people get hurt, they start to drink wine and find
excuses for themselves, saying that the sincerity of good people isn\'t
worth a single copper coin,\" Chen Ping\'an continued in a calm voice.
\"Unfortunately for you, Fan Dache, your clan and powerful background
still exist, so you\'re unable to make more excuses and appear more
pitiful, making it appear as if she left you due to your lack of money.

\"As for whether you can take responsibility for yourself in the
relationship, with this being the cornerstone of you being able to take
responsibility for your lover, is there any need to think about this? I
reckon not. You\'re completely heartbroken, so how can you move yourself
to tears if you stop to consider whether you did something wrong?\"

Fan Dache shakily stood up, with his face contorted and his eyes
bloodshot as he shouted, \"Do you want to fight, Chen Ping\'an?!\"

Chen Ping\'an waved a hand and replied, \"No, I\'ll pass. I\'m only
speaking these unpleasant truths because you\'re Chen Sanqiu\'s
friend.\"

He then downed the contents of his wine bowl before filling it up,
downing it once again, and saying, \"If I\'ve said too much, then you
can just treat it as the musings of a drunk person. You have my
apologies if that\'s the case.\"

Fan Dache laughed loudly and said, \"I\'m surely not worthy of an
apology from you, Chen Ping\'an!\"

His two other friends were also extremely displeased with Chen
Ping\'an\'s behavior.

Was this any way to persuade someone? Was he not adding fuel to the
fire?

Fan Dache glowered intently at Chen Ping\'an and interrogated, \"Just
how many things have you experienced? Do you have the right to talk
about these grand principles?\"

\"That\'s enough! Stop with your drunken antics!\" Chen Sanqiu snapped
at Fan Dache.

There was a tragic expression on Fan Dache\'s face as he stumbled
forward and steadied himself with much difficulty, and he sobbed,
\"Sanqiu.\"

Chen Sanqiu sighed and stood up, saying, \"Let\'s leave it at this.
I\'ll grab the bill.\"

Chen Ping\'an shot an apologetic look at Chen Sanqiu, to which Chen
Sanqiu smiled and nodded in acknowledgment.

Chen Ping\'an left the table and walked toward Die Zhang.

Fan Dache suddenly raised his wine bowl and swung it at Chen Ping\'an.

Chen Ping\'an slowed down but didn\'t turn around, and Chen Sanqiu
immediately made his way around the table and wrapped his arms around
Fan Dache, exclaiming in anger, \"Fan Dache! Has the wine washed away
your brain?!\"

Die Zhang was just about to make a move, but Chen Ping\'an, who had his
back to the table, shook his head at her.

Regardless of whether a person\'s feeling of grief was reasonable or
not, their feeling of grief would remain real and painful when they were
in a despondent state.

Fan Dache struggled to break free with all his might, not forgetting to
scream at the back of that young man in azure, \"Chen Ping\'an, just who
do you think you are? You don\'t understand Yu Qia at all! I\'ll never
forgive you if you dare to slander her like this!\"

Chen Ping\'an turned around and replied, \"We can discuss this when
you\'re sober.\"

Fan Dache accidentally elbowed Chen Sanqiu\'s chest, allowing him to
break free from the latter\'s arms. He clenched his hands into fists,
and his eyes were bloodshot as he panted loudly and shouted, \"You can
criticize me, but you\'re not allowed to criticize Yu Qia, not one
bit!\"

Chen Ping\'an looked at him and said, \"I\'m speaking to you in a calm
and composed manner not because you\'re correct, but because I have
manners.\"

Die Zhang gazed at Chen Ping\'an\'s figure.

She felt a hint of respect and fear at this moment, similar to what she
felt when looking at those lofty sword immortals.

A\'Liang had said before that they didn\'t need to be afraid of those
senior sword cultivators who appeared imposing on the surface. Rather,
they needed to respect and fear those sword cultivators who appeared
very calm and easy-going during normal times.

This was because the so-called rough edges of a person\'s personality
weren\'t like the small stones that slipped into people\'s shoes and
made every step painful, but they were instead like the pebbles in the
streams, seemingly smooth and easily manipulated, but able to chip
people\'s teeth when bitten.

Chen Sanqiu was furious at this moment, and he pushed Fan Dache\'s
shoulder and sent him stumbling forward. \"Go on, hit him. Hit him as
hard as you can! I\'ll count it as my bad luck and accept you back as a
good friend if you render yourself crippled and half-dead. I\'ll still
carry you home!\"

Fan Dache suddenly stood still, regaining his sense of clarity as if a
gust of wind had blown away the effects of the alcohol. Beads of sweat
formed on his forehead.

However, Chen Ping\'an unexpectedly smiled and said, \"There\'s no need
to take this too seriously. After all, who hasn\'t experienced a drunken
fit before? Just remember to pay the bill.\"

Chen Sanqiu felt immense regret. If he had known this earlier, he
shouldn\'t have allowed Fan Dache to invite Chen Ping\'an over to their
table. Right now, he still needed to drag Fan Dache home.

He would be done for if Ning Yao learned about this, and it would be
anyone\'s guess whether he could still enter the Ning Residence as a
guest in the future.

Die Zhang walked over to Chen Ping\'an and asked, \"Are you not angry?\"

Chen Ping\'an squatted down and picked up the shards of the shattered
wine bowl, replying with a smile, \"Do I need to do something if I\'m
angry? If that\'s the case every time, then\...\"

Die Zhang also squatted down to clean up the mess with Chen Ping\'an,
and she looked over in slight curiosity when she realized that he
wasn\'t saying anything else.

Chen Ping\'an smiled and continued, \"If the person speaking doesn\'t
have ill intentions, then there won\'t exist any unpleasant remarks in
the world. If there does, then that points to a shortcoming in one\'s
cultivation of the heart.\"

Die Zhang held back a smile and asked, \"Then what about the person you
punched to death before?\"

\"To say nothing of that person\'s ill intentions, did I ever claim that
my cultivation of the heart is sufficient?\" Chen Ping\'an replied as a
matter of fact.

After cleaning the shards on the ground, Chen Ping\'an stood up to clean
up the mess on the wine table. Apart from half a pot of unfinished wine,
there was also the other pot of unopened wine that Chen Ping\'an had
brought over earlier. However, Chen Sanqiu and the others were very
generous, paying for this pot of wine as well.

Chen Ping\'an\'s mood improved greatly, and he poured himself a bowl of
wine. As for the unopened pot, he planned to bring it back to the Ning
Residence and give it to Senior Nalan.

Shopkeeper Die Zhang turned a blind eye to this.

Chen Ping\'an sat at the table and drank wine by himself. One year had
passed, and another year had arrived.

The old year out, the new year in, peace and prosperity, year after
year.

1\. This references the *Heavenly Questions* (天问), a poem composed by
Qu Yuan, a Chinese poet and aristocrat in the State of Chu during the
Warring States period. It also references the *Heavenly Response*
(天对), composed by Liu Zongyuan to respond to the *Heavenly Questions*.
Liu Zongyuan was a Chinese philosopher, prose writer, poet, and
politician who lived during the Tang dynasty. ☜
