light flowing over its body and a five-buddha treasured crown on its
head. It was suited in golden armor and wearing many ornaments and
jewels, also holding a treasured tower in its hand.

Another golden deity statue was dressed in crimson-purple armor, an
expression of fury on its face and a spear in its right hand, the tip
pointing at the ground. In its other hand was a treasure mirror
reflecting the vast land.

The third Heavenly King Dao Manifestation was wearing a heavenly robe,
with its left arm pointing down and holding a saber, and its right palm
holding a valuable treasure.

The last divine statue had a dragon wrapped around its body, and there
was a red rope in its right hand, rumored to be a treasure that could
suppress and subdue dragon kings of all areas.

Li Zhen had his attention split between two battlefields right now, and
he was both focusing on his opponent\'s true body, which was setting up
a formation, as well as paying close attention to the yin soul in white,
which was facing the two tribulations of heaven and earth inside the
sword intent formation.

Each of the four Heavenly King Dao Manifestations was holding a
treasure, and they used the treasure light of these valuable items to
once again create a small world. The four sword immortals in black
disappeared after creating the formation, transforming into wisps of
extremely pure sword intent.

Chen Ping\'an unleashed a punch, using the Rain Evaporation Technique
and causing the barrier of the small world to violently tremor. Heaven
and earth were not yet able to crush him in between.

At the same time, First shot out from Chen Ping\'an\'s acupoint and
sliced through the nearby sword intent.

Li Zhen pursed his lips. His opponent also had many trump cards, and
only at this moment was he forced to use them to block his attacks.

The little boy issued a command with his mind, and \"Guan Zhao\" strode
forward from behind him, appearing like a guardian god as he shielded Li
Zhen.

A streak of dark green light rapidly shot over at an unimaginable speed,
instantly burying itself into Guan Zhao\'s body before breaking through
his back. The tip of the sword shuddered slightly as it came to a rest
just one foot away from Li Zhen\'s glabella.

Li Zhen stepped back, and Guan Zhao\'s faint body became increasingly
solid and material, and it was just about to reach down and use two
fingers to seal the extremely sneaky and vicious flying sword.

Unexpectedly, however, the dark green flying sword flew backward and
disappeared after failing to strike its target.

Mortal humans had frail bodies, and they wouldn\'t be able to control
immortal treasures from the mountains even if one fell in their lap. In
fact, they would suffer calamity as a result.

Similarly, it wasn\'t the case that all earth immortals were able to
completely control a pseudo-celestial tool.

As for becoming the recognized master of a celestial tool, this was as
difficult as ascending to the heavens.

However, Li Zhen owned a celestial tool right now. Not one, but two.

Li Zhen raised a hand, revealing the Three Mountain Talisman, the
ancestor formation of the true appearances of the Five Mountains.

He would need to pay a huge price after activating this talisman, a
price so big that the little boy would continue to moan in bitter pain.
He would be willing to use this talisman against Ning Yao, but he was
quite reluctant to waste it on the young man standing in front of him.

Thus, Li Zhen kept his hand in a loose fist and opened his other hand,
inside of which was a slowly rotating sword pellet. This had once been
his --- or more accurately, Guan Zhao\'s --- bonded flying sword. It had
been severely damaged and on the verge of destruction after the battle
at Holding Moon Mountain, but the mountain had paid a huge price to
nurture this flying sword for ten thousand years, allowing it to slowly
return to the peak of its power.

Every time the Savage World launched a large assault on the Sword Qi
Great Wall, some great demons would specifically be tasked with using an
ancient secret technique to collect Guan Zhao\'s sword intent from the
Sword Qi Great Wall, secretly transporting it back to Holding Moon
Mountain.

Among them, the great demon from Holding Moon Mountain had personally
snuck over and ventured into extreme danger, wanting to retrieve more of
Guan Zhao\'s sword intent. It was because of this that Dong Sangeng and
Chen Xi had managed to work together and capture the great demon.

Capturing an Ascension Tier great demon alive was far more difficult
than simply killing a great demon.

After Li Zhen spread his palm, the sword pellet rang softly and caused
the space around him to distort. Meanwhile, Sword Immortal Guan Zhao,
who was formed from nothing more than sword intent, surprisingly turned
around and looked over. He was clearly without sentience, yet a
complicated and lifelike expression appeared in his eyes at this moment.

Li Zhen looked up and clenched his hands into fists again, saying to
Guan Zhao with a faint smile, \"This is mine, not yours.\"

Guan Zhao lightly swung his sword, swatting away the streak of dark
green that had suddenly shot over.

Li Zhen chose to ignore the unpredictable flying sword as he strode
forward, walking through Guan Zhao\'s intangible body as he continued to
spectate the battle inside the sword intent formation.

That young man was truly able to take a beating, and he directly used
his elbow to block a downward strike from one of the Heavenly King Dao
Manifestations. However, such was the power of the strike that his legs
sank directly into the ground.

On the city wall, the young prodigies of the Sword Qi Great Wall
continued to communicate using their mind\'s lakes.

Dong Bude smiled faintly and remarked, \"This is another battle where
Chen Ping\'an is completely unable to fight back. It\'s one-sided,
completely one-sided.\"

Guo Zhujiu nodded earnestly and said, \"That little brat is truly very
powerful, and he can completely become brothers with someone like Qi
Shou. They can have a heart-to-heart conversation when they meet on the
battlefield in the future.\"

Chen Sanqiu smiled wryly when he heard this.

These remarks were seemingly carefree and teasing, but in reality, they
perfectly reflected the tension and unease in everyone\'s hearts.

Looking at Lü Duan, the young girl who was unafraid of heaven and earth,
her forehead was covered in beads of sweat, betraying her anxiousness.

The sea of clouds continued to sink lower and lower, while the earth
continued to rise. Heaven and earth were yet to fully come together, but
the thunder pool below attracted furious bolts of lightning from the
sky. More and more arcs of lightning whipped between heaven and earth,
with countless tendrils of lightning true intent snaking into the
surroundings.

A yin soul in white was trapped in the formation, forced to dash through
the air to avoid being struck. Not only did Chen Ping\'an need to dodge
the bolts of lightning violently hammering the earth, but he also needed
to dodge the chaotic tendrils of electricity that were rapidly emanating
like small branches.

However, he would have nowhere left to hide once heaven and earth met,
bringing together the two tribulations.

Li Zhen smiled and said to the four Heavenly King Dao Manifestations,
\"There\'s no hurry. You can slowly reduce this powerful pure martial
artist into nothing but a skeleton. You can let him savor the process of
a mortal transforming into a god.\"

After saying this, Li Zhen looked up at Ning Yao. According to his
senior sister at Holding Moon Mountain, sword cultivators at the Sword
Qi Great Wall were most susceptible to comments like these.

The young man whose yin soul and true body were bogged down in two
separate battlefields was most likely one of the very few exceptions.

However, Ning Yao didn\'t spare Li Zhen so much as a single glance.
Rather, her gaze remained fixed on the sea of clouds that was descending
quicker and quicker.

Ning Yao didn\'t care about Li Zhen\'s provocative words.

Above the vast land far away from the city wall, a flying sword
continued to shoot toward Li Zhen, appearing like a sword cultivator
challenging its opponent to a duel.

This time, it wasn\'t just the dark green sword light by itself, and it
was instead three flying swords arriving together.

The first to arrive was the extremely slender Pine Needle.

Guan Zhao swung his sword, yet the flying sword immediately altered its
path and disappeared without a trace. Only a ditch with consistent depth
was left in the ground.

Guan Zhao twisted his wrist and continued to unleash sword strikes.
Lightning Devourer arrived with astonishing might, yet it also chose to
retreat without engaging the opponent. However, it was affected by the
abundant sword qi from Guan Zhao\'s sword strike, causing its tip to be
thrown slightly off path as it retreated.

Li Zhen found this quite fun.

As it turned out, these were two mediocre flying swords that were more
flashy than they were strong. They would indeed be very terrifying on
ordinary battlefields, and they could certainly change the outcomes in
many life-and-death situations.

Only Fifteenth, the flying sword which genuinely possessed killing
intent, raced over from the side, carving an arc in the air as it
rapidly shot toward the back of Li Zhen\'s head.

Right now, Guan Zhao was limited by both Li Zhen\'s current cultivation
base and thoughts, preventing him from unleashing sword strikes based on
his instincts, and he was also limited in the sense that he no longer
possessed his true body and his pinnacle cultivation base. Unable to
unleash a sword strike in time, Sword Immortal Guan Zhao decided to
reach forward to grab the flying sword.

Li Zhen was completely unfazed by these sneak attacks.

It wouldn\'t matter even if he were struck by one of the flying swords.

In any case, he still had Guan Zhao standing here to block or slow down
the flying swords.

Right now, Li Zhen\'s only worry was trying to determine whether the
true body of that young man was genuinely his complete true body, or
whether it was nothing more than an external yang soul.

If his opponent\'s true body were still hiding in some unknown place,
waiting for the right moment to strike, then this current body would
again have little bearing on the outcome of the battle but be enough to
embarrass him.

His opponent appeared very different from typical sword cultivators who
liked to fight directly and without any nonsense.

Zuo You was a good representation of those typical sword cultivators.

Li Zhen thought for a moment, deciding it would be best to stand here
and wait for the two battles to finish. However, it seemed to make no
sense for him to be so idle.

With this in mind, he summoned a bonded flying sword widely regarded as
unique and blessed by the heavens, sending it soaring into the sky in a
pillar of snow-white radiance. The bonded flying sword eventually
transformed into a bright moon of the Savage World, competing with the
radiance of the sun.

The round moon hung in the sky, its radiance scattering across the world
below like water and illuminating an area with a radius of more than
fifty kilometers. Wisps of primordial sword intent faltered slightly
after catching the soft glow of the moon.

The thunder pool was a small world formed from a pile of treasures as
well as Li Zhen\'s formation skills, which he viewed as very elementary.

The four sword immortals in black were an illusion technique, yet they
were also real at the same time. The four Heavenly King Dao
Manifestations that had appeared later formed another small world.

Li Zhen\'s bonded flying sword formed the third small world.

He focused his gaze, observing that the lunar radiance on the land
carried with it the aura of the river of time. So, with a single
thought, Li Zhen easily froze the third small world, which existed
independently of the other two, even freezing the land up to three
hundred meters below.

Reality proved that the young man didn\'t have any other tricks up his
sleeve, ones that would allow his true body to sneakily hide elsewhere.

However, the three elusive flying swords finally learned their lesson,
no longer insisting on hassling Li Zhen and instead flying around in the
distance like aimless flies. The two pretentious flying swords appeared
especially comical as they shakily flew around, appearing like they
might fall from the sky at any moment.

Apart from the sword immortal sword intent being unrestrained by the
suppression of heaven and earth in the small world, only slowing down
slightly, the countless remaining wisps of sword qi were all pulverized
by the flowing lunar radiance.

Li Zhen breathed a sigh of relief, glad that there were no more
unexpected surprises. However, he couldn\'t help but feel slightly
disappointed at the same time.

Chen Ping\'an\'s flying sword had already escaped Guan Zhao\'s hand,
thanks to its extraordinary sharpness.

Guan Zhao was unhurt, and if the dark green flying sword remained unable
to make any inroads, then its owner would inevitably be drawn closer and
closer to death. At that time, the flying sword would also shatter and
crumble.

Both the flying sword and its owner were engaging in a futile struggle
against death.

[]{#chapter-111.xhtml}

# Chapter 615: (3): Death of Li Zhen

Sword of Coming

The heaven and earth of the first small world had already come together,
meeting at a height below the city wall. A huge wave of sword qi
exploded outward, appearing like many sword immortals unleashing their
flying swords in unison.

How could Chen Ping\'an\'s measly yin soul possibly withstand this?

Over at the second small world created by the four Heavenly King Dao
Manifestations, the true body of the young man who was launching punches
as a pure martial artist was already showing signs of wear, with the
bones on his shoulders and hands naked and visible. Li Zhen had
threatened to reduce him to nothing more than a skeleton, and the little
boy clearly hadn\'t been making an empty threat.

Even so, the bloody and wounded Chen Ping\'an continued to unleash
punches, using the Deity Drumming Technique to attack a certain location
on the barrier of the small world.

His fists were nothing more than bare bones.

Between each punch, his flying sword, First, would also seize the
opportunity to launch an attack.

Fifteenth, which was located in the third small world, suddenly turned
its sword tip, seemingly wanting to interact with the sword tip of
First.

The two flying swords came together, creating a fissure in the barriers
of the small worlds.

The young man in azure unleashed the final punch of the Deity Drumming
Technique, paying the price of a broken arm to shatter the small worlds.
He continued to charge through the dazzling and colorful explosion,
surging toward Li Zhen, the most prodigious youth of the Savage World.

He should have been obstructed when passing from one shattered small
world into the next, especially considering the severity of his wounds,
meaning that his speed should have theoretically dropped a little.

However, Chen Ping\'an\'s pinnacle fist intent flowed over him like a
waterfall, and it was as if a lofty deity had entered his body, allowing
him to travel as quickly as a flash of lightning. He covered more than
five kilometers in the blink of an eye, and his golden fist intent
collided with Li Zhen\'s flowing lunar radiance, causing an explosion
that threw the latter backward.

There was a bright glimmer in Ning Yao\'s eyes as she kept her gaze
firmly fixed on Chen Ping\'an, the pure martial artist who was wearing
an azure robe but no longer wearing a white jade hairpin. She forced
herself not to look at the two heavenly tribulations booming through the
juncture of heaven and earth.

Li Zhen\'s hands no longer remained open, and he lightly clenched one
hand into a fist, following which the blood and flesh on his entire arm
peeled off, with even his bones crumbling apart.

He hadn\'t imagined that he would need to go as far as to sacrifice an
arm and use the celestial tool talisman.

Li Zhen\'s entire arm disappeared, and his face also became slightly
pale. Hovering in the place of his fist was now a primordial talisman
that radiated with an ancient aura.

Chen Ping\'an\'s arm hung limply by his side, and he shook his left
sleeve to retrieve a golden robe. He continued to sprint forward, and
the golden robe automatically wrapped around his body at the same time.

In the next moment, a mountain range with three peaks rose above the
vast land.

The young man who had changed from an azure robe into a golden robe was
nowhere to be seen.

A streak of golden light soared over the Sword Qi Great Wall and raced
over the three mountains.

It then hacked apart the small world formed by the bonded flying sword
and the flowing lunar radiance, after which it slashed down at Li
Zhen\'s head.

Li Zhen tossed his sword pellet into the air, and it instantly fused
into the glabella of Sword Immortal Guan Zhao.

Sword light instantly erupted from Sword Immortal Guan Zhao\'s unstable
body, and the puppet that towered more than thirty meters into the air
wielded his sword to parry the attack from the golden sword.

Blood poured from Li Zhen\'s face, and intense hatred gripped his heart.

That bastard was trying to severely wound him before death!

Only Ning Yao should have had the right to force him into paying such a
huge price!

Li Zhen needed to sacrifice one immortal soul and one mortal form for
the sake of activating that celestial tool talisman! Moreover, Li
Zhen\'s initial goal was to use the sword pellet and sacrifice \"Guan
Zhao,\" who was equivalent to two celestial tools, as well as the Three
Mountain Talisman, to ensure mutual death with Ning Yao!

Now, however, he would never be able to truly control Guan Zhao --- who
wielded a celestial tool and was a celestial tool to begin with --- if
his sword heart had even a sliver of conflict with Guan Zhao. The puppet
would become useless, and Li Zhen\'s Dao Heart would also be ruined as a
result. Guan Zhao, one of the oldest prisoner sword immortals of the
Sword Qi Great Wall who had wanted to fight alongside Chen Qingdu and
swore to never emulate Long Jun, deserved to die and comprehensively
vanish from this world!

Li Zhen\'s eyes widened as he suddenly turned around to look at the
juncture between heaven and earth.

There was a white jade hairpin slowly descending from the sky.

The yin soul in white was nowhere to be seen.

In the sky, the golden streak of light that represented Sword Immortal,
a celestial tool, collided with the long sword in Guan Zhao\'s hand.

Apart from where Li Zhen was standing, the surrounding earth instantly
sank several dozen meters.

Quietly hovering between the white jade hairpin and Li Zhen were the two
flying swords, Pine Needle and Lightning Devourer, that had been putting
on a show from the beginning to the end.

The four of them coincidentally formed a straight line.

Chen Ping\'an appeared before the falling white jade hairpin.

In the next instant, Chen Ping\'an strode onto Pine Needle before
dashing onto Lightning Devourer.

He was accustomed to running along flying swords, having used this as an
escape method before reaching the Wing Formation Tier of martial arts.

Thus, Cui Dongshan, Qi Jinglong, and Nalan Yexing had come together to
invent this secret technique for Chen Ping\'an.

He had first refined Pine Needle and Lightning Devourer into
talisman-like flying swords, allowing him to use them as something akin
to waypoints in the river of time. This gave Chen Ping\'an the ability
to instantly retreat dozens or even hundreds of kilometers from the
battlefield.

For a pure martial artist like Chen Ping\'an, however, these escape
techniques would ultimately be transformed into deadly weapons!

In reality, Chen Ping\'an\'s true body had been hiding in his yin soul
the entire time, and he had simply tricked Li Zhen into thinking that he
had fled from the thunder pool and left behind his yin soul.

The \"yin soul\" had purposely allowed itself to be severely wounded by
the eighteen sword immortals amid the two tribulations of heaven and
earth, and only at the very last instant had Chen Ping\'an and his yin
soul hidden inside the jade hairpin on the latter\'s head.

Otherwise, if he had entered the jade hairpin too early, it was possible
that the temporarily ownerless jade hairpin would have fallen into his
opponent\'s hands.

As for his four flying swords, First, Fifteenth, Pine Needle, and
Lightning Devourer, Chen Ping\'an had left them to his yang soul, which
had played the role of a pure martial artist and pretended to be his
true body. Of course, there was also the celestial-grade Dao robe,
Golden Sweet Wine.

Chen Ping\'an had simply strived to stay alive on both battlefields,
nothing more and nothing less.

Disregarding cultivation bases and sword skills, and only focusing on
the many thoughts and considerations in the few short moments, none of
the sword immortals on the city wall could compare to Chen Ping\'an.

He had done everything for the sake of unleashing a sword strike at this
moment.

Li Zhen looked up with a complicated expression. He had unleashed all of
his trump cards already, so what else could he do? The worst outcome,
the culmination of all the unexpected surprises, had truly come to pass.

Chen Ping\'an made a grabbing motion and silently uttered a single word.

He swung his sword down, directly splitting Li Zhen\'s body into two.

Li Zhen only had time to slightly tilt his head to the side.

This allowed him to keep his head intact.

The sword in Chen Ping\'an\'s hand was only a replica sword formed from
sword intent. Indeed, he hadn\'t been wasting his time and effort during
all those training sessions with Zuo You on the city wall.

His celestial tool, Sword Immortal, was still facing off against Guan
Zhao.

When scholars looked at the world, all matters could be studied and
transformed into one\'s own abilities.

The replica sword had already shattered when Chen Ping\'an descended to
the ground, and he placed a foot on Li Zhen\'s head before extending a
hand and capturing the little boy\'s fleeing soul.

Li Zhen\'s soul was already damaged to begin with, and right now, it was
held in the hand of a young sword cultivator whose name he still didn\'t
know. Chen Ping\'an lightly raised his hand, using his fist aura, which
had the indistinct sound of spring thunder, to firmly imprison Li
Zhen\'s soul.

Chen Ping\'an stomped down and crushed the little boy\'s head, and he
dug his fingers into his soul and asked, \"Why aren\'t you spouting
nonsense anymore, you little piece of trash?\"

Li Zhen\'s soul didn\'t put up a struggle, and it pursed its lip and was
just about to say something. However, Chen Ping\'an immediately
obliterated the little boy\'s soul and continued, \"I\'m begging you to
say another word, okay? Are you able to say another word?\"

Between heaven and earth, only the astral wind and sword qi caused the
young man\'s hair and robes to billow in the air.

In the distance, many of the fourteen great demons were itching to make
a move.

However, the old man in gray raised a hand, stopping the paramount great
demons of the Savage World from targeting the young man. He stepped
forward and said with a smile, \"Quite an impressive mental state, young
man.\"

Not only that, but he even flicked a sleeve and casually shattered Guan
Zhao, who had just ingested a celestial-grade sword pellet.

The mountain range summoned by the Three Mountain Talisman also
disappeared without a trace.

Chen Ping\'an caught the returning Sword Immortal and pointed its tip at
the old man in gray, with his action being as provocative as could be.
In contrast, however, he said, \"You\'re not allowed to take advantage
of your age and experience to pick on me, okay? I\'m a very timid
person.\"

The old man in gray smiled faintly and said, \"Don\'t push your luck.
You can go back to the Sword Qi Great Wall now.\"

Chen Ping\'an turned around with Sword Immortal in his hand.

Nothing could escape his hands, and he even picked up what others would
view as trash. In fact, even the head of the Ascension Tier great demon
was thrown into his minimization treasure.

His yin soul jumped out from his white jade hairpin, returning to his
body along with the severely wounded yang soul, whose bones could be
seen in many places.

Chen Ping\'an suddenly stood still on the battlefield, clenching his
hand into a fist and raising it high into the air. He then slowly put
his hand down and looked at Ning Yao, lightly tapping his chest as he
did so. However, this caused him to stumble and cough up a mouthful of
blood. Afterward, it was Sword Immortal that flew up and dragged him
back to the city wall.

During this, the handsome great demon truly couldn\'t contain his urge
and wanted to pat his Sword Nurturing Gourd to unleash his sword intent,
directly killing that extremely detestable young man.

However, his Sword Nurturing Gourd didn\'t respond to his command, and
the handsome great demon huffed and retracted his hand after shooting a
glance at the old man in gray.

The old man in gray strode forward, standing between the fourteen
paramount great demons and all of the sword immortals of the Sword Qi
Great Wall. He gestured with his hand and said, \"Chen Qingdu, you can
launch a sword strike as per our agreement.\"

\"You\'re acting so haughtily, so how about we strike a deal, and you
let me launch two sword strikes?\" Chen Qingdu asked with a smile.

The old man in gray retracted his hand and smiled, not offering a
response to this stupid question.

Chen Qingdu turned around and beckoned Chen Ping\'an forward, saying,
\"I can\'t let you fight for nothing, so come here and let me teach you
a sword strike.\"

He then placed a hand on Chen Ping\'an\'s shoulder.

The sea of clouds dissipated completely, not only from the Sword Qi
Great Wall, but for as far as the eyes of the paramount great demons
could see.

In addition to this, everything between the great demons and the city
wall obediently lay on the ground, including every little speck of sand.

Atop the city wall, an old man in billowing white robes suddenly
appeared behind Chen Qingdu and Chen Ping\'an, sitting cross-legged on
the city wall. He extended his large hand and grabbed a sword, casually
swinging it down at the old man in gray without any technique to speak
of.

Dust and rocks swirled through the air again.

A short moment later, the dust suddenly settled, revealing the old man
in gray. He was still on the battlefield, but he was hovering in the air
instead of standing on the ground. His hands were clasped behind his
back, and he had upheld his promise and faced a sword strike from Chen
Qingdu head-on.

The hearts of many of the fourteen paramount great demons wavered at
this moment.

Half of them turned around and glanced back in unison.

The old man in gray turned around and left.

He was the manifestation of the Savage World\'s Great Dao, so him facing
a sword strike from Chen Qingdu was equivalent to the entire Savage
World facing a sword strike from Chen Qingdu. It was entirely
negligible.

The Savage World had always been barren and desolate, so what did it
matter if this sword strike destroyed countless mountains and rivers?

However, Chen Qingdu\'s sword skills had indeed improved after ten
thousand years.

This was because a small portion of his sword intent had refused to obey
the old man in gray\'s command, forcefully striking a stretch of land
measuring thousands of kilometers in radius behind the great demons.

Chen Qingdu patted Chen Ping'an's shoulder and asked, \"Did you get
that?\"

Chen Ping\'an haphazardly wiped his face with his hands, smearing away
the blood that had poured out as a result of this lesson. He didn\'t
answer the old great sword immortal\'s question and instead asked, \"Did
that little boy not die?\"

Chen Qingdu smiled and replied, \"He was never alive to begin with, so
how can he die? If we ignore Guan Zhao and only focus on the little boy
pieced together by the remnant soul, then he is indeed as dead as can
be. And with him dead, Guan Zhao is even more comprehensively dead than
before.

\"I have some discouraging news for you, though. Guan Zhao\'s true sword
heart is completely different from Long Jun\'s, and it never actually
strayed from the Sword Dao. Thus, Holding Moon Mountain is purposely
hiding the most important portions of Guan Zhao\'s soul, not giving it
to that little boy. Otherwise, if Guan Zhao\'s true heart reappears in
the world and his sword pellet is allowed to fuse together with his
sword heart, then Guan Zhao returning to the Sword Qi Great Wall will
pose a huge danger to the vile beasts of the Savage World.\"

Chen Qingdu pointed at the great demon wearing a ragged robe and
explained, \"As for this person, formerly known as Long Jun, he harbors
the strongest resentment toward the Sword Qi Great Wall. He didn\'t hold
back with his attacks on the demons when I dragged him to Holding Moon
Mountain back then, and he was also one of the first sword immortals of
the Sword Qi Great Wall to seek death in battle.

\"He felt like he didn\'t owe the Sword Qi Great Wall anymore after
dying once, and he most likely wants to challenge the Sword Qi Great
Wall as an exiled sword cultivator. I understand this, but I can\'t
accept it. Thus, some might be able to breach the Sword Qi Great Wall in
the future, but this definitely won\'t include Sword Cultivator Long
Jun.\"

A slight expression of surprise appeared on Chen Qingdu\'s face, and he
remarked, \"Hmm? You don\'t feel any sense of guilt toward Senior Guan
Zhao? This is quite unlike you, Chen Ping\'an.\"

\"To say nothing of that braindead little boy, I would have also hacked
Guan Zhao\'s true body to death if he dared to utter such nonsense in
front of me,\" Chen Ping\'an replied calmly.

He turned around and looked toward the south.

Following the old man in gray\'s departure, the fourteen paramount great
demons and the remaining great demons also retreated.

Chen Ping\'an closed his eyes. Bloody hell, he had experienced a fall in
cultivation base! Not one tier, but several tiers! Fortunately, he had
used his experience from his travels through the Northern Complete Reed
Continent to forcefully resist the two tribulations of heaven and earth,
so he could offset this fall in cultivation base by striving to elevate
his martial arts cultivation base.

Everything would be okay as long as his bridge of immortality didn\'t
crumble and his four critical bonded items were still intact. He had
only been a fifth tier Qi refiner to begin with, so suffering a drop of
several tiers wasn\'t a deadly blow. In fact, he might receive fortune
from misfortune if he relied on the old great sword immortal\'s teaching
to nurture a genuine bonded flying sword as quickly as possible\...

Ning Yao slung Chen Ping\'an onto her back.

Chen Ping\'an could faintly hear the echo of a horn the moment before he
drifted into unconsciousness.

The siege had begun.

[]{#chapter-112.xhtml}

Chen Ping\'an opened his eyes, and four flying swords materialized
around him in an instant. First was asking for praise and reward,
Fifteenth was as obedient as always, while Pine Needle and Lightning
Devourer were far less sentient and expressive than the other two due to
being replica swords, even though they had already reached advanced
refinement.

There was a familiar scent of medicine in the small room.

Glancing outside, he saw that it was already approaching dusk.

Chen Ping\'an closed his eyes and sensed the hazy aura of the Sword Qi
Great Wall in the distance, and when he opened his eyes again, he
retracted his flying swords and focused his attention on his body,
checking on the wounds from the battle and, more importantly, inspecting
his four critical acupoints.

When it came to battles between cultivators, one\'s Great Dao would be
fundamentally damaged if one\'s bonded acupoints became something
resembling an ancient battlefield ruin.

An overbearing fire dragon swam over the instant that Chen Ping\'an\'s
consciousness appeared inside his body, and standing on the head of the
dragon was a small golden person dressed in Confucian robes as usual. In
addition to carrying a sword, the small person was also carrying a
golden scripture. However, he had become a small baldy now.

The small golden person glared intently at Chen Ping\'an as he stood on
the head of the dragon, clearly winding up to unleash on the young man.

Chen Ping\'an attempted a bluff and said, \"Don\'t scold me, okay? When
I get angry, I can\'t help but scold myself as well.\"

Did the small baldy care about these things? He immediately unleashed a
torrent of abuse at Chen Ping\'an.

Chen Ping\'an naturally couldn\'t engage in a shouting match with the
small golden person, so he could only play deaf and mute and ignore his
incisive remarks.

After all, if it weren\'t for the small golden person helping to patrol
his body and preventing his True Qi as a pure martial artist from
interfering with the channeling of his spiritual energy in his
acupoints, the intense battle just then would have put his mind into a
slumber. His True Qi as a martial artist would have clashed violently
with his spiritual energy as a Qi refiner, exacerbating the severity of
his wounds and planting the seeds of countless future troubles.

The spiritual energy had already dried up completely at the water
palace, with the water veins on the murals appearing dull and lifeless
and the small pond having no more water. However, the foundations of the
water seal, the murals, and the small pond weren\'t damaged, not in the
sense that they were completely unharmed, but in the sense that they
could potentially be repaired in the future.

For example, some of the paint had peeled off from the murals, causing
many initially unstable paintings of water gods to become increasingly
faint and unstable. Among them, some of the livelier paintings of the
water gods had initially radiated with a pure golden glow, but right
now, their radiance also appeared much more muted than before.

The entire water palace felt a little gloomy, and the small children in
green were all wandering around with nothing to do --- they couldn\'t
repair the water palace without the necessary materials.

They looked up at Chen Ping\'an\'s consciousness, and despite not
grumbling in displeasure, their worried frowns and sulky gazes silently
voiced their protest. Seeing this, Chen Ping\'an could only promise that
he would try his best to provide them with materials to repair the
vitality of the water palace as soon as possible. The small children in
green hung their heads in despondence, clearly very skeptical of Chen
Ping\'an\'s promise.

Over at the entrance of the water palace, the small golden person sat
cross-legged on the fiery dragon\'s head and shot a glare at the
children in green.

The dispirited children in green immediately stood up straight and
respectfully bid Chen Ping\'an farewell.

After leaving the water palace, the small golden person continued to
chase after Chen Ping\'an on the fiery dragon and scold him.

The mountain shrine and the wood residence weren\'t faring much better
than the water palace, and Chen Ping\'an would need to become a handyman
and rely on a flow of immortal coins, as well as some corresponding
treasures of the Five Elements, to slowly repair these critical
acupoints.

Three of Chen Ping\'an\'s critical acupoints and bonded items were
damaged, causing his cultivation base to fall three entire tiers. Thus,
he was now a \"powerful\" second tier cultivator.

The good news was that he no longer faced any obstacles with the
Eighteen Stops Technique that A\'Liang had modified.

First and Fifteenth occupied two critical acupoints and continued to
sharpen their blades using the Dragon Slaying Platform.

Of the three acupoints that the three extremely small wisps of sword qi
had initially occupied, only one remained, appearing like an empty
residence waiting for an occupant.

It was waiting for Chen Ping\'an to nurture a more legitimate bonded
flying sword than First and Fifteenth; it was waiting for him to become
a legitimate sword cultivator.

The main reason why Chen Ping\'an had failed to overcome the final
barrier of the Eighteen Stops Technique for so long was that the
acupoint containing that final wisp of sword qi had formlessly become a
\"mighty border pass\" obstructing the advance of his sword intent.

Chen Ping\'an suddenly chuckled to himself. The bald little head of the
small golden person actually looked quite adorable.

Right after this thought appeared in his mind, however, it felt like a
furious punch launched by the Deity Drumming Technique slammed into his
chest, knocking the wind from him and causing him to cough up a mouthful
of blood.

Why was the small golden person so good at holding grudges? Who had he
learned this from? He had most likely learned this from his opening
disciple, right?

Chen Ping\'an put on his boots, displaying no signs of struggle as he
got up from bed and walked around.

Grandma Bai, who had been standing guard in the corridor outside the
entire time, smiled and asked, \"You\'re awake?\"

Chen Ping\'an opened the door and asked, \"How long have I been
sleeping, Grandma Bai?\"

\"Not long. Only three days and three nights,\" Grandma Bai replied.

Chen Ping\'an breathed a sigh of relief and asked, \"How is the battle
at the city wall going?\"

\"This might sound strange, but their assault is just as lackluster as
before, a far cry from the domineering formation they put forward in the
beginning,\" Grandma Bai replied in amusement. \"Their assault this time
is quite similar to the previous two assaults --- they\'re essentially
charging over to seek death.\"

Chen Ping\'an nodded in response and turned around to carry a bench into
the corridor, allowing him to sit down and chat with Grandma Bai.

Grandma Bai was naturally trying to put his mind at ease.

Moreover, this was indeed the case on the surface, and Grandma Bai
wouldn\'t lie about something as significant as the demons\' assault on
the Sword Qi Great Wall. However, there was no way she would be
oblivious to the truth behind the veil: the stifling feeling as if dark
clouds were bearing down on the city and waiting to unleash a storm.

The loud commotion, but unexpectedly muted battles, were simply the calm
before the storm.

The fourteen great demons definitely hadn\'t appeared to simply
accompany the old man in gray and take a few glances at the Sword Qi
Great Wall.

Grandma Bai looked at the solemn and composed Chen Ping\'an and asked in
amusement, \"You\'re not in a hurry to go to the city wall?\"

\"Hurrying won\'t help, so I\'m not in a hurry,\" Chen Ping\'an replied.
\"I\'ll recuperate for a while before finding a disguised method to help
out at the city wall. Otherwise, if I stay by Ning Yao\'s side, the
results will be much worse than my expectations, and that\'s if I don\'t
make things worse. Give me two days maximum, and I\'ll be able to
recover more than half of my combat power and ascend the city wall to
help.\"

Grandma Bai nodded and said, \"That\'s a good point. You\'re in the top
three on the to-kill list, so if you\'re not careful, you\'ll easily
attract the attention of one or two great demons.\"

\"My name shot up the ranks that quickly?\" Chen Ping\'an asked with a
chuckle. \"The Savage World is holding a second tier Qi refiner in such
high regard? Oh, I understand now. How sinister of them. They\'re
clearly trying to anger Pang Yuanji, Qi Shou, and Gao Yehou to death.\"

Grandma Bai smiled in understanding and said with emotion, \"There are
many principles that I understand, but I ultimately can\'t bring myself
to properly adhere to them. For example, it would be more beneficial for
me to use more power when sparring fist techniques with you, but I just
can\'t bring myself to be as ruthless as Old Bastard Nalan. In any case,
you\'ve traveled extensively through the martial world, giving you a
wealth of experience in conflicts and fights to the death, so it\'s
actually not my place to feel worried for you.\"

Chen Ping\'an shook his head and said, \"Every Go game starts on a fresh
board, and the dangers of the martial world and the deadly conflicts in
the mountains don\'t come anywhere close to rivaling the large-scale
battles at the Sword Qi Great Wall.

\"Indeed, even the death of an earth immortal cultivator is generally a
huge matter in the Majestic World. To say nothing of Grandma Bai feeling
worried, I also feel very afraid. However, it\'s precisely because of
this fear that I like to think about some small and trivial matters all
the time.\"

Chen Ping\'an extended his hands and drew a Go board in the air, after
which he circled a small region on the board and continued in a soft
voice, \"If the Go board is this big, and the two players of the Go game
are the Savage World and the Sword Qi Great Wall, then the old man in
gray will represent the former, and the old great sword immortal will
represent the latter. The old man in gray will understandably possess
immense skills and have many Go stones.

\"My cultivation base is low, so when I enter the battlefield later, my
role will be to hide and appear weak on the Go board, secretly carving
out a smaller Go board that I can control in the meantime. By creating a
smaller world in the big world, I\'ll be able to enjoy fewer unexpected
surprises and better chances at victory.

\"So, if things hadn\'t been so tense before, not giving me any time to
think, I wouldn\'t have jumped down the city wall so early to engage in
battle. Rather, I would have wanted those vile beasts in the Savage
World to remain completely oblivious to the existence of someone called
Chen Ping\'an at the Sword Qi Great Wall, from the beginning of the
battle all the way until the end.\"

After saying this, Chen Ping\'an grabbed his Sword Nurturing Gourd and
swirled it around, saying with a faint smile, \"Thankfully, my force of
habit made me think a bit more when I left the city wall.\"

There was actually a much deeper implication to the wager between the
old great sword immortal and the old man in gray.

In fact, it could be said that Chen Qingdu\'s wager was the reason
behind Chen Ping\'an making a decision on how to face his enemy in
almost a split second.

The reason for this was very simple. The old great sword immortal fully
understood Chen Ping\'an\'s capabilities, perhaps even more so than his
own senior brother, Zuo You.

Similarly, Chen Qingdu could also gauge the approximate strength of the
little boy, Li Zhen.

And so, Chen Ping\'an instantly knew at that moment that he didn\'t need
to go all out and fight to the death with his opponent.

At the same time, he shouldn\'t fight to stay alive, and he should
instead fight to achieve victory.

As for Li Zhen, he had severely overestimated his standing in the old
man in gray\'s heart.

The disciple that the old man in gray actually wanted was a completely
new \"Guan Zhao,\" one who had comprehensively changed his Dao Heart and
was able to inherit all of his past sword intent.

Li Zhen was the direct disciple of the old man in gray, the
manifestation of the Savage World\'s Great Dao, but his standing in his
master\'s heart was at most only equivalent to that of the Sword Qi
Great Wall\'s Ning Yao.

As a stone on the Go board that was oblivious to its own standing as a
sacrificial piece, failing to fundamentally change its standing and
situation would only lead it toward peril.

Chen Ping\'an needed to remember this lesson.

First, it was Huai Qian losing his life in the Northern Complete Reed
Continent, and now, it was Li Zhen being killed outside the Sword Qi
Great Wall.

One was a prodigy from the Middle Earth Divine Continent, and another
was a destined individual in the Savage World.

Chen Ping\'an raised his Sword Nurturing Gourd and said, \"I\'ll take a
few sips in secret, and I definitely won\'t drink too much, so please
don\'t dob on me, Grandma Bai.\"

\"It\'s okay for you to drink a bit more as long as you don\'t become
drunk. You\'re always able to make people feel at ease regardless of
whether it\'s a big matter or small,\" Grandma Bai replied slowly with a
kindly expression.

Chen Ping\'an broke into a coughing fit after drinking a few sips of
wine, so he quickly put away the Sword Nurturing Gourd.

This small hiccup wasn\'t enough to make Grandma Bai feel worried,
especially since Chen Ping\'an had enjoyed significant benefits to his
physique as a martial artist in the previous battle.

From now onward, Yu Juanfu might end up slamming into the wall each time
she challenged Chen Ping\'an to a fistfight.

\"The tribulations of heaven and earth are incredibly dangerous, so why
did you take such a huge risk?\" Grandma Bai asked in a quiet voice.

She had felt a sense of lingering apprehension after hearing about the
battle from Nalan Yexing.

\"I previously traveled around the Northern Complete Reed Continent, and
I already became relatively accustomed to heavenly tribulations
descending from the sea of clouds, as well as constructs such as thunder
pools,\" Chen Ping\'an replied softly.

\"In reality, the fundamental Great Dao channeling these two phenomena
possesses similar rules and regulations, and this allowed me to be
calmer and more composed when I faced them before. So, luck is actually
quite important in many scenarios.

\"Li Zhen also considered many things during the battle, but his luck
couldn\'t be regarded as very good. However, if I were Li Zhen, I would
definitely include luck and subjugation abilities in my calculations
when fighting against someone at the Sword Qi Great Wall. At the end of
the day, Li Zhen was still\... too young. He would have become a
terrifying opponent if he had grown a bit older and experienced a few
more battles with the Sword Qi Great Wall.\"

Chen Ping\'an couldn\'t help but chuckle to himself.

Throwing punches and unleashing sword strikes with his full power to
kill Li Zhen was ultimately a very satisfying feeling.

The next so-called Li Zhen that Holding Moon Mountain put together with
remnant souls and a reconstructed body wouldn\'t be the same Li Zhen
anymore. Disregarding cultivation base and only focusing on the \"true
self\" of the soul, Li Zhen would fare even worse than Huai Qian, who
had stayed alive thanks to having a wisp of his soul in a bonded lamp.

Li Zhen\... His name was indeed a bad omen.\[1\]

Chen Ping\'an interlaced his fingers, appearing slightly idle as he
pushed his thumbs together. He naturally wasn\'t relaxed and unworried,
but rather, he was simply able to contain his thoughts.

Old Man Yao was the first person to teach him this kind of so-called
mental ability, but the old man had spoken too vaguely and had barely
explained the principles. This was no surprise, as the old man cherished
his words like gold when he spoke to Chen Ping\'an, who had only been an
apprentice and not his disciple.

Thus, Chen Ping\'an would always think a lot when molding pottery and
firing pottery back then, but he would often become more worried the
more he thought about these tasks. Similarly, he would end up becoming
more distracted the more he tried to focus. This was caused by his frail
physique, with his mind being quicker than his hands, resulting in him
always making mistakes.

1\. Li Zhen (离真) literally means departing from truth.

[]{#chapter-113.xhtml}

The person who had allowed Chen Ping\'an to truly come to a realization
and to use the same principles in all matters of life was actually Ning
Yao when she had first traveled to the Jewel Small World.

When encountering any problem in life, one should first control one\'s
emotions and focus all attention on identifying the root cause of the
issue.

Ning Yao\'s speech and actions were crisp and straightforward, and she
never dilly-dallied or beat around the bush. Even so, she wouldn\'t
strike people as a cold and heartless person.

Later, while reading books during his travels, Chen Ping\'an came across
the phrase \"The winter is adorable, the summer is frightening\" in a
history book, which resonated strongly with him.

In contrast to Ning Yao, some of the prodigies, such as Ma Kuxuan, were
like the scorching summer sun hanging high in the sky, completely
uncaring about the potential droughts and mass casualties in the human
world.

A person\'s encounters in life would silently and subtly shape the way
they viewed and resonated with the various principles in the world.

They would instantly fall in love with some principles, unable to let go
no matter what.

They would feel neutral toward other principles, or perhaps even a sense
of resentment.

Cui Dongshan had once chuckled and remarked that if one were willing to
carefully examine the human heart, digging deep into its depths, would
there still exist any unexplainable or unreasonable emotions of joy and
anger? These were merely external displays of the emotions in one\'s
heart, emotions that traveled along different paths at different speeds.

Cui Dongshan had also revealed some secrets, saying that the tenet of
his knowledge was setting up nine relatively general principles for the
hazy concepts of life, death, the seven emotions, and the six desires.
He had then divided them up into thirty-six more detailed rules.

Beyond these principles and rules were three of the most fundamental
rules of calculation. As these different parts interacted with each
other and criss-crossed, they actually formed nothing more than a Go
board. Each thought and consideration of a person would sprout and die
on this Go board, with traceable reasons for their rise and fall.

This side of Cui Dongshan was naturally very terrifying.

In fact, Chen Ping\'an had a vague feeling that as long as the Eastern
Treasured Vial Continent was defended from the Savage World\'s conquest
in the future, Cui Dongshan\'s growth would be even quicker and loftier
than that of Imperial Preceptor Cui Chan.

As such, Chen Ping\'an needed to act more like a legitimate master.

If a master only taught their disciple Dao power and fist techniques,
and if the disciple was more talented and enjoyed better fated
opportunities, allowing their fist technique to one day overtake their
master\'s, then the relationship between the master and the disciple
would often become very complicated.

If a teacher only taught the principles in the scriptures to their
disciples, yet the teacher wasn\'t morally upright to begin with, how
could they possibly hope that their disciples would still sincerely
respect them upon gaining loftier knowledge in the future?

\"You commented that Li Zhen would have been terrifying had he grown up,
but in the moment before his death, Li Zhen most definitely felt like
you were already a very terrifying person,\" Grandma Bai suddenly smiled
and said.

Chen Ping\'an was already suffering the consequences of his words and
actions so soon.

He smiled wryly and responded, \"I simply wish that all of my opponents
view me as a weak and easily bullied pushover.\"

Grandma Bai stood up and walked away, saying in a soft voice, \"I won\'t
disturb your rest and recuperation. Young Mistress said before that you
can feel at ease and continue to recover here. She, Die Zhang, Dong
Huafu, and the others can look after themselves at the city wall.\"

Chen Ping\'an nodded and also stood up, suddenly asking, \"The details
of my battle with Li Zhen haven\'t spread around, have they?\"

Grandma Bai smiled and replied, \"The sword immortals who witnessed the
battle from the city wall didn\'t say anything, but there are currently
three versions of the story circulating around the city, originating
from Lü Duan, the young lady of the Dong Clan, and Gu Jianlong. Which
version do you want to hear?\"

Chen Ping\'an could feel a headache forming, and he answered, \"I\'ll
just listen to Gu Jianlong\'s version.\"

Grandma Bai smiled and said, \"Well, this version isn\'t as exciting as
the other two. Little Lü Duan\'s story is the most exaggerated, and
she\'s truly proven herself to be your disciple with her inheritance of
your storytelling skills. She can go on for more than an hour about Li
Zhen\'s twenty powerful celestial tools.

\"The young lady of the Dong Clan came up with the longest story, and
this is in contrast to Gu Jianlong\'s story, which is the shortest and
most concise of the three. He said that the second shopkeeper had put up
with the little brat on the battlefield for a long time, but he was
eventually unable to endure the little brat\'s nonsense any longer, so
he sneakily jumped over and launched a surprise attack on Li Zhen,
hacking him to death with a single sword strike.

\"Not only that, but the second shopkeeper even managed to make a huge
profit, bending down with his head lowered and bum raised in front of
all the sword immortals and great demons as he scoured the battlefield
for a long time. If it weren\'t for the second shopkeeper still wanting
to keep some face, he would have gone as far as to retrieve a shovel and
scour over the same area seven to eight times. Sure enough, the second
shopkeeper never engages in a transaction where he suffers a loss.

\"These are Gu Jianlong\'s actual words, and I was only repeating them
to you.\"

Grandma Bai couldn\'t wipe the smile from her face as she said this.

In reality, she had already left out some of the more humorous parts of
the story.

\"The shamelessness and thick skin of the second shopkeeper are
incredible. If he rests against the city wall with his face on the
ground, I surmise that we won\'t need a single sword immortal to guard
the city wall and fight against the demons. Everyone can get on with
their lives or drink wine and snack on roasted seeds as they enjoy the
good show at the city wall. In any case, the demons of the Savage World
won\'t be able to breach the second shopkeeper\'s thick skin and ascend
the city wall even if they draw on their full strength and attack for a
hundred years.\"

Gu Jianlong was from Taixiang Street, and he had been renowned for his
loose and unrestrained comments from a very young age. He wasn\'t a bad
person, and he had always enjoyed a good relationship with Qi Shou\'s
circle. Afterward, he also developed fairly good relationships with Pang
Yuanji and Gao Yehou.

Chen Ping\'an held his hands inside his opposite sleeves and walked
beside Grandma Bai, saying with a grin, \"This is as expected of Gu
Jianlong, someone whose flying sword is called Arsenic. I\'ve already
put up with his nonsense for a while, so I\'ll definitely invite him to
the wine shop for a drink when I return afterward.\"

\"There\'s more to the story?\" Grandma Bai asked in curiosity.

Chen Ping\'an nodded and explained, \"That little bastard always
complains about me being too ruthless regarding selling wine and hosting
bets, so he\'s clearly trying to damage my reputation with this story.\"

Grandma Bai held back a smile and concurred, \"This is far too
unreasonable. You should indeed give him a good talking to when you
return.\"

Chen Ping\'an saw Grandma Bai off at the entrance before quickly making
his way to the wing room where the seals and folding fans were stored.
He grabbed a handful of Go stones from the container on the table, but
he had already given his original engraving knife, which had inscribed
countless bamboo slips, to his disciple, Cao Qinglang, so he could only
use his flying sword, Fifteenth, to inscribe characters instead.

Each time he finished inscribing characters on a Go stone, he would
record all of the relevant details he remembered onto a piece of paper.

After killing Li Zhen and crushing his head and shattering his soul on
the battlefield, Chen Ping\'an had finished by pointing his sword at the
old man in gray. This was reckless and based on emotion, but there was
more to it than just this.

It was also for the sake of openly taking a few more glances at those
great demons from a close distance, those paramount beings who stood at
the pinnacle of the Savage World.

Chen Ping\'an planned to write a detailed book about the great demons of
the Savage World.

There were two books on the table, one of which almost every single
sword cultivator at the Sword Qi Great Wall owned. The other was a book
that the Great Emblem Sword Sect\'s Disciplinary Sword Immortal Huang
Tong had given Li Cai back then. Qi Jinglong had made a copy of this
book and given it to Chen Ping\'an.

Chen Ping\'an shut his eyes.

The old great sword immortal\'s sword strike had actually been a message
to those sword immortals who had already remained hidden or been lying
low in that foreign land for many years, those like-minded individuals
who were carrying out tasks similar to that of Great Sword Immortal Yue
Qing.

They could draw their blades now.

And thus, further south of the Sword Qi Great Wall and the battlefield,
chaos and commotion gripped the Savage World following that sword strike
as unrest rippled through the regions.

The sword immortals who had concealed themselves in the Savage World
didn\'t expose their identities straight away, and they instead started
to secretly reel in the nets, taking advantage of their various
positions and powers to trigger many internal conflicts.

Some other sword immortals, who had hidden their identities and
cultivated alone in the Savage World, started to quietly make their way
to a gathering spot according to some agreement they had made prior to
leaving the Sword Qi Great Wall.

There were also some sword immortals who changed their minds after
initially thinking that they had cut off all ties with the Sword Qi
Great Wall.

Atop some mountain towering into the white clouds, a sword immortal
directly crushed his scabbard and descended the mountain with his now
scabbardless sword.

In some water nation in the Savage World, a sword immortal stepped onto
their blade and soared into the sky.

Inside a flourishing region that was no inferior to the mortal capitals
of the Majestic World, a sword immortal closed their shop and beheaded
the emperor with a single slash, after which they held a pot of wine in
one hand and flew north on their sword.

A sword immortal had been tempering their blade in volcanic lava for
hundreds of years, and they laughed loudly at this moment as they
sheathed their sword and embarked on the journey home.

There was an old sword immortal who had already established a sect and
overseen it for many years in the Savage World, and he resolutely exited
seclusion and wielded his sword without fear of death. He wasn\'t doing
this for the sake of the Sword Qi Great Wall, nor for the sake of Chen
Qingdu. Rather, he was doing this because he was a human sword
cultivator.

Chen Ping\'an was temporarily unaware of these things, and all he could
do was focus on the matters in his sight and within his reach.

Having picked up many items on the battlefield like a stingy wandering
merchant, Chen Ping\'an retrieved a white jade tablet, a minimization
treasure.

The old man in gray had personally told him not to push his luck before,
so Chen Ping\'an had heeded his advice and not pushed his luck by
collecting all of the valuables on the battlefield. Truth be told, Chen
Ping\'an would have done the same even without the \"encouragement\"
from the old man in gray.

The old great sword immortal hadn\'t stopped Chen Ping\'an, signifying
that the items on the battlefield hadn\'t been tampered with and were
safe for him to collect.

Of the eighteen immortal treasures and pseudo-celestial tools that Li
Zhen had used as the cores of the large formation, more than half of
them had been destroyed.

Even so, they were still extremely rare treasures no matter how damaged
they were. With this in mind, it would have clearly been a waste to
leave them behind, hence Chen Ping\'an\'s decision to collect them all.

Of course, some of the treasures were relatively undamaged.

For example, there was the Daoist Five Lightning Dao Seal, which was
extremely heavy despite only being the size of a palm.

The material of the Dao seal was unclear, and it resembled both jade and
wood even though it was neither.

The seals collected and placed on study tables by those in the human
world seldom contained engravings of human figures, much less the
self-portraits of scholars and literati.

However, this Dao seal contained depictions of a thunder general, a
lightning goddess, a wind lord, a rain god, a cloud guardian, a heavenly
official, and many other primordial deities.

The characters inscribed using bird-worm seal script read: Gathering the
Five Lightnings, encompassing all Dao; Severing the five deficiencies,
becoming the core of heaven and earth.\[1\]

These words were extremely bold, so bold that they yearned to swallow
heaven and earth.

However, those who cultivated the orthodox Five Lightning Righteous
Technique and were genuinely lofty Daoist spiritual masters who had
attained the Great Dao could indeed claim to be one with heaven and
earth, allowing them to grasp the fabric of fate in their hands.

Among them, the esteemed Daoist priests from Mount Longhu\'s Heavenly
Master Residence represented one of the most powerful groups.

There was a world-renowned horizontal scroll that hadn\'t been composed
by the Daoist priests of Mount Longhu, and had instead been gifted to
them by someone else.

The horizontal scroll read: Wind, lightning, clouds, and rain rise from
the palm, all immortal formulations birthed from this place.

Chen Ping\'an held the valuable Daoist treasure that had \"only\" fallen
one grade and chuckled, saying to himself, \"These numbers are the
building blocks of all matter, with five representing earth and
commanding the four directions. You have a chance to return to the
pseudo-celestial grade in the future.\[2\]

\"You were unfortunate in the past, coming across such a heartless
owner, but it\'s good fortune for both of us now that you\'re in my
hands. You can accompany me to slay demons and vanquish fiends when I
become a mighty Middle Five Tier immortal and learn lightning techniques
in the future.\"

Chen Ping\'an used his sleeve to thoroughly clean the horizontal scroll
before gently placing it on the table. He could perform advanced
refinement on this treasure in the future, and he would hang it beside
the entrance of his wood residence, just like those evil-warding copper
mirrors hung inside the mortal residences in the small town.

He retrieved another paramount treasure that had fallen to the level of
immortal treasure, the copper treasure pagoda that was a replica of the
White Jade Capital.

Chen Ping\'an was the happiest about seeing and obtaining this item.

He would place it inside the mountain shrine after completing advanced
refinement on it.

Chen Ping\'an didn\'t have many thoughts about establishing more
critical acupoints to store his bonded items, and thinking too much
about this would be useless now that he had become a second tier
cultivator.

The final treasure was a picture scroll, with the ancient wooden rods
fractured, and the painting itself damaged. The eighteen lifelike sword
immortals depicted in the painting were the most top-notch sword
cultivators in the history of the Savage World.

It was a shame that the picture scroll was far too damaged, rendering it
almost worthless.

In the beginning, Chen Ping\'an thought to himself that he couldn\'t be
so biased, and he could give the painting scroll to the small golden
person after refining it. However, a sharp and unexpected pain instantly
struck his chest.

The small golden person was truly very difficult to serve and satisfy!
He was even looking down on Chen Ping\'an\'s potential gift for him.

Chen Ping\'an could only change his mind, thinking that he would place
the picture scroll in the mountain shrine alongside the copper treasure
pagoda.

He placed all of the treasures inside his minimization treasure and left
the wing room, walking to the entrance of the small residence before
returning to the courtyard.

He couldn\'t help but feel anxious about the situation at the city wall.

And thus, he started to practice the six-step walking meditation.

After completing the fist stance a few times, Chen Ping\'an still
couldn\'t conceal the faint smell of blood on his body despite wearing a
Dao robe.

Things wouldn\'t be easy when a cultivator suffered a drop in
cultivation base.

Chen Ping\'an had gone the extra and unnecessary step to ask Grandma Bai
about whether the process of the battle had been divulged just then, and
this hadn\'t had much to do with whether things were a plot or not.

It was simply the case that Chen Ping\'an didn\'t want too many people
at the Sword Qi Great Wall to know about this side of him.

Between the rising land and the descending sea of clouds, Chen
Ping\'an\'s true body and yin soul had actually been hazy during the
overwhelming tribulations of heaven and earth.

Thus, Chen Ping\'an had felt incredibly content and delighted even
though he had been trapped in a perilous situation.

This was seemingly how life should be.

Chen Ping\'an couldn\'t calm down when seated, and he still felt uneasy
even when he practiced walking meditation.

In the end, he went inside to sit down and inscribe seals, but he would
give every single copper coin back to the Sword Qi Great Wall even if he
made money from this. However, the process of earning money itself was a
very satisfying one, yet many people didn\'t understand this joy.

There were countless sword cultivators at the Sword Qi Great Wall, but
there were very few scholars. Thus, when it came to inscribing seals and
writing on folding fans, it wouldn\'t matter much for the holder of the
knife or brush to make small blemishes due to an uneasy heart.

Sitting in front of the table, Chen Ping\'an grabbed his Sword Nurturing
Gourd and occasionally took a sip of wine.

He held Fifteenth in his hand and inscribed another stone seal that was
as snow-white as jade.

The side of the seal read: The people in the world act as expected,
always busy vying for fame and fortune, making me roll my eyes in the
martial world.

The inscription on the seal read: Time to drink wine.

Chen Ping\'an started to inscribe another seal.

The side inscription read: Poets and lyricists throughout history have
always longed to destroy the character of love, and only I lament that
love and sorrow never visit my door. I drink my damned wine and fury
rises from within; I slam my book down and break apart the delicate
verses.

The inscription on the seal read: How miserable single men feel.

He inscribed yet another seal.

The side inscription read: Sword immortals with no money can\'t afford
wine to get drunk; lithe beauties suddenly have hearty meals to make up
for weight lost in summer.

The inscription on the seal read: What should I do?

Chen Ping\'an picked up the final seal.

The side inscription read: Moss grows thick on the steps, where a noble
descendant waves his fan; vegetables withered by the well, tears stream
down his face.

Chen Ping\'an was just about to inscribe the seal face, but he suddenly
tightened his grip and crushed the seal into smithereens.

He took a deep breath.

He stood up and left the room, walking to the main room under the night
sky to retrieve Sword Immortal.

Chen Ping\'an unsheathed the sword, and the soft glow of the moon was
like water as it washed over the blade.

He sheathed the sword, but he didn\'t strap it to his back, instead
hanging it by his waist. He then summoned a talismanic boat and made his
way to the city wall.

Heroes slay criminals, and sword cultivators kill demons --- how could
he not yearn for this? And so, he resolutely charged to the battlefield.

1\. The bird-worm seal script is a type of ancient seal script
originating in Ancient China.

2\. This is a line from 道法会元, often used to describe lightning
techniques.

[]{#chapter-114.xhtml}

# Chapter 617: (1): Who\'s Worthy of Ning Yao

Sword of Coming

Bai Lianshuang offered a very concise description of the early stages of
all battles between the Savage World and the Sword Qi Great Wall:
courting death.

The sword immortals and sword cultivators atop the city wall unleashed
their flying swords in unison, sending a furious wave of sword qi toward
the south, pulverizing everything in its path.

The hordes of demons charging at the Sword Qi Great Wall were cut down
like grass, falling dead to the ground in swathes upon swathes.

Three moons hung above the Savage World, yet the most illuminated by the
moonlight was the city wall.

There were innumerable sword cultivators on the city wall, and the
entire battlefield would become as bright as day when they unleashed
their flying swords in unison, so bright that the three moons would
seemingly lose their luster.

The dense army of demons continued to surge forward, fearlessly pushing
back against the deadly flying swords. However, it was still too early
--- far too early --- for the demons to create a sloped wall with their
bodies to charge onto the city wall.

The demons could only sacrifice countless soldiers to slowly exhaust the
spiritual energy of the sword cultivators, exchanging this for an
opportunity to gradually approach the Sword Qi Great Wall. They needed
to pay a huge price for each meter that they advanced.

A group of great demons assumed their true forms, and under the lead of
Ascension Tier Great Demon Zhong Guang, they were responsible for
uprooting many mountains in the Savage World and carrying them to the
battlefield in the south, after which they would hurl the mountains with
their full strength at the Sword Qi Great Wall.

Great Sword Immortal Yue Qing, who was widely regarded as someone
ranking just outside the top ten pinnacle sword immortals, had two
swords hanging by his waist: Mighty Guardian of the Five Mountains and a
standard sword from the sword market.

Both swords were sheathed, but he had summoned two bonded flying swords,
with Thousand Feet Spring appearing like a thundering waterfall as it
cut down the many large mountains being viciously launched at the Sword
Qi Great Wall. The earth trembled as the mountains crashed down and
flattened countless demons.

Meanwhile, Soaring Cloud Sparrow, Sword Immortal Yue Qing\'s other
bonded flying sword, released a downpour of sword qi onto the
battlefield.

Sect Leader Han Huaizi of the Northern Complete Reed Continent\'s Great
Emblem Sword Sect didn\'t point his flying sword at the demons rushing
to their deaths, and he instead helped Sword Immortal Yue Qing strike
down the large mountains hurtling toward the city wall.

Immortal Tier Sword Immortal Li Tuimi, the chief guest elder of the Yan
Clan, also had two bonded flying swords, White Flood Dragon and Black
Hornless Dragon. The two flying swords were like flood dragons that
measured hundreds of meters in length as they wantonly rolled through
the battlefield and massacred the demons.

Ao Fish, the bonded flying sword of Immortal Tier Sword Immortal Mi Hu,
left the city wall and directly dove into the earth, ripping many deep
ditches in the ground and obstructing the advance of the demon army.

His little brother, Mi Yu, summoned his bonded flying sword to cooperate
with Ao Fish, with the thick iridescent light of the flying sword
sweeping through the ditches and preventing the great demons from
filling them in. At the same time, the flying sword crushed all of the
demons in the ditches.

Sword Immortal Yuan Qingshu from the Southern Whirl Continent also
summoned his flying sword, Frost Snow, to help the Mi brothers protect
the ditches and slow down the demons. His flying sword was brimming with
sword qi, and many demons standing around the ditches of various sizes
felt as if they were plunged into bone-chilling temperatures, almost as
if thick snow were covering the ground and heavy snowfall was continuing
without reprieve.

Demons were renowned for their tough physiques, yet the flesh on their
feet was melted by the sword qi, completely exposing their bones. Their
bodies also became bloodied and mangled.

Sword Immortal Wu Chengpei, who had been stuck at the peak stage of the
Unpolished Jade Tier for many years, was sitting cross-legged on the
city wall. His bonded flying sword, Sweet Dew, was very strange, even in
a place like the Sword Qi Great Wall. Sweet Dew didn\'t travel along a
set path, and it flew through the mountains of corpses and rivers of
blood on the battlefield. Wu Chengpei didn\'t attack the demons, and he
surprisingly focused his attention and started to refine his bonded
flying sword.

Female Sword Immortal Zhou Cheng didn\'t possess a high cultivation
base, but she enjoyed a peculiar fortune: As the last surviving member
of her lineage, she could use the sword intent of her predecessors to
temper her bonded flying sword while cultivating at the Sword Qi Great
Wall. After cultivating for many years, she was eventually able to forge
and nurture a bonded flying sword named Seven Radiance. The sword light
consisted of seven colors, and it was as if Sword Immortal Zhou Cheng
were wielding seven bonded flying swords.

Nalan Shaowei and Lu Zhi, both of whom were regarded as members of the
top ten pinnacle great sword immortals, didn\'t launch any attacks.
Instead, they led a dozen or so Upper Five Tier sword immortals with
extremely quick flying swords to patrol the battlefield, specifically
targeting the great demons hidden among the hordes of demon soldiers. Of
course, they would also draw their swords to kill the demons inching
closer to the city wall, preventing them from reaching the foot of the
city wall too easily.

Countless sword cultivators performed their own duties atop the city
wall.

The flying swords of the Upper Five Tier sword cultivators were at the
forefront of the tidal wave of sword qi, venturing furthest away from
the great wall and killing the most enemies. As such, they naturally
consumed the most spiritual energy and faced the most danger.

The flying swords of the earth immortal sword cultivators at the Nascent
Tier and the Golden Core Tier followed closely behind them. They
weren\'t necessarily seeking to kill the demons in the distance, and
they only needed to stabilize the river of sword qi flowing outside the
city wall. If they had the extra energy, they would target and kill the
demon cultivators wearing Dao robes or talismanic armor, and they would
especially go to great lengths to kill the formation cultivators
secretly transported over by the demons.

The Middle Five Tier sword cultivators under the Golden Core Tier needed
to be especially careful when they launched attacks, and in reality,
their main purpose wasn\'t to kill the demons at all. Rather, they were
responsible for maintaining the formation in front of the city wall,
using it to prevent the demons from specifically targeting them and
damaging their bonded flying swords.

There were three waves of sword cultivators taking turns to attack or
carry out other roles. Being flashy would appear frightening but was
actually useless, so every single sword cultivator at the Sword Qi Great
Wall launched their sword strikes in the most functional and effective
manner, seeking nothing but results.

This was especially important given that the demons\' assault on the
Sword Qi Great Wall wouldn\'t last a few days or a few months, but
instead would generally drag on for several years.

For the demons of the Savage World, the current assault of three days
and three nights was truly nothing more than an appetizer.

The only unexpected surprise during these three days came from Bai Ying,
one of the fourteen pinnacle great demons. He sat high atop his skeletal
throne and appeared like a towering figure overseeing the army of the
demon tribe. He stood up one time, channeling a mystical ability and
causing thousands of corpses on the bloody battlefield to instantly
stand up.

For some unknown reason, however, these corpses didn\'t attack or
retreat, and they simply stood there in a dazed manner, allowing the
sweeping sword qi to comprehensively shatter them and render them
worthless.

Bai Ying sat back down on his throne and extended a hand, seemingly
gesturing for the sword cultivators at the Sword Qi Great Wall to
continue their attacks.

He took an extra glance at the Unpolished Jade Tier Sword Immortal Wu
Chengpei, feeling especially interested in his bonded flying sword,
Sweet Dew.

The great demon\'s gaze stretched further. If he could bathe in sweet
dew and temper his physique in this skeletal form, he would receive some
minor benefits to his Great Dao.

Apart from this, Bai Ying didn\'t find any value in spectating this
battle.

With the exception of a few pinnacle great demons who had no descendants
or forces of their own, all of the other great demons mobilized the full
strength of their sects and vassal forces, including Bai Ying\'s
Skeleton Mountain.

Thus, if someone were able to peer down at the vast lands from the three
moons like that Daoist priest great demon who had refined the core of
the moon, then they would be able to see specks appearing on the land
before forming thin trails that slowly moved toward the Sword Qi Great
Wall. These were the endless trails of demons continuing to arrive at
the battlefield to take the places of their fallen comrades.

Each thin trail could represent more than tens upon hundreds of
thousands of demons, with many of them being puppets that had yet to
develop any intelligence, controlled by their cultivator handlers. Among
these trails were also countless demon cultivators who had embarked on
the path of cultivation and assumed human form. Furthermore, many of
them were powerful beings who ruled over a region, emulating the
Majestic World and establishing their own kingdoms and empires.

Regardless of whether they were violent demons who resided deep in the
