# Chapter 624: (1): Sword Cultivator

Sword of Coming

Atop the city wall, Qi Shou couldn\'t help but turn around to look at
his neighbor. Chen Ping\'an had retrieved stacks of yellow paper
talismans, making it appear like he was about to open a new shop.
However, who was he going to sell these low-grade talismans to? Surely
not to those vile beasts in the Savage World, right?

There was genuinely a huge number of talismans, with the same types
stacked together in a pile. As such, there were a dozen or so small
mountains of varying height, corresponding to at least one thousand
talismans.

The yellow paper talismans were made from extremely ordinary materials
that definitely weren\'t worth much. Moreover, such items weren\'t sold
at the Sword Qi Great Wall, so Chen Ping\'an had definitely brought this
trash over from the Majestic World. These talismans weren\'t even
crafted using the most elementary yellow jade talisman paper for Lower
Five Tier talisman cultivators, and they were genuinely the most
ordinary yellow paper talismans casually sold by vendors in the markets.

If Chen Ping\'an paired these talismans with a peach wood sword, he
would have everything he needed to become one of those Daoist priests
who lied and scammed people outside the mountains.

Chen Ping\'an turned around to look at Qi Shou when he finished setting
everything up.

Qi Shou had a very bad feeling about this.

There was a sincere look in Chen Ping\'an\'s eyes --- like that of a
father looking at his son --- as he smiled and said, \"Don\'t let slip
this rare opportunity, Brother Qi. I\'m the wandering merchant, Chen
Haoren, and I\'m like a completely different person from the wine
shop\'s second shopkeeper. My shop might appear small, but I\'ve
traveled around the Eastern Treasured Vial Continent, the Parasol Leaf
Continent, and the Northern Complete Reed Continent for many years.

\"I\'m especially renowned for my decently-priced and high-quality
talismans, and my reputation is as good as can be. In fact, I\'ve
received many golden plaques, and they\'re all from extremely grateful
customers who have purchased my talismans and reaped significant
benefits as a result. They insisted on thanking me, and I wasn\'t able
to turn them down even if I wanted to.

\"Are you interested, Brother Qi? You and I have fought alongside each
other, so our relationship is stronger than that of friends, even if we
aren\'t necessarily friends. I can even give you a discount. It doesn\'t
matter if you don\'t have immortal coins on you right now, and I\'ll
allow you to pay me back later without interest. I\'m totally open to
negotiations.\"

Qi Shou pretended he couldn\'t hear this.

However, he couldn\'t stand Chen Ping\'an\'s endless rambling,
especially the detailed descriptions of the ingenuities related to each
of the dozen or so talismans. For example, even though the Celestial
Lightning Talisman was only derived from an unorthodox lightning
technique, its destructive power was immense and impressive.

Meanwhile, the Vast Flowing River Talisman was perfect for battlefields
covered in seas of blood, while the Earth Pinch Talisman could create
mountains from flat terrain, making it a brilliant choice for
obstructing the advance of the demon army. Indeed, the Earth Pinch
Talisman was a mystical talisman that could seemingly summon mountains
from thin air.

Qi Shou couldn\'t tolerate this anymore, so he chuckled coldly and said,
\"I might be a measly Nascent Tier sword cultivator who\'s nowhere near
as mighty and impressive as the powerful second tier Second Shopkeeper,
but I am ultimately a sword cultivator, after all. Why would I need your
talismans? To burn yellow paper and pay my respects at the graves?
There\'s no such tradition at the Sword Qi Great Wall.\"

Chen Ping\'an grabbed a stack of talismans, and he was as patient as
could be as he explained to \"Brother Qi\" with a wide smile, \"This is
a fated opportunity of the Great Dao that I paid for with countless pots
of immortal wine. It was only after some great sword immortal became
completely drunk that they accidentally revealed a few secrets and
taught me these guidance talismans.

\"So, what are these so-called guidance talismans? Well, they can guide
living people through certain passes, and on the battlefield, they can
naturally guide enemies onto the path of the afterlife. Are you truly
not interested, Brother Qi? The battle hasn\'t reached its true peak
yet, so it\'s quite uninteresting to just crush those vile beasts with
your flying swords.

\"This is analogous to me simply drinking wine at the wine shop. No
matter how delicious the wine is, even if it\'s the best wine at the
Sword Qi Great Wall, it won\'t taste perfect unless it\'s paired with a
plate of pickled vegetables and a bowl of yangchun noodles.\"

Chen Ping\'an used his other hand to grab another large stack of
talismans, continuing, \"The origin of this talisman is even more
impressive. It represents the trump card and livelihood of that great
sword immortal, and it\'s known as the Sword Qi Bridge Crossing
Talisman. Your cultivation base is too low right now, Brother Qi, but I
trust that your observation skills are very good. Take a look, just how
complicated are these brush strokes? These talismans don\'t look big,
but they\'re genuinely entire talisman formations.

\"I won\'t say too much, but just think about how much immortal ink is
needed for a single talisman? How can Brother Qi call my talismans
worthless simply because the talisman paper isn\'t necessarily
top-notch? Brother Qi, I didn\'t take you for the type of person who
judges a book by its cover. I\'m very disappointed. Li Zhen was killed
by me on the battlefield, but Brother Qi only lost to me by a sliver
when we fought back then. There were many exchanges between us, so
Brother Qi can also be regarded as a prodigy who\'s slightly more
powerful than Li Zhen. With this in mind, it won\'t be difficult for
Brother Qi to become the senior brother at Holding Moon Mountain\...\"

\"That\'s enough, Chen Ping\'an!\" Qi Shou exclaimed in anger. \"The
battle is still ongoing, so please focus your attention on killing the
enemies! Even if you dare to be careless and want to risk your life,
please don\'t drag others down with you!\"

Chen Ping\'an put down the two stacks of talisman, using the closed
folding fan to lightly tap his heart. He looked at the battlefield to
the south and said with a faint smile, \"Since Brother Qi currently
doesn\'t have any plans to buy my talismans, then so be it. Having the
wares catch your eye is the most important consideration when making any
purchases.

\"Now, let me take a good look at Brother Qi impressively killing
enemies. Some people in the main city have small criticisms about your
methods, saying that you\'re too cruel. If you ask me, however, your
methods are as good as can be. Brother Qi has the aura of a noble young
master, and being a haughty and selfish sword prodigy who looks down on
everyone else and refuses to allow others at the same age to become
stronger than you is only a very minor problem.

\"However, you always transform into a genuine hero once you arrive on
the battlefield. You\'re able to tolerate Chen Ping\'an, someone whom
you yearn to kill but are unable to kill in the city. In fact, you can
even overcome the slight displeasure in your mind to defend the city
wall and kill enemies alongside me. Sword Cultivator Qi Shou truly
possesses the graceful demeanor of a sword immortal\...\"

Qi Shou took a deep breath and asked, \"Will you keep spouting nonsense
as long as I refuse to buy your crappy talismans?\"

Chen Ping\'an flicked open his folding fan and replied with a faint
smile, \"No, of course not. I won\'t say anything else. Please continue
to unleash sword strikes in a calm and elegant manner, Brother Qi.\"

Qi Shou retracted his gaze and continued to kill demons with his two
flying swords, Flying Kite and Heartstring.

Compared to before the temporary pause, there was clearly a higher
percentage of demon cultivators in human form on the battlefield. The
demon army was no longer made up of just lowly demons that lacked
intelligence, so lowly, in fact, that sword cultivators with a higher
cultivation base wouldn\'t even receive military merit for killing them.

In the earlier stages of the battle, the lowly demons that couldn\'t
even be regarded as legitimate cultivators had been forced to mindlessly
charge forward, with their only function being to create mountains of
corpses and fill in the deep trenches that the sword immortals had
carved out with their blades. Blood and flesh seeped into the ground,
affecting the favorable conditions and geographical advantage of the
Sword Qi Great Wall.

Qi Shou was completely uninterested in the talismans belonging to the
Five Elements, but he did indeed have some slight interest in the
Guidance Talisman and the Sword Qi Bridge Crossing Talisman, especially
the latter. This was because wisps of sword qi flowed across the
talisman, something that couldn\'t be faked. There wasn\'t much sword
intent in the talismanic core, but it was very pure. Seeing this, Qi
Shou was slightly more inclined to believe Chen Ping\'an\'s claim that a
great sword immortal had secretly taught him how to craft these
talismans.

However, it wasn\'t difficult for Qi Shou to defend his section of the
battlefield, and he had absolutely no interest in doing business with
Chen Ping\'an. Regardless of how fabulously Chen Ping\'an pitched these
talismans, the second shopkeeper was already infamous at the Sword Qi
Great Wall for how he sold wine and hosted bets.

In fact, he had taken things so far that even other people who hosted
bets were unable to make any money, something that had never happened
before at the Sword Qi Great Wall. Thus, the more experienced the
gambling addicts were, the more they would curse the second shopkeeper.
Was Chen Ping\'an not aware of this?

The sword cultivator responsible for replacing Liu Xianyang and Xie
Songhua was an old Nascent Tier cultivator who had said very few words
after arriving at his section of the city wall. He was none other than
Cheng Quan, who had fallen from the Upper Five Tiers back down to the
Nascent Tier.

He and Sword Immortal Zhao Geyi, with whom he had argued for half his
life, liked to guard opposite sections of the city wall, one in the
north and one in the south, and they would immediately spit at each
other at the smallest of disagreements. The old Nascent Tier sword
cultivator had talked a lot when facing off against Zhao Geyi in the
past, but now that he was alone, he remained silent the entire time,
most likely because he had no one to argue with.

In reality, Cheng Quan\'s grandmaster had used his military merit to
obtain a private residence left behind by a deceased sword immortal in
the south of the city, and afterward, he had recorded this private
residence under Cheng Quan\'s name. This was because, apart from Cheng
Quan, everyone else in his branch of the Cheng Clan had already died.
Cheng Quan\'s situation was quite similar to that of Sword Immortal Zhou
Cheng.

Cheng Quan\'s sword strikes were extremely direct, and mountain peaks
that were seemingly carved from blue jade would materialize in the sky
wherever his flying sword, Water Mountain, passed. These mountains would
then plummet to the ground, crushing the demons into puddles of blood
and flesh. If some demon cultivators were fortunate enough to survive or
dodge Cheng Quan\'s attacks, then he would simply use his flying sword
to summon a few more mountain peaks.

If these mountains were shattered by the immortal treasures of powerful
demon cultivators, they would transform into limpid waters that
instantly froze upon hitting the battlefield, obstructing the demon
cultivators and preventing them from dodging the next round of mountain
peaks that slammed down from the sky.

Compared to his two neighbors --- Chen Ping\'an, who was using four
flying swords, and Qi Shou, who was brutally torturing his victims to
death --- Cheng Quan\'s battlefield appeared straightforward and
no-nonsense.

This wasn\'t all, and the biggest eye-opener for Chen Ping\'an was how
the souls of many weaker demons were involuntarily dragged into the
limpid waters of the shattering mountains, where they would eventually
freeze and crumble together.

In reality, Cheng Quan had another bonded flying sword called Stone
Rubbing, which appeared very mediocre on the surface. Apart from this,
he also had a bonded item that had reached advanced refinement, and
though its name was unknown, it looked much like a miniature landscape,
with stones representing mountains and puddles representing rivers.

Many years ago, Cheng Quan\'s esteemed master had been one of the sword
immortals leading teams into the Savage World to hunt, and while doing
so, he would perform basic refinement on rivers and mountains and bring
them back to the Sword Qi Great Wall. He would then give these to his
disciple to perform standard refinement.

When Cheng Quan unleashed the small mountains and narrow rivers from his
miniature landscape, pairing them with the mystical ability of his
flying sword, Stone Rubbing, a peculiar phenomenon would appear on the
battlefield. Roaring rivers would descend, and majestic mountains would
rise, with the rivers becoming even more thunderous and the mountains
towering even higher once they came under the influence of Stone
Rubbing\'s sword intent.

It was because of this that Great Demon Zhong Guang had kept a close eye
on Cheng Quan during the war that had followed the wager of the thirteen
battles, even going as far as to launch a sneak attack on Cheng Quan and
causing him to suffer a drop in cultivation base.

Even though the Unpolished Jade Tier Cheng Quan hadn\'t necessarily
appeared outstanding in the eyes of the other sword immortals, he was
able to cause immense damage and death to the army of the Savage World
on the battlefield, similar to Unpolished Jade Tier Wu Chengpei, who
wielded a flying sword called Sweet Dew.

Chen Ping\'an turned around and looked over, causing Cheng Quan to
immediately say, \"Shut up. I don\'t have any money for you to scam.\"

\"Alrighty then,\" Chen Ping\'an replied with a smile.

Qi Shou didn\'t know whether to laugh or to cry. Both he and Cheng Quan
were Nascent Tier sword cultivators, so why was Chen Ping\'an so
easygoing with Cheng Quan?

Not only that, but Qi Shou discovered that Chen Ping\'an didn\'t develop
a grudge after being bluntly rejected, and he even tossed a pot of Azure
Divine Mountain Wine, which was worth five snowflake coins, toward the
old man in the distance.

Cheng Quan cracked open the clay seal and smelled the wine, after which
he said in disdain, \"Can this be called wine? It\'s nowhere near potent
enough. Only ladies like Zhao Geyi like to drink this.\"

Even though he said this, he definitely wouldn\'t waste the wine.

Chen Ping\'an unexpectedly tossed over another pot of wine that the wine
shop had just started selling, and Cheng Quan gave it a sniff before
nodding and saying, \"Now this is what I call wine. No wonder business
is going well at your wine shop. I would also purchase this wine if you
opened your wine shop on the city wall.\"

\"I don\'t accept credit,\" Chen Ping\'an said with a smile.

Cheng Quan shot a sideways glance at the young man and asked, \"I heard
you were felled by the punch of a young girl at the entrance of the Ning
Residence?\"

Chen Ping\'an lightly tapped his hand with his folding fan and replied,
\"To tell you the truth, Senior Cheng, putting on a strong facade in
front of opponents is a great skill of mine. People actually enjoy a
very strong chance of victory against me, no matter who they are. For
example, Brother Qi over here.\"

The battle continued to rage on, and Chen Ping\'an\'s control over his
four flying swords became increasingly relaxed and natural. His flying
swords were lightning-quick as they sliced through the battlefield.

Sure enough, his greatest skill was controlling flying swords, where he
didn\'t need to be constrained by the many principles, allowing his mind
to become purer. Principles were good, and they could also suppress
people when used in great numbers, but one\'s flying swords would
naturally become ever-so-slightly slower as a result. Moreover, this
extremely minor difference would result in huge differences on the
battlefield.

# Chapter 624: (2): Sword Cultivator

Sword of Coming

Cheng Quan felt like this young man was far more interesting than Zhao
Geyi.

Thus, the elderly Nascent Tier sword cultivator surprisingly shuffled
over to sit beside Chen Ping\'an, asking, \"I\'ve heard that there are
many wonderful mountains and peculiar rivers in the Majestic World,
making a feast for the eyes and ears?\"

Chen Ping\'an didn\'t so much as turn around, instead gazing straight
ahead as he replied with a smile, \"It isn\'t all that special. People
still grow tired of these mountains and rivers after looking at them for
a long time, especially if they have to climb them and traverse them.
Their vision will always be blocked, so it\'s difficult for their minds
to become transcendent and free.

\"After residing in the mountains for a long time, cultivators in the
Majestic World will also seek movement after extended periods of
stillness. They\'ll journey through the mortal world beyond the
mountains and waters. However, it\'s quite pointless to leave the
mountains for the sake of re-entering the mountains.\"

Cheng Quan started to regret shuffling over to sit beside Chen Ping\'an.
The young man\'s words had been quite intriguing before, but he was
beginning to sound very superficial now. This was truly very
uninteresting.

Chen Ping\'an retrieved a copy of the *Seal Manual of the Two Hundred
Sword Immortals* from his Dao robe before turning around and handing it
to Cheng Quan with a wide grin. \"Senior Cheng, take a look and see if
there\'s any seal you\'re interested in. Business is booming, and almost
all of them are sold out. However, if you ask for a particular seal, I
can even offer a discount on top of carving a new one. Even if you
aren\'t interested in any of the seals, you can resell them afterward
and make enough money to purchase one or two pots of wine. It\'s a
win-win situation.\"

Cheng Quan accepted the *Seal Manual of the Two Hundred Sword Immortals*
and casually flipped to a random page. He clicked his tongue in wonder
and remarked, \"Beyond the business aspect, it appears on the surface
like someone\'s eye has been caught when they choose a certain seal, but
in reality, it\'s actually a feeling of attraction in their heart. In
other words, you\'re not only making money, but you\'re also able to
take a peek at people\'s hearts for no extra cost. What impressive
business sense, Second Shopkeeper.

\"After taking a peek at people\'s hearts, is it better for you to push
the door of their hearts open, or is it better for you to knock first? I
say that neither option is good.\"

Chen Ping\'an rocked his folding fan and replied with an aggrieved
expression, \"Senior Cheng, don\'t speak nonsense and bully a junior
just because your sword techniques are mystical and you\'re able to
stand out among the many sword immortals. In any case, you are drinking,
reading, and unleashing attacks at the same time now. To flip through
the book with sword qi, and to kill demons as a side dish to accompany
your wine\... Senior Cheng, you truly possess the elegant demeanor of
eminent scholars.\"

Cheng Quan\'s sword strikes didn\'t falter at all even though he was
casually flipping through the seal manual. Meanwhile, Chen Ping\'an\'s
flying swords also remained as quick and deadly as always even though he
was rekindling his hustle as a wandering merchant.

Cheng Quan paused briefly when he saw the side inscription of a certain
seal, and he was just about to purposely flip to another page when he
discovered something out of the corner of his eye. As it turned out,
that shameless little bastard was staring straight at him. Chen Ping\'an
smiled knowingly, seemingly saying that he understood without actually
saying this out loud. As such, Senior Cheng didn\'t need to feel
embarrassed at all.

Seeing this, Cheng Quan also stopped trying to conceal his interest. He
reached down to caress those characters, especially the characters
\"beautiful lady\" at the end. The old sword cultivator couldn\'t help
but sigh with emotion.

\"Wearing a tattered hat and old clothes, I ride a lame donkey through
the familiar green mountains and blue waters. Above me are the glowing
clouds of dawn, the iridescent clouds of dusk, and the starry night sky;
in front of me are the flickering lamps, potted flowers, and a beautiful
lady.\"

He and Zhao Geyi had competed with each other for so long, yet they were
still unclear about who she actually liked. She had simply said that she
would like whichever one of them advanced to the Immortal Tier first.

Cheng Quan\'s cultivation base had been higher at the time, and his
aptitude was also better than that of Zhao Geyi. Because of this, Cheng
Quan had claimed that she definitely liked him instead of Zhao Geyi.

However, Zhao Geyi always argued that she had been going to great pains
to motivate his Dao Heart.

They both had their own views, and they had been arguing over this for
countless years.

Once upon a time, there had been a breathtakingly elegant female sword
immortal called Song Yuncai at the Sword Qi Great Wall.

She had come from the same impoverished alley as Cheng Quan and Zhao
Geyi, and all three of them had eventually become Upper Five Tier sword
cultivators and fought alongside each other for many years. During this
time, the impoverished alley that had produced three sword immortals at
once became so famous that even Stalactite Mountain, the distant Rain
Dragon Sect, and the even more distant Southern Whirl Continent had all
heard about the matter.

Cheng Quan returned the *Seal Manual of the Two Hundred Sword Immortals*
to Chen Ping\'an and said casually, \"Don\'t become too involved in
mortal practices when you become a sword cultivator in the future.\"

Chen Ping\'an put away the seal manual. Both of his sales today had
fallen through, and he had even sacrificed two pots of immortal wine in
the process. However, since Cheng Quan had mentioned him becoming a
sword cultivator, and keeping in mind the notion of the third being the
charm, this was a good omen. Thus, Chen Ping\'an smiled and replied,
\"Thank you for your well wishes, Senior. I\'ll consider this after I
become a sword cultivator.\"

The two of them fell silent and continued to launch sword strikes.

Qi Shou felt slightly envious of the second shopkeeper. He was truly
able to strike up a conversation with anyone.

Two hours later, Cheng Quan suddenly said, \"Disregarding your fist
techniques and immortal treasures and whatnot, I\'d say that you have
quite the quick wit, young lad.\"

\"This is one of the most fundamental skills. If I ask you to carve the
seal from just then, keeping the side inscription but changing the main
inscription, what will you choose to write for the main inscription? If
you ask me, there\'s a mess of characters on the *Seal Manual of the Two
Hundred Sword Immortals* and those folding fans, and those who have read
some books can all plagiarize or take so-called inspiration like this.
It can\'t be regarded as a genuine ability. A disciple of the Scholarly
Sage should be much more knowledgeable than this.\"

It was Cheng Quan\'s turn to have his eyes opened this time, and he was
astonished to see Chen Ping\'an directly retrieve a blank seal and say
with a smile, \"Please look after my battlefield for a moment. Of
course, the military merit will still count towards me.\"

Things would be extremely safe with Cheng Quan helping to defend his
battlefield.

Chen Ping\'an boldly stopped focusing on the battle, retrieving his four
flying swords and having three of them enter his Sword Nurturing Gourd
to rest for a brief moment. Meanwhile, he used Fifteenth as a carving
knife on the blank seal. However, he not only changed the main
inscription but also the side inscription.

After he handed the seal to Cheng Quan, the old sword cultivator held it
up and nodded expressionlessly, saying, \"It\'s okay.\"

Cheng Quan placed the brand-new seal, which he seemingly found okay but
wasn\'t genuinely fond of, inside his sleeve.

*An old friend and a beautiful lady, generous and full of extraordinary
virtues.*

*A mountain peak in the youth\'s heart, suddenly stolen away by the
clouds.*

The main inscription read: *A moment of carelessness.*

Chen Ping\'an was in no hurry to summon his flying swords and rejoin the
battlefield, and he continued to have Cheng Quan help him sweep the
battlefield as he murmured to himself, \"A great beauty in my heart, not
afraid of being seen by others.\"

Chen Ping\'an used the jade bamboo folding fan that his disciple, Cui
Dongshan, had given him to create a cool breeze for himself and Senior
Cheng. He then chuckled and continued, \"Senior, not only is this custom
seal for you made from top-quality material, but each character engraved
on the seal was also done so with utmost care.

\"The original price isn\'t high at one grain rain coin, and I can offer
a discount of twenty percent since you are a sword immortal. Now that
you\'ve helped me kill enemies on the battlefield, I can improve the
discount further to fifty percent. In other words, this custom seal will
only cost you five lesser heat coins!\"

Chen Ping\'an lowered his voice and continued, \"If it were me, what
kind of discount would I ask for? I would directly pay the original
price of one grain rain coin.\"

Cheng Quan completely ignored the young man, and he appeared slightly
adrift as the look of vicissitude on his face was gradually replaced
with a faint smile.

\"She was the most beautiful woman at the Sword Qi Great Wall back then.
She was very attractive,\" he murmured to himself.

After saying this, he turned to Chen Ping\'an and said in a serious
voice, \"She was even more outstanding than Ning Yao.\"

Unexpectedly, the young scholar\'s temper flipped even quicker than the
pages of a book.

\"Bull-fucking-shit!\" Chen Ping\'an loudly spat in anger.

Cheng Quan wasn\'t offended by this, but rather, his mood was greatly
improved. This was a very familiar situation, and he wasn\'t afraid of
it at all. However, he was drinking the young man\'s wine and taking the
young man\'s seal, so it ultimately wouldn\'t be good for him to reply
with a curse of his own. With this in mind, he smiled and remarked,
\"Why are you suddenly cursing?\"

\"Suppress your cultivation base to the third tier and see whether I
continue to curse you or not,\" Chen Ping\'an retorted.

\"Second Shopkeeper, I won\'t hold back if you continue to push me,\"
Cheng Quan smiled faintly and said in warning.

Qi Shou felt slightly exasperated.

Only two people were arguing, but the old sword cultivator and the young
man were causing such a ruckus that it appeared like two hundred people
were engaged in a free-for-all fight.

Thankfully, this didn\'t affect their performance on the battlefield.

This was only normal. One was an old sword cultivator with many years of
experience on the battlefield, and the other was the second shopkeeper
who would haggle over every copper coin.

The only thing that surprised Qi Shou was their impressive ability to
curse and argue.

By the looks of it, Chen Ping\'an was enjoying the upper hand, as he was
using the local dialect from his hometown or the official dialects of
some other continents as he cursed.

Cheng Quan wasn\'t able to understand these dialects, so he needed to
guess what Chen Ping\'an was even saying. There would sometimes be a
look of sympathy in Chen Ping\'an\'s eyes as he used these other
dialects to praise and scold Cheng Quan, and he would occasionally
repeat what he said using the local dialect of the Sword Qi Great Wall.

Cheng Quan wanted to retort to the young man, but he needed to guess
which of his praises and curses were sincere or sarcastic. This put him
in a tough spot, and much of his experience gained from arguing with
Zhao Geyi over the years was rendered ineffective.

Things were as lively as could be.

Fan Dache felt numb and apprehensive when he walked over to deliver wine
to Chen Ping\'an.

In fact, he only visited once before not daring to visit again, instead
asking Dong Huafu to deliver the wine since he was taking a short rest
from battle. Dong Huafu quite enjoyed this commotion, and he sat to the
side with his ear pricked up, allowing him to both nurture his sword and
enjoy a lively show at the same time. He felt like he was able to learn
many new things. In any case, Dong Huafu\'s ability to add fuel to the
fire and fan the flames was uniquely impressive and impossible to
replicate.

Ten days later, the battle between the Savage World and the Sword Qi
Great Wall continued to rage, but the battle between Cheng Quan and Chen
Ping\'an came to another temporary pause.

Truth be told, the person suffering the most was actually Qi Shou.

Chen Ping\'an often used him as an example, talking about what Brother
Qi had done or how he was so impressive. For example, Brother Qi was
very young, and he had already become a Nascent Tier sword cultivator at
the young age of thirty, so Old Man Cheng needed to hurry up and piss
off further away from Brother Qi if he didn\'t want to embarrass
himself.

Moreover, so be it if Old Man Cheng\'s cultivation base wasn\'t very
high, but it appeared like he only had two bonded flying swords as well?
And how many bonded flying swords did Brother Qi have again? Most
importantly, each of Brother Qi\'s bonded flying swords was of
exceptional quality and grade not seen in thousands of years. As such,
how could Old Man Cheng compare to Brother Qi?

To say nothing of cursing Qi Shou, once Cheng Quan became lost in the
moment, his temperament was such that he would even curse the ancestors
of the entire Qi Clan.

Cheng Quan smiled and said, \"Little Brother Chen, I\'m very confident
of beating that feminine Zhao Geyi in our arguments after sparring with
you over the past few days.\"

Chen Ping\'an rocked his folding fan and replied with a faint smile,
\"Allow me to offer a fair assessment. I can take on the two of you
alone.\"

Cheng Quan shot a glare at the second shopkeeper and exclaimed, \"I\'m
giving you an inch, and you\'re taking a mile, huh? Let\'s go again?!\"

Chen Ping\'an seemingly fell silent, but he was actually compressing his
voice to a thread and secretly saying something to Cheng Quan.

Cheng Quan appeared to be weighing up the benefits and drawbacks, and he
eventually nodded and said to Qi Shou, \"Hey, crook-eyed brat from the
Qi Clan, Grandpa Cheng can see that your aptitude is quite good, so how
about I gift you a fated opportunity? What do you say?\"

Qi Shou played deaf and mute.

Two stacks of talismans appeared in Cheng Quan\'s hands as he walked
over to Qi Shou.

Cheng Quan returned a short moment later, not to Chen Ping\'an\'s side,
but to the section of the wall that Sword Immortal Xie Songhua and Liu
Xianyang had been defending before.

Qi Shou picked out two talismans, a Guidance Talisman and a Bridge
Crossing Talisman, and looked at them carefully. These talismans were
higher grade than he had expected, and it was truly a waste to draw them
on such poor-quality talisman paper. Qi Shou hesitated for a moment
before finally saying to Chen Ping\'an using his mind\'s lake, \"Just
what are you planning to do?\"

Cheng Quan had said to Qi Shou that his bonded flying sword, Jumping
Spider, had yet to be refined to a top-notch stage, so it was still
lacking some might. Afterward, he had offered some teachings as a
senior, making some statements that Qi Shou needed to carefully ruminate
on.

These teachings pertained to the comprehensions of Cheng Quan and Zhao
Geyi regarding sword techniques, and they weren\'t necessarily one
hundred percent compatible with Qi Shou\'s sword techniques. However, to
Nascent Tier cultivators who could very easily become stuck at the same
cultivation base for a long time, even a sliver of inspiration regarding
the Great Dao needed to be taken seriously.

Apart from this, Cheng Quan had also suggested that Qi Shou make a
transaction with Chen Ping\'an. He definitely wouldn\'t be shortchanged,
and if he was, he could ask Zhao Geyi for compensation.

Chen Ping\'an smiled and said, \"Helping others is also helping
myself.\"

He then added, \"As for whether or not you want to give the Savage World
a small surprise, that\'s completely up to you. I never scam unwilling
customers. Rather, business should be mutual and voluntary, with one
happy to make money and one happy to spend money.\"

Qi Shou fell deep into thought.

Cheng Quan\'s proposal to him had been very simple but also quite
complicated at the same time.

It was simple because Jumping Spider, which had the potential to become
a celestial tool in the future, could transform into hundreds upon
thousands of genuine flying swords, with the sword intent of each being
as powerful as the original. And since it was great enough in number,
why not add a little something else, similar to adding a mystical
ability to a bonded flying sword?

Meanwhile, it was complicated because the process of so-called adding
something to the bonded flying sword would be an incredibly cumbersome
process. Someone needed to attach a talisman to each flying sword,
ensuring that there was a good link between all of them. Each individual
\"Jumping Spider\" needed to create its own talisman formation,
ultimately allowing all of them to link together and transform into a
larger talisman formation.

Apart from this, Qi Shou was secretly worried about the cost being
greater than the benefits. More precisely, he was worried about Chen
Ping\'an becoming too familiar with his flying sword during the process
of attaching the talismans.

Compared to the pseudo-celestial tool, High Radiance, Jumping Spider was
an even more fundamental aspect of Qi Shou\'s Great Dao.

Whether he was fighting to the death with someone or killing enemies on
the battlefield, just what kind of scenes would appear when Qi Shou was
able to wield one thousand genuine Jumping Spiders?

And just how would his enemies feel?

[]{#chapter-131.xhtml}

# Chapter 624: (3): Sword Cultivator

Sword of Coming

As Qi Shou had said before, he and Chen Ping\'an would be enemies once
they left the city wall.

Chen Ping\'an suddenly smiled and asked, \"Have you thought about this
before? With the Qi Clan\'s immense wealth, you simply need to throw
money at the problem and learn this mystical ability of crafting
talismans from me before Jumping Spider reaches its pinnacle grade. By
using this mystical ability, you\'ll then be able to open new doors and
reap huge benefits, no? Is it a loss to have me become familiar with
Jumping Spider\'s unique mystical ability, or is it a benefit to
genuinely elevate your combat power? Why don\'t you think carefully and
weigh this up, Brother Qi?\"

Qi Shou glanced down at the two stacks of talismans in his hands that he
had yet to return, furrowing his brows and saying, \"I can control close
to seven hundred Jumping Spiders after breaking through, but can your
yellow paper talismans truly form a formation that large? And how much
will each talisman cost? What happens if it\'s all show and no
substance, and the Upper Five Tier sword cultivators of the demon tribe
are able to easily destroy them in battle? Whose responsibility is it
then?

\"Most importantly, will you truly teach me everything without holding
back? Will you explain all of the intricacies of the talisman formation?
Taking ten thousand steps back, I\'m a pure sword cultivator, so how can
I self-learn talisman techniques during the pauses in battle? What
should I do if you\'re simply making big claims and promising
significant benefits, yet I\'m unable to realize any of these benefits
no matter how much money I spend?\"

Chen Ping\'an clicked his tongue in wonder and replied, \"Brother Qi,
you aren\'t bold enough. You won\'t suffer a loss doing business with
me, and it\'s only a matter of whether you earn more or earn less. I\'m
not saying this without basis, and it\'s a claim based on my track
record that all of you can see.\"

In the end, Chen Ping\'an turned around and closed his folding fan, a
look of disappointment on his face as he shook his head and said with a
sigh, \"What\'s more important, Brother Qi? Viewing me as a
life-and-death opponent outside the battlefield, or the Great Dao of
sword immortals that\'s at your fingertips?\"

Chen Ping\'an beckoned with his folding fan and summoned the talismans
back to his side, smiling and continuing, \"A deal may fall through, but
goodwill remains. I\'ll offer you a sagely teaching for free: Noble
people strive for self-improvement within their means, yearning not for
the blessings of the heavens, and thus achieve progress every
day.\"\[1\]

Cheng Quan smiled and used his mind\'s lake to ask, \"The deal has
fallen through just like that?\"

\"It\'s only normal,\" Chen Ping\'an replied. \"If I were Qi Shou, I
wouldn\'t rashly agree to a deal like this either.\"

Cheng Quan nodded and said, \"A formation talisman is indeed more show
than substance. Qi Shou at least has some brains to turn down your
offer.\"

Chen Ping\'an smiled and replied, \"It can\'t be framed like this. It
was extremely difficult to learn this talisman technique, and the
talisman formation can indeed unleash decent power once I master
it\...\"

Cheng Quan faltered for a moment before exclaiming, \"Wait a second\...
So what you\'re saying is that there\'s no guarantee for whether this
succeeds or not?!\"

\"Did I claim to you or Qi Shou that this could succeed straight away?\"
Chen Ping\'an replied. \"In any case, drawing talismans depends a lot on
talent and then practice making perfect, which is completely normal.
What\'s wrong with wasting a few hundred talismans first? Qi Shou is
extremely wealthy, so does he need to be afraid of these expenses?
Fucking hell, if I didn\'t have a conscience, I could have directly
retrieved stacks of yellow jade talisman paper and proposed an even
worse offer.\"

Cheng Quan laughed loudly and remarked, \"Not a bad plan, Little Brother
Chen. You can help others, practice drawing talismans, and even make
money at the same time, killing three birds with one stone.\"

Chen Ping\'an smiled and said, \"Will a butcher ever complain about
their pig being too fat?\"

Cheng Quan chuckled in amusement.

However, Chen Ping\'an said in the end, \"Looking at this largest battle
in the world, I\'m truly eager to see Qi Shou unleash one thousand
flying swords at once. Even though I\'m yet to become a sword
cultivator, just thinking about this makes me feel a sense of
yearning.\"

Noble people strive for self-improvement within their means, yearning
not for the blessings of the heavens, and thus achieve progress every
day.

In reality, this sagely teaching --- this good principle --- came from
the work of Chen Ping\'an\'s master.

Would it be even better if one could envy what others had and thus
strive even harder for self-improvement?

Chen Ping\'an decided that he would definitely mention these small
questions and minor comprehension to his master in the future.

\"How much does each yellow paper talisman cost?\" Qi Shou asked.

Chen Ping\'an slid the folding fan into his waistband before standing up
and giddily running over to Qi Shou with a slightly bent back. \"Please
help me kill the enemies for a moment while I give you a detailed
explanation, Brother Qi. To give you the short answer, the more
talismans you buy, the bigger the discount will be! The brotherly
relationship between us is truly priceless in its honesty and
sincerity!\"

After arriving at Qi Shou\'s side, Chen Ping\'an turned around and
shouted, \"Old Brother Cheng, please act like the senior you are and
provide some assistance on Brother Qi\'s battlefield. Brother Qi can
return to the city wall after a few hours at most.\"

Chen Ping\'an left the city wall with Qi Shou, and the two of them
squatted down on the carriageway at the foot of the wall. Chen Ping\'an
stacked all of the yellow paper talismans beside his feet before
compressing his voice to a thread and saying in a soft voice,
\"Different talismans have different prices, and Brother Qi, you clearly
aren\'t the type of person to haggle over every single copper coin, so
I\'ll directly give you a fair price for the lot. For one thousand
talismans, not one less, I\'ll only charge three grain rain coins.\"

Qi Shou was just about to stand up and leave.

How many taels of silver would one thousand sheets of yellow talisman
paper cost in the Majestic World? It wouldn\'t be anything more than a
few dozen taels of silver.

Even if a large amount of immortal ink were needed to draw these
talismans, with Chen Ping\'an\'s miserly nature, the grade of the
immortal ink definitely wouldn\'t be very good, seeing that he had used
them to draw one thousand or so talismans at once. How many snowflake
coins would this have cost him? It would have cost him at most a few
lesser heat coins.

Chen Ping\'an didn\'t stop Qi Shou, and he simply continued to say, \"My
set of talismans is related to the Three Mountains and Nine Lords
Talismans, but it obviously isn\'t a direct copy of it. Truth be told, I
don\'t have the ability to draw those talismans with my current
cultivation base. However, the foundations of my talismans do indeed
have a close link to the powerful Three Mountains and Nine Lords
Talismans.

\"In addition to this, I definitely draw these talismans to the best of
my ability, and I don\'t hold back at all. I will try to save as many
talismans for you as I can. Of course, let me say this first: This is a
long-lost talisman formation, after all, so drawing these talismans is
no simple task. You need to be mentally prepared for some extra
expenditure. As for how to attach the talismanic intents to your flying
swords, this is yet another unique and incredible technique.\"

Qi Shou squatted back down again.

It was difficult to find stepping stones in the mountains, just as it
was difficult to purchase top-notch immortal techniques no matter how
wealthy one was.

This was how things were in the mountains.

Qi Shou narrowed his eyes and asked with a smile, \"How will these one
thousand pre-drawn talismans assist my flying sword? Perhaps you were
planning to make this transaction with me from the very beginning, so
each talisman here was drawn with this goal in mind? Moreover, you were
even able to guess that I would be your neighbor?\"

\"Oh, look, Brother Qi is projecting his noble mindset onto a sagely
individual again. This is so unjust to me!\"

Chen Ping\'an appeared slightly vexed as he grabbed a stack of talismans
and spread them apart one by one using his fingers. As it turned out,
they were all blank apart from a few at the top and bottom of the stack.
Chen Ping\'an appeared helpless as he explained, \"Drawing talismans is
a difficult matter with the most stringent requirements on being
detailed and meticulous, and during my intense battle with Li Zhen, I
lost far too many talismans of incredible value, after which I suffered
severe wounds and fell three cultivation tiers.

\"Ask your conscience, Brother Qi, can you imagine just how torturous
that was? Afterward, I needed to attend to so many things at once,
practicing fist techniques, repairing my cultivation base, and so on. I
didn\'t have any time to draw these talismans. So, I forgot to mention
it to you before, but regarding the cost of drawing these talismans, as
well as the cost of speaking to you instead of killing demons and
earning military merit on the city wall\...\"

Qi Shou chuckled coldly and said, \"Cheng Quan is helping you kill
demons, so your military merit won\'t run away.\"

\"Oh, then let\'s just talk about the cost of me going to great pains to
draw these talismans,\" Chen Ping\'an said with a nod. \"There\'s a
so-called brush fee in the Majestic World, but you can feel free to give
any amount as a symbolic gesture. Two or three lesser heat coins are
just spare change to you.\"

\"There\'s no such tradition at the Sword Qi Great Wall,\" Qi Shou
stated.

\"Then I truly can\'t offer a discount on the price of three grain rain
coins,\" Chen Ping\'an said.

\"Do you insist on treating me like a pig to butcher?\" Qi Shou asked.

\"Don\'t denigrate yourself like this, Brother Qi. Even calling yourself
a foolish customer is better than calling yourself a pig.\"

After saying this, Chen Ping\'an laughed heartily in a rare display,
patting Qi Shou\'s shoulder and continuing, \"I just thought of an old
friend with whom I had a good first encounter, a good parting, and I
often think of reuniting with. You will definitely be the same as him.
You\'ll also enjoy incredible fortune and live until the very end.\"

Qi Shou shrugged Chen Ping\'an\'s hand off his shoulder and frowned in
response.

Chen Ping\'an looked up and stared at Qi Shou, saying with a faint
smile, \"Sure enough, I wasn\'t wrong about you, Brother Qi. There\'s no
need to fight to the death on the battlefield.\"

\"What do you mean?\" Qi Shou asked.

\"Guess,\" Chen Ping\'an replied with a smile.

Qi Shou chuckled and said, \"Aren\'t you afraid that I\'m just playing
along with you? Don\'t forget that Jumping Spider can transform into a
huge number of flying swords, a number that you\'re currently unaware
of. Are you able to keep a close eye on my battlefield the entire
time?\"

Chen Ping\'an nodded and replied, \"I have quite a lot of free time, and
I\'m very good at doing things like this.\"

Qi Shou recalled something at this moment.

He had heard from the old ancestors in his clan that all of the sword
immortals at the Sword Qi Great Wall had received a strange instruction
not long ago, asking sword immortals along different sections of the
city wall to hold back and weaken their attacks during different periods
of time.

This definitely wasn\'t something that the old great sword immortal
would be willing to do.

If someone were willing to defect to the enemy and dared to betray the
Sword Qi Great Wall, then that was their freedom.

It would be a reflection of their impressive abilities if they were able
to conceal their intentions. If they failed to do so, however, then they
would face certain death once they were caught by the old great sword
immortal.

Thus, this was definitely a suggestion from someone else.

Apart from this, many young sword cultivators had received a strange
talisman from the garment market, one that could hide their presence.

It wasn\'t the case that no one in the past could draw this type of
talisman at the Sword Qi Great Wall, but rather, not a single sword
cultivator had seen the value in doing so.

Perhaps some sword cultivators had thought about this before, but they
could only bury these thoughts --- which would draw strong suspicions of
shirking battle --- deep in their hearts.

Thus, it was again an outsider who had convinced the old sword immortal
to mandate the young sword cultivators to wear this talisman.

Moreover, apart from the ten paramount sword immortals and some other
critical great sword immortals, many sword immortals atop the city wall
started to quietly shuffle their defensive positions.

\"Did you make some suggestions to the old great sword immortal?\" Qi
Shou asked.

Chen Ping\'an smiled and replied, \"Not only do the vile beasts in the
Savage World want me dead, but even some sword immortals who need to
find a new path of retreat for themselves now want me dead as well.\"

\"Are you this unafraid of death? What are you trying to achieve?\" Qi
Shou asked with a strange expression.

Chen Ping\'an lightly tapped his own shoulder with his folding fan and
replied, \"If you regard me as seeking death, then you won\'t be able to
fathom my goals and plans. If you regard me as seeking life, then
you\'ll be even more hard-pressed to understand what I\'m trying to
do.\"

Qi Shou decided to sit down and lean against the wall. He extended a
hand and said, \"Give me a pot of wine.\"

Chen Ping\'an also sat down and tossed a pot of Bamboo Sea Small World
Wine to Qi Shou. Meanwhile, he grabbed his Sword Nurturing Gourd, which
was currently nurturing four flying swords.

He had heard that the Sword Nurturing Gourds that were about to ripen
and drop to the ground in Stalactite Mountain\'s Spring Banner Inn were
all of very high grade. However, they were far too dear, and there was
far greater demand than supply.

\"Please wait for a moment longer, Senior Cheng. Allow me to drink a pot
of wine first,\" Qi Shou said to Cheng Quan.

\"While Brother Qi is drinking, all of his military merit should count
toward me,\" Chen Ping\'an immediately hollered.

Qi Shou felt slightly helpless. He had used the ripples of his mind\'s
lake to communicate with Cheng Quan just then.

\"And the old grudges between you and me?\" Qi Shou asked as he drank.

\"Even though the Qi Clan relied on their strength to bully others in
the past, everything was ultimately done in the open,\" Chen Ping\'an
replied with a smile. \"I\'m actually able to accept this. The Qi Clan
is powerful and direct, and this can also be regarded as one form of
treating people with sincerity. I\'ll endure something like this
regardless of whether I\'m fond of such a principle or not. It\'s
incredibly simple and doesn\'t require any deep analysis. In fact, it
can almost blur right and wrong and have the two cancel each other out.

\"If the grudges remain statically balanced when I\'m eventually able to
throw punches and launch sword strikes, then things will also be very
simple. I\'ll gradually return the favor to the Qi Clan. Qi Shou, it\'s
not that I\'m looking down on you in regard to some truly difficult
matters, but you\'ll only understand the extremes of worry and trouble
once you visit the Majestic World. Remember to take things easy if you
get the chance to head over there in the future.\"

Qi Shou shook his head and replied, \"I have no interest in the Majestic
World. However, I\'m very interested in visiting the heartland of the
Savage World. I want to be like A\'Liang and challenge the most powerful
enemies.\"

Chen Ping\'an smiled and remarked, \"Embarking on a distant journey with
your sword, departing your homeland without any attachments\... This is
indeed the demeanor of a sword immortal.\"

Chen Ping\'an put his Sword Nurturing Gourd away and said, \"Time to
start work and make money.\"

Qi Shou summoned six hundred and thirty-two Jumping Spider flying
swords, gathering them together at the foot of the parapet. After doing
this, he was just about to jump onto the parapet and rejoin the battle.

Chen Ping\'an suddenly lowered his voice and said, \"The talisman
formation and sword formation will become even more incredible if yellow
jade talisman paper or even higher-grade talisman paper is used for the
critical talismans. The might of your attacks will transcend the
heavens!\"

Qi Shou stopped and asked in curiosity, \"And how much will that cost?\"

Chen Ping\'an thought for a moment before gazing north and replying with
a chuckle, \"I\'m in a great mood, so I\'ll charge you the same amount
as before for the upgraded talisman paper.\"

Qi Shou had just turned around when he heard Chen Ping\'an add, \"Only
five immortal coins in total.\"

Qi Shou looked back.

\"Brother Qi, was our heart-to-heart conversation not even worth two
grain rain coins?\" Chen Ping\'an asked.

Qi Shou put on a stern expression and shook his head, replying in a
solemn voice, \"No, it wasn\'t.\"

\"It\'s not good for you to always look down on yourself like this,
Brother Qi,\" Chen Ping\'an said in an exasperated voice.

Qi Shou jumped onto the parapet and expressed his thanks to Senior Cheng
Quan.

------------

Inside the secret room in the Ning Residence, Chen Ping\'an opened his
eyes.

He looked down, and he was surprised to discover his body in one piece,
completely unharmed.

Unable to make heads or tails of the situation, Chen Ping\'an groggily
walked out of the secret room and arrived at the training ground, with
deathly silence accompanying him the entire way.

He didn\'t see Grandma Bai anywhere, and it was as if he were the only
person in this entire world as he arrived at the Dragon Slaying Cliff.

Chen Ping\'an looked up, and someone descended to the training ground as
if splitting open the skies.

Chen Ping\'an\'s heart stirred slightly, and he felt a mysterious sense
of pain as an acupoint, which he had never focused on establishing
before, churned violently. However, this strange feeling disappeared as
quickly as it had arrived.

The person arriving at the Ning Residence was none other than the old
great sword immortal. More accurately, a wisp of the old great sword
immortal\'s soul.

Chen Ping\'an cupped his fists and said, \"Thank you for launching a
sword strike, Old Great Sword Immortal. And thank you again for
concealing this heaven and earth.\"

Chen Qingdu smiled and replied, \"I did indeed launch a sword strike,
but what\'s this about concealing heaven and earth?\"

Chen Ping\'an became even more puzzled.

\"Countless sword cultivators have existed over the past ten thousand
years, but it\'s truly rare for a sword cultivator to remain completely
oblivious to their own bonded flying sword,\" Chen Qingdu said.

He then chuckled and looked around, nodding and saying, \"Remaining
inside yourself, much like a caged sparrow.\"

Chen Ping\'an finally understood the situation.

He felt deeply satisfied.

\"Is it enough to simply trap your enemies inside this heaven and earth?
Where\'s your second bonded flying sword?\" Chen Qingdu asked.

Apart from Chen Ping\'an and Chen Qingdu, countless flying swords
materialized in this heaven and earth at this instant, densely packed
together in layer upon layer.

*Those in my heaven and earth are all caged sparrows.*

*If I\'m not a sword cultivator, then who is?!*

[]{#chapter-132.xhtml}

# Chapter 625: (1): Betrayal

Sword of Coming

Chen Qingdu took a glance at Chen Ping\'an, and the latter immediately
withdrew that unnamed flying sword. He was able to do so on a whim, and
all of his flying swords instantly returned to his acupoint, where they
fused together to become a single sword.

Essentially, the flying sword was traveling in and out of Chen
Ping\'an\'s acupoint completely uninhibited by the river of time, and
this shouldn\'t have been possible.

The only reason why this could happen was that the bonded flying sword
was situated in a small world created by another bonded flying sword,
and the abilities of the two bonded flying swords combined to achieve
this effect.

The bonded items of Qi refiners that just so happened to be flying
swords were ultimately just things left behind by swordsmen, so while
they appeared similar to a swordsman\'s bonded flying sword, there was
actually an enormous fundamental difference between the two.

Even if advanced refinement had been completed on the former, it would
still technically be an external object, whereas the latter had a much
more direct connection to a swordsman and possessed all types of
incredible innate abilities.

Pine Needle and Lightning Devourer were replica swords from Hatred Sword
Mountain, so they were mostly used by Chen Ping\'an as surprise weapons
or tools that would allow him to escape from a battle.

First and Fifteenth once belonged to a sword immortal from ancient
times, and even after Chen Ping\'an completed advanced refinement on
them, he was still unable to use their innate abilities. They were
extremely fast, resilient, and sharp, but that was nowhere near their
full potential. However, despite his best efforts, that was all he could
get out of the two flying swords, but that certainly wasn\'t anything to
complain about.

Chen Ping\'an withdrew the innate ability of his other bonded flying
sword, and the small world that encompassed Chen Ping\'an and Chen
Qingdu on the training ground instantly disappeared.

Bai Lianshuang was standing in the walkway in the distance, watching
from afar.

She had already noticed that something was amiss when Chen Ping\'an
stumbled out of the secret chamber in the Ning Manor, as if in a
sleepwalking state. However, at the time, Chen Ping\'an still hadn\'t
fully awakened yet, and he had no idea that he had already nurtured a
bonded flying sword. He was also oblivious to the fact that the flying
sword had already revealed itself and was using its innate ability to
protect its owner. As a result of the flying sword\'s innate ability, he
had been walking within a small world this entire time.

The presence of Chen Qingdu was no less astonishing to Bai Lianshuang
than the revelation that Chen Ping\'an had finally nurtured a bonded
flying sword, and she hurriedly cupped her fist and extended a
respectful bow toward the old great sword immortal.

Chen Ping\'an took a deep breath, then also cupped his fist and bowed in
gratitude toward Chen Qingdu.

Chen Qingdu slowly made his way onto the Dragon Slaying Cliff with his
hands clasped behind his back, while Chen Ping\'an trailed along behind
him.

\"In the very beginning, she did a great kindness to the human race, and
I\'ve remembered her act of kindness for over ten thousand years,\" Chen
Qingdu mused as he walked along. \"Back when you first came to the Sword
Qi Great Wall, I had actually already noticed. Even though you had
already used up the three wisps of sword qi that she left to you, their
residual aura was extremely familiar to me.

"After all, I was taught my swordsmanship by her former owner. However,
I was concerned that this could be a plot hatched by the people behind
the scenes, and on top of that, I also had some self-serving motives of
my own. If I am to return a favor, then how and when I am to return it
should be for me to decide.

"Hence, I pretended to be oblivious to the hints that she threw at me,
and I didn\'t reconstruct your bridge of immortality, nor did I provide
you with any assistance in nurturing your bonded flying sword, all so I
could be reunited with her someday. I owe her a favor, but I don\'t owe
you anything. If she\'s not happy about it, then she can come to the
Sword Qi Great Wall to see me.\"

Chen Qingdu cast his gaze toward the south, where he could see the city
walls in the distance, and he continued, \"There are countless ancient
figures who were my acquaintances or even my juniors. There are also
countless ancient deities and great demons who were once my enemies or
were even slain by me, but I\'m not going to bore you with all of those
trivial details. It\'s been many years since I\'ve seen the city walls
from so far away.

"I recall that when they were first constructed, I had been standing
with my two good friends, Long Jun and Guan Zhao, on Taixiang Street,
and we joked to ourselves that with such tall city walls, we would be
able to defend the city for ten thousand years. And so we did.\"

Chen Qingdu turned to Chen Ping\'an with a hint of pride in his eyes and
said, \"What you have accomplished today wasn\'t given to you by anyone
else, nor did you have to beg anyone for it. You achieved all of this on
your own.\"

\"I still must thank you for serving as my Dao guardian and Dao
mentor,\" Chen Ping\'an said as he cupped his fist in a grateful salute.

\"If you insist on saying that, then I suppose you can,\" Chen Qingdu
mused. \"If you look back on the process after achieving a positive
outcome, then you\'ll see positives everywhere, whereas if you look back
on life in the wake of a terrible outcome, then you\'ll see negatives at
every turn.\"

\"I\'m only focusing on the positives and expressing my gratitude,\"
Chen Ping\'an replied with a smile. \"I have many gripes and complaints
against you as well, but I don\'t dare to raise them.\"

This was the truth. If he had managed to successfully reconstruct his
bridge of immortality and become a swordsman during his first visit to
the Sword Qi Great Wall, then he would\'ve been able to avoid many
mishaps. He wouldn\'t have had to travel to the Parasol Leaf Continent
with Lasting Sword Qi on his back to seek out the East Sea Observing Dao
Temple, and perhaps he could\'ve avoided that subsequent battle in Old
Dragon City.

He wouldn\'t have been forced to endure that trial of self-reflection at
Bamboo Scroll Lake due to his insufficient cultivation base, and he
wouldn\'t have had to subject himself to so much peril at Skeleton
Shoal, nor would he have had to endure that heavenly tribulation for no
benefit to himself. Everything would\'ve been completely different had
Chen Qingdu reconstructed his bridge of immortality back then. As for
whether that would\'ve ultimately led to a positive or negative outcome,
no one could answer that question, so it was a moot point.

Then there was also the predicament that he had found himself in today
on the Sword Qi Great Wall. If Chen Ping\'an were to raise all of his
gripes, then he could easily complain to Chen Qingdu for days on end.

\"When can I reopen my minimization treasure?\" Chen Ping\'an asked in a
quiet voice. \"Given the urgent state of the war, I\'m going to have to
leave the city with Ning Yao and the others to join the battle at some
point.\"

There was also something else that he had intentionally omitted, which
was that his inability to access his minimization treasure would
severely hamper his money-making operations. If he had to lug around a
massive rucksack of items as a traveling salesman, then the likes of Gu
Jianlong would never let him hear the end of it.

\"Why are you asking me something so trivial when you could go ask Yan
Ming instead?\" Chen Qingdu asked with a puzzled expression.

Initially, Chen Ping\'an was a little suspicious. Yan Ming was someone
that Chen Qingdu clearly had a great deal of trust in, so how could he
possibly have screwed up so badly when it came to his minimization
treasure? However, a look of realization then quickly appeared on Chen
Ping\'an\'s face. This was indeed a trivial matter. He could simply
borrow a minimization treasure from the wealthy Yan Ming.

Chen Qingdu could hardly care less about what Chen Ping\'an was
plotting. By his estimates, Chen Ping\'an was most likely going to
borrow a minimization treasure, but as for whether he would return it,
that was very difficult to say.

Yan Ming wasn\'t all that exceptional as a swordsman, but he was an
expert when it came to making money, so he was especially fond of Chen
Ping\'an. Unlike Yue Qing, whose impression of Chen Ping\'an had
improved over time, Yan Ming had been very impressed with Chen Ping\'an
from the very beginning.

It seemed like Chen Qingdu was a detached senior figure who didn\'t care
about anything, but in reality, he kept tabs on all of the swordsmen on
the Sword Qi Great Wall.

\"Regarding your two bonded flying swords, it\'s not just a simple
matter of one being suited to offense and the other to defense,\" Chen
Qingdu suddenly said. \"The bonded flying swords of the likes of Qi Shou
and Gao Yehou possess a lot of destructive power, but going forward,
their flying swords aren\'t going to be able to work together with one
another to produce as many possibilities as yours. Now that you\'re a
swordsman, you finally have some decent tricks up your sleeve.\"

As he prepared to set off back to the Sword Qi Great Wall, Chen Qingdu
turned to Chen Ping'an and asked, \"How did it feel to have both your
body and soul baptized by both sword intent and the river of time?\"

\"It\'s an infinitely more grueling experience than even the martial
arts training that I underwent back in my hometown,\" Chen Ping\'an
replied with a wry smile. \"I never want to have to go through that
again.\"

\"Well, I\'ve got some bad news for you,\" Chen Qingdu said with a
smile.

Cold sweat immediately began to bead up on Chen Ping\'an\'s forehead,
and he pleaded, \"Please tell me you\'re joking.\"

\"I\'m not,\" Chen Qingdu denied.

\"Whatever you say, Senior,\" Chen Ping\'an sighed, resigning himself to
his fate.

\"This time, the process is going to be much, much slower,\" Chen Qingdu
said with a smile.

\"Why do I still have to go through this when I\'m already a
swordsman?\" Chen Ping\'an asked in a trembling voice.

Instead of answering the question, Chen Qingdu advised, \"A young man
should not harbor resentment.\"

With that, he vanished from the spot.

In the wake of his departure, a small world abruptly appeared,
encompassing the entire Dragon Slaying Cliff and the nearby pergola, one
that even a sword immortal would struggle to break into, even with a
hundred years of persistent effort. Chen Ping\'an was trapped within the
small world, and he collapsed onto his backside in despair in the center
of the pergola.

A streak of sword light came descending from the top of the pergola at
an extremely slow speed, and it crashed down directly onto the top of
Chen Ping\'an\'s head. His entire body instantly became riddled with
cracks, like a piece of porcelain that was on the verge of shattering
into countless pieces. In particular, his head and face, which were the
first parts of his body to come into contact with the sword light,
suffered the most.

If he were capable of releasing his yin soul from his body in this
moment to observe himself, then he would discover that his face had
become even more unsightly than that of the Flying Eagle Fortress
Lord\'s wife.

Not only was his skin and flesh riddled with cracks, but even his
eyeballs were also beginning to crumble, and to further compound his
woes, this torturous transformation was happening at an excruciatingly
slow rate, in complete contrast with the rapid bout of torment that Chen
Ping\'an had been subjected to earlier in the secret chamber.

After the cascading sword light came into contact with the ground, it
didn\'t burst out of the small world. Instead, it was like water pouring
into a well, and the water level gradually rose past Chen Ping\'an\'s
knees.

Other swordsmen only ever cleansed their swords, yet Chen Ping\'an\'s
body had taken the place of his swords to undergo the same process of
cleansing and refinement.

Bai Lianshuang continued to observe from afar, and she murmured to
herself in an elated voice, \"Not only is Young Master Chen not slacking
off after becoming a swordsman, but he\'s also become even more
conscientious in his cultivation!\"

On the Sword Qi Great Wall, Zuo You asked, \"How did it go?\"

\"How do you think it went?\" Chen Qingdu asked with a smile. \"How
could he possibly fail with a senior brother like you?\"

Zuo You was very pleased to hear this, but at the same time, he also
couldn\'t help but feel a little dismayed, and he asked, \"If he has a
bonded flying sword, then why hasn\'t he immediately come to the
battlefield?\"

\"I begged him to come, but now that he\'s a swordsman, he\'s become
super cocky and refused to come,\" Chen Qingdu scoffed.

Zuo You burst into laughter upon hearing this.

\"This is a war, not a battle; that\'s something that your junior
brother understands better than you,\" Chen Qingdu suddenly said.
\"There are some things he told me that I\'ll reveal to you later.\"

\*\*\*

As the demonic army attacked the city, an unexpected and spectacular
sight quickly arose.

Five imposing mountains had appeared on the battlefield, laid out side
by side. They were all extremely tall mountains from the Savage World,
and they had been moved here by the great demon, Zhong Guang. The
Ascension Tier great demon\'s Great Dao foundation had been harmed after
performing this miraculous feat, and he wasn\'t going to take any
further part in the war.

At the moment, he was resting and recuperating far away from the front
lines. The Savage World had to have paid a heavy price to move these
mountains, one that was definitely not just limited to the harm that had
befallen Zhong Guang\'s cultivation base.

For example, the gods of these five mountains were all Upper Five Tiers
mountain deities of the Savage World, and they had already fused their
mountain god temples and godly bodies with the fortune of the five
mountains.

Otherwise, even if the great demons of the Savage World were able to
carry these mountains, it would\'ve been impossible for them to force
their way through the flood of sword qi, so they wouldn\'t have been
able to transport the mountains to this battlefield.

The five mountains were only around half as tall as the Sword Qi Great
Wall, but they posed a massive headache to all of the swordsmen of the
Sword Qi Great Wall.

The five mountains ensured that the demonic army was able to forge ahead
on the battlefield in a quicker and safer fashion, and on each mountain
was a mighty mountain-protection formation. Within the formations were
mighty cultivators of the Savage World, all of whom had essentially
given half their lives to create the formations.

The five mountains had had their mountain roots and water veins severed
before being essentially refined into treasures at the cost of an
unimaginable amount of resources. Only then was Zhong Guang able to
freely move them.

The Savage World had paid an incredibly heavy price to accomplish this
feat, but all of their efforts were clearly paying off here.

At the moment, the woman dressed in dragon robes seemed to have taken
the place of the great demon Bai Ying, serving as the leader of the
demonic army for this stage of the siege.

Her alias was Yang Zhi, and even in the Savage World, the only ones who
were entitled to the knowledge of her true name were all ancient beings
who were extremely close with her. These were all beings that she would
never engage in true battles of life and death against, so she had no
qualms letting them know her true name.

At this point, she had already given all of the rivers and lakes under
and including Elite Cavalry River to another great demon, but prior to
doing so, she had naturally reserved some for herself, directing the
water of several large rivers into her bonded item.

At this moment, she was personally stationed on one of the mountains,
but she hadn\'t revealed her enormous true form. Instead, she looked no
different from a normal woman. There was a smile on her face as she bent
down slightly and released five green water beads out of the sleeve of
her dragon robe, and she called out, \"Go on, it\'s time for you to
become moats.\"
