# Chapter 625: (2): Betrayal

Sword of Coming

A turbulent river appeared at the foot of each of the five mountains,
perfectly encircling them. The water contained a fierce, murderous aura,
and sure enough, the water beads had formed moats around the bases of
the five mountains. Many of the wandering spirits on the battlefield
would\'ve been eventually refined by the pervasive sword qi, but as soon
as they entered the water, they immediately transformed into malicious
ghosts that began swimming in the river.

From the moment the five mountains had first appeared on the
battlefield, a whole host of sword immortals had lashed out with their
flying swords at once, both to attack the mountains and to try and save
the bonded flying swords of many Middle Five Tiers swordsmen.

Even though the sword immortals had reacted extremely quickly, there
were still over a hundred bonded flying swords that were crushed under
the five mountains and pulverized on the spot.

Thankfully, a sword immortal was able to manifest a golden deity using
his bonded flying sword to carry one of the mountains on its shoulders.
In doing so, he was able to successfully impede the mountain\'s descent
for a moment, saving countless Middle Five Tiers swordsmen in the
process.

On this occasion, even Nalan Shaowei was going all out. His bright red
bonded flying sword had transformed into an extremely long and vibrant
flood dragon with flames burning all over its body, and as it wound
itself around one of the mountains, it was able to embed itself deep
into the mountain to cause immense destruction, and the entire mountain
quickly began swaying in an unsteady fashion.

Nalan Shaowei\'s flying sword flood dragon clashed against the mighty
river conjured up by Yang Zhi, and at the same time, Lu Zhi, Yue Qing,
Yao Lianyun, and Li Tuimi were also lashing out at the mountains.

If left unchecked, these mountains were going to have an extremely
potent impact on the state of the battlefield. Essentially, they would
serve as five strongholds for the demonic army, granting them a massive
advantage over the opposing swordsmen of the Sword Qi Great Wall.

Tens of thousands of flying maidens had appeared around the five
mountains. They were all dressed in vibrant robes and holding pipas in
their hands, and it seemed that they were serving as another
mountain-protection formation.

The flying maidens were all playing their pipas, producing an orchestra
of delightful music that varied drastically in style and tone. Wisps of
water fortune spiritual energy were drawn in by the music from their
pipas, rising up as water vapor before condensing to form a series of
green threads that rose high up into the sky. Those green threads became
connected with the five-colored streamers being worn by the flying
maidens, and it was as if a thin green veil had been draped onto the
five mountains.

Li Tuimi lashed out directly at the middle mountain, but his giant
flying sword was caught in the grasp of an inky-black Dao Manifestation
conjured up by Yang Zhi.

Not only was Li Tuimi not concerned in the slightest that his flying
sword was going to be captured, but he also adopted an extremely
aggressive approach, summoning his second bonded flying sword, Silver
Thread, which raced through the air toward the glabella of the Dao
Manifestation, leaving a long line of silver sword light in its wake. On
top of that, he was also flying ahead at full speed with a longsword in
his hand, charging headfirst into the fray with seemingly no concern for
his own safety.

His Dao partner and all three of his direct disciples had perished at
the hands of great demons of Elite Cavalry River.

He was all alone anyway, so what did he have to fear?

\"You\'re a courageous man, I\'ll give you that,\" Yang Zhi praised with
a seductive smile. \"Looks like I\'m just going to have to strip you of
your courage.\"

The five mountains were protected by powerful formations and thousands
of demonic cultivators wielding talismans and treasures, and that
wasn\'t even to mention Yang Zhi herself. There was no way a single
sword immortal could hope to land a meaningful blow on the mountains on
his own.

Zuo You didn\'t care about any of that. He didn\'t know Li Tuimi, and
they had never even spoken before, but the fact that Li Tuimi was
willing to lay down his life in such decisive fashion was enough to earn
Zuo You\'s respect.

He could see that Li Tuimi had already resolved to sacrifice himself. He
was going to detonate his own body and his two bonded flying swords to
destroy as much of the middle mountain as he could, hoping to restore
some parity to the state of the battlefield, which was currently skewed
heavily in the demonic army\'s favor.

If the five mountains were allowed to take root on the battlefield and
develop new mountain roots and water fortune, then they would only
become even more difficult to eradicate.

The difference between all five mountains remaining intact and even just
a single one being ruined was like that between night and day.

Li Tuimi forged ahead with single-minded determination.

It was in times like these when sword immortals needed to step up and
set an example, even if it meant doing so at the cost of their own
lives. What were they supposed to do otherwise? Simply stand by and
watch as Yan Zhuo and all of the other juniors fell to their demise?

Zuo You split the inky-black Dao Manifestation into two with a swing of
his sword.

However, Li Tuimi didn\'t take that opportunity to retreat back to the
city walls. Instead, he crashed straight into the middle mountain
alongside his two flying swords.

\"I\'ll be going ahead, everyone!\"

Yang Zhi\'s brows furrowed slightly as her black dragon robe rose up
from her body, then instantly enshrouded the entire mountain, forming a
protective barrier to stand in Li Tuimi\'s path. If the five mountains
could successfully take root on the battlefield, then the battle
frontier would\'ve essentially been moved several hundred kilometers
closer to the Sword Qi Great Wall.

The ideal situation for the demonic army would be if the opposing sword
immortals weren\'t content to stand by and watch as the mountains
settled on the battlefield, but also didn\'t possess the resolve to do
anything decisive about it. That way, they would send out more and more
people to try and destroy the mountains, only to stop just short each
time, whittling down their forces in the process.

Only sword immortals of at least the Unpolished Jade Tier would have any
chance of striking down the mountains, and the more of them were
sacrificed in vain, the more the tides of war would turn in the Savage
World\'s favor.

The Savage World had intentionally taken it easy in the opening battle,
but this time, they fully intended to kill a good number of sword
immortals and deal the Sword Qi Great Wall a heavy blow.

Li Tuimi\'s immediate resolution to sacrifice himself was the last thing
that Yang Zhi wanted to see.

She hurriedly began communicating with the mighty great demons concealed
within the other four mountains through her mind\'s lake, telling them
not to remain hidden and refrain from retaliation. If the demonic army
were to successfully carry out its plan, then it was of the utmost
importance that the four great demons remained hidden until it was time
for them to be revealed.

Even though Li Tuimi had resolved to detonate his own golden core, soul,
and bonded flying swords, the resulting explosion was already being
suppressed by Yang Zhi\'s celestial-tool-tier Dao robe, so at the very
most, he would only be able to destroy half of the mountain-protection
formation, while the mountain itself would remain largely unharmed.

However, to her surprise, Zuo You lashed out with his sword once again,
slicing through the dragon robe that enshrouded the mountain to ensure
that the impact of Li Tuimi\'s sacrifice would be maximized.

With Zuo You clearing the path, Li Tuimi was able to make his final
sacrifice count. His two bonded flying swords exploded with an almighty
boom, and in the wake of the explosion, not even a single shred of his
soul remained.

Not only was the entire mountain summit destroyed, but all of the
demonic cultivators in the mountain-protection formation below the
Nascent Tier also perished on the spot. As a result, the slowly
stabilizing roots of the mountain were shaken violently.

It was undoubtedly going to be controversial that Zuo You had
essentially just sent Li Tuimi to his doom, but he didn\'t stop there.
Instead of retreating, he descended onto another one of the five
mountains, then grasped the hilt of his sword with both hands before
plunging it into the mountain summit.

*How big could a mountain possibly be? Would it truly be able to
withstand my sword qi?!*

Yang Zhi was furious at this turn of events, but she reacted to the
situation in an immediate and decisive manner. She discarded the
celestial-tool-tier Dao robe to focus on the higher priority, which was
stabilizing the fortune of the mountain, and on top of that, she
continued to urge the other four great demons to remain hidden.

Killing Zuo You was going to be too difficult, so she was going to
personally keep him occupied. The other four mountains had to at least
kill several sword immortals of Li Tuimi\'s caliber. Otherwise, the
second stage of the plan would be reduced to a massive joke.

She revealed her true form, and her massive body instantly rose to the
mountain summit. During her ascent, she crushed many of the demonic
cultivators on the mountain to death, but she could hardly care less.

The Hidden Official had been playing with her own braids this entire
time, and her eyes instantly lit up in excitement at the unexpected
flurry of action unfolding before her.

She turned to look at Chen Qingdu in the distance, and the latter said,
\"You can go play on your own.\"

The Hidden Official crouched down slightly, and a violent tremor ran
through the entire city wall as she launched herself into the distance,
crashing straight through a mountain.

After landing on the ground, she dusted herself off, then began racing
back and forth, using her head to plow through the entire mountain over
and over again.

Whenever she emerged from the mountain, she would always be looking a
little dusty and disheveled, but she seemed to have been thoroughly
enjoying herself.

The two close friends from the Pure White Continent, Zhang Xiao and Li
Ding, exchanged a glance and a smile.

The two sword immortals then departed from the city walls in unison,
soaring through the air atop their flying swords before picking out a
mountain, with one of them landing at the foot of the mountain, while
the other swooped down halfway up the mountain.

Sword Immortal Zhang Xiao stepped straight into the river that branched
off from Elite Cavalry River, then declared with a smile, \"I am
Swordsman Zhang Xiao from the Pure White Continent.\"

Li Ding slowly scaled the mountain, then situated himself right next to
Zhang Xiao with their backs facing one another, and he smiled and said,
\"What a coincidence! I am also a swordsman from the Pure White
Continent.\"

The two of them were calmly embracing death, and they had destroyed the
entire mountain\'s roots and water veins.

Atop the city walls, the old great sword immortal\'s eyes narrowed
slightly as his gaze fell upon a certain spot on the battlefield,
following which he took a step forward.

The old man in gray standing at the northern entrance of the tent smiled
and said, \"There\'s no hurry. You and I will only be responsible for
wrapping things up. As long as you don't take part in the battle, I
definitely won\'t, either. At this point, I\'m sure you\'ve already
gotten used to seeing your juniors die before your eyes one after
another.\"

The old man in gray turned to Yang Zhi before issuing her an
instruction, and the Ascension Tier great demons and Immortal Tier
swordsmen concealed in the mountains immediately revealed themselves.

As for the survival of the thousands of demonic cultivators on the
mountains, whether the mountains would be able to continue to take root
on the battlefield, and how much longer the mountain-protection
formations would be able to withstand the concerted attacks from the
opposing sword immortals, that was no longer important to them.

The four great demons converged toward the middle mountain in unison to
convene with Yang Zhi, and their objective was to kill Zuo You.

A short old man appeared on the scene, standing atop a flying sword, and
he abruptly rose to over a hundred feet tall. Both his hair and brows
were completely white, and he had a long staff resting on his shoulders.
He slowly rose up into the sky atop his flying sword, and during his
ascent, he was gobbling down dozens of pipa-bearing flying maidens each
time he opened his mouth, as if he were munching on beans.

Dong Sangeng launched himself onto the battlefield from the city walls,
and Chen Xi and Qi Tingji wanted to accompany him, but they were stopped
by Chen Qingdu.

\"Let Zuo You be,\" Chen Qingdu said. \"It would do him some good to
test himself in a trial of life and death. There are no good battles for
him to fight in the Majestic World, but he\'ll get plenty of those here.
If everything goes too smoothly for him, he\'ll continue to be a
recluse, and his swordsmanship won\'t improve.\"

Dong Sangeng, Zuo You, and the Hidden Official, who was still playing on
the battlefield, were locked in a confrontation against Yang Zhi, the
staff-bearing old man, and four other great demons.

Standing atop the city walls, Yan Zhuo was biting down on his lower lip
in a tense silence.

Elsewhere, Cheng Quan and Qi Shou\'s attention was focused entirely on
the battlefield, and they failed to notice that Chen Ping\'an had fallen
completely still with a look of struggle on his face.

By the time Chen Ping\'an\'s yin soul regained the ability to move, it
was already too late.

A mishap that was even more massive than the mountains had just appeared
on the battlefield.

The Hidden Official had punched straight through Zuo You\'s sword qi and
blown a hole into his abdomen.

If he hadn\'t reacted just in the nick of time and taken some evasive
measures, that punch would\'ve destroyed his heart.

Zuo You instantly retreated several kilometers, and he was grabbed by
the shoulder by Dong Sangeng, who withstood an all-out attack from the
staff-bearing old man before fleeing with Zuo You.

Aside from a tiny handful of swordsmen on the Sword Qi Great Wall,
everyone was stunned into silence by what they had just witnessed.

The Hidden Official spat out a mouthful of blood, then turned to Chen
Qingdu and gave him the middle finger as she yelled, \"You\'re the one
who deserves to die the most, you old fart!\"

Chen Qingdu only took an expressionless glance at the Hidden Official
before turning his gaze to Dong Sangeng and Zuo You, and he mused to
himself, \"That junior brother of yours told me to be wary of the Hidden
Official.\"

Aside from Dong Sangeng, even Chen Xi and Qi Tingji couldn\'t be fully
trusted. Chen Xi harbored too much resentment, while Qi Tingji was too
ambitious. The two old sword immortals could face the Sword Qi Great
Wall with a clear conscience, but they harbored immense resentment
toward the entire Majestic World. However, when it came to these two
sword immortals, Chen Ping\'an was ultimately unable to predict whether
they would definitely defect to the Savage World.

On the ground below, the Hidden Official made a beckoning motion, and
Zhu An and Luo Shan, who were in the process of attacking a nearby
mountain, immediately stopped what they were doing before arriving by
her side. From there, the three of them turned their backs on the Sword
Qi Great Wall and made their way toward the Savage World.

Looking on from afar, Pang Yuanji collapsed to the ground atop the city
walls, tears streaming down his face.

He couldn\'t understand why this had happened.

Chen Ping\'an was finally able to move again, but he didn\'t go to
confront Chen Qingdu for intentionally hiding the truth, nor did he go
to visit the severely wounded Zuo You. It was never easy to judge who
was right and who was wrong. Thus, Chen Ping\'an merely sat down on the
spot and opened his folding fan, peering over it onto the southern
battlefield as he mused to himself, \"Looks like we have a battle on our
hands.\"

> Anyone knows what\'s going on? lol

[]{#chapter-134.xhtml}

# Chapter 626: (1): The New Hidden Official

Sword of Coming

This turned out to be a very short battle that was restricted to a very
small scale, but mass casualties had been suffered on both sides.

The Savage World didn\'t immediately launch another attack.

Clearly, this had been an extremely unexpected outcome for everyone, so
they had to regroup and adjust their plans in accordance with the recent
turn of events.

Of the five mountains, the middle one had been completely destroyed as
collateral damage resulting from the battle between Zuo You and Yang
Zhi. Another one had had its mountain roots and water fortune destroyed
at the cost of the lives of the two foreign sword immortals from the
Pure White Continent, following which it was split apart by Lu Zhi.

As for the remaining three mountains, they were also in terrible
condition. One of them had been severely ravaged by Luo Shan and Zhu An.
That was the final contribution that the two sword immortals had made to
the Sword Qi Great Wall before defecting to the Savage World.

The three mountains had been abandoned, and the few demonic cultivators
on the mountains who were fortunate enough to have survived could only
await their fate. Even if they tried to get away, it wouldn\'t do them
any good. Their lives were already intertwined with the mountains.
However, some of them refused to go down without a fight, and they
called upon their comrades to reactivate the mountain-protection
formations to resist to the death.

Sword Immortal Zhao Geyi sought out Cheng Quan, and the two of them flew
toward a mountain together. Zhao Geyi was planning to protect Cheng Quan
while the latter did his best to refine the mountain for himself.

\"I can\'t even leave the city now without feeling like a traitor!\"
Cheng Quan spat through gritted teeth. \"Before today, I considered both
Zhu An and Luo Shan as close friends that I would\'ve gladly laid down
my life for! Are you going to stab me in the back at some point as well,
Zhao Geyi? If you are, then hurry up and just do it now! Let me die fast
so I don\'t have time to feel disgusted!\"

\"Shut the hell up!\" Zhao Geyi snapped. \"I have no clue what Song
Caiyun sees in a useless piece of trash like you!\"

Cheng Quan fell into a dejected silence.

The Sword Qi Great Wall had secured victory in this battle, but none of
the swordsmen in the city felt any joy at this outcome.

Not only had the Hidden Official betrayed the Sword Qi Great Wall and
defected to the Savage World with Luo Shan and Zhu An, but she had also
made sure to deal a heavy blow to the near-invincible Zuo You before she
went.

Her betrayal had cast a shadow over the sword hearts of virtually
everyone in the city, particularly the younger swordsmen.

Chen Ping\'an strapped his folding fan back to his waist, then set off
for the thatched cottage on his talismanic boat.

The thatched cottage once served as Wei Jin\'s temporary residence, and
at this moment, Zuo You was seated beside the bed, using sword qi to
help him heal the hole that had been blown into his abdomen.

\"How the hell did this happen, Chen Qingdu?!\" Dong Sangeng roared in a
furious voice at the entrance. \"Has the Hidden Official gone insane?!\"

Chen Qingdu was standing on the city wall in the distance, and he
didn\'t even bother to turn around as he replied, \"You saw what
happened. There\'s nothing more for me to add.\"

Dong Sangeng was furious because he had always been very fond of the
Hidden Official, feeling like she was one of the few people who walked
the same path as him. Furthermore, Dong Guanpu, once his most prized
grandson, had also gotten along really well with the Hidden Official in
the past.

Dong Sangeng had already spotted Chen Ping\'an, but he showed no signs
of relenting as he yelled, \"You should\'ve killed her just now!\"

\"Dong Guanpu\'s collusion with the Savage World was widespread
knowledge on the entire Sword Qi Great Wall; you think I didn\'t know?\"
Chen Qingdu sneered. \"Despite that, did I kill him before all of you
turned things into a massive farce?\"

Chen Ping\'an pretended not to be able to hear anything. He had
personally witnessed the old great sword immortal putting an end to Dong
Guanpu\'s life atop the city walls. However, at the time, he still
thought about things in a very simple and naive fashion, so he didn\'t
truly understand what kind of place the Sword Qi Great Wall was.

What puzzled him the most was something that Ning Yao had said after the
event. Specifically, she had referred to Grandpa Little Dong as a good
person. It was true that Dong Guanpu had betrayed the Sword Qi Great
Wall, but it was also true that he was a good person, so how was one
supposed to evaluate him?

Perhaps to the old great sword immortal, the task of defending the Sword
Qi Great Wall really was just that, nothing more and nothing less.

Dong Sangeng had to fight to suppress his fury, and he informed Chen
Ping\'an that Zuo You wasn\'t in any life-threatening danger, then
stormed away without another word.

Instead of entering the thatched cottage, Chen Ping\'an gently closed
the door.

After witnessing such an epic battle, one in which both sword immortals
and great demons had fallen in great numbers, he felt even smaller and
more insignificant.

After seeing the decisions made by Chen Qingdu, Chen Ping\'an felt like
if he had to undergo the trial of self-reflection at Bamboo Scroll Lake
again, even if he still had the same cultivation base as he did back
then, he would\'ve been able to negotiate the trial with ease.

Chen Ping\'an only stayed briefly at the thatched cottage before going
to meet up with Ning Yao and the others.

Ning Yao took a glance at Yan Zhuo, then shook her head at Chen
Ping\'an.

Chen Ping\'an nodded in response, indicating that he understood the
delicate nature of the situation.

Yan Zhuo\'s hands were balled up into tight fists, and he was having to
fight back tears.

Back when he was a boy, Li Tuimi had been the one that he resented the
most. Many of the hurtful remarks that had felt most scathing to him had
been directed at him by none other than Li Tuimi, making him a
laughingstock to the entire Sword Qi Great Wall. Given the status of the
Yan Clan on the Sword Qi Great Wall, no one would\'ve dared to bully and
deride him so severely had it not been for the example set by Li Tuimi.

Even after Yan Zhuo became a true swordsman, putting his life on the
line over and over again on the battlefield, Li Tuimi still constantly
looked down on him. He begged Li Tuimi on several occasions to instruct
him in swordsmanship, but Li Tuimi kept sneering at him each time,
telling him that an inept old fart like himself was unworthy of
instructing the young master of the Yan Clan.

It was only recently that Li Tuimi finally agreed to instruct him in
swordsmanship, and even though he always carried out his lessons with a
stern expression, there was always a hint of a smile in his eyes. He had
also finally stopped insulting Yan Zhuo, yet just as Yan Zhuo thought
that he had finally earned the old sword immortal\'s approval, the
latter became the first sword immortal to perish on the battlefield.

Chen Ping\'an sat down beside Yan Zhuo in silence, knowing that the
latter didn\'t require any commiserations or words of consolation from
him.

This was the Sword Qi Great Wall, where everyone was accustomed to
losing loved ones. In a sense, Li Tuimi could almost be considered
fortunate for the fact that he was finally going to be reunited with his
loved ones in the afterlife.

\"Are you alright?\" Ning Yao asked as she sat down beside Chen
Ping\'an.

\"I\'m doing great,\" Chen Ping\'an replied in a quiet voice.

Ning Yao had many questions that she wanted to ask him, so many that she
didn\'t know where to start.

\"Don\'t think about anything,\" Chen Ping\'an said in a gentle voice.
\"Leave all the thinking to me.\"

The two of them looked out to the south together.

\"I\'m not getting in your way, am I?\" Yan Zhuo suddenly asked.

Chen Ping\'an opened his folding fan, then began fanning Ning Yao as he
smiled and said, \"I think we should all be more self-aware.\"

Dong Huafu was just about to sit down beside Ning Yao, but he
immediately froze on the spot in a half-standing, half-squatting
position.

However, Chen Sanqiu had no such qualms, and he sat down beside Yan
Zhuo. Fan Dache then sat down beside Dong Huafu, while Die Zhang sat
down beside Chen Sanqiu, and everyone looked into the distance together,
quietly waiting for the next battle.

Pang Yuanji was still in a daze, staring off into space in a blank,
soulless silence.

Gao Youqing had been sitting beside him this entire time, and he wanted
to say something, but didn\'t dare to.

Gao Yehou sat down beside Pang Yuanji, then said concisely, \"Endure
it.\"

Pang Yuanji turned to him with an unfocused gaze.

\"If you truly want to find out the answer, then you can\'t allow
yourself to wallow in despair and self-pity,\" Gao Yehou continued.
\"Instead, you must strive to challenge the Hidden Official someday and
make her explain herself to you!\"

\"You\'re not me, nor am I you,\" Pang Yuanji murmured. \"It can\'t be
done.\"

\"Fine. In that case, today is the day that the Hidden Official lineage
comes to an end,\" Gao Yehou said with a chuckle.

A little girl had snuck onto the scene behind them, and she crossed her
arms and declared, \"It\'s decided then! I will take over the position
of Hidden Official!\"

Pang Yuanji turned to her with a bleak smile and asked, \"Why didn\'t
you leave the Sword Qi Great Wall? Sword Immortal Guo Jia and Chen
Ping\'an both hoped that you would leave.\"

Guo Zhujiu\'s eyes were bright as she shook her head and replied, \"No
matter how much I respect and admire my father and my master, I can\'t
just do everything that they say. As a swordsman, you have to live and
die on your own terms, don\'t you?\"

Pang Yuanji could only shake his head with a wry smile. He knew all the
principles, but what did that matter?

\"That was very well said, Lü Duan,\" Gao Yehou praised with a
thumbs-up.

\"Why are you praising me?\" Guo Zhujiu asked. \"You should be praising
my master for teaching me well. That way, you\'ll be praising two people
at once with a single compliment. You\'re not that bright, are you?\"

Gao Yehou didn\'t know what to say.

Ning Yao and Dong Bude were perhaps the only ones who could claim the
upper hand when dealing with Lü Duan.

Gao Youqing was unable to suppress her amusement, and she burst into
laughter through her tears.

Guo Zhujiu turned to her with a sympathetic expression and said, \"Look
at you, crying and laughing at the same time; there must be something
wrong with you upstairs!\"

Gao Youqing tugged on Gao Yehou\'s sleeve with a disgruntled expression,
and the latter scoffed. \"Oh, so *now* you come to me!\"

Guo Zhujiu imitated her master, tucking her hands up their opposite
sleeves as she turned to depart.

Pang Yuanji continued looking toward the south with a forced smile on
his face, as if he were hoping to see his mistress one more time.

On the Sword Qi Great Wall, all those who were familiar with Zhang Xiao
and Li Ding were also in a collective state of mourning.

The two sword immortals were renowned for their detachment from worldly
affairs, yet they had just perished on the battlefield.

Among the thirty-two swordsmen from the Pure White Continent, Zhang Xiao
and Li Ding possessed the loftiest cultivation bases, both at the
Unpolished Jade Tier.

The Pure White Continent had just about the fewest number of swordsmen
on the Sword Qi Great Wall out of all of the continents, yet they had
never been discriminated against here. However, deep down, this was
something that weighed on them.

There was no point in comparing themselves with the Northern Complete
Reed Continent, as that was the continent where swordsmen were most
abundant in the Majestic World. As for the Southern Whirl Continent,
that was the nearest continent to Stalactite Mountain and the Sword Qi
Great Wall, so there was no need for a comparison there, either.

However, the Circling Ascension Continent, the Flowing Dawn Continent,
and the Golden Armor Continent all had more swordsmen on the Sword Qi
Great Wall than the Pure White Continent.

Of the only two continents with fewer swordsmen than the Pure White
Continent, one of them was the smallest Eastern Treasured Vial
Continent. However, they were represented by Wei Jin, a young sword
immortal who could compete against native sword immortals in both
aptitude and accomplishments, and Chen Ping\'an, who had earned
everyone\'s respect despite not being a swordsman himself.

The final continent was the Parasol Leaf Continent, which was renowned
for keeping to itself.

The Eastern Treasured Vial Continent was rife with internal conflict,
while great demons were wreaking havoc on the Parasol Leaf Continent.

In contrast, everything was fine and peaceful on the Pure White
Continent, and its intercontinental ships were reaping great profits
from Stalactite Mountain.

The heroic sacrifices made by Zhang Xiao and Li Ding should\'ve been
something for the other swordsmen of the Pure White Continent to be
proud of, yet they didn\'t feel that way at all. Instead, they only felt
even more disgruntled.

Somewhere atop the city walls was a group of scholars dressed in
Confucian robes.

Chen Chun\'an was among them, and there was a grim look on his face.

Chen Shi was standing together with Liu Xianyang and Qin Zhengxiu, and
he sighed in concern. \"If we make a stand against the enemy, then more
and more people will die, but if we don\'t make a stand, then all of the
sacrifices that have already been made will go in vain. Li Tuimi, Zhang
Xiao, Li Ding\... If I were the old great sword immortal, my Dao Heart
would\'ve crumbled long ago.\"

Liu Xianyang squatted down with a grass stalk in his mouth, and he said
in a muffled voice, \"The old great sword immortal has presided over the
Sword Qi Great Wall for so long that everyone takes him for granted. No
one really stops to consider what he thinks and how he feels.\"

\"Over the past ten thousand years, we\'ve endured a total of ninety-six
wars without a single defeat,\" Qin Zhengxiu said.

\"The war is not just being waged on the southern battlefields, but also
in the hearts of those in the north,\" Liu Xianyang said. \"Hence, there
have always been both victories and defeats.\"

\"Our Majestic World cannot avoid culpability for our grave missteps,\"
Chen Chun\'an suddenly declared, and he had spoken outright instead of
through his mind\'s lake.

Aside from Liu Xianyang, everyone else\'s expressions instantly changed
slightly upon hearing this.

\*\*\*

The Hidden Official swaggered into the tent with Luo Shan and Zhu An.

The old man in gray was standing outside the tent, and he smiled and
said, \"You don\'t have to worry about having no one to fight on our
side. You\'re free to challenge any Ascension Tier great demon that
hasn\'t played a role in this battle. If you kill them, and someone
dares to complain about it, then you can kill them as well.\"

The Hidden Official nodded in response, then began playing with one of
her pigtails as she grinned and demanded, \"Once we reach the Majestic
World, I want half a continent to myself, and I want to be able to kill
every single Upper Five Tiers cultivator on that half-continent!\"

The old man in gray saw no reason to refuse. In his eyes, the little
girl standing before him was the finest prospect in all of the Savage
World. Her Great Dao couldn\'t have been more aligned with the Savage
World, and staying by Chen Qingdu\'s side would\'ve been like constant
torture for her. The Sword Qi Great Wall was never the place where she
was destined to cultivate.

Instead, it was more like a cage that kept her true self restricted and
confined. The Hidden Official had grown up for her entire life on the
Sword Qi Great Wall, and she possessed a bonded flying sword, but she
virtually never used it in battle. At the very most, she would only
wield a longsword on the battlefield, and she would switch to using her
fists once the sword was broken.

The old man in gray had very few regrets, but one of them was that the
Hidden Official hadn\'t been born in the Savage World and didn\'t get to
go and cultivate on Holding Moon Mountain from a young age. Otherwise,
the hierarchy of the fourteen spots in that ancient well would\'ve been
significantly shaken up.

At this moment, the old man in gray was accompanied by only a single
person, namely the bearded man who was carrying both a saber and a
sword.

Luo Shan turned to the man and asked, \"Why didn't you try to stop Dong
Sangeng from saving Zuo You?\"

\"I don\'t need to explain to anyone my reasons for who I choose or
choose not to kill,\" the bearded man replied in an indifferent voice.
\"I\'m only answering your question because you\'re a sword immortal and
a woman, but I suggest you don\'t test my patience any further beyond
this.\"

Luo Shan was just about to say something, but Zhu An grabbed onto her
wrist to stop her.

\"There\'s no need to be cautious and restrained,\" the old man in gray
said with a smile. \"According to the rules established by Holding Moon
Mountain, you are both esteemed guests of our Savage World. If Liu Cha
dares to raise his sword against you, then he\'ll be raising his sword
to Holding Moon Mountain, isn\'t that right?\"

The old man turned to Liu Cha as he spoke, while the latter remained
silent.

\"Our Savage World is indeed just a savage, uncultured place,\" the old
man in gray continued. \"This place isn\'t the Sword Qi Great Wall, and
it certainly isn\'t the Majestic World. I don\'t have many rules, only a
few, but anyone who breaks any of those rules will pay with their
lives.\"

\"Oh, by the way, make sure you don\'t kill that stupid disciple of
mine, Pang Yuanji, no matter how hard he tries to get himself killed,\"
the Hidden Official said with a serious expression. \"I still want him
to challenge me over and over again in the future.\"

\"You don\'t need to speak to me about something so trivial; just get
Luo Shan and Zhu An to spread the message to everyone,\" the old man in
gray replied with an exasperated smile.

\"What do I do then?\" the Hidden Official asked.

\"If you\'re bored, then you can go kill all of the great demons hiding
in what Chen Qingdu calls the rat\'s nest,\" the old man in gray said.
\"Perhaps that\'ll help you make a breakthrough.\"

\"Are you worried that I\'ll work with Chen Qingdu from the inside to
beat you all up?\" the Hidden Official asked.

If she were to go to the rat\'s nest and kill all of the Ascension Tier
great demons there, her cultivation base would undoubtedly advance, but
at the same time, she would be integrating herself with the Heavenly Dao
of the Savage World, at which point her life would be intertwined with
the Savage World.

That was the price that she had to pay if she wanted to overcome her
Ascension Tier bottleneck and become an undying being like the blind old
man. In order to rise beyond the Ascension Tier, one had to use their
own internal small world to refine a part of the greater world around
them, and if they could refine an entire world, then they would become a
transcendent existence on par with the Paramount Sage, the Buddha, and
the Dao Ancestor!

[]{#chapter-135.xhtml}

# Chapter 626: (2): The New Hidden Official

Sword of Coming

\"Do you want to go or not?\" the old man in gray chuckled.

A wide smile appeared on the Hidden Official\'s face, and she
immediately flew away as a streak of light, racing directly toward the
rat\'s nest.

What was there for her to refine on the Sword Qi Great Wall? The Sword
Qi Great Wall itself? The Sword Qi Great Wall was Chen Qingdu; Chen
Qingdu was the Sword Qi Great Wall!

However, the Savage World was different because even the old man in gray
hadn\'t refined the entire world, so she still had chances, and perhaps
she could even compete against the old man in gray in the future.

\"Is it a good idea to be giving her so much?\" Liu Cha asked with
tightly furrowed brows.

\"I can\'t let you and Zhou Mi have everything,\" the old man in gray
chuckled. \"Once Chen Qingdu dies, it\'ll be about time for the
Etiquette Sage to meet me in the Majestic World. Let\'s see if great
heroes really do step up in times of crisis as the scholars of the
Majestic World claim.\"

\"What about Bai Ze?\" Liu Cha asked.

\"He\'s in about the same situation as the blind old man,\" the old man
in gray sneered. \"He\'s utterly disappointed in everyone and won\'t
help either side.\"

\"There can be light in the deepest depths of darkness,\" Liu Cha said.

\"Have you considered in which world that phrase is more applicable?\"
the old man in gray asked with a smile. \"The Majestic World is already
on a decline, while we are ascending. Soon enough, the gap between our
two worlds will become insurmountable. Once we reach the Majestic World,
it\'ll be time for you to draw your sword and saber.\"

\"Of course,\" Liu Cha replied with a nod.

The old man in gray patted Liu Cha on the shoulder and continued, \"Once
we get to the Majestic World, you\'ll be sure to have an opportunity to
meet A\'Liang again. When that time comes, I\'ll let you have a
continent in the Majestic World as a prize for whichever one wins the
battle between you two.\"

A\'Liang had traveled to many places in the Savage World and slain many
demons, but he had also made a true friend there, and that was Liu Cha.

After returning to the Sword Qi Great Wall, A\'Liang had spoken quite
highly of Liu Cha to some children, describing him as a loyal and
generous man who was well-versed in both poetry and song.

Of course, he then immediately reverted back to his normal demeanor,
spitting onto his hands to smooth down his hair before \"revealing the
truth.\"

\"He\'s a remarkable guy, but ultimately, he was still won over by my
charm and flair, and he even tried to gift his sword to me. I refused,
so he drew his saber and used it as a brush to write a poem to honor me.
Of course, I\'m a legitimate scholar, so his poetry was never going to
impress me, but I suppose it\'s the thought that counts. Anyway, if any
of you ever run into Liu Cha on the battlefield, don\'t be afraid. If
you can\'t beat him, then tell him that you\'re A\'Liang\'s friend.\"

As a self-proclaimed scholar, A\'Liang had never once dressed as a
scholar during his century-long stay on the Sword Qi Great Wall, and by
the time he left, he didn\'t even have a sword anymore. Instead, all he
had was a saber and his conical bamboo hat.

Unbeknownst to anyone else, Chen Qingdu had given him a very solemn
parting message: \"Don\'t come back here again. As an outsider who\'s
stayed on the Sword Qi Great Wall for this long, even if you didn\'t
leave, I would\'ve kicked you out.\"

A\'Liang patted the old great sword immortal on the shoulder as he
grinned, \"If you come across any fine wine, make sure to save it for
me. It\'s up to me whether I drink it or not, but you gotta make sure to
save some for me. However, if the Sword Qi Great Wall turns on the
Majestic World, then I won\'t be returning. No matter how fine the wine
is, who would I have to share it with?\"

\*\*\*

After Bai Ying and Yang Zhi, the next great demon to preside over the
demonic army was Huang Luan, who possessed thousands of palaces,
pavilions, and pagodas.

As usual, Huang Luan was sitting alone on the railing, giving her the
appearance of a celestial maiden residing in an ethereal immortal city
in the heavens.

All twenty-four solar terms were playing out in the city at once, and
one could experience all four seasons within its boundaries.

The residence in the city where Huang Luan was currently situated was
home to her most beloved Ruoye Creek. The flowing water in the creek was
extremely clear, and on its bank was an elderly fisherman and some women
who were washing clothes and collecting lotus flowers. All of them were
formed by talismans, and they repeated the same activities year after
year.

Beneath this city atop the clouds was the steadily advancing demonic
army, which consisted entirely of cultivators. There were over fifty
thousand of them, and they were all at least at the Abode Tier, with
spirit tools and immortal treasures to boot.

There was a flood of flying swords surging toward the south from the
Sword Qi Great Wall, and in opposition, there was a mighty river of
countless spirit tools and immortal treasures crashing toward the north.

The demons had already decided to pledge half of the power of their
entire world to attack the Sword Qi Great Wall, and their determination
was certainly on full display.

There were no sinister conspiracies or elaborate plans; it was just a
direct clash of power and resources.

If Yang Zhi had managed to plant the five mountains onto the
battlefield, then the losses suffered by the Sword Qi Great Wall
would\'ve been even more severe.

However, Li Tuimi and Zuo You had completely disrupted their plans. Not
only were they not able to kill more Immortal Tier swordsmen, they very
nearly ended up with nothing at all to show for their efforts. Yang
Zhi\'s shortcomings had also thrown a wrench into Huang Luan\'s plans.

Otherwise, if she had been closer to the city walls, then the demonic
army would\'ve been sure to have suffered casualties at a much faster
rate, but the swordsmen of the Sword Qi Great Wall would\'ve had to
sacrifice more of their bonded flying swords as well.

Five Upper Five Tiers mountain gods and thousands of talismanic
cultivators had all sacrificed themselves to refine the five mountains
so that Zhong Guang could carry them to the battlefield, and these
sacrifices were all on record.

If it weren\'t for the massive saving grace that was the Hidden
Official\'s betrayal, then Yang Zhi would\'ve been in huge trouble.

At the moment, things were taken into much more meticulous consideration
in the demonic army than they had been in the past. Those tents weren\'t
just there for show. Some of the cultivators in the tents weren\'t
particularly impressive in terms of cultivation base, and many of them
were even young children, but any order that came out of those tents had
to be taken seriously even by the likes of Huang Luan, Yang Zhi, and Bai
Ying.

Huang Luan raised a hand up high before waving it forward, and the
demonic army released their treasures all at once.

The vast torrent of treasures resembled a resplendent river of stars in
the night, and even an old demon who had been around for as long as
Huang Luan had to admit that it was a stunning sight to behold; she just
didn\'t know how many more times she would get to see it.

According to the outcomes of past divination, it seemed that such
opportunities would be difficult to come by once they reached the
Majestic World.

All of a sudden, an intrigued look appeared on Huang Luan\'s face, and
she opened the restriction with a smile and remarked, \"What a rare
guest!\"

It was none other than Yang Zhi, who was currently wearing linen
garments after her Dao robe was destroyed. She had managed to salvage
most of the scraps, but mending it simply wasn\'t worth the effort and
cost, and she would be better off simply going to the Majestic World and
taking some Dao robes from others.

She sat down beside the railing with a sullen expression.

\"What\'re you doing here?\" Huang Luan asked with a smile. \"Are you
trying to steal the credit from me?\"

\"I\'m just here to help you out and make myself useful,\" Yang Zhi
sighed. \"Our patriarch didn\'t say anything excessively severe, but it
was clear that he wasn\'t happy with my performance. After this battle,
I\'ll have to return to the Savage World right away to hunt down the
sword immortals who are wreaking havoc everywhere as a form of
self-redemption.\"

Huang Luan cast a slightly forlorn gaze toward a certain spot on the
Sword Qi Great Wall. Even she hadn\'t been tipped off in advance about
the Hidden Official\'s defection, and she had no idea it was going to
happen.

\"When are our pawns in the northern city and on Stalactite Mountain
going to make their move?\" Yang Zhi asked.

\"How am I supposed to know that?\" Huang Luan chuckled.

The demonic army down below continued to advance onward while hurling
more treasures at the city walls up ahead.

The mighty rivers of sword qi and immortal treasures clashed with the
force of a thousand suns, presenting an incredibly marvelous spectacle
to behold. It was as if countless stars were constantly spraying in all
directions, illuminating the night to be as bright as day.

Aside from that, there were also some soldiers charging forward from
either flank of the demonic army, and it was not just for show. Instead,
they were truly sacrificing their lives to try and advance the demonic
army. This was the \"helping hand\" that Yang Zhi had been referring to.
The soldiers running ahead on this suicide charge were all directly
under her command.

In order to make amends, she obviously couldn\'t just sit beside Huang
Luan to look at the scenery, or launch a few attacks at the oncoming
stream of sword qi whenever it suited her. She had to actually do
something substantial, and in this case, it meant completely sacrificing
several branches of soldiers that had taken her a long time to nurture
and develop.

The best thing about the Savage World was that everyone was absolutely
obedient to those more powerful than them. If you didn\'t want to be
forced to sacrifice yourself, then you would have to die on your own
terms before that.

\"Since when did the sword immortals of the Sword Qi Great Wall learn to
work together in such a cohesive fashion?\" Huang Luan suddenly mused
with a faint smile. \"At this rate, the losses suffered by the enemy
will surely be lower than projected. Is your bad luck rubbing off on me,
Yang Zhi? Look at them!

"Even the likes of Yue Qing and Mi Hu, and a bunch of sword immortals
who purportedly aren\'t on very good terms with each other, are suddenly
working together as a united front. It\'s nothing out of the ordinary to
see two or three sword immortals working together seamlessly, but I\'ve
never seen so many of them willing to set aside their differences like
this. What\'re we supposed to do now?\"

\"Be that as it may, their resistance is still futile,\" Yang Zhi
sneered with a cold look in her eyes.

Huang Luan observed the ongoing battle for a moment, then lamented,
\"They\'ve all just retreated a kilometer together like a well-oiled
machine! Is this really still the Sword Qi Great Wall we\'re dealing
with right now?\"

\"Why are you still just watching and not doing anything?\" Yang Zhi
asked.

\"I\'m trying to put those young guys in the tents through some
adversity,\" Huang Luan explained with a smile. \"I don\'t think we\'re
going to suffer too heavy a loss on this battlefield anyway, and if we
want to be able to contend with the Majestic World, then our demonic
army can\'t just rely solely on a few great demons like ourselves.\"

Yang Zhi turned in a certain direction. There, in the extremely far
distance, was another, even larger battlefield, one that she was yet to
visit, and it was rife with native swordsmen of the Savage World.

No matter how precious these swordsmen were, they had to be sent into
battle at some point. Otherwise, they would simply be sitting around,
doing nothing.

Only those who could hone their swords using the Sword Qi Great Wall as
their whetstone and live to tell the tale could be considered true
swordsmen.

\*\*\*

Over on the Sword Qi Great Wall, a strange group had been assembled. The
group consisted of around a dozen people, roughly half of whom were
outsiders.

They had been gathered as the newest swordsmen of the Hidden Official\'s
branch, and it was the first time in the history of the Hidden Official
lineage that outsiders were being recruited.

After assembling everyone, Lu Zhi quickly departed, only leaving behind
a pair of picture scrolls sent to the Sword Qi Great Wall by Daoist
sages.

The two massive scrolls had been unfurled and laid out by Lu Zhi on the
carriageway, and one of them depicted the clashing rivers of sword qi
and treasures.

As for the other one, it presented a scene further south of the
battlefield, where the tents of the demonic army were situated. The
image was rather blurry and unclear, but the scene became clearer and
clearer the more it moved toward the north. It was as if there were some
type of barrier separating the two areas.

All Lu Zhi told everyone was that they were now considered part of the
Hidden Official\'s branch, and that they wouldn\'t have to go into
battle for now. That was the extent of her message, and she didn\'t
offer any further elaboration.

The vast majority of the swordsmen were left exchanging puzzled glances
with one another.

Many of them didn\'t even know each other, and they had no idea what
they were supposed to do.

Mi Yu was the most awkward one of all as he was the only Upper Five
Tiers swordsman in the group.

Given that he possessed the loftiest cultivation base out of everyone,
he decided to take charge, and he said, \"Let\'s all introduce
ourselves. My name is Mi Yu, and I am an Unpolished Jade Tier
swordsman.\"

\"I am Lin Junbi from the Middle Earth Divine Continent, and I\'ve only
just reached the Dragon Gate Tier.\"

From there, everyone else made their self-introductions one after
another.

\"Pure White Continent, Deng Liang, Nascent Tier.\"

\"Circling Ascension Continent, Song Gaoyuan, Golden Core Tier.\"

\"Flowing Dawn Continent, Cao Gun, Dragon Gate Tier.\"

\"Golden Armor Continent, Xuan Can, Golden Core Tier.\"

The rest of the group consisted of Pang Yuanji, Dong Bude, Situ Weiran,
Gu Jianlong, Wang Xinshui, Guo Zhujiu, and Chen Ping\'an.

Guo Zhujiu was ecstatic to see her master here, and the two of them were
squatting down beside one another with their hands tucked up their
opposite sleeves, looking as if they had been cast out of the same mold.

Guo Zhujiu immediately began applauding vigorously after her master
declared his name and cultivation base.

\"Where\'s your composure?\" Chen Ping\'an asked as he turned to his
disciple with a smile.

Guo Zhujiu immediately stopped applauding and began nodding vigorously.

\"Even if these demons retreat, we\'re definitely still going to have to
deal with a whole host of enemy swordsmen. That\'s likely the reason why
we\'ve been gathered here,\" Lin Junbi analyzed. \"Let\'s think about
some possible courses of action that the enemy could take and devise
some plans accordingly.

"Aside from Sword Immortal Mi, none of us are particularly advanced in
cultivation base, so we\'re not going to be able to play any important
roles in the battle. Hence, our job is just to fill in some holes, and
we could make ourselves useful if we can think of some good ideas.\"

While Lin Junbi was speaking, Chen Ping\'an sat with his legs crossed at
the edge of the picture scrolls, gently tapping his palm with his
folding fan as he observed the scenes unfolding in them.

Lin Junbi turned his gaze to Mi Yu, and the latter nodded and put on a
composed smile, but in reality, he felt incredibly awkward and uneasy,
as did Gu Jianlong.

Lin Junbi turned his gaze to Chen Ping\'an, who smiled and said, \"I\'m
happy to follow your lead.\"

This came as a bit of a surprise to Lin Junbi, but he quickly accepted
his role as the strategist of the group.

Looking down at the battlefield below, it was as if he were presiding
over a Go board, and his opponent on the other side of the board was the
entire Savage World. If he could help the Sword Qi Great Wall even just
a little, then he would already be making a contribution that was
massively beyond what was expected of him.

With that in mind, Lin Junbi immediately sprang into action, assigning
missions to everyone else in the group.

Meanwhile, Chen Ping\'an turned to Gu Jianlong and greeted, \"Fancy
meeting you here, Brother Gu!\"

Gu Jianlong immediately rushed over to Chen Ping\'an\'s side before
squatting down with a fawning look on his face, and he said, \"I
wouldn\'t dare to make the esteemed second shopkeeper refer to me as a
brother; you can just call me Junior Gu instead.\"

A series of short desks were laid out onto the carriageway, and each
person sat down with their legs crossed behind their assigned desk.
Among them, Mi Hu was responsible for recording the information that was
gathered, after which Guo Zhujiu would hand out the records for everyone
to read.

As for the more important pieces of intelligence, those could simply be
conveyed verbally as everyone was situated quite close to one another
anyway.

Out of everyone in the group, Chen Ping\'an was the only one who hadn\'t
been assigned any duties, and the reason for this was very simple.

Earlier, Lu Zhi had sent someone to deliver the desks, writing brushes,
ink, and paper, and they had also delivered a message on her behalf.
\"From this moment forth, Chen Ping\'an will be the Sword Qi Great
Wall\'s new Hidden Official.\"

Mi Hu was rather dismayed to hear this, while Pang Yuanji was very
relieved.

He didn\'t care who inherited the position as long as it wasn\'t him,
and in his eyes, having Chen Ping\'an fill the role was the ideal
outcome.

In the wake of Chen Ping\'an\'s assignment, Guo Zhujiu erupted into such
thunderous applause that it sounded like a whole party of people
clapping at once.

Chen Ping\'an was the youngest Hidden Official in the history of the
Sword Qi Great Wall and also the one with the lowest cultivation base.
He stood up to accept the ancient jade tablet that represented the
status of the Hidden Official, then sat back down with the jade tablet
hanging from his waist, on the opposite side of the Sword Nurturing
Gourd. On his desk was a writing brush and some ink, as well as a stack
of blank account books and that jade bamboo folding fan.

Chen Ping\'an interlaced his fingers as he looked down at the familiar
setup on his table, and he was feeling very good. Even though he hadn\'t
summoned his bonded flying sword, it was as if he were already presiding
over a small world.

To him, becoming the Hidden Official was nothing more than going from an
innocuous traveling salesman to a more professional accountant.
