# Chapter 627: (1): Keeping Account on the Entire World

Sword of Coming

For now, the Savage World remained unaware that the most powerful Hidden
Official in the history of the Sword Qi Great Wall had just been
replaced by a successor with the lowest cultivation base of the entire
Hidden Official lineage. Even if they were to be made aware of this,
they would most likely only treat it as a massive joke.

The reality was that even on the Sword Qi Great Wall, not many people
were taking this seriously. In particular, all of the sword immortals
felt like this was a completely unnecessary arrangement made by the old
great sword immortal.

After becoming the new Hidden Official, Chen Ping\'an did exactly three
things.

The Hidden Official\'s branch owned two private residences, both outside
the city, one to escape the heat in summer, and the other to avoid the
winter chill. All of the secret files stored in those two private
residences over the past century were transported to the carriageway,
forming a massive pile of documents behind Chen Ping\'an.

The previous Hidden Official hadn\'t taken away the ancient Hidden
Official jade tablet, nor had she destroyed the archives of the Hidden
Official\'s branch that had been around for thousands of years.

In addition to the mountain of files, Chen Ping\'an also made a request
to the sword chamber for two messenger flying swords per person, then
asked the blacksmiths of the sword market to engrave each person\'s name
onto their respective swords: Chen Ping\'an, Mi Yu, Pang Yuanji, Dong
Bude, Gu Jianlong, Wang Xinshui, Guo Zhujiu, Lin Junbi, Deng Liang, Song
Gaoyuan, Cao Gun, Xuan Can.

At the moment, that was the entire roster of swordsmen under the Hidden
Official\'s branch.

However, the two flying swords that belonged to Chen Ping\'an were all
engraved with the words \"Hidden Official\" as opposed to his name.

The third and final thing that Chen Ping\'an did as the new Hidden
Official was to deliver a frank and candid address to his
\"subordinates.\"

\"In total, there are twelve of us, including myself. All of you are
very intelligent, and I\'m sure it\'s already become apparent to you
that all of us share some common traits. Our cultivation bases are
rather lacking, and none of us possess the combat prowess to make any
difference in the ongoing battle, but we all have decent heads on our
shoulders and a penchant for thinking.

"Something that the average sword cultivator would only think about once
may be something that we think about over and over again, and as the
saying goes, practice makes perfect. The fact that we\'ve all been
assigned to the Hidden Official\'s branch is a great show of confidence
in our abilities, but that is no reason for us to grow complacent.

"Every suggestion that we make, particularly the ones that will
ultimately impact the entire sword formation, will influence the
strategy of tens of thousands of swordsmen, and even sword immortals, on
the battlefield. All I ask is that all of you do your best to come up
with the best strategies possible. If I deem any of you to be too
incompetent for this role, then I will cast you out of the Hidden
Official\'s branch.

"I would much rather harm your ego than play games with the lives and
bonded flying swords of so many swordsmen. This is most definitely not
going to be an easy task, so make sure you\'re mentally prepared for
what\'s to come. We have to take responsibility for every single sword
cultivator that falls on the battlefield, but the even more difficult
part of this job is having to face the swordsmen who\'ve suffered fates
worse than death, or have had close friends and relatives perish in
battle.

"They may even come to resent us for doing nothing but giving
suggestions while everyone else risks their lives on the front lines.
That is simply a part of human nature, and it is not something that we
can hope to change. However, we must never lose faith in ourselves, not
even a little bit. If I detect that any of you have become bitter and
resentful in your role and intentionally try to sabotage the swordsmen
on the front lines in retaliation, then I will ask Sword Immortal Mi Yu
to cut you down where you stand.

"I won\'t listen to excuses. Once I\'ve made my decision, it will be
final, and you will be killed on the spot. With all of that made clear,
would any of you like to back out of the Hidden Official\'s branch?
It\'s still not too late to do so now. If you think that you can rely on
your cunning to get the better of me, then I\'d say you\'re better off
leaving the city right now to kill some demons. At the very least,
you\'ll be securing some battlefield accolades for yourself before you
die, rather than staying here to doom both yourself and others.\"

The other eleven swordsmen all remained silent with looks of resolve in
their eyes.

\"Good,\" Chen Ping\'an said with a nod of approval. \"A young prodigy
like Lin Junbi has so much potential and so much ahead of him, yet even
he is willing to pledge his life and Great Dao here without any
hesitation, and that inspires a great deal of confidence in me.\"

Lin Junbi was immediately left feeling very uneasy by this remark, and
he couldn\'t help but wonder if Chen Ping\'an was going to take this
opportunity to get back at him.

Chen Ping\'an\'s eyes narrowed slightly as his gaze roamed over the
faces of the swordsmen standing before him, and he said, \"Right now, we
are making a deal with the Savage World on behalf of the Sword Qi Great
Wall, and we have to ensure that this deal is as profitable for the tens
of thousands of swordsmen on the Sword Qi Great Wall as possible. Our
goal is to sacrifice as few of our allies as possible in exchange for
the greatest number of enemy casualties!

"This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. In fact, even in the next
lifetime, such an opportunity will not present itself. Even if you
ascend to the pinnacle of the Great Dao, reaching the Immortal Tier or
the Ascension Tier, when will you get another opportunity to have so
many sword cultivators and sword immortals at your beck and call?

"Make sure you cherish this opportunity because the twelve of us have
been granted the utmost honor, one that hasn\'t been granted to anyone
else before us and won\'t be given to anyone after us!\"

Guo Zhujiu sat behind her desk with a resolute look on her face, and for
once, she was silent as she cupped her fist in a salute.

Dong Bude also did the same, looking very much inspired by Chen
Ping\'an\'s speech.

Everyone else, including even Mi Yu, quickly followed suit, cupping
their fists in a collective salute.

In particular, the young swordsmen who weren\'t native to the Sword Qi
Great Wall were extremely excited by this opportunity.

It was already a commendable show of courage for outsiders who dared to
come to the Sword Qi Great Wall in the first place, and those who chose
to stay even after the war broke out were all swordsmen of great pride
and pure hearts.

\"There\'s no hurry for us to issue orders to the Sword Qi Great Wall,\"
Chen Ping\'an said. \"For now, let\'s familiarize ourselves with the
battlefield. Do as Lin Junbi says for the moment, and I\'ll come up with
a plan in an hour.\"

Given the urgency of the situation, everyone would just have to follow
Lin Junbi\'s instructions for now, but if they still couldn\'t come up
with any better strategies in an hour, then in Chen Ping\'an\'s eyes,
the Sword Qi Great Wall had next to no chance of victory against the
demonic army.

Chen Ping\'an began browsing through the mountain of files, doing so
extremely quickly. Whenever he saw something important, he would record
it in one of the blank account books. At the same time, he was keeping
an eye on the picture scrolls of the battlefield while also occasionally
observing the eleven other swordsmen to gauge their expressions.

The more mellow and elegant handwriting belonged to Sword Immortal Zhu
An, while, surprisingly, the more angular and forceful handwriting
belonged to the female sword immortal, Luo Shan.

Seeing their handwriting was like directly seeing *them*.

The contents of the files were clean, concise, and impeccable.

Even though the three sword immortals had betrayed the Sword Qi Great
Wall, they had certainly been diligent in their record-keeping.

Exactly an hour later, Chen Ping\'an raised his folding fan, then
slammed it down onto the table and said, \"Keep observing the
battlefield; just multi-task and listen to me at the same time. From now
on, each of you must simultaneously focus on three things at once.
Firstly, you must keep a constant eye on the picture scrolls. Secondly,
you must begin keeping records that others can view. If the need arises,
you can request each other\'s records for reference purposes.

"Thirdly, you must send letters by flying sword to certain places at
certain times. The flying swords from the Hidden Official\'s sword
market are extremely fast, and they will serve as a vital tool for us to
communicate with other parts of the battlefield. There are some
important decisions that I will personally convey through flying sword
letters, but I will need all of you to convey the minor changes we want
to make to the sword formation.

"Mi Yu, Dong Bude, and Gu Jianlong will be responsible for corresponding
with all of the native swordsmen of the Sword Qi Great Wall via flying
sword letters. You will split the Sword Qi Great Wall into three major
territories, and each of you will be responsible for one territory.
Meanwhile, Guo Zhujiu and Wang Xinshui will be tasked with communicating
with the Upper Five Tiers sword immortals.\"

Mi Yu\'s brows furrowed slightly upon hearing this. This arrangement
didn\'t make much sense to him. He was the only sword immortal in the
group, so was it not better for him to be tasked with communicating with
the other sword immortals?

Chen Ping\'an could see that Mi Yu had some reservations, so he
explained, \"I understand that you\'re the only sword immortal among us,
Mi Yu, but that\'s precisely the problem. There is an established
hierarchy among sword immortals based on cultivation base, and with such
preconceived notions in the way, you may not be able to communicate with
them as freely as you\'d like.

"Many opportunities on the battlefield will only present themselves for
extremely short windows of time, and even the slightest hesitation could
prove very costly. Does that make sense?\"

Mi Yu nodded in response.

Chen Ping\'an was already being very delicate with his words to look
after Mi Yu\'s feelings. The more important and perhaps more valid
reason was the terrible impression that all of the other sword immortals
on the Sword Qi Great Wall had of Mi Yu.

In comparison, Guo Zhujiu and Wang Xinshui were indeed much more suited
to the task. Their cultivation bases were so lowly that they would serve
purely as messengers, whereas if someone like Mi Yu were to try and
issue orders to the other sword immortals, then there was a very good
chance that he would be ignored simply because no one respected him.

\"If any of you have similar questions going forward, just raise them to
me right away,\" Chen Ping\'an continued. \"If you can come up with
better ideas and convince me to change my mind, then that would be very
much welcome. Pang Yuanji, I will put you in charge of contacting the
military supervisors under the former Hidden Official, as well as the
Confucian battlefield recorders.

"There aren\'t many of them, so on top of that, I\'ll also have you
contact the swordsmen of the Middle Earth Divine Continent. Lin Junbi
will contact the swordsmen of the Southern Whirl Continent, Deng Liang
will contact all of the Northern Complete Reed Continent\'s swordsmen,
Song Gaoyuan will contact everyone from the Golden Armor Continent, and
Xuan Can and Cao Gun will be responsible for the Flowing Dawn Continent
and the Pure White Continent, respectively.\"

Most of the swordsmen present possessed exceptional calculation
abilities and were very accomplished Go players. For example, Lin Junbi
and Xuan Can were both among the cream of the crop when it came to the
best Go players from their respective nations.

\"Why not have everyone contact the swordsmen from their own continents?
Wouldn\'t that ensure smoother communication?\" Mi Yu asked.

\"All of these outsiders have already gotten the short end of the stick,
getting stuck on the Sword Qi Great Wall in the midst of a war, and now,
they\'ve been assigned to the Hidden Official\'s branch, which is really
quite a thankless position. It\'s only right that I give them a chance
to make some new connections as compensation,\" Chen Ping\'an explained.
He was being very direct and straightforward here, making his intentions
abundantly clear.

A faint smile appeared on Lin Junbi\'s face, while the other foreign
swordsmen were a little embarrassed, but of course, they were also
overjoyed at this opportunity, and they felt a sense of genuine
gratitude toward Chen Ping\'an.

Who would want to die if they could live? And if they could live, then
they had to think about paving the way for their future. It was all
perfectly justified.

Mi Yu quickly understood Chen Ping\'an\'s considerations, and he cupped
his fist in a salute toward Chen Ping\'an and raised no further
questions.

The native swordsmen of the Sword Qi Great Wall had all been tasked with
communicating with other native swordsmen, but special considerations
had been made when it came to all of the foreign swordsmen. For example,
Lin Junbi had been assigned to the Southern Whirl Continent, which was
situated to the south of the Middle Earth Divine Continent, and Deng
Liang of the Pure White Continent was responsible for the Northern
Complete Reed Continent, which was situated in the northeastern part of
the Majestic World.

The same applied to the other foreign swordsmen as well, all of whom had
been tasked with communicating with swordsmen from neighboring
continents. Deep and meaningful bonds would surely be built if they
could all survive this war as comrades, and these intercontinental bonds
could prove to be very useful in the future.

As for all of the native swordsmen, they had already been granted
superior status from being assigned to the Hidden Official\'s branch, so
they required no further compensation from Chen Ping\'an.

All of the young swordsmen who had been selected for the Hidden
Official\'s branch were very sharp and intelligent, so they were quick
to figure everything out for themselves. Thus, it made sense that Mi Yu
was the only one who questioned Chen Ping\'an\'s arrangements.

Chen Ping\'an picked up a stack of books beside him. There were over ten
of them, and each one only had a name written upon it.

\"What I\'m about to tell you all next is of the utmost importance, so
make sure you listen carefully.\"

Chen Ping\'an picked up the two books at the very top of the pile, which
were named \"Primary Book A\" and \"Secondary Book A.\"

\"These two books will contain detailed records of the names, bonded
flying swords, and flying sword innate abilities of all of the Upper
Five Tiers sword immortals on our side. The primary book will hold
information on the native swordsmen of the Sword Qi Great Wall, while
the secondary book will keep records on all foreign sword immortals.

"Each sword immortal will only have one page dedicated to them, and
there will be a page number at the bottom right corner of each page. You
must have the page numbers and their corresponding sword immortals
memorized like the back of your hand.\"

Chen Ping\'an set down those two books, then explained the purposes of
the other books.

Book B would contain records of all of the Upper Five Tiers great demons
from the Savage World to have made an appearance on the battlefield, and
it was also split up into two: one primary and one secondary.

The primary book kept records of all Ascension Tier and Immortal Tier
great demons outside of the peak great demons who occupied the fourteen
thrones in the Heroic Spirit Hall, as well as all demons who were
Unpolished Jade Tier swordsmen.

The secondary book would contain information on all Unpolished Jade Tier
demonic cultivators who weren\'t swordsmen.

If the names of any of them were unknown, then they were simply to be
given an alias. The books were to contain information like physical
descriptions of their human forms, physical descriptions of their true
forms, their key treasures, their innate abilities, which faction of the
Savage World they belonged to, who they partnered up with in battle\...
The more information, the better.

Book C had no secondary book, and it kept records of all earth immortal
swordsmen of the Sword Qi Great Wall, particularly those who possessed
bonded flying swords that naturally thrived on the battlefield. The
whole purpose was to figure out how those flying swords could be used in
conjunction with one another to maximize their effectiveness on the
battlefield.

Chen Ping\'an had already raised a few examples, one of which was the
Nascent Tier swordsman, Cheng Quan. He was a special earth immortal
swordsman similar to the Unpolished Jade Tier sword immortal, Wu
Chengpei, and special attention had to be paid to people like him.

Similarly, Book D was a record of all of the earth immortal demons to
have appeared on the battlefield.

Chen Ping\'an placed special emphasis on this book, declaring that this
demographic of demonic cultivators was extremely impactful on the
battlefield, but also relatively easier to kill compared with great
demons. In the past, the Sword Qi Great Wall had often made the mistake
of discounting their importance.

It never seemed like they posed a particularly potent threat at any
particular stage of a battlefield, but upon reflection, it was always
discovered that the longer the battle wore on, the more destructive
these earth immortal demons proved to be, perhaps causing even more
damage to the Sword Qi Great Wall than any particular Upper Five Tiers
great demon.

In Chen Ping\'an\'s words, killing this demographic of demonic
cultivators was the best value for money. For the sword immortals of the
Sword Qi Great Wall, killing them wasn\'t a particularly difficult task,
and the more earth immortal demons that were slain, the more the state
of the battle would tilt in the Sword Qi Great Wall\'s favor over the
long term.

\"Book D is extremely important. We need to gather as much information
on as many of these earth immortal demonic cultivators as possible, then
request the sword immortal seniors in the primary and secondary Book A
to target and kill the demonic cultivators in Book D. Right now, this is
the most impactful thing that we can do. Every single name that we
manage to eliminate in Book D is a contribution that we\'ve made to the
Sword Qi Great Wall!\"

\"What if the sword immortal seniors refuse to go after them for
whatever reason?\" Xuan Can asked. \"What if they refuse to follow our
instructions? The two sides have accumulated a lot of bad blood over
time, and some sword immortals may feel more inclined to go after their
personal enemies rather than follow our instructions. What should we do
then?\"

\"In that scenario, you need to emphasize that the instructions being
issued to them are coming directly from the Hidden Official\'s branch,\"
Chen Ping\'an said. \"These are military orders, not suggestions or
requests. If that still doesn\'t work, then employ a three-strikes
system. If instructions have been issued to a sword immortal twice via
flying swords, only to be ignored on both occasions, then I will send a
more powerful sword immortal to confront them. If they still refuse to
comply with our orders, then they will be made to suffer the
consequences.\"

The mood had suddenly gotten a little heavy.

Chen Ping\'an had spoken in a rather joking tone, but this was most
definitely no laughing matter.

In the wake of the previous Hidden Official\'s defection and the severe
injuries suffered by Zuo You, morale on the Sword Qi Great Wall was at
an all-time low, and in this situation, they couldn\'t afford any
further mishaps.

\"What\'re you all looking at me for?\" Chen Ping\'an chuckled. \"I\'m
the Hidden Official; I can\'t just be going around personally issuing
instructions. I don\'t care about embarrassing myself, but I would
certainly feel bad if I embarrassed all of you as well. Wouldn\'t you
agree, Brother Gu?\"

Gu Jianlong hurriedly nodded in response.

[]{#chapter-137.xhtml}

# Chapter 627: (2): Keeping Account on the Entire World

Sword of Coming

\"For now, you don\'t need to know the significance of the Hidden
Official\'s branch,\" Chen Ping\'an said as his smile faded away. \"All
you need to know right now is that on the Sword Qi Great Wall, the
Hidden Official\'s branch can dictate whether someone gets to live or
die, and no reasons need to be provided! It\'s alright if you have
doubts; just wait and see.

"In any case, I\'m certainly willing to sacrifice a disobedient sword
immortal to stamp my authority. As for all of you, there\'s nothing for
you to worry about. Even if the sky falls on the Hidden Official\'s
branch, I will be the one to carry the burden as the Hidden Official.\"

Chen Ping\'an picked up another book, this one labeled Book E.

Book E was a record of all of the siege strategies used by the Savage
World during the past three battles, and it was extremely detailed. As a
result, the book was undoubtedly going to be very thick, and there were
going to be constant additions made to its contents.

Book F was going to contain a record of all of the merits and mistakes
made by the twelve swordsmen of the Hidden Official\'s branch, and Chen
Ping\'an was the only one allowed to alter and read its contents.

Book G was a record of all of the swordsmen on the Sword Qi Great Wall
who perished in battle, or had their bonded flying swords destroyed.
This was undoubtedly going to be quite a thick book as well.

\"Do we have to record all of the swordsmen who died or lost their
flying swords in the past two battles as well?\" Deng Liang asked.

\"No,\" Chen Ping\'an replied. \"We can just add that information to the
book later on when we don\'t have any more pressing matters to attend
to.\"

In times of war, the living were always more important than the dead.

Deng Liang raised no objections to this. As a matter of fact, this came
as quite a relief to him.

If Chen Ping\'an had answered that question incorrectly, then he would
immediately have lost the respect of many of the swordsmen in the Hidden
Official\'s branch.

All of the swordsmen present were extremely intelligent, and if Chen
Ping\'an wanted to command their respect, then he would have to display
superior competency and foresight over them at all times. In the Hidden
Official\'s branch, only the one with the most superior mental
cultivation was worthy of the position of Hidden Official.

There was a saying on the Sword Qi Great Wall that seemed rather
comical, but was actually very harsh and brutal.

On the Sword Qi Great Wall, even swordsmen of the Lower Five Tiers would
often say that they were better than Zong Yuan.

Zong Yuan was Chen Qingdu\'s longest-running comrade aside from Long Jun
and Guan Zhao, and he was once touted as the likeliest to overcome the
Ascension Tier bottleneck.

During the horrific battle in which the demon army overran the city
walls, he had singlehandedly slain two Ascension Tier great demons,
driving back the demon army with the help of Chen Qingdu.

In terms of accolades, Zong Yuan was most definitely worthy of engraving
a character into the city wall, two, in fact. However, he was dead, so
none of that mattered.

No matter how powerful he had been in life, he was now useless as a dead
man, so everyone was better than him. That was simply the harsh reality
of war.

Chen Ping\'an set down Book G, then went on to explain the purposes of
the final three books: H, I, and J.

Book H was a tally of the Savage World\'s losses on the battlefield.

Book I was a record of the overall wealth of the Sword Qi Great Wall,
including that of the sword market, the garment market, and the
alchemical pill market, as well as the Nalan Clan and the Yan Clan.

Losses on a battlefield didn\'t just come in the form of casualties, but
also in material things like immortal coins and treasures.

Book J was going to contain any appraisals, theories, and opinions that
the twelve swordsmen of the Hidden Official\'s branch had on the next
battle. Any thoughts and ideas they felt were worth putting down on
paper could be recorded in Book J, and it would be given to Guo Zhujiu,
who would then pass it on to Chen Ping\'an.

After explaining the purposes of all of the books, Chen Ping\'an said,
\"Now that all of that has been made clear, it\'s time to address our
strategy going forward. Lin Junbi has done a good job thus far, but the
situation on the battlefield has been constantly changing, and we need
to adjust accordingly. This is the most important doctrine that all of
us in the Hidden Official\'s branch must follow.

"We cannot be lazy and take a one-size-fits-all approach and pray that
everything works out. Instead, we have to constantly adapt and figure
out the best strategy for any given scenario. Each flying sword letter
that we send out must be for the betterment of the Sword Qi Great
Wall!\"

Finally, Chen Ping\'an assigned everyone specific duties before
reemphasizing the importance of keeping a constant eye on the overall
battlefield while attending to said duties. Otherwise, if the twelve of
them were to become too focused on their individual duties, then they
could very easily begin acting independently of one another and lose
sight of the big picture.

\"Now then, it\'s time for action, everyone,\" Chen Ping\'an declared
with a smile. \"Let us all plot against the Savage World together.
Earning money is hardly impressive; I would much rather earn the heads
of great demons!\"

Only in this moment did Chen Ping\'an truly earn Lin Junbi\'s respect.

As expected of Cui Dongshan\'s master; both of them were practical to a
fault!

Chen Ping\'an turned to Pang Yuanji with a smile and instructed, \"Pang
Yuanji, write in Book B \'Xiao Xun, pet name Zheng Yun, peak Ascension
Tier cultivator, bonded flying sword unknown.\' Make sure you don\'t
make the mistake of writing this entry in Book A. If you know anything
about her bonded flying sword, you can include it in the entry as well.
If the information that you provide is useful, then I will mark that
down as a merit in Book F under your name.\"

Pang Yuanji nodded in silence with a deathly pale complexion.

Xiao Xun was the name of the previous Hidden Official, a name that had
long been forgotten by many of the younger swordsmen on the Sword Qi
Great Wall because they had all grown accustomed to respectfully
referring to her as Lord Hidden Official.

\"You need to speak up, Pang Yuanji,\" Chen Ping\'an urged as his eyes
narrowed slightly. \"I can\'t read your mind; do you know anything about
Xiao Xun\'s bonded flying sword or not?\"

\"I do not,\" Pang Yuanji replied with a shake of his head.

\"It\'s fine,\" Chen Ping\'an said with a smile. \"Xiao Xun most likely
isn\'t going to be taking any part in the battle for now, so if you
accidentally forget or accidentally remember, you can still claim the
merit later.\"

Even though all of the other swordsmen had nothing to do with the
conversation, all of them felt chills run down their spines.

Chen Ping\'an looked around as he began fanning himself with his folding
fan, and he said, \"I already know all of your names, cultivation bases,
and where you come from, but I have an additional request to make to all
of you. I want you to tell me your biggest strengths and weaknesses.
This is just a minor thing, so focus on your duties for now.

"I\'ll ask all of you one by one, and when it\'s your turn, just give me
your answer through your mind\'s lake. This is not a top priority, but
nor is it a laughing matter, so I hope you can all be honest and
forthcoming with me.\"

Lin Junbi was rather perplexed by this request.

Chen Ping\'an definitely wasn\'t doing himself any favors here.

However, he quickly understood why Chen Ping\'an was doing this. The
purpose of the exercise was for him to get a handle on everyone\'s
character as quickly as possible.

At the moment, there were three ongoing \"battles.\" The first one was
naturally the battle between the Sword Qi Great Wall and the Savage
World. The second one was between the Hidden Official\'s branch and all
of the swordsmen of the Sword Qi Great Wall, and the third one was
between the twelve members of the Hidden Official\'s branch.

The third battle seemed like the smallest and least consequential one,
but any shifts in the emotions and power balance between the twelve
swordsmen could have a huge impact on the other two battlefields.

As the Hidden Official, Chen Ping\'an could obviously take a slow and
steady approach, gauging the character and personality of the other
eleven swordsmen by observing their actions over time. However, that
would be far too slow. If the Hidden Official\'s branch were too slow to
issue its orders, then the changes that had to take place on the
battlefield would also be delayed.

By asking this question, no matter how the other eleven swordsmen
answered, their answers would inevitably reveal some things about them,
thereby giving Chen Ping\'an something to work with to form his
judgments.

Shortly thereafter, everyone had given their answers. Instead of
recording their answers in any of the books, Chen Ping\'an wrote them
down on a separate slip of paper, which he tucked in between the pages
of Book F.

Yu Juanfu made her way onto the scene, and she was silent for a moment
before asking, \"Can I help with anything?\"

No one even turned to look at her as everyone was too focused on their
duties.

\"No,\" Chen Ping\'an said with a shake of his head.

Yu Juanfu wasn\'t bothered by the rejection, making her way to a quiet
spot on the city wall to drink on her own.

Chen Ping\'an turned to Mi Yu and said, \"Sword Immortal Mi Yu, I need
you to conjure up a sword formation that encompasses an area with a
radius of one and a half kilometers around this place. That will be a
strictly off-limits area to everyone else. After that, I need you to
bring in some young swordsmen. Their cultivation base doesn\'t matter;
they could even be swordsmen of the Lower Five Tiers, and just three to
five of them will suffice.

"Their only job will be to inform all passing swordsmen of the new
rules. No one outside of our Hidden Official\'s branch is allowed to
enter this area without special permission, and that applies even to
sword immortals. You possess the loftiest cultivation base out of
everyone here, so you\'re the only one who can play the role of
enforcer. If a conflict arises, then feel free to let your sword do the
speaking for you. If you encounter someone that you can\'t subdue by
force, then I\'ll go and personally reason with them.\"

Mi Yu felt a little better after hearing this, and he set off to carry
out Chen Ping\'an\'s instructions.

The past Hidden Officials had all been different in how strictly they
enforced their rules, but when it came to Chen Ping\'an, he was going to
have zero tolerance for insubordination, and the entire Sword Qi Great
Wall was going to find that out very soon.

Chen Ping\'an closed his folding fan before setting it down onto the
desk, then removed the Hidden Official jade tablet from his waist before
putting it down beside the folding fan. After that, he began writing out
lists of names in the primary and secondary Book A and Book B. He
already had a list of names prepared in his mind, so he was able to
churn them out very quickly.

There were exactly twelve books in total, perfectly matching the number
of people in the Hidden Official\'s branch.

Chen Ping\'an\'s hope was that everyone would survive the war and be
able to each take a book for themselves.

All of a sudden, Xuan Can declared, \"Right now, Sword Immortal Yue Qing
is unleashing some very powerful attacks, but he\'s affecting the
overall balance of the sword formation, and the two nearby sword
immortals are being forced to keep up with him. In a small area, it
seems like what they\'re doing is very effective, but all of the other
swordsmen around them are being significantly slowed down, and as a
result, more Middle Five Tiers swordsmen are losing their bonded flying
swords than would otherwise be the case.\"

Two other swordsmen quickly nodded in agreement with his assessment.

Chen Ping\'an took a glance at the picture scroll, then continued
writing down names in Book A and Book B as he instructed, \"Send a
message to Yue Qing via flying sword.\"

Wang Xinshui hurriedly did as he was told, writing up a concise letter
before attaching it to a flying sword and sending it off to Yue Qing. As
the flying sword flew into the distance, sweat began to bead up on the
young swordsman\'s forehead. He was only at the Dragon Gate Tier, and
even though he was one of the brightest young prodigies of the Sword Qi
Great Wall, it was still incredibly nerve-wracking for him to be tasked
with issuing orders to a great sword immortal that was ranked just
outside the top ten pinnacle sword immortals.

Chen Ping\'an continued writing down names while observing the picture
scroll out of the corner of his eye, and a short while later, he
suddenly ordered in a cold voice, \"Wang Xinshui, send another flying
sword letter to Yue Qing. This time, don\'t try to reason with him.
Instead, tell him to follow the orders or piss off! And before he
leaves, tell him to go and inform the old great sword immortal why he\'s
been told to leave!\"

Wang Xinshui sent out a second, much more strongly worded message, and
he was feeling even more uneasy as he watched the flying sword race away
into the distance.

All of a sudden, a thought seemed to have occurred to Chen Ping\'an, and
he cursed under his breath before sending a message to the old great
sword immortal using his messenger flying sword.

He then instructed Guo Zhujiu to send a flying sword letter to the
Unpolished Jade Tier sword immortal, Wu Chengpei, asking him how his
refinement of Sweet Dew was coming along.

After that, he said to everyone else, \"These should all be things that
you\'re taking care of even without my instructions. I don\'t want to
warn you all a second time.\"

Moments later, not only did Yue Qing begin following orders and holding
back in his attacks, but an unexpected guest had arrived outside the
sword formation.

In the flying sword letter sent to the old great sword immortal, Chen
Ping\'an had requested a more formidable enforcer, one that would ensure
the orders of the Hidden Official\'s branch would be carried out right
away, rather than having to be issued twice.

It was the old deaf man.

Mi Yu naturally didn\'t dare to get in his way, and he turned to lead
the old deaf man to Chen Ping\'an, only to see Chen Ping\'an observing
them with a cold expression.

Mi Yu immediately stopped cold in his tracks.

\"I don\'t trust you. Get someone else to come here in your place,\"
Chen Ping\'an said in a brutally honest fashion.

The old deaf man scratched his head momentarily, but he didn\'t seem
bothered at all, and he immediately turned to depart, vanishing from the
spot in the blink of an eye.

Shortly thereafter, Lu Zhi arrived to take the old deaf man\'s place.

\"Lu Zhi, I need you to stand on lookout duty in case a great demon
decides to attack us,\" Chen Ping\'an ordered. \"If any of us die under
your watch, I\'m going to take you to task.\"

\"I won\'t give you the chance to do that,\" Lu Zhi replied in an
indifferent voice, then stationed herself nearby.

Chen Ping\'an set down his brush and said, \"I\'m going to be keeping an
eye on all of you for an hour. That\'s all the time that you\'re going
to get to prove your competence to me. If any of you perform below the
standards that I expect of you, then you\'ll still be a swordsman of the
Hidden Official\'s branch, but you must pass all of your duties onto
someone else. If no one else can take over from you, then I\'ll take on
your duties.

"All of you are supposed to be among the most intelligent young
prodigies under the heavens; surely you\'re not going to be outdone by a
Lower Five Tiers Qi refiner like myself! You\'d better not make it so
that in the end, I\'m the only one doing anything, while all of you are
laid off from your duties due to incompetence. I\'m sure that\'s going
to be a very embarrassing outcome for all of you.\"

Everyone immediately began attending to their duties with a heightened
degree of focus, and they felt even more tension and pressure than those
actually fighting on the battlefield.

An hour later, Chen Ping\'an rose to his feet with a pleased smile and
praised, \"Well done! All of you have well and truly made me eat my
words. It turns out *I\'m* the one who\'s been laid off from my duties.
Pang Yuanji, Lin Junbi, and Guo Zhujiu, in particular, have done an
exceptional job over the past hour.

"Your performance has been near flawless, to the point that I could only
latch onto tiny mistakes that could barely even be considered mistakes
at all. As for everyone else, you\'ve all surpassed my expectations as
well. Make sure to keep it up! As someone once said, I\'m an extremely
shameless person\...\"

\"Lord Hidden Official, please allow me to set the record straight!\" Gu
Jianlong interjected in an urgent voice while continuing to keep an eye
on the picture scrolls.

Chen Ping\'an scoffed with an amused expression. \"Piss off!\"

\"Your benevolence and magnanimity are truly unmatched, Lord Hidden
Official!\" Gu Jianlong praised.

\"Over the next fifteen minutes, I want all of you to come up with a
list of twenty earth immortal demonic cultivators,\" Chen Ping\'an
ordered. \"Make sure that these earth immortal demonic cultivators are
ones that can be easily slain without impacting the overall state of the
battlefield. Once you\'ve come up with the list, distribute it to all of
our sword immortals.

"Also, are any of you proficient in making rubbings? I need one of you
to make copies of all of the twelve books aside from Book F. That way,
each of you has a copy of all eleven books, but this is not a
particularly urgent matter.\"

\"I can do that,\" Cao Gun volunteered with a smile.

Chen Ping\'an transferred the eleven books on his desk onto Cao Gun\'s
desk, and communicated some of his insights to Cao Gun through his
mind\'s lake. All the while, Cao Gun listened with full focus and
concentration, occasionally raising a question or two.

Two hours later, Huang Luan was observing the battlefield as she
chuckled. \"Well, this has been a very frustrating couple of hours.\"

Yang Zhi was standing beside her with a furious look on her face. Her
subordinates had been charging toward the Sword Qi Great Wall from
either flank of the demonic army, but she was losing earth immortal
cultivators at an alarming rate. It was often the case that a streak of
sword light would flash past and instantly harvest the lives of several
earth immortal cultivators, and after just a few repetitions of this,
she had already suffered extremely heavy losses.

What was even more frustrating to her was that the sword immortals on
the Sword Qi Great Wall didn\'t even have to go out of their way to
accomplish this. Instead, they were only casually launching attacks here
and there while continuing to maintain the sword formation, but their
attacks were landing with unerring accuracy.

It was almost as if someone had painted targets onto all of the earth
immortal demonic cultivators!

Yang Zhi\'s original plan was to return to the Savage World to hunt down
the sword immortals who were wreaking havoc there, but she couldn\'t
just leave the battlefield after being humiliated like this.

\"What the hell is going on?!\" she snapped in a furious voice as she
cast her gaze toward the city walls.

\"You\'re not going to be able to get anything done at this rate, Yang
Zhi. How about we join forces?\"

Huang Luan pointed at a certain spot on the city walls. That was where
Lu Zhi was standing, and a young man who was holding a folding fan had
appeared beside her.

Yang Zhi also turned her gaze to Lu Zhi. If she were to let her emotions
get the better of her and attack the city wall on her own, there was a
good chance it would be the last thing she ever did. However, if she had
Huang Luan on her side, then self-preservation shouldn\'t be an issue.
Even if they couldn\'t gain a significant advantage together, at the
very least, no one should be capable of preventing their retreat.

Thus, she decided to agree to Huang Luan\'s proposal, but before she
could do so, she noticed that the young man standing beside Lu Zhi had
turned to look directly at them.

There was a vibrant smile on his face as he raised his middle finger
toward the two great demons from afar.
