# Chapter 628: Mishap

Sword of Coming

Huang Luan\'s proposal of joining forces was indeed very alluring.

The sword formations on the Sword Qi Great Wall were so closely packed
together that there were barely any spare sword immortals around.

Yang Zhi was standing on the railing, and she had even revealed her true
form.

However, she didn\'t immediately make a move.

Instead, she cast her gaze toward the young man standing atop the city
wall and said, \"I\'ve never seen the sword formations on the Sword Qi
Great Wall operating so smoothly before. Is it because of him? Why are
they all willing to follow his instructions? Isn\'t he an outsider?
Since when did the Scholarly Sage\'s branch command this much respect on
the Sword Qi Great Wall? I\'ve heard that Lu Zhi has never been fond of
scholars.\"

All of the most powerful great demons of the Savage World had witnessed
the battle that took place between Chen Ping\'an and Li Zhen, but at the
time, none of them had been convinced that Chen Ping\'an possessed any
abilities that would allow him to influence the state of the war. It was
a clash between an entire world and the Sword Qi Great Wall.

In the grand scheme of things, even Upper Five Tiers sword immortals
couldn\'t be considered indispensable. Earlier, three sword immortals
from the Sword Qi Great Wall had perished, and it had hardly mattered at
all.

There was once a great demon who had made it to the top of the city
walls, but sustained severe injuries that ultimately led to his demise.
Prior to his passing, he declared that no one on the Sword Qi Great Wall
was worth anything aside from Chen Qingdu, and that the same applied to
the Savage World and the old man in gray.

\"He\'s really asking for it, isn\'t he?\" Huang Luan chuckled. \"I
wonder how much longer he\'s going to survive if he keeps this up.\"

\"Looks like he harbors a lot of resentment toward me,\" Huang Luan
remarked. \"It\'s probably because of that little gift I gave him during
his battle against Li Zhen, and he\'s definitely also less than pleased
about the injuries his senior brother suffered. If he wants to have a go
at me, then I\'d be happy to oblige.\"

All of a sudden, an ancient palace disappeared from the city in the sky
at Huang Luan\'s behest, alongside a lone mountain with a stone tablet
erected on its summit.

The palace was sent to the top of the city wall where Lu Zhi and Chen
Ping\'an were situated, while the mountain traveled to the two thatched
cottages.

The ancient palace was split into two by a slash of Lu Zhi\'s sword, and
the two halves crashed heavily down onto the city wall beneath their
feet before disintegrating into dust.

Wei Jin appeared on the summit of the mountain beside the stone tablet,
and in the next instant, the entire mountain was erased from existence
by an eruption of sword light.

Back when Wei Jin first arrived on the Sword Qi Great Wall, he had still
been an Unpolished Jade Tier cultivator. Since then, only a few years
had passed, and he had only taken part in one battle, but simply
practicing his sword techniques in close proximity to the old great
sword immortal and Zuo You had taken him to the doorstep of the Immortal
Tier.

Yang Zhi called out to Huang Luan, and before she departed, she took one
final glance at Chen Ping\'an to commit his face to memory.

In response, Chen Ping\'an closed his folding fan, then made a
throat-slitting gesture with it, and he did so very slowly, which made
the threatening gesture all the more insulting.

Huang Luan had to suppress an amused chuckle. Yang Zhi was the former
owner of Elite Cavalry River and a great demon at the pinnacle of the
Ascension Tier. If she threw all caution to the wind and insisted on
going after Chen Ping\'an, then their conflict would undoubtedly get
many people involved, and it was something that Huang Luan would be
happy to see.

After all, Yang Zhi would be suffering all the losses, while Huang Luan
would collect all the accolades. Once they reached the Majestic World,
all of them would be busy claiming their own territories, and whoever
had more troops under their command would naturally be better equipped
to claim more of the Majestic World.

Not only did the great demons have to contend against the Sword Qi Great
Wall, but they also had to prepare to compete against one another upon
reaching the Majestic World, and this was certainly not a trivial
matter.

However, Huang Luan wasn\'t going to go as far as to make any
inflammatory remarks to try and goad Yang Zhi. Doing so would only have
the opposite of the intended effect, alerting Yang Zhi to the fact that
she was doing something irrational, and it would also make Yang Zhi
resent her.

There were no rules in the Savage World, and that was a blessing most of
the time, but it could also occasionally prove to be a bit of a pain.

\"Huang Luan, if you can capture him and hand him over to me, then I\'ll
compensate you for whatever price you had to pay to capture him, and on
top of that, I\'ll throw in a first-rate sect from the Majestic World
and the capital city of a large empire. What do you say?\" Yang Zhi
proposed with a smile.

\"I would\'ve surely agreed to your proposal before seeing Chen Ping\'an
today, but now, I think that price is a bit too low,\" Huang Luan
refused with a shake of her head.

Yang Zhi\'s smile instantly faded, but Huang Luan paid no heed to her
discontent.

Shortly thereafter, Yang Zhi departed, and as she did so, she left
behind a warning. \"I hope you\'re not going to regret this decision.
Remember this: if you dare to try and claim any capital city of any of
the mortal empires, then you will be my enemy.\"

Huang Luan had not just refused to capture Chen Ping\'an, but also
turned down Yang Zhi\'s implicit offer to form an alliance. She wasn\'t
fazed at all by Yang Zhi\'s threat.

The torrent of immortal treasures flowing out of the demonic army was
still as mighty and impressive as ever, but compared with the orderly
river of sword qi surging out of the Sword Qi Great Wall, it was made to
appear rather chaotic and disjointed.

At this point, all of the sword immortals had begun to follow Chen
Ping\'an\'s orders. They were no longer throwing caution to the wind and
doing as they pleased with no regard for those around them. Instead,
every single attack that they unleashed was much more calculated than
before, striving to best conform with the sword formation\'s needs while
simultaneously protecting their allied Middle Five Tiers swordsmen as
much as possible.

In addition to that, they were also working toward other objectives,
such as destroying a certain key treasure in the opposing camp, or
slaying certain earth immortal demonic cultivators.

Huang Luan was naturally feeling a little dismayed, but this wasn\'t a
true cause for concern for her. Instead, her main concern at the moment
was the tents in her own camp.

The old man in gray had set a rule for the fourteen great demons in
their siege of the city. He had told them that if they ever grew bored,
then they could personally stage an attack on the city walls. However,
they had been instructed not to go all-out unless it was absolutely
necessary to do so. In particular, they were heavily discouraged from
using their innate abilities and other trump cards before reaching the
Majestic World.

The longsword in Lu Zhi\'s hand had been forged by the sword market, and
it was unable to bear her sword intent and survive the clash against the
oncoming palace, instantly disintegrating in her hand.

She turned to take a glance at Chen Ping\'an and asked, \"Are you that
eager for an early death, or do you plan to take no further part in this
battle? I\'ve been stationed here under the old great sword immortal\'s
orders, but my instructions were to protect the entire Hidden
Official\'s branch, not to serve as your personal bodyguard, so you
better be careful not to put yourself in a position where I won\'t be
able to protect you.\"

The great demons of the Savage World never cared much for looking at
concepts like right and wrong in the grand scheme of things, but they
took personal grudges very seriously, and the higher their cultivation
base, the more offense they took to personal slights. Hence, it was no
exaggeration to say that Chen Ping\'an had just made sworn enemies out
of the two great demons with his provocative gestures.

However, he was a little disappointed to see that his provocation
hadn\'t been enough to goad the two great demons into launching an
all-out attack on the city wall.

If they had taken the bait, then Lu Zhi would\'ve only needed to hold
them off for a moment, and three other sword immortals that had already
been notified in advance would\'ve instantly sprung out of hiding to cut
off any and all paths of retreat for the two great demons. The trio
consisted of Yue Qing, Yuan Qingshu, and Wu Chengpei, but they weren\'t
going to be the ones to slay the two great demons.

Instead, Yang Zhi and Huang Luan would\'ve found themselves swarmed by a
whole host of sword immortals. Prior to stepping onto the city wall,
Chen Ping\'an had instructed Guo Zhujiu and Wang Xinshui to immediately
send out flying sword messages to all of the native sword immortals if
any great demon dared to approach the city walls.

At the moment, all of the Sword Qi Great Wall\'s sword immortals were
busy playing their roles in the sword formations atop the city walls,
but if the Hidden Official\'s branch were to send out those flying sword
messages, dozens of sword immortals would instantly converge onto the
scene. Even if abandoning their posts meant that the sword formations
were going to be compromised, they still had to follow the orders of the
Hidden Official\'s branch.

\"It\'s fine,\" Chen Ping\'an said with a nonchalant smile. \"There are
plenty of people out to get me; it hardly matters if I throw a couple
more into the mix. If Huang Luan and Yang Zhi had allowed their impulses
to get the better of them, then there\'s a very good chance that they
would\'ve both met their demise here.\"

There was one more thing that Chen Ping\'an hadn\'t revealed, which was
that one of the two flying swords that he had been assigned as the
Hidden Official had been sent to the old great sword immortal. If any
great demons had taken his bait, then not only would they have faced the
collective wrath of dozens of sword immortals, but the old great sword
immortal would\'ve also issued an order to Chen Xi and Qi Tingji to
ensure beyond a shadow of a doubt that the great demons were slain.

With so many sword immortals on the scene serving as witnesses, Chen Xi
and Qi Tingji wouldn\'t have dared to hold back, and Huang Luan and Yang
Zhi would\'ve certainly been killed.

Not only had Chen Ping\'an predicted Xiao Xun\'s betrayal, but he also
didn\'t have much trust in those two old sword immortals, either. This
seemed like it would be massively detrimental to his plans, but in
reality, he simply had to make some adjustments to the way that he did
things. Just because he didn\'t trust them didn\'t mean that he
couldn\'t still find ways to use them.

If Yang Zhi and Huang Luan were of the opinion that the current Sword Qi
Great Wall was still the same Sword Qi Great Wall of old, and that they
would be able to stage an attack before retreating unscathed, then they
would\'ve been made to pay the ultimate price.

\"You\'re far too naive and optimistic,\" Lu Zhi remarked with a shake
of her head. \"There\'s no way someone as old as Yang Zhi would\'ve
fallen for such a simple trick.\"

\"Perhaps, but we don\'t lose anything in trying, so why not make an
attempt?\" Chen Ping\'an countered with a smile.

\"You may return to your duties, Lord Hidden Official,\" Lu Zhi said
with a dismissive wave. \"Rest assured, I\'ll continue to keep watch
here.\"

Thus far, Lu Zhi felt like Chen Ping\'an had been quite competent as the
new Hidden Official. In fact, he had performed beyond her expectations,
but her personal opinion of Chen Ping\'an was still less than stellar,
and the reason for this was very simple: he wasn\'t a sword immortal. In
fact, he wasn\'t even a swordsman at all.

Chen Ping\'an jumped down from the wall and returned to his seat at the
desk, then smiled and said, \"They didn\'t take the bait this time, but
it was always going to be a long shot, so there\'s no need to be
disappointed. At this point, the Savage World\'s attack on the city has
already entered the third stage. The first attack led by Great Demon Bai
Ying was more of a probing attack than anything else, designed to assess
the defenses of our Sword Qi Great Wall.

"In the process, he was fed information via flying sword messages by
certain traitors of the city, and that allowed the Savage World to gain
the upper hand. This is actually a very delicate task that requires
skillful handling, and it makes sense that the duty fell upon Bai Ying.
Among the fourteen great demons, Bai Ying has always preferred to
achieve his goals through strategic means, rather than by using brute
force.

"Hence, if Bai Ying had been leading this attack, then I wouldn\'t even
have bothered to try and provoke him at all. Next, we have to talk about
the five mountains that Yang Zhi was tasked with guarding on the
battlefield. Compared with Bai Ying, who needs to constantly communicate
with the sixty tents, Yang Zhi clearly doesn\'t need to make as many
adjustments on the fly on the battlefield.

"The five mountains concealed five great demons for the purpose of
killing our Immortal Tier sword immortals, and they don\'t have much to
do with Yang Zhi herself. Then there\'s Huang Luan. Clearly, Yang Zhi is
the most direct and straightforward of the great demons, so she was the
one that I deemed to be most prone to falling for our trap.

"If we had successfully lured in and managed to kill either one of them,
then that would\'ve served as a massive morale boost for everyone,
enough to make up for the drop in morale from Xiao Xun\'s defection. Of
course, I never believed that Yang Zhi would be foolish enough to fall
for this trap. However, I was hoping that she would be eager to make
amends after her previous failure, and I was also hoping that Huang Luan
would give us a helping hand by goading her just a little.

"Let\'s say the Sword Qi Great Wall falls, and the demon tribe manages
to infiltrate the Majestic World. What do the great demons stand to gain
from this? Of course, it\'s the vast new territory that would help
elevate them in their pursuit of the Great Dao. However, that\'s not
something for them to compete over. At the end of the day, the cut of
the pie that each of them receives is entirely dependent on how much the
patriarch of the demon tribe decides to give them, so I\'m sure Yang Zhi
is desperate to make amends to get back into the demon tribe
patriarch\'s good graces.

"Unfortunately, that wasn\'t enough to convince her to take the bait.
This shows us that the great demons of the Savage World are extremely
pragmatic, and that is something that we can learn from them, as well as
something that we must be wary of. From here onward, we can actually
somewhat predict the strategies that the Savage World is going to employ
going forward.

"However, with sixty tents\' worth of brainpower on their side, they\'re
going to undoubtedly have a strategic advantage over us, so there\'s not
much point to making such predictions.\"

Nearby, Lu Zhi couldn\'t help but shake her head in exasperation.

Clearly, Chen Ping\'an could tell that she had no interest in hearing
his plans and rationale, so instead of telling her all of this to her
face, he was speaking indirectly to her while addressing the others, and
in doing so, he was making her hear what he had to say whether she liked
it or not.

Her impression of Chen Ping\'an didn\'t improve at all, but she had
become even more impressed with how he was handling himself as Hidden
Official.

She cast her gaze toward the southern battlefield, then took a glance
back at the group of young swordsmen behind her, and a faint smile
appeared on her face.

This group of young individuals was likely the ones that the old great
sword immortal had the highest hopes for.

Chen Ping\'an cast his gaze toward the Hidden Official\'s branch, and a
stunned look appeared on his face as he exclaimed, \"I just said all of
that, and none of you have anything to say in response? Have all of my
words fallen upon deaf ears this entire time?\"

After a brief silence, Deng Liang said in a grim voice, \"The next army
that the demon tribe is going to assemble will consist entirely of
swordsmen, and they\'ll have undoubtedly learned from observing us. For
example, they\'ll have learned how to maximize the overall power of a
sword formation by having the sword immortals hold back and refrain from
using their full power, as well as how to have sword immortals strike
down enemy earth immortals without any warning.

"By putting our strategies on display, we\'ve essentially provided them
with a blueprint for how they should arrange their sword formations.
Even if they don\'t manage to learn all of our tricks, if we do not
prepare any countermeasures, then we\'ll be sure to suffer heavy losses
in the next battle.\"

Chen Ping\'an pointed his folding fan at Lin Junbi with a smile and
prompted, \"Go ahead, Junbi. Tell us what\'s on your mind.\"

Lin Junbi immediately came up with an idea, and he smiled and said,
\"Right now, the Savage World has the upper hand, so we can\'t afford to
alter our sword formations. However, what we *can* do is set a series of
concealed traps around all of our key earth immortal swordsmen. From
this point onward, all of our sword immortals will be assigned a new
task, which would be to protect a certain earth immortal swordsman.

"However, that doesn\'t mean that they should focus solely on passive
defense, as that would be completely pointless. Instead, everything that
we do should pave the way for a counterattack, and this time, we will
not just be targeting the earth immortal cultivators in the enemy camp.
Instead, we will be going after their sword immortals!\"

Chen Ping\'an nodded in response.

Even though he had failed to kill Yang Zhi and Huang Luan with his trap,
claiming the lives of several enemy sword immortals would certainly not
be a bad compromise.

Chen Ping\'an had been waiting for Deng Liang and Lin Junbi to speak up
this entire time, and now that a concrete plan had been laid out,
everyone immediately began working.

Gu Jianlong took a glance at the clashing torrent of flying swords and
immortal treasures on the picture scroll, then opened one of the books
on his desk and said, \"In that case, we\'ll need to go through the
entirety of Book C and select ten to twenty of our earth immortal
swordsmen to serve as bait. Up to this point, Wang Xinshui has been the
one solely responsible for updating Book C, but going forward, he\'s
going to require some help with that task.

"This is also a good opportunity for us to assess our sword immortals
and try out more possibilities. In the past, our sword immortals have
been too averse to working with others on the battlefield. At the very
most, you\'ll only see small groups of maybe two or three sword
immortals who are close friends working with one another to slay demons.

"However, just because they\'re close friends doesn\'t necessarily mean
that they\'ll have the best synergy in battle. Going forward, Book C is
going to become extremely important, and it would be unfair to have Wang
Xinshui carry such a heavy responsibility alone. What do you think, Lord
Hidden Official?\"

Chen Ping\'an was supporting his chin with his hand, while his elbow was
resting on the desk, and he seemed to have been writing something down
on a sheet of paper.

Beside the sheet of paper was Book F, which already had many other
sheets of paper tucked between its pages, and he continued writing as he
nodded and said, \"That\'s a fair assessment. From now on, I will
personally be helping Wang Xinshui manage Book C and select twenty earth
immortal swordsmen to be used as bait.\"

\"Prior to this, we\'ve only had very limited opportunities to examine
the effectiveness of different combinations of sword immortals working
together with one another,\" Xuan Can said. \"Going forward with this
plan, we\'ll have more opportunities to try out different combinations
and have our sword immortals become more and more skilled at and
accustomed to working with one another.

"Initially, they may be resistant to the idea, but once they begin to
see the benefits of working together with one another, I\'m sure
they\'ll come around very quickly. Right now, the sword immortals are
willing to follow our orders because the strategies that we\'ve
implemented have been very effective, but if we don\'t make any further
contributions beyond this, then the sword immortals will quickly begin
to look down on us, and they\'ll become more and more averse to
following our instructions.

"Lord Hidden Official is right. Our main enemy right now is the Savage
World, but another battle that we have to fight is against our own sword
immortals. We have to constantly be aware of their thoughts, feelings,
and attitude, and we need to act accordingly. On top of that, we can\'t
just adjust on the fly. Instead, we have to take a more preemptive
approach.

"Otherwise, if they become resistant to following our orders, then
fleeting opportunities on the battlefield could pass us by. I think we
need to assign someone specifically to this role.\"

\"Leave it to me,\" Dong Bude volunteered.

A hesitant look appeared on Lin Junbi\'s face.

\"Dong Bude will only be responsible for the sword immortals native to
the Sword Qi Great Wall, while Lin Junbi will be responsible for all
foreign sword immortals,\" Chen Ping\'an decided. \"Junbi, if you have
any questions, then all of the foreign swordsmen, including Deng Liang,
are obligated to answer you to the best of their abilities, even if what
you\'re asking concerns private secrets of certain sword immortals.

"Some sword immortals may become angry or resentful at having their
secrets exposed, but their resentment will only be directed toward me,
the Hidden Official, so none of you need to be concerned. If I can\'t
even protect all of you, then I will have been an utter failure of a
Hidden Official.\"

\"What if the enemy has already come up with the same plan as us?\" Guo
Zhujiu suddenly proposed. \"What if they also come after our sword
immortals instead of taking the bait to hunt down our earth immortal
swordsmen? If that happens, then we could end up trading sword immortals
with them. They have far more sword immortals than us, so that would
play right into their hands!\"

Guo Zhujiu turned to Chen Ping\'an with a concerned expression as she
spoke.

\"That\'s a very good point that Guo Zhujiu has just raised,\" Chen
Ping\'an said with a smile. \"We always have to be more careful and
prudent than the Savage World. Even if things go wrong for them, they
can bear the consequences, but the same doesn\'t apply to us. Pang
Yuanji, it\'s time for you to begin thinking about which combinations of
the sword immortals in Primary Book A would work best in battle. As
usual, you come up with the plans, and I\'ll issue all the orders so
that if there\'s any discontentment from the sword immortals, it\'ll
only be directed toward me.\"

Pang Yuanji nodded in response.

\"At the rate things are going, it\'ll only take half a month at the
very most before we reach a very awkward position, one in which we\'re
going to run out of optimizations to make,\" Chen Ping\'an said. \"At
that point, we\'ll have become so familiar with all of the sword
immortals and earth immortal swordsmen of the Sword Qi Great Wall that
we\'ll know them like the backs of our hands. What should we do then?

"Perhaps we can learn more about the Abode Tier, Sea Observation Tier,
and Dragon Gate Tier swordsmen, but that definitely shouldn\'t be our
main focus. Instead, our main focus should still be on the southern
battlefield and on the primary and secondary editions of Book B, as well
as Book D. For all of us in the Hidden Official\'s branch, it\'s
inevitable that we\'ll become disappointed and disillusioned at some
point, but you must draw upon your mental fortitude and persevere.

"None of us are perfect; we\'ll all make mistakes, and the mistakes that
we make will not be ones that we can fix. Any mistake on our end will
result in mass casualties, and once we make even a single misstep, all
of our past merits and contributions will be instantly forgotten by
everyone. Our job is a thankless one where faultless perfection is the
baseline expectation, and anything that falls short of that will
immediately be met with resentment from all directions.\"

Everyone nodded in response with solemn expressions.

Chen Ping\'an closed his folding fan, then set it down on the desk
beside him and declared, \"Let\'s get to work!\"

Meanwhile, a talismanic boat had just drifted over to the top of the
city wall in the north, and a young man disembarked. He had a pale
complexion and a weary expression, as if he had only just recovered from
a major illness, and he stowed the talismanic boat away up his sleeve
before slowly making his way toward the Hidden Official\'s branch.

Not only were all of the swordsmen of the Hidden Official\'s branch
stunned to see him, but even the Unpolished Jade Tier Mi Yu had also
been caught completely off guard.

This entire time, not a single one of them had realized that the Hidden
Official was nothing more than Chen Ping\'an\'s yin soul.

They were certain that the old great sword immortal had to have
personally cast an illusion to keep them in the dark.

Chen Ping\'an\'s yin soul rose to its feet with a smile, then picked up
the folding fan on the desk and began walking backward until it became
one with the true Chen Ping\'an.

From there, Chen Ping\'an returned to the desk, then sat down with his
legs crossed with a smile and said, \"I\'ve really missed you all.\"

[]{#chapter-139.xhtml}

# Chapter 629: (1): Killing Intent at Every Turn

Sword of Coming

All of the swordsmen of the Hidden Official\'s branch were top-tier
cultivation prodigies, and the only reason why they were limited in
their cultivation bases was that they were all still quite young.

Hence, they were all aware that one\'s yin soul could leave their body,
but this was certainly quite a rare sight in a third tier Qi refiner.
Furthermore, it was even more remarkable that Chen Ping\'an\'s yin soul
was able to leave his body for so long without being exposed as a yin
soul, particularly in an environment as abundant with sword qi as the
Sword Qi Great Wall.

Despite this, everyone in the Hidden Official\'s branch barely even
batted an eyelid. When it came to Chen Ping\'an, they had already
learned to expect the unexpected.

However, Lu Zhi was rather intrigued, and she asked through her mind\'s
lake, \"Chen Ping\'an, when you were provoking Yang Zhi and Huang Luan
just now, did you intend to allow them to kill you from the very
beginning?\"

Chen Ping\'an was flipping through the pages of Book C, helping Wang
Xinshui pick out twenty suitable earth immortal swordsmen, and as he did
this, he replied through his mind\'s lake, \"If an ordinary piece of
bait attracts a large fish, even if the large fish is ultimately reeled
in, would you expect the piece of bait to survive? You said it yourself:
Yang Zhi is no fool. If I want to successfully lure her in and prevent
her from escaping, then I can\'t just rely on our sword immortals. A
sacrifice must be made to ensure her demise.\"

\"But if your yin soul is destroyed, then the foundation of your Great
Dao will be damaged,\" Lu Zhi said with tightly furrowed brows. \"Why
would you go so far?\"

\"The yin soul of a third tier cultivator in exchange for the lives of
one or two Ascension Tier great demons; isn\'t that a fantastic deal?\"
Chen Ping\'an asked with a smile.

Lu Zhi was unconvinced by this answer, and she requested in a direct and
straightforward manner, \"I hope that you can be sincere and truthful
with me.\"

Chen Ping\'an was silent for a moment, then explained, \"If our Hidden
Official\'s branch wants to establish itself as an authoritative force,
then we can\'t just rely on intangible battlefield contributions. The
biggest problem with the Hidden Official\'s branch is that we are all
sheltered behind the front lines. We are all swordsmen, yet we play no
direct role on the battlefield.

\"When things are going smoothly, this is not a problem, but as soon as
the Sword Qi Great Wall begins suffering losses, the Hidden Official\'s
branch will be sure to come under intense scrutiny and criticism. This
is only to be expected. Hence, if I make an early sacrifice, then there
will be less of an impact on the mental state of everyone in the Hidden
Official\'s branch in response to the criticism that will inevitably
come.

\"The more focused and unwavering the Hidden Official\'s branch, the
more decisive we\'ll be in our plans and strategies, and over the long
term, that will benefit the Sword Qi Great Wall immensely.\"

\"I can tell you\'re telling the truth here, but I can also tell that
you\'re withholding something from me,\" Lu Zhi said.

Chen Ping\'an didn\'t deny this.

\"There are some things that I must keep to myself for now, so I can
only ask you to suppress your curiosity. Right now, all you need to
focus on is protecting the Hidden Official\'s branch. There\'s no need
for you to think about anything else.\"

\"Ordering me around, are you, Lord Hidden Official?\" Lu Zhi jibed,
making a rare lighthearted remark.

\"Your swordsmanship is far beyond anything I can even hope to fathom,
Sword Immortal Lu Zhi,\" Chen Ping\'an lauded, doing his best to channel
Pei Qian\'s abilities in insincere flattery. \"If I don\'t put on an
authoritative front and try to order you around, then you\'ll brush me
off as nothing more than a joke.\"

Lu Zhi merely smiled and offered no response.

Chen Ping\'an was performing three tasks at once. On one hand, he was
selecting earth immortals from Book C while communicating with Wang
Xinshui through his mind\'s lake to finalize the selections.

On the other hand, he was keeping a constant eye on the two picture
scrolls laid out on the carriageway. That was one of his basic duties as
the Hidden Official. Just because he had delegated the task to others
didn\'t mean that he could completely let go of the reins. At the same
time, he had to carefully observe the other eleven swordsmen and listen
to their conversations.

In the Majestic World, all eleven swordsmen would\'ve been considered
top-tier cultivation prodigies, and several of them had particularly
outstanding strengths. For example, Xuan Can was essentially a walking
map, and his attention and memory of the events unfolding in the two
picture scrolls put even Chen Ping\'an to shame.

He had an exceptional grasp on the geography of the battlefield, down to
extremely fine details. For example, he would know if there were a
crater somewhere on the battlefield, and he would also know how and when
it had gotten there, as well as what impact it would have on the ongoing
battle. The others could accomplish this as well if they put their mind
to it, but it would require a great deal of conscious effort, whereas
Xuan Can almost did this as a hobby, and it didn\'t seem to feel like an
additional burden to him at all.

Hence, Chen Ping\'an had instructed Xuan Can to keep real-time records
of the state of the battlefield, and those records were something that
the other swordsmen had to regularly consult.

Wang Xinshui had an astonishing level of intuition when it came to
small-scale battles. Hence, whenever Chen Ping\'an wasn\'t overly busy
with the tasks at hand, he always liked to observe Wang Xinshui, who
often saw flaws in the way that the swordsmen of the Sword Qi Great Wall
utilized their flying swords in battle, and it never failed to frustrate
him when he saw the opposition use their immortal treasures to great
effect on the picture scrolls.

All of these were just fleeting moments on the battlefield, yet in order
to remember these details, he would often stare intently at the picture
scrolls while rapidly taking notes in extremely messy handwriting.
Occasionally, he would look a little dejected, and it seemed like he was
wondering if all of the notes that he was taking would even come in
useful at all.

After all, he was too far away from the battlefield, and it wasn\'t like
he could provide real-time instructions to all of the swordsmen of the
Sword Qi Great Wall on how they could better optimize their offensive
output. Hence, out of everyone in the Hidden Official\'s branch, he was
always the one who went through the most drastic emotional swings, often
displaying the entire spectrum of human emotions in a span of mere
moments. This, coupled with his habit of mumbling to himself, made him
very amusing to watch.

Lin Junbi\'s strategic acumen was so outstanding that it was almost like
an innate ability of sorts. As long as he was given enough information
to make informed decisions, he almost never made any mistakes.

Guo Zhujiu was always able to think of the worst-case scenario faster
than everyone else, and the worst-case scenarios that she thought of
were often even worse than what everyone else had considered.

\"What I\'m worried about is that the sword formations of the Savage
World could simply advance using the simplest and most direct methods,\"
Dong Bude suddenly said. \"If they focus only on themselves, maximizing
the power of their sword formations without considering anything else,
then all of our plans and schemes will be thwarted. The biggest problem
for us right now is that if we don\'t gain an advantage, then we\'ll be
suffering a loss. What should we do in that scenario?\"

\"That is a problem that can be addressed,\" Chen Ping\'an said with a
smile. \"We have to change our mindset and stop regarding the demons of
the Savage World as puppets that lack intelligence and emotions.
Instead, we must put ourselves in their shoes and see them as living
beings with emotions and attachments. As long as one has emotions and
shares bonds with those around them, their mental fortitude can be
swayed.

\"If they want to take a safe and solid approach and focus solely on
maximizing the power of their sword formations without worrying about
anything else, then there are three things that we can do to disrupt
their strategy. Firstly, we can learn from Qi Shou and strive to kill
our enemies in the most horrific and brutal ways possible. Secondly,
there will be many enemies on the battlefield that simply won\'t have
much of an impact on the state of the battle, so we can choose whether
we want to kill them or not.

\"In those circumstances, just spare them, but make sure to inflict
severe injuries upon them; the more painful, the better. Once they
retreat behind the Savage World\'s front lines, they will be extremely
bitter and resentful at the pain that they have to endure, and they\'ll
be constantly poisoning the emotions and morale of those around them.
Thirdly, find some people who excel in wars of words and, like Zhao Geyi
and Cheng Quan, and have them hurl insults at the enemy while fighting
on the battlefield.

\"In particular, make sure to insult the enemy swordsmen and sword
immortals. We have to get as many of our swordsmen hurling insults at
the enemy as possible. If we can provoke them into abandoning the safe
and steady approach, then we will have achieved our objective. Earlier,
when I was fighting against Li Zhen, did you really think I was
completely unbothered by his provocative remarks? Of course I was
bothered. As a matter of fact, I wanted to skin him alive!

\"However, I couldn\'t allow myself to get distracted in a one-on-one
battle, so I had to suppress those emotions, but the currently ongoing
battle is different. Instead of just two combatants, there are tens of
thousands of swordsmen on each side, and not everyone is going to be
able to control their emotions.

\"While we are doing our best to understand the thoughts and emotions of
the sword immortals and swordsmen on our side, it\'s important to
remember that we also have to place ourselves in the shoes of our
enemies to see the battlefield through their eyes. Once we\'re able to
do that, we\'ll be able to predict many things before they happen, and
that will give us an immense advantage, allowing us to set traps that
the Savage World will have no choice but to step into.\"

\"That is indeed the case,\" Lin Junbi agreed with an earnest nod. \"If
we can turn this entire battlefield into something like a small world,
then we\'ll be able to gain advantages everywhere.\"

\"Think about this: if we can be fully aware of all of the thoughts of
the demon tribe\'s patriarch and the aspirations of all of the fourteen
great demons, what kind of position would that place us in?\" Chen
Ping\'an envisioned.

Everyone stared at him in a stunned silence.

\"Of course, that\'s not possible,\" Chen Ping\'an continued with a
smile. \"There is always a limit to everyone\'s capabilities, and
knowing one\'s limits is a commendable quality in itself.\"

\"With the information in the primary and secondary Book B, I can find
some leads and go through the files of the Hidden Official\'s branch to
uncover more secrets about the Savage World,\" Guo Zhujiu suddenly said.
\"That should allow us to make some educated guesses on the wants and
needs of some of the great demons. Rest assured, taking on this extra
task isn\'t going to get in the way of my existing duties, so you can
count on me, Master\...\"

Guo Zhujiu\'s voice instantly trailed off into silence as soon as the
word \"master\" slipped out of her mouth. She was really frustrated with
herself for speaking without thinking and bringing shame to her master.
While it was true that they were master and disciple, in this scenario,
she had to follow the rules of the Hidden Official\'s branch.

\"I don\'t mind if you call me master,\" Chen Ping\'an said. \"Just like
I would prefer for everyone else to call me directly by my name, rather
than awkwardly referring to me as Lord Hidden Official.\"

Gu Jianlong was very relieved to hear this, and a bright smile appeared
on his face.

\"It seems that I was right, Brother Gu,\" Chen Ping\'an mused as he
turned to Gu Jianlong with an amused smile. \"Judging from your
reaction, you really did feel awkward referring to me as Lord Hidden
Official, isn\'t that right? The fact that you took the bait so easily
shows that you still have much room for improvement in the way of mental
cultivation. You may be a cultivation prodigy in the Majestic World, but
if you\'re going to wear your heart on your sleeve like this and be so
easy to read, then I suggest you stay out of politics.\"

Gu Jianlong\'s relieved expression instantly turned to one of sullen
dismay. It seemed that Chen Ping\'an was intent on picking on him.

\"While it may seem like we have it much easier than everyone else,
issuing orders from behind the front lines, the reality is that our
burden is one that no one should have to bear,\" Chen Ping\'an said.
\"Not only is this true for outsiders like Xuan Can, but even native
swordsmen like Dong Bude and Pang Yuanji also shouldn\'t have to
shoulder such a heavy burden. In our position, one single misstep could
be all that it takes to crush our Dao Hearts. Pang Yuanji, if you were
given the choice, would you rather be here, or would you rather take
your chances out on the battlefield?\"

\"I would rather be out on the battlefield,\" Pang Yuanji replied in a
truthful manner.

Wang Xinshui was just about to speak when Chen Ping\'an turned to him
with a smile and asked, \"Do you disagree, Xinshui?\"

\"Not at all,\" Wang Xinshui hurriedly said. \"I was just about to agree
with Pang Yuanji.\"

Wang Xinshui was truly a rather special case. He was the type of
prodigious swordsman whose thoughts often outpaced his sword, and due to
his lackluster cultivation base, he was often detrimental to his allies
on the battlefield. That wasn\'t to say that he came up with terrible
ideas.

Instead, all of his suggestions were perfect, but he was unable to let
his sword do the talking, and the same applied to his friends. Hence,
while he was brilliant at telling others what they should do on the
battlefield, his execution was always lacking whenever he set foot on
the battlefield himself.

Fortunately, his lackluster execution had never resulted in any
catastrophic outcomes, but even so, he still had very mixed feelings
about going into battle. It wasn\'t that he was afraid of dying in
battle. Instead, it simply felt like the battlefield was a place where
he didn\'t belong, and he found himself in a constant state of
frustration whenever he went into battle.

\"Alright, that\'s enough chit-chat.\" Chen Ping\'an chuckled. \"From
now on, I may be leaving this place frequently to go elsewhere. If you
resent me for that, make sure to hide it. Also, none of you will get a
chance to go into battle outside the city, but I still have that option
if I want to take it, so feel free to envy me.\"

\"I am in no position to advise you against taking risks, but I implore
you to be careful, Lord Hidden Official,\" Deng Liang said. \"Even if
you\'re going to step onto the battlefield outside the city, make sure
to conceal yourself well. If we lose you, then we will be forced to
elect a new leader on the fly, and that type of instability among our
ranks is sure to cause problems.\"

\"I appreciate that you\'re looking out for me, and I also appreciate
how direct and straightforward you\'re being with me,\" Chen Ping\'an
said. \"This is how things should be in our Hidden Official\'s branch.
Everyone should feel free to speak their minds as long as it\'s for the
benefit of others, even if it can come off as confrontational and
potentially even offensive.

\"However, what I can say is that the people who are capable of killing
me, such as Yang Zhi and Huang Luan, don\'t dare to come after me for
now, and as for the others, they can come and have a go at me if they
think they have what it takes. For now, I\'m going to pay Nalan Shaowei
and Yan Ming a visit.\"

[]{#chapter-140.xhtml}

# Chapter 629: (2): Killing Intent at Every Turn

Sword of Coming

Chen Ping\'an picked up his Hidden Official jade tablet before strapping
it to his waist, and he was planning to approach the seniors to discuss
some matters about the Stalactite Mountain intercontinental ship. This
was a conversation that had to be had in person, and it wasn\'t
something that could be discussed through exchanges of flying sword
messages.

Mi Yu looked on with mixed emotions as he watched Chen Ping\'an depart
into the distance.

Previously, when Chen Ping\'an had presided over the Hidden Official\'s
branch with only his yin soul, everything that he said and did had come
across as very calculating. All of his words and actions seemed to have
some type of deeper purpose, designed to prop up his authority as Hidden
Official. In contrast, the current Chen Ping\'an was much more direct
and straightforward, and it was difficult to say which version of him
was better.

Heck, as far as Mi Yu was concerned, neither version was great.

He was an Unpolished Jade Tier sword immortal, yet somehow, he had
become nothing more than a glorified lackey of the Hidden Official\'s
branch, and the thought of his past run-in with the Scholarly Sage\'s
branch only made him feel even worse about his current situation.

\"Am I really just not that bright?\" Mi Yu murmured to himself.

All of a sudden, Chen Ping\'an turned back and yelled, \"Come with me,
Sword Immortal Mi. You\'re likely going to be busy very soon.\"

Mi Yu could only muster up some courage and set off after Chen Ping\'an,
but he was quite relieved after hearing what Chen Ping\'an wanted him to
do. It was not an undesirable task, and it would give him an opportunity
to go and get some fresh air on Stalactite Mountain. Not only that, but
Chen Ping\'an even asked Mi Yu for his opinion on some thoughts and
ideas, and Mi Yu replied truthfully, telling Chen Ping\'an that he
disapproved of all of the thoughts and ideas that he proposed. Despite
this, Chen Ping\'an didn\'t seem disheartened at all.

The owner of the Spring Banner Inn, Shao Yunyan, was renowned on
Stalactite Mountain for his reclusive nature. On this day, Shao Yunyan
visited the Ape Havoc Estate, the Water Essence Palace, and the Plum
Blossom Garden out of the four major private estates, but he merely
passed by all of them and took a few glances at them from afar.

Due to his reclusive nature, barely anyone knew what he looked like, and
on top of that, he had cast an illusion onto himself, so there weren't
many people capable of identifying him.

In the end, he made his way to a wine shop, then knocked on the door
using an immortal technique. Ripples spread over the surface of the
door, following which it swung open, and Shao Yunyan stepped into the
shop. As usual, business was very bleak, and there wasn\'t even a single
customer inside aside from him.

Drinking a cup of Forgetting Sorrow Wine in the remnants of the Golden
Millet Blessed Land was something that was on the to-do list of almost
every unfathomable cultivator who came to visit Stalactite Mountain.

An old man was sitting behind the counter, taking a nap, and there was
an ornate birdcage sitting on the counter. Inside the birdcage was a
little oriole, and just like the old man, it was also taking a nap.

The young man by the name of Xu Jia was very happy to see Shao Yunyan,
mostly because he was very interested in Shao Yunyan\'s gourd vine.
Normally, he was renowned among the regular patrons of the wine shop for
his laziness on the job, but on this day, he was particularly diligent
and energetic, quickly carrying a jar of wine and setting it down on the
table.

Xu Jia had never actually spoken to Shao Yunyan before, but he heard
that back when Shao Yunyan first came to Stalactite Mountain, he had
come to the wine shop for its stellar reputation. However, he didn\'t
have money to buy wine, so he asked for a jar of wine in exchange for a
certain Sword Nurturing Gourd on his gourd vine, and in the end, he
drank himself into a stupor.

After that, he earned some money and began to regret his decision, so he
tried to pay for the wine using grain rain coins in accordance with the
market price. However, the shopkeeper refused, and Shao Yunyan never
returned to drink at the wine shop again, seemingly holding a grudge
against the shopkeeper.

Shao Yunyan stood in front of the wall and examined it briefly, then
smiled and mused, \"It\'s only been seven or eight hundred years since I
last came, yet the wall is almost entirely full. It seems like business
has been booming.\"

\"That\'s nothing,\" Xu Jia sighed. \"I heard that there\'s a wine shop
in the city that sells wine of a terrible quality. They\'ve only been
open for just over a year, yet they\'ve already accumulated enough
safety tablets to fill almost three walls!\"

Shao Yunyan apologized to Xu Jia, then picked up the jar of Forgetting
Sorrow Wine and sat down at the same table as when he first visited the
wine shop all those years ago.

He poured himself a bowl of wine, then turned to the counter with a
smile and said, \"The gourd vine has already been taken to Water
Scripture Mountain on the Northern Complete Reed Continent by a little
girl. In about a dozen more years, the Sword Nurturing Gourd will reach
full maturity and fall from the vine, at which point you\'ll need to
send someone to retrieve it. I\'ve already informed Water Scripture
Mountain of my deal with you, so you should be able to pick up the gourd
without any trouble.\"

The old man nodded in response, then opened his eyes and turned to Xu
Jia. \"Do you wanna go?\"

\"What if the young mistress returns while I\'m away from the shop?\" Xu
Jia asked.

\"I just don\'t get it!\" the old man chuckled in exasperation. \"Why
are you so infatuated with her? That daughter of mine has nothing in the
looks department, nor does she have much going on upstairs, and on top
of that, she\'s already in love with someone else! How is she worthy of
your devotion?\"

\"I\'ve been here ever since I was a kid; how many women have I even
seen throughout my life?\" Xu Jia snapped. \"Who am I supposed to like
if not the young mistress?! Should I fall in love with an old geezer
like you instead?\"

The old man was unbothered by Xu Jia\'s snarky remarks. His daughter had
already been gone for many years, leaving only Xu Jia to keep him
company, so he couldn\'t bear to get angry at him. If he were too hard
on Xu Jia, only for the latter to abandon him like his daughter, then
the shop would be in shambles.

\"That\'s even more reason for you to leave then,\" the old man
chuckled. \"Go out there and see what truly beautiful women are like.
Before you know it, you\'ll have already forgotten all about my
daughter.\"

\"I do miss Cao Ci a little,\" Xu Jia mused with a nod. \"I\'ll go to
the Middle Earth Divine Continent to find him after I\'ve picked up the
Sword Nurturing Gourd from the Northern Complete Reed Continent.\"

He then strode over to the counter and picked up the birdcage before
giving it a violent shake as he snapped, \"What do we even keep you
around for? Why weren\'t you able to identify Chen Ping\'an\'s martial
arts aptitude when he came to visit? You were too busy pretending to be
sick, is that it?\"

The oriole was the same species as the one owned by Branch Master Lu
Chen, except that one identified scholarly fortune, while the other
identified martial fortune.

\"Any stories to tell, Shopkeeper?\" Shao Yunyan asked with a smile.

\"Just shut up and drink,\" the old man scoffed. \"What a massive waste
it is that you\'re drinking Forgetting Sorrow Wine like it\'s just
ordinary wine. If it wasn\'t for that Sword Nurturing Gourd, I wouldn\'t
even sell you any wine.\"

Shao Yunyan took a sip of wine, then said, \"The Water Essence Palace is
still solely fixated on making money. I suppose some things never
change. In contrast, the Ape Havoc Estate has already been completely
emptied out, but none of that is important. All I want to know is where
you\'ll be relocating your shop in the future. I\'ve drunk almost all of
the immortal wines under the heavens, but the only ones that have truly
made a lasting impression on me are your Forgetting Sorrow Wine and the
Bamboo Sea Small World\'s Azure Divine Mountain Wine.\"

The old man took a glance at Xu Jia, who was still glowering angrily at
the oriole in the cage, and he stepped around the counter, then grabbed
a jar of wine for himself before sitting down at the same table with
Shao Yunyan. He poured himself a bowl of wine as well, and the two of
them began sharing a drink together.

\"You are completely detached from all of this, so why are you trying to
get involved?\" the old man asked. \"If you\'re going to get involved,
then what does it matter to you where I plan to relocate my shop? Even
if you know the location, it\'s not like you\'ll get to drink there
anyway.\"

\"Can I tell you something straight from the heart?\" Shao Yunyan asked
with a smile.

The old man nodded and replied, \"You know the rules of the shop;
what\'s said in here stays in here.\"

Shao Yunyan cast his gaze toward the white mist at the entrance of the
wine shop and revealed, \"I made a promise to the Sword Qi Great Wall
some time ago, and it\'s a promise that I must follow through on.\"

\"You can\'t just run away?\" the old man asked.

\"That\'s likely going to be difficult,\" the old man mused, quickly
answering his own question.

\"I don\'t have to run away,\" Shao Yunyan asked with a smile. \"As long
as I don\'t blatantly leave Stalactite Mountain without making any
effort at concealing myself, I can leave at any time.\"

\"If that\'s the case, then why are you still here?\" the old man asked.
\"With your paltry cultivation base and shoddy swordsmanship, you\'re
most definitely not going to survive for long here. I suppose death by
inebriation is always preferable to death by stupidity, so I\'ll do you
a favor and give you a free jar of wine.\"

\"The Hidden Official has already defected from the Sword Qi Great Wall
and turned to the Savage World,\" Shao Yunyan said.

\"I didn\'t realize Xiao Xun harbored that much resentment toward the
Majestic World,\" the old man mused as he raised an eyebrow.

\"I heard that a new Hidden Official has been selected to take her
place,\" Shao Yunyan continued with a smile. \"If you can guess who it
is, then I won\'t make you treat me to a free jar of wine. You can have
three guesses.\"

The old man thought about it, then asked, \"Is it Chou Miao, the boy who
picked up the most money with A\'Liang, or is it Ning Yao? Surely it
can\'t be the boy that Xiao Xun took a liking to. What\'s his name
again?\"

\"I think it was Pang Yuanji,\" Xu Jia said.

\"Looks like I\'ll be getting a free jar of Forgetting Sorrow Wine!\"
Shao Yunyan chortled with glee.

After downing two jars of Forgetting Sorrow Wine, Shao Yunyan stumbled
out of the wine shop in a drunken manner, feeling like he had just made
a very worthwhile trip.

Shao Yunyan strolled back to his own residence, which was in a similar
state to the Ape Havoc Estate, and everywhere he stepped, there was
killing intent all around because it was all on Stalactite Mountain.

Bian Jing hadn\'t remained on the city walls to fight, nor had he
traveled to the Southern Whirl Continent with Jiang Guancheng and his
other young compatriots.

Instead, Bian Jing had chosen to stay in the Plum Blossom Garden,
playing Go against Lady Tuo Yan, and it was as if the war raging on the
Sword Qi Great Wall had nothing to do with him.

However, on this day, he left the Plum Blossom Garden and paid a visit
to the Catch and Release Pavilion to see the intercontinental ships come
and go.

The Catch and Release Pavilion was regarded as the least impressive
tourist attraction on Stalactite Mountain, yet it was still absolutely
packed every day. Aside from when it was late at night, the tiny
pavilion was always packed to the rafters.

Bian Jing didn\'t step into the overcrowded pavilion. Instead, he sat on
the railing of the observation deck on the cliff outside the Catch and
Release Pavilion, speaking to himself through his mind\'s lake.

\"Aren\'t you always bragging about how you\'re acquaintances with the
old deaf guy? There are no sword immortals stationed at his prison at
all; is there really no chance that we can\'t do anything there?\" Bian
Jing asked.

\"There\'s no chance. Don\'t even think about it.\"

\"See, this is what I don\'t get about you people from the Savage
World,\" Bian Jing sighed in exasperation. \"Your cultivation base is so
high, yet you\'re still so dogmatic and inflexible.\"

\"Do you consider constantly scheming and plotting a part of your
cultivation?\"

\"Is the Daoist second disciple who reduced you to this state really
invincible?\" Bian Jing asked, intentionally bringing up a sore spot.

\"Unless you\'ve faced him in battle, it\'ll be impossible for you to
understand just how terrifying that old bastard is.\"

\"It\'s a real shame that Lady Gui of Old Dragon City didn\'t accept
Lady Tuo Yan\'s invitation,\" Bian Jing sighed in a forlorn manner.

\"That is indeed quite a shame. Her true form is the most authentic seed
of the Moon Palace. If she were willing to work with us, then that would
significantly boost our chances of success.\"

\"*Our* chances of success?\" Bian Jing scoffed. \"Don\'t lump me in
with you; I\'m just a completely insignificant pawn who was forced into
all of this.\"

\"You may have been forced into this, but it\'s not like you\'re morally
against this, so stop trying to make yourself sound like some type of
valiant martyr.\"

\"According to the latest news from Lady Tuo Yan, there are quite a few
sword immortals who are tempted, and they\'re in a very awkward
situation right now,\" Bian Jing said. \"I bet all of them would like
nothing more than to hack that second shopkeeper to death!\"

This time, Bian Jing\'s assertion was met with no response.

Bian Jing looked out at the intercontinental ships, and there were looks
of unbridled joy on everyone\'s faces.

He smiled and mused to himself, \"When I see so many people so eager to
leave, I no longer feel guilty at all about what I\'m doing.\"

People came to Stalactite Mountain to do business with the Sword Qi
Great Wall, and it was always extremely lucrative. They came with large
quantities of goods that they exchanged for other goods here, and once
they returned to their home continent, they would be able to sell those
goods at astonishing profit margins.

Just one trip to Stalactite Mountain would earn them several years\'
worth of profits, and this business was particularly lucrative in times
of war as the Sword Qi Great Wall was desperate for resources, so they
had all of the bargaining power in the world.

\"There\'s no right or wrong, only different standpoints,\" Bian Jing
mused.

\"Is that meant to be an ironic statement?\"

\"No, I genuinely subscribe to this idea,\" Bian Jing replied with a
smile and a shake of his head. \"Just like how I support the idea that
one\'s fists are the most convincing principles under the heavens.\"

Bian Jing began looking around, inspecting his surroundings.

Very soon, everything was going to be completely different.

# Chapter 630: (1): Assassinating the Hidden Official

Sword of Coming

Chen Ping\'an went to see Yan Ming first. The two of them took a stroll
together, while Mi Yu trailed along in the distance.

Chen Ping\'an\'s first objective was to request the Yan Clan\'s account
books, while his second objective was to ask Yan Ming about the rules of
trade between the Sword Qi Great Wall and the intercontinental ships on
Stalactite Mountain.

What he was truly asking was how much wealth the Yan Clan possessed. How
long could they continue to make losses in these transactions, and how
was the Sword Qi Great Wall going to compensate the Yan Clan for these
losses?

The two of them chatted for close to two hours, with each of them
harboring their own objectives.

On the way here, Chen Ping\'an had shared a very candid conversation
with Mi Yu, who told Chen Ping\'an that he felt like Nalan Shaowei was
going to be very difficult to convince, while Yan Ming would be a much
easier target. On one hand, Chen Ping\'an was the Hidden Official, and
he had been thrust into the role in a time of crisis, so he wielded
immense power.

On the other hand, he was very close with Yan Zhuo, so Yan Ming was
almost obligated to support Chen Ping\'an, even if it meant sacrificing
his entire wealth. On top of that, Chen Ping\'an had a certain level of
sway over the old great sword immortal, and that was the most important
factor to consider.

After parting ways with Yan Ming, Chen Ping\'an set off in search of
Nalan Shaowei. When it came to foreign trade, the Yan Clan and the Nalan
Clan were the two foremost authorities on the Sword Qi Great Wall. The
Dong, Chen, and Qi Clans controlled the garment market, the sword
market, and the alchemical pill market, yet money never passed through
their hands, so Yan Ming and Nalan Shaowei were the two wealthiest
people on the Sword Qi Great Wall.

\"Did things go smoothly?\" Mi Yu asked.

\"For the most part, yes, but there were many hiccups in the discussion
of the finer details,\" Chen Ping\'an sighed. \"I thought that when it
came to interacting with the two seniors, it would be difficult in the
beginning, but it would get easier over time. Instead, it looks like
it\'s only going to become more and more difficult.\"

\"Doesn\'t that mean you called him Uncle Yan for nothing?\" Mi Yu
jibed.

A hint of anger then appeared on his face as he grumbled, \"Does Yan
Ming even understand who he\'s dealing with? This is the Hidden
Official\'s branch! It\'s no exaggeration to say that the welfare of the
entire Sword Qi Great Wall rests on our shoulders! If even I can
understand that, surely Yan Ming wouldn\'t be blind to the bigger
picture. Is he feeling insecure because he\'s lost both his arms, and
he\'s afraid that you\'ll take his power and wealth away from him as
well?\"

Yan Ming had fallen all the way down to the Nascent Tier, so Mi Yu
didn\'t fear him at all.

He had so much money, but couldn\'t use it on his bonded flying sword.
It really was a very pitiful existence, and in Mi Yu\'s eyes, he was
much more pathetic than the swordsmen who had to put their lives on the
line to slay demons and earn money to nurture their bonded flying
swords.

\"It\'s not that simple,\" Chen Ping\'an said with a shake of his head.
\"Yan Ming is a very shrewd businessman. Seeing as we\'ve reached a
consensus on the general direction, it\'s not necessarily a bad thing to
take great care in polishing the finer details. I\'ll just have to visit
him a few more times.

"I think it\'s quite commendable that Yan Ming is not simply bowing to
the authority of the Hidden Official. Instead, he\'s approaching the
situation objectively and treating this just like any other deal, and I
think it shows that he's being responsible to the Sword Qi Great Wall.\"

\"You don\'t feel resentful at all?\" Mi Yu asked.

\"Every piece of hardship is a test, and each test that you overcome
will be sure to bring benefits,\" Chen Ping\'an replied.

Mi Yu offered no response.

Clearly, despite what he was saying, he was still feeling resentful, but
he couldn\'t do anything to Yan Ming, so he was forced to internalize
those feelings.

Chen Ping\'an\'s conversation with Nalan Shaowei turned out to be a very
brief one. The old sword immortal only told him one thing: \"I never
manage my clan\'s financial matters. If you want to speak to someone, go
find Nalan Caihuan.\"

Thus, Chen Ping\'an went to seek out Nalan Caihuan, who turned out to be
a Nascent Tier female swordsman. Her cultivation base was nothing
special, but she had a good head on her shoulders and was very good with
money.

This time, Mi Yu was truly incensed.

\"That old fart is really full of himself, isn\'t he?!\"

Chen Ping\'an didn\'t say anything, and Mi Yu only dared to complain
after the event. Back when they were actually in the presence of Nalan
Shaowei, he didn\'t even dare to breathe too loud.

Nalan Caihuan was a beautiful woman with an elegant figure, and to
complement her natural beauty, she was also very well-dressed, making
her a renowned beauty on the Sword Qi Great Wall.

However, despite her elegant appearance, she was no less brutal and
ferocious than Qi Shou in battle.

Mi Yu was going into this interaction with mixed emotions, and he
intentionally put on a cold facade.

Even though all of the other sword immortals on the Sword Qi Great Wall
looked down on Mi Yu, he was actually very popular with the opposite
sex. He had many female pursuers, and the women who had been rejected by
him were even more scathing in the insults that they directed toward him
than the men. Nalan Caihuan just so happened to be one of those women.

Prior to becoming an Unpolished Jade Tier sword immortal, everything had
gone ridiculously smoothly in Mi Yu\'s life, and it became a common
saying on the Sword Qi Great Wall that Mi Yu took everything in his life
for granted, and that was why he couldn\'t hold down a good woman.

The reality wasn\'t that he couldn\'t hold down a woman. Instead, he had
countless female admirers on the Sword Qi Great Wall and in the Majestic
World, but none of them were able to hold *him* down.

While looking at Nalan Caihuan, Mi Yu saw her for the person that she
was, while Chen Ping\'an saw the mountains of gold and silver that she
managed on behalf of the Nalan Clan.

The first thing that Chen Ping\'an said to Nalan Caihuan came as such a
shock to Mi Yu that he was almost unable to keep up his cold facade.

\"I have already spoken with your clan leader, and the old sword
immortal clearly has an eye for the bigger picture. He told me that
he\'s determined to help the Sword Qi Great Wall overcome this ordeal,
even if it means having to sacrifice the interests of the Nalan Clan.
However, as we were about to part ways, he told me that you were in
charge of the clan\'s financial matters, so I should come and notify you
of his decision.\"

Nalan Caihuan didn\'t doubt Chen Ping\'an\'s assertion, and they began
discussing some finer details.

As Chen Ping\'an and Mi Yu departed along the carriageway, the latter
asked, \"Isn\'t your lie going to be exposed as soon as Nalan Caihuan
speaks to Nalan Shaowei?\"

\"If that\'s the case, then so be it,\" Chen Ping\'an replied. \"Nalan
Shaowei wasn\'t willing to hear me out, so I\'ll get Nalan Caihuan to
speak to him in my stead. If she comes after me, I\'m sure you\'ll be
able to stop her on your own. If Nalan Shaowei decides to come after me,
you\'re most likely going to have a much harder time, but you still have
to make sure to protect me to the best of your abilities, Brother Mi.\"

\"Hasn\'t Lu Zhi been tasked with protecting the Hidden Official\'s
branch? As long as she\'s around, surely it won\'t fall upon me to hold
off Nalan Shaowei,\" Mi Yu said with a wry smile.

Both Nalan Shaowei and Lu Zhi were among the top ten sword immortals of
the Sword Qi Great Wall. Whenever Mi Yu was in their presence, he would
be struck by a deep sense of inferiority, and he normally did everything
in his power to stay out of their way.

Most of Mi Yu\'s friends were swordsmen of the Middle Five Tiers, and
among those, the majority of them were womanizers. As for sword
immortals of the Upper Five Tiers, barely any of them were willing to
acknowledge Mi Yu as a friend.

On the way here, Mi Yu had only been greeted by a single Unpolished Jade
Tier sword immortal by the name of Lie Ji. In terms of cultivation, both
Lie Ji and Mi Yu were in the same boat, starting off as bright prodigies
before quickly reaching their ceiling.

It was said that Lie Ji had a rather flighty personality and could never
bear long stints of seated meditation. In fact, he once had a nickname
of \"Magpie\" for his tendency to dart around from place to place
instead of focusing on his cultivation.

Lie Ji and Mi Yu often drank together to drown their sorrows, and upon
encountering Chen Ping\'an, Lie Ji had smiled and greeted him as Lord
Hidden Official.

In response, Chen Ping\'an also smiled and cupped his fist in a salute.

After they were out of earshot of Lie Ji, Chen Ping\'an jibed, \"You
sure have a lot of friends, Sword Immortal Mi.\"

Mi Yu directed his gaze southward. Just like Pang Yuanji, he would also
prefer to be out slaying demons on the battlefield.

Over the next few days, Chen Ping\'an spent all of his time presiding
over the Hidden Official\'s branch, or went out to discuss matters with
important figures on the Sword Qi Great Wall, accompanied by Mi Yu.

During this time, Mi Yu noticed that Ning Yao was wearing the Golden
Sweet Wine Dao robe, and that she had also crafted a sword case, within
which were two swords. One of them was Sword Immortal, which Chen
Ping\'an had used to slay Li Zhen. It was truly a good name.

It was no wonder Chen Ping\'an would occasionally brag to Gu Jianlong
and Wang Xinshui about his talent in naming things, proclaiming that if
one\'s naming acumen could contribute to their cultivation, then he
would already be at least at the Immortal Tier.

Pang Yuanji mentioned that the Hidden Official\'s branch had been
accumulating secret documents for several thousand years, all of which
were stored in the summer and winter palaces. There were far too many of
these documents for all of them to be transported to the carriageway,
and it would be too inconvenient to send people back and forth to the
two palaces to consult the documents before returning to the
carriageway.

Hence, he proposed that it would be better for everyone to move to the
summer palace, where the majority of the documents were stored. The
messenger flying swords of the Hidden Official\'s branch were extremely
fast, and if they were to take the two picture scrolls with them to the
summer palace, then they could continue to keep an eye on the state of
the battlefield from there.

At this point, the great demons were already aware that the Hidden
Official\'s branch was gathered on the carriageway, so Lu Zhi was forced
to stay on lookout duty for their protection. If they were to move to
the summer palace, not only would they have easier access to all the
documents of the Hidden Official\'s branch, they would also be able to
liberate Lu Zhi and allow her to return to the battlefield.

Everyone in the Hidden Official\'s branch agreed with Pang Yuanji\'s
proposal, but Chen Ping\'an disagreed. He told everyone that there was
no hurry, and that he would decide when the time was right for them to
move to the summer palace.

Pang Yuanji didn\'t argue with his decision, but Dong Bude and Deng
Liang were very much opposed to Chen Ping\'an\'s stance on the matter,
and they were quick to voice their dissent.

Dong Bude\'s main concern was that the Hidden Official\'s branch was far
too important, and that if they were to remain on the carriageway, then
they ran the risk of being wiped out all at once.

In contrast, Deng Liang was more bothered by the idea that Lu Zhi had to
be stationed here for their protection, feeling that it was a massive
waste for her to be tethered here away from the battlefield.

For once, Guo Zhujiu didn\'t defend her master. The entire time, she
stared down at her desk in silence, and it looked as if she were trying
to bore holes into the desk with her gaze.

Her silence was very telling. Normally, she was always her master\'s
staunchest supporter, ready to rise to his defense at a moment\'s
notice, but this time, she couldn\'t bring herself to come to his aid.

However, Chen Ping\'an refused to budge, and he gave some more reasons
to support his decision, but none of them were very convincing. Thus,
there had been some lingering tension in the Hidden Official\'s branch
over the past couple of days.

On this day, Yue Qing came to visit. He paused momentarily outside the
sword qi restriction set up by Mi Yu, and only when he was permitted
entry did he continue onward.

Chen Ping\'an immediately rose to his feet to meet Yue Qing, and the two
of them didn\'t approach the other swordsmen of the Hidden Official\'s
branch.

\"Chen Ping\'an, I\'ve come here to apologize to the closing disciple of
the Scholarly Sage\'s branch, and I\'ve also come to express my
gratitude to you, Chen Ping\'an, not the Hidden Official,\" Yue Qing
said with a smile.

\"I accept both your apology and your gratitude,\" Chen Ping\'an replied
with a nod.

\"I made no effort to conceal my contempt for the Scholarly Sage\'s
branch in the past, so I should be just as forthright with my expression
of apology and gratitude to you now,\" Yue Qing said. \"Honestly, if
someone else had become the Hidden Official instead of you, and they
tried to tell me what to do in battle, I wouldn\'t have taken very
kindly to that at all.\"

\"As is to be expected for a mighty sword immortal of your caliber,\"
Chen Ping\'an replied.

\"You\'re a very competent kid, I\'m willing to concede that, but the
way that you speak really annoys me,\" Yue Qing mused as he rubbed his
own chin.

Chen Ping\'an offered him a flagon of wine.

Yue Qing immediately burst into laughter as he accepted the flagon of
wine, then departed atop his flying sword.

As soon as Chen Ping\'an returned to his seat, Gu Jianlong immediately
smiled and said, \"You\'re going to give Sword Immortal Yue a flagon of
wine, but ignore all of us? That\'s hardly fair, is it, Lord Hidden
Official?\"

\"I could really do with some wine right about now,\" Cao Gun chuckled.

\"I\'ve yet to taste the immortal wine from your wine shop, and that\'s
always been one of my biggest regrets. I hope that can still be
remedied,\" Xuan Can chimed in.

\"You want wine? Pay up!\" Guo Zhujiu snapped as she slammed a hand down
onto her desk.

\"Let\'s leave the drinking for later,\" Chen Ping\'an said with a
smile. \"Once the battle is over, I\'ll cough up the same number of
flagons of wine as the number of the Savage World\'s earth immortal
swordsmen that we manage to slay.\"

Boos immediately rang out all around, with Gu Jianlong and Wang
Xinshui\'s voices the loudest of all.

\"Some of us have gotten very brave,\" Dong Bude remarked without even
raising her head.

\"What the hell\'s wrong with you, Xinshui?\" Gu Jianlong immediately
turned on Wang Xinshui to save his own hide.

\"I was just copying you,\" Wang Xinshui replied with an innocent
expression.

The heavy mood was lightened a little by that brief interlude, and
shortly thereafter, Chen Ping\'an departed once again.

At this point, Mi Yu had already accepted his fate. He now had two more
titles designed to mock him, the first of which was the swordsman with
the loftiest cultivation base in the Hidden Official\'s branch, and the
second was the Hidden Official\'s personal lackey.

It was often the case that he would be walking along when a passing
sword immortal would throw a jab at him, something along the lines of,
\"Lord Hidden Official is taking you out for your daily walk, I see,
Brother Mi.\"

Once again, the two of them passed by Lie Ji, who was having a drink.

Upon spotting the duo, Lie Ji pulled out two flagons of wine from his
pocket treasure, then tossed them at Mi Yu and Chen Ping\'an as he
smiled and said, \"This wine is from the second shopkeeper\'s shop.\"

Mi Yu caught the flagon of wine that had been tossed his way. It was a
flagon of Bamboo Sea Small World wine that cost one snowflake coin. It
seemed that Lie Ji wasn\'t willing to put in a substantial investment
even when he was trying to suck up to others.

Chen Ping\'an also reached out to catch the second flagon of wine, but
right as he did so, a streak of bright sword light suddenly shot through
the air, aimed directly at his heart.

It was Lie Ji\'s bonded flying sword, Burning Flower.

Mi Yu was horrified to see this, and he crushed the wine flagon in his
hand, then instantly summoned his bonded flying sword, Radiant Sunset,
to intercept Burning Flower.

Even if he couldn\'t completely intercept Burning Flower, he had to at
least try to earn Chen Ping\'an a sliver of a chance at survival, no
matter how slim. Even if he were to suffer catastrophic injuries, that
would still be better than dying outright. In addition to injuries
inflicted by the flying sword of a sword immortal, their sword qi would
also linger in the target\'s acupoints, and that was massive pain to
deal with.

Lie Ji and Mi Yu may have been looked down on by all of the other sword
immortals, but they were both still sword immortals, nevertheless. This
was an all-out attack from Lie Ji at point-blank range, and both Chen
Ping\'an and Mi Yu had been caught completely off guard, so all Mi Yu
could hope to do now was save Chen Ping\'an\'s life.

Even though Mi Yu was a tiny bit slow to react, the tip of his flying
sword, Radiant Sunset, was still just barely in time to strike the end
of Burning Flower\'s hilt, knocking it ever-so-slightly off course so
that it was no longer aimed directly at Chen Ping\'an\'s heart.

At the same time, Mi Yu stepped forward and drew his sword to oppose Lie
Ji, who had also sprung forward.

Mi Yu possessed a longsword of an extremely high caliber, and of course,
it had been given to him by his brother, Mi Hu. In contrast, Lie Ji had
no Dao partner or master, so his sword was only an ordinary longsword
from the sword market.

Having given Golden Sweet Wine to Ning Yao, Chen Ping\'an was currently
only wearing the Dao robe from the Ning Manor and a generic Dao robe
from the garment market. In response to the oncoming Burning Flower,
Chen Ping\'an made a hand seal, and a burst of radiant light erupted out
of his innermost Dao robe before taking on the form of an ethereal
golden talisman. It was his Sword Suppressing Talisman.

However, Lie Ji was simply far too close, and he hadn\'t held back at
all, clearly intent on taking Chen Ping\'an\'s life. The two bonded
flying swords clashed, and there was an explosion of sword light. Just
the scattered specks of sword light from that explosion alone were
enough to instantly tear Chen Ping\'an\'s outermost market Dao robe to
shreds.

Burning Flower pierced into the golden Sword Suppressing Talisman, and a
series of cracks instantly appeared over the talisman\'s surface.
Clearly, it wasn\'t going to be able to keep Burning Flower at bay for
long.

However, the Sword Suppressing Talisman had bought Chen Ping\'an some
time, enough time to allow him to whip out a Land-Shortening Talisman,
allowing him to retreat over a hundred feet with just a single step. But
that was nowhere near enough.

The two bonded flying swords raced onto the scene at once, except
Radiant Sunset was trying to save Chen Ping\'an, while Burning Flower
was trying to take his life.

In order to achieve maximal speed, Burning Flower pierced into Chen
Ping\'an\'s body around an inch below his heart.

To further compound Chen Ping\'an\'s woes, Lie Ji detonated Burning
Flower while it was still embedded in his body.

Mi Yu swung his sword down upon Lie Ji\'s shoulder, splitting his body
into two, but Lie Ji didn\'t seem concerned at all for his own safety.

His yin soul sprang forth, abandoning his body as it raised his sword
market longsword and decapitated Chen Ping\'an with a swift and decisive
swing.

At the same time, Burning Flower exploded within Chen Ping\'an\'s body,
and not only did it kill him on the spot, Lie Ji\'s yin soul was also
obliterated in the explosion. In the blink of an eye, both Chen Ping\'an
and Lie Ji had fallen, while Mi Yu was left reeling from shock and
anguish.

> Johnchen and Flying Dumpling\'s Thoughts
>
> Damn, so many people trying to kill Ping\'an. This guy can\'t get a
> break!
