# Chapter 633: (3): The Young Man in the Main Seat

Sword of Coming

The young man accepted the salute, pulled his hands from his sleeves,
and returned it.

Suddenly, it seemed as if a huge weight had been lifted from Shao
Yunyan\'s shoulders, and, to reciprocate the young man\'s goodwill, he
said, \"My Spring Banner Inn is always happy to do business with you.\"

The young man immediately latched onto Shao Yunyan\'s arm and praised,
\"What a generous man you are, Sword Immortal Shao! I was waiting for
you to say exactly that. Thank heavens I didn\'t stand around watching
the snow all this time for nothing!\"

Shao Yunyan was caught a little off guard, and he could tell that the
intercontinental ship administrators were in for a rough time because
two more sword immortals had just arrived, namely Sun Juyuan and Gao
Kui.

That was in addition to Mi Yu, Ku Xia, Yuan Qingshu, Pu He, Song Pin,
Xie Zhi, Xie Songhua, Li Cai, and Wei Jin.

All of these foreign and native sword immortals had suddenly left the
Sword Qi Great Wall to congregate on Stalactite Mountain, and that was
something that had never been seen in the history of the Sword Qi Great
Wall.

Shao Yunyan took his leave before entering the room first and sitting
down on his chair. Among the sword immortals visiting Stalactite
Mountain, there were none from the Parasol Leaf Continent. The Parasol
Leaf Continent was the only continent with no intercontinental ships,
and there were also no sword immortals from the Parasol Leaf Continent
on the Sword Qi Great Wall, so it worked out just fine.

However, the man who had nodded at the Great Heavenly Lord earlier had
just left the Sword Qi Great Wall with a swordsman of the Middle Five
Tiers from the Parasol Leaf Continent, who had traveled alone to the
Sword Qi Great Wall. Together, the two of them made their way to the
downtrodden Parasol Leaf Sect.

However, on this occasion, the man\'s intention wasn\'t to lash out at
the Parasol Leaf Sect. Instead, he was going to help the Parasol Leaf
Continent and the Majestic World. Otherwise, he certainly wouldn\'t have
been willing to leave his junior brother on his own on the Sword Qi
Great Wall.

Scholars always felt obligated to serve the greater good, and Zuo You
had always identified as a scholar, not a sword immortal.

More importantly, there would be more battles for him to fight on the
Parasol Leaf Continent, and there was a very good chance that he would
go into those battles alone without any sword immortals by his side.

His junior brother had tried to trick him by sending him to the Southern
Whirl Continent, telling him that that was where the action was going to
be. However, after hearing from someone else, Zuo You decided to travel
to the Parasol Leaf Continent instead, much to his junior brother\'s
dismay.

It was a long journey to the Parasol Leaf Continent, and he would pass
by the Flood Dragon Trench and the Rain Dragon Sect along the way, but
he wasn\'t going to stop at any of those places.

Instead, he would only linger briefly on Reed Flower Island to see if
the person presiding over the Creation Cave was a powerful Daoist
cultivator as the legends suggested, or if it were a great demon in
hiding instead, as Cui Dongshan proclaimed.

If it were the former, then Zuo You would have a conversation with them,
and if it were the latter, then he would cut them down on the spot.

There were very few things that Zuo You ever felt conflicted about.

Zuo You\'s companion on this journey was a young Golden Core Tier
swordsman from the Parasol Leaf Continent. He was only young in relative
terms. In reality, he was around the same age as Zuo You.

His name was Wang Shizi, and he was a vagrant cultivator. The fact that
a vagrant cultivator like him had become a Golden Core Tier swordsman at
his age was a clear indication of his exceptional aptitude.

Unfortunately for him, there were barely any other cultivators from the
Parasol Leaf Continent on the Sword Qi Great Wall, and there were sword
immortals everywhere. Given his less-than-stellar cultivation base, he
found himself in a very awkward position.

The Eastern Treasured Vial Continent technically counted as a neighbor
of the Parasol Leaf Continent, but Wei Jin was the only cultivator on
the Sword Qi Great Wall from the Eastern Treasured Vial Continent, and
Wang Shizi certainly didn\'t dare to approach Wei Jin. What would they
even talk about?

Thus, he had led a very lonely existence over the past dozen or so years
that he had spent on the Sword Qi Great Wall, focusing solely on his
cultivation. He had taken part in a few battles, but wasn\'t able to
earn any significant battlefield accolades, only just barely enough to
allow him to continue living on the Sword Qi Great Wall.

It was only in the past couple of years that his situation improved a
little because he often went to a certain wine shop to buy wine. The
wine shop was usually packed, and there weren\'t enough tables for its
patrons, so he often had to squat by the side of the road to drink wine
and eat yangchun noodles, but he was happy just to be in the company of
others.

It was a huge surprise that he had been allowed to return home on this
occasion, and he certainly wasn\'t expecting to be accompanied by Zuo
You.

Wang Shizi wasn\'t someone who didn\'t know his place, and he had
remained silent this entire trip.

As they drew close to the Flood Dragon Trench, Zuo You said, \"There\'s
no need to be overly reserved around me. If you have any questions about
cultivation, feel free to ask.\"

\"At my lowly cultivation base, none of my questions are very pressing,
so I can ask them once we\'ve reached the Parasol Leaf Continent,\" Wang
Shizi replied.

Zuo You offered no response as he took a glance back in the direction of
Stalactite Mountain.

\"Senior Zuo, can I ask why you\'re still willing to instruct me in my
cultivation even though I\'ve chosen to leave the Sword Qi Great Wall at
a time like this?\" Wang Shizi asked.

Zuo You turned his gaze back to Wang Shizi, then smiled and said, \"Over
the past fourteen years, you\'ve traveled to the top of the city walls
thrice, but were forced to retreat on all three occasions. You and I are
comrades, so the instruction that I would be providing you would be in
the form of sparring.\"

Wang Shizi wanted to say something, but seemed very hesitant.

\"If you have something to say, then say it,\" Zuo You prompted.

\"I just wanted to say that it almost felt like the second shopkeeper
was speaking to me just now,\" Wang Shizi said with a smile.

Zuo You burst into laughter upon hearing this.

\"Chen Ping\'an is my junior brother, so it\'s no surprise that you find
us similar in the way that we act and speak.\"

\"I\'m sure the second shopkeeper will be renowned across the entire
Majestic World someday!\" Wang Shizi said.

\"We\'ll have to wait and see about that,\" Zuo You replied with a shake
of his head. \"The Majestic World will only blame him for not doing
enough, and everything that they refused to acknowledge in the past
would be used to slander him.

"They\'ll say that he\'s the closing disciple of the Scholarly Sage\'s
branch, my junior brother, a young man who even Chen Qingdu thinks
highly of, and the newly appointed Hidden Official who gets to stay far
away from the battlefield; all of those things will be used as reasons
to deny him the credit that he deserves. If he dies, then so be it, but
as long as he remains alive on the Sword Qi Great Wall, then he will be
faulted for everything that he does.\"

A solemn look appeared on Wang Shizi\'s face.

\"There\'s no need to feel bad; it\'s just something that you have to
get used to,\" Zuo You said.

From there, the two of them continued eastward in silence.

The decor in the main hall of the Spring Banner Inn was reminiscent of a
scholar\'s study. There was a piece of artwork hanging on the wall
depicting a nameless mountain on the Northern Complete Reed Continent,
and hanging on either side of the piece of artwork was a pair of
couplets containing sagely Confucian wisdom. In front of the wall was a
long desk, and in front of that was an eight immortals table with a
chair placed on either side.

The rest of the space in the room was occupied by a series of chairs
arranged in an orderly fashion, and anyone who stepped into the room
would find themselves in an isolated small world.

The administrators of the intercontinental ships filed into the main
hall one after another.

Bai Xi of the Mountain and Water Cave sat down before exchanging a few
glances with some acquaintances, and none of them dared to communicate
through their mind\'s lakes, but each of them could see their own
concern mirrored in one another\'s eyes.

The placement of the chairs in the room was clearly very well
thought-out, and it seemed like many factors had been taken into
account, including the power of the sects, the sizes of the
intercontinental ships, and even the reputations of the administrators.

For example, Bai Xi had noticed a particular administrator from the Pure
White Continent. He was in charge of the Southern Winnowing Basket
intercontinental ship, and he was a Golden Core Tier cultivator who
didn\'t have much of a reputation. He wasn\'t particularly renowned for
his business acumen, and out of all of the administrators present, he
would be considered as someone who was rather low on the pecking order.

However, he had been assigned a very prominent seat on this occasion,
but this came as no surprise to Bai Xi, as the patriarch of the Mountain
and Water Cave had once revealed to him that this administrator was
actually an Unpolished Jade Tier talismanic cultivator in disguise. His
business dealings with Stalactite Mountain were nothing more than a red
herring, while his true objective was to travel to the Flood Dragon
Trench in secret to do business there.

He would use a secret technique to secure Dragon Qi in exchange for
immortal coins, and the Dragon Qi would be injected into talismans. Upon
returning to the Pure White Continent, he would sell the talismans to
the Liu Clan for exorbitant sums.

The patriarch of the Mountain and Water Cave had instructed Bai Xi to be
prudent with his interactions and that there was no need to try to
befriend this particular administrator. Instead, curt nods would
suffice.

The Golden Core Tier administrator reacted quite calmly to this, but Bai
Xi was certain that he was feeling rather disgruntled.

Finally, everyone arrived and sat down.

The dozen or so sword immortals who had left the Sword Qi Great Wall
were seated on the chairs on the right, while all of the
intercontinental ship administrators were seated on the left, and it was
as if the two parties were in opposition to one another.

Only now did all of the intercontinental ship administrators begin to
take a closer look at the young man.

All of the administrators present were sly old foxes who were extremely
observant, and they had all noticed the young man in the room. The main
hall of the Spring Banner Inn was very large, and many pillars inside
had couplets hanging from them. Up to this point, the young man had been
reading the couplets and paying no heed to anyone else.

The two Upper Five Tiers immortals, Wu Qiu and Tang Feiqian, were also
observing the young man, but they were rather perplexed. Of course, they
didn\'t truly believe that he was a cultivator of the Lower Five Tiers.
Instead, they were both of the opinion that he had to have been a sword
immortal adept in disguising his physical appearance and cultivation
base.

The chairs on either side of the eight immortals table in the room
remained vacant.

However, a jade tablet was placed on the eight immortals table a little
closer to the intercontinental ship administrators relative to the sword
immortals of the Sword Qi Great Wall.

Everyone was speculating about who those two chairs were reserved for.
Could it be that one of them was reserved for Han Huaizi, while the
other would be occupied by some mighty sword immortal like Nalan
Shaowei? Perhaps it could even be the leader of one of the Dong, Chen,
and Qi Clans. Otherwise, why would there be so many other sword
immortals present to set the scene?

At the moment, it was extremely difficult to gather any information from
the Sword Qi Great Wall, so everyone was making sure to proceed with
caution.

Even a swordsman as easygoing as Sun Juyuan had begun turning all
visitors away from his manor quite some time ago, and after that, he had
gone straight to the top of the city walls. As for all of the servants
in his manor, they either accompanied him to the city walls or were
confined to the manor. There was a servant who didn\'t think this was
necessary, and he snuck out in secret. Shortly thereafter, he was dead.

Hence, all of the information that had been leaked to Stalactite
Mountain was information that the Sword Qi Great Wall didn\'t feel a
need to hide anymore.

By the time everyone arrived, all of the sword immortals were also
seated, and in the face of such a formidable lineup of sword immortals,
even Wu Qiu was struck by a sense of asphyxiation.

The chairs in the main hall had been positioned in a way to make it feel
as if they were locked in a confrontation against more than ten sword
immortals!

Most importantly, the sword immortals among them who had come from the
Majestic World were all representing the Sword Qi Great Wall on this
occasion.

Aside from the Middle Earth Divine Continent and the Northern Complete
Reed Continent, all of the intercontinental ship administrators from the
other six continents were all feeling very apprehensive.

It had already been quite an ordeal for them, facing a sword immortal
native to their respective continents, yet little did they know that
there was an even more intimidating ordeal waiting for them here.

What was even more unsettling to everyone was that all of the sword
immortals were completely silent, normally only seen when a sword
immortal was about to take someone\'s life.

Why would they bother to speak to someone who was about to be dead?

Shao Yunyan was sitting near the entrance of the main hall, and just
like all of the sword immortals, he was also sitting in silence. The
seat that he had been assigned indicated that he was not going to be the
first to speak, and Yan Ming and Nalan Caihuan weren\'t displaying any
intention of speaking, either.

Some of the more fretful administrators in the room were already
beginning to sweat a little.

*Did they gather us here to kill us all?*

Some of the administrators were carefully looking at the two vacant main
seats in the room, while some others were observing the young man.

One of them just so happened to meet the young man\'s gaze, and the
latter flashed him a faint smile. The administrator was able to muster
up a smile of his own in response, but it was clearly rather forced.

After allowing the tension in the room to marinate for a moment longer,
the young man finally broke the silence, making his way toward one of
the main seats in the room as he smiled and said, \"Now that everyone\'s
here, let\'s begin.\"

All of the sword immortals immediately sat up straight in their chairs,
and as the young man arrived at the main seat on the right-hand side of
the eight immortals table, Mi Yu stood up from his chair, followed by
all of the other sword immortals, as well as Yan Ming and Nalan Caihuan.

All of the intercontinental ship administrators hurriedly rose to their
feet as well, and those among them who were just a little too slow to
stand up wanted to slap themselves for their slow reactions. They still
had no idea what was going to happen, but they were certainly feeling
thoroughly intimidated at this point.

Only after the young man had taken a seat did all of the sword immortals
sit down.

The young man extended a finger and gently tapped the surface of the
eight immortals table, causing the jade tablet on the table to flip
itself over and reveal the words \"Hidden Official\" engraved on its
surface.

The entire hall was deathly silent.

All of the intercontinental ship administrators were aware of the
significance of the jade tablet, and they were waiting with bated breath
to see what would come next.

The young man\'s identity was finally revealed as he smiled and
declared, \"Allow me to introduce myself. I am Chen Ping\'an, the newly
appointed Hidden Official of the Sword Qi Great Wall.\"

[]{#chapter-154.xhtml}

# Chapter 634: (1): Moving Mountains and Turning Seas

Sword of Coming

*The Hidden Official of the Sword Qi Great Wall? Wasn\'t that a little
girl with pigtails?*

All of the intercontinental ship administrators present had heard of
Xiao Xun\'s incredible feats. Apparently, she was able to pulverize
great demons with nothing more than her bare fists, and they had also
heard that she was the most belligerent person on the Sword Qi Great
Wall.

So why was it that this young man was claiming to be the Hidden
Official?

Despite everyone\'s confusion, they had no choice but to believe the
young man, given that there was no way he could get away with making a
false claim of this nature with so many sword immortals present.

Even for those who didn\'t believe him, they had to pretend. Otherwise,
if they were to express any doubt, only to be cut to pieces by a
disgruntled sword immortal, then who would avenge them? One would have
to be incredibly naive to believe that their peers would avenge them.

Even though the intercontinental ship administrators all appeared to be
on cordial terms with one another, the fact of the matter was that they
were more so enemies than allies. There had always been conflicts of
interest between many of the intercontinental ships, and everyone would
be happy to see one fewer competitor.

After taking a moment to assess the situation, an elderly administrator
from the Pure White Continent rose to his feet and said,
\"Congratulations on your appointment to the role of Hidden Official,
Sword Immortal Chen. My name is Dai Hao, and I am the administrator of
the Sacrificial Broth intercontinental ship from the Pure White
Continent. Mentioning my lowly cultivation base would only dirty your
ears, so I\'ll keep that to myself.

\"I think I can speak on everyone\'s behalf when I say that it is an
immense honor to have the Hidden Official personally attend to us, and
in all honesty, there was really no need to have all of these sword
immortals come here as well. Forgive me for perhaps not being as
well-informed as I should be, but at the moment, I am unfamiliar with
how the battle on the Sword Qi Great Wall is progressing.

\"What I *do* know, however, is that all of the sword immortals present
are among the most powerful cultivators under the heavens, and every
moment that they spend on Stalactite Mountain is a moment that they\'ll
spend away from the battlefield, which I think is a real shame.\"

Wu Qiu was quite pleased with this opening salvo from Dai Hao.

While he had spoken with a great deal of reverence and respect, he had
also tactfully expressed some displeasure at the rather obvious
intimidation tactic of gathering so many sword immortals in one place.
While he was only a Golden Core Tier cultivator, if his cultivation base
were directly related to his business acumen, then he would\'ve
undoubtedly already been a cultivator of the Upper Five Tiers.

Indeed, he had just raised a very valid point. These sword immortals
weren\'t good with business matters anyway, so instead of having them
waste their time here, it would be much more appropriate to have them
return to battle on the Sword Qi Great Wall.

Wu Qiu made a mental note of the favor that Dai Hao had just done
everyone. After all, he had taken a great risk in speaking first, and he
was fighting for the interests of all of the intercontinental ships from
all eight continents. If any sword immortal tried to kill him, then Wu
Qiu would be sure to intervene.

Xie Songhua raised an eyebrow as she fixed her gaze on Dai Hao, clearly
unhappy with the fact that the first person to challenge the authority
of the Sword Qi Great Wall was from her Pure White Continent.

Chen Ping\'an listened patiently until Dai Hao was finished, and while
his gaze remained on Dai Hao the entire time, he made a calming hand
gesture toward Xie Songhua, indicating for her to remain seated.

Chen Ping\'an gave Dai Hao a nod, then smiled and said, \"Firstly, I\'m
not a sword immortal. As a matter of fact, it would be debatable to even
call me a swordsman. If you\'re interested, you can make a game out of
trying to guess my cultivation base. I\'ve taken many journeys by
intercontinental ship, and I know that these long journeys can be very
grueling without some way to pass the time.

\"Secondly, regarding your point about how these sword immortals should
be on the battlefield instead of on Stalactite Mountain, that is a very
good point, and I appreciate your candor and concern. You\'ve set a very
good example, Dai Hao. From now on, all of us should be as open and
direct as you are.\"

Many of the intercontinental ship administrators present were expecting
Chen Ping\'an to fly into a rage, and they were rather disappointed at
his mellow response.

After a brief pause, Chen Ping\'an gently tapped the surface of the
table with his knuckles, then continued, \"However, ultimately, it\'s
not up to me what these sword immortals should and shouldn\'t do. In
fact, even the old great sword immortal has never ordered them to do
anything. Why? It\'s very simple: sword immortals are sword immortals,
and they should be as free as their flying swords.

\"Otherwise, they wouldn\'t be as feared as they are, wouldn\'t you all
agree? A sword immortal is only at their most fearsome when they\'re
free to do whatever it is that they please without any regard for things
like sagely teachings and the rules of sects and empires.\"

Sitting across from the administrator of the Mountain and Water Cave\'s
Clay Pot intercontinental ship was Sword Immortal Xie Zhi of the
Circling Ascension Continent.

Sitting across from the intercontinental ship administrators from the
Golden Armor Continent was the female sword immortal, Song Pin.

Sitting across from the intercontinental ship administrators from the
Flowing Dawn Continent was Sword Immortal Pu He, and the administrators
from those three continents were very much in agreement with the
sentiment raised by Chen Ping\'an.

Chen Ping\'an\'s demeanor remained pleasant and amicable, as if he were
speaking to a group of friends, and he continued, \"I appreciate your
good intentions, Dai Hao, but I feel like it would be more appropriate
for someone from another continent to raise these concerns. Sword
Immortal Xie has made two very significant contributions on the
battlefield for the Sword Qi Great Wall.

\"The first time, she ruined the Great Dao foundation of an Unpolished
Jade Tier demon sword immortal, and the second time, she destroyed an
Unpolished Jade Tier demon cultivator, including their body, soul, and
golden core. After these two contributions, Sword Immortal Xie has
already earned herself sufficient accolades to leave the Sword Qi Great
Wall, so she won\'t be returning there anyway.

\"Instead, she\'ll be leaving Stalactite Mountain and returning to the
Pure White Continent with you all. Did she forget to mention this
because she was too busy catching up with you all?\"

Chen Ping\'an turned his gaze to Xie Songhua as he spoke, and the latter
was staring intently at Dai Hao as she replied, \"I did tell them; I
presume Dai Hao must\'ve forgotten.\"

\"That\'s fine,\" Chen Ping\'an said as he took a glance at the falling
snow outside. \"If he\'s forgotten, then just tell him again now. It\'s
not every day that you get to meet someone from your home continent on
Stalactite Mountain, so he must\'ve forgotten amid all the excitement.\"

Dai Hao had been standing ever since he stood up, and he didn\'t dare to
sit back down.

\"What\'re you standing up for?\" Chen Ping\'an asked as his smile faded
away. \"It makes it look like you\'re looking down on everyone when
you\'re the only one standing, while the rest of us are all sitting.
Take a seat.\"

Dai Hao immediately sat down, while Wu Qiu and Tang Feiqian exchanged a
quick glance with one another. It seemed that this newly appointed
Hidden Official behaved very differently from other sword immortals.

The administrator of the Pure White Continent\'s Southern Winnowing
Basket intercontinental ship was called Jiang Gaotai. He was the
Unpolished Jade Tier immortal who was posing as a Golden Core Tier
cultivator. He was very advanced in age, but his appearance was quite
youthful, and his seat was in the front row, right next to Tang
Feiqian\'s.

He was on very good terms with Dai Hao, and in addition to that, his
disguise had been completely ruined by the Sword Qi Great Wall. All of
the intercontinental ship administrators present were extremely shrewd
and cunning businessmen, and Jiang Gaotai was concerned that some of
them would meddle with his dealings with the Flood Dragon Trench. With
that in mind, he felt the need to speak up. He couldn\'t just allow a
woman like Xie Songhua to intimidate the entire Pure White Continent
into silence.

\"Lord Hidden Official, forgive me for being blunt, but all of us are
businessmen, and none of us are particularly proficient in battle,\"
Jiang Gaotai said, not even bothering to stand up from his chair. \"If
this turns into a fight, I daresay just two or three of the sword
immortals that you\'ve assembled here today would be able to kill all of
us with ease.\"

Xie Songhua\'s eyes narrowed slightly as her gaze fell upon Jiang
Gaotai, but she was stoically ignored by the latter, who continued,
\"From the moment that we stepped into this room with all these sword
immortals, we\'ve placed our lives in your hands. We\'re just trying to
do some business and earn a living.

"If you want to have a proper business discussion, then all of us would
be more than happy to oblige. However, if you want to make us comply by
force instead, then we\'ll have to accept whatever terms you propose to
save ourselves, no matter how terrible those terms may be.

\"I don\'t know what everyone else is thinking, and to be honest, I
don\'t really care. I can only speak on behalf of myself and my Southern
Winnowing Basket ship. State whatever price that you fancy, and I\'ll
accept it, even if I have to make a loss. It\'ll be my congratulatory
gift to you for your appointment as the new Hidden Official.\"

Everyone was very impressed with Jiang Gaotai\'s bold declaration, and
this was exactly the courageous display that was needed.

Wu Qiu\'s main concern at the moment wasn\'t Chen Ping\'an. Instead, it
was the possibility that all of the administrators present would descend
into internal conflict and infighting. For example, the Northern
Complete Reed Continent and the Pure White Continent had always been at
odds with one another, and it wouldn\'t surprise Wu Qiu at all to see
the administrators from those two continents try to tear each other down
in this highly tense situation.

Earlier, Shao Yunyan had split all of the intercontinental ship
administrators up by continent before having them meet with a sword
immortal from their respective continent, and that had been a truly
devious move.

It was common knowledge that the Northern Complete Reed Continent and
the Pure White Continent were at odds with one another, and in the wake
of Jiang Gaotai\'s statement, an elderly Nascent Tier administrator from
the Northern Complete Reed Continent was immediately struck by the urge
to speak up in opposition.

Even if he wasn\'t opposed to what Jiang Gaotai had said in principle,
the mere fact that Jiang Gaotai had spoken in such a cocky fashion in
front of everyone was enough to make his blood boil. Two administrators
from the Pure White Continent had just delivered the two opening
statements, and he was not about to let them go unopposed any longer!

However, before any of the intercontinental ship administrators from the
Northern Complete Reed Continent could stand up against Jiang Gaotai,
they received a message from Li Cai through their mind\'s lakes, telling
them, \"Don\'t react to him. All you have to do is sit and watch
tonight.\"

\"Stand up when you speak,\" Chen Ping\'an said with a smile.
\"Etiquette is very important in the Majestic World.\"

This statement from Chen Ping\'an immediately created a slight stir
among the intercontinental ship administrators.

*First, you tell Dai Hao to sit down, and now, you tell Jiang Gaotai to
stand up? What do you take us for, your playthings?!*

Jiang Gaotai was certainly less than pleased. His life thus far had
mostly been smooth sailing. He had been blessed with a constant string
of fated opportunities, and he had never been humiliated like this by
anyone, even when doing business with the Liu Clan on the Pure White
Continent.

Chen Ping\'an tucked his hands up their opposite sleeves, watching Jiang
Gaotai with a smile.

Dai Hao had tactfully criticized Chen Ping\'an for gathering all of
these sword immortals here instead of allowing them to fight on the
Sword Qi Great Wall, and in response, Chen Ping\'an had said a bunch of
inconsequential nonsense. The only truly impactful statement that he had
made was that Sword Immortal Xie had destroyed the golden core of an
Unpolished Jade Tier great demon, alluding to Dai Hao\'s Golden Core
Tier cultivation base in a thinly veiled threat.

Jiang Gaotai had gone on the attack, adopting a direct and forceful
approach to try and force the Sword Qi Great Wall\'s hand, yet in
response, Chen Ping\'an had brought up the etiquette of the Majestic
World.

This was very frustrating to many of the old administrators present, as
this was precisely the way that business was often discussed in the
Majestic World. They had used similar tricks many a time in their
business dealings, and they were now being given a taste of their own
medicine.

Jiang Gaotai smiled as he stood up and cupped his fist in a salute.
\"Please pardon me for my lack of etiquette, Lord Hidden Official.\"

All of the other administrators heaved a collective sigh of relief. They
had been terrified that Jiang Gaotai would give Chen Ping\'an an excuse
to kill him and set an example.

\"Apology accepted,\" Chen Ping\'an said with a smile. \"You can sit
down and speak now.\"

A furious look appeared on Jiang Gaotai\'s face as he stood rooted to
the spot. If he had been in a private meeting, then as a businessman, he
would\'ve had much more tolerance for any humiliation that Chen Ping\'an
directed his way. However, his concern was that if he were to allow Chen
Ping\'an to humiliate him like this in front of all of these people, it
would impact the many secret business deals that he had with the Liu
Clan of the Pure White Continent in the future.

With that in mind, he began to storm out of the room, no longer willing
to play Chen Ping\'an\'s game.

\"Looks like I\'ll be returning to the Pure White Continent on the
Southern Winnowing Basket then, Lord Hidden Official,\" Xie Songhua
said.

Shao Yunyan was even more direct and straightforward, standing at the
entrance directly in Jiang Gaotai\'s path as he said, \"Even if the
Sword Qi Great Wall and the Southern Winnowing Basket can\'t work
together in business, the friendship still remains, and that has nothing
to do with me anyway, but it just so happens that I\'m the owner of the
Spring Banner Inn. Hence, before Sword Immortal Xie leaves, I\'d like to
invite Administrator Jiang on a tour of my Spring Banner Inn.\"

Shao Yunyan didn\'t want to see Xie Songhua go to extremes, as that
could negatively impact her future cultivation prospects. In contrast,
there wasn\'t much of a future for him left in cultivation anyway, so he
didn\'t have anything to lose.

Jiang Gaotai stopped in his tracks as he burst into laughter, then
turned to Chen Ping\'an and sneered. \"Do you think we\'re all fools,
Lord Hidden Official? Is this how the Sword Qi Great Wall does its
business? By intimidating its business partners and killing those who
refuse to comply? If you keep this up, I\'d like to see how many ships
will be willing to come and do business on Stalactite Mountain in half a
year\'s time!\"

\"You\'re a smart man, Administrator Jiang,\" Chen Ping\'an said with a
smile. \"Otherwise, you wouldn\'t have been able to reach the Unpolished
Jade Tier. A smart man like you clearly knows the etiquette of the
Majestic World, so I can only assume that you never wanted to do
business with our Sword Qi Great Wall from the very beginning. That\'s
fine. You\'re allowed to leave and take a stroll with Sword Immortal
Shao.

"However, before anyone misunderstands, I want to make it clear that
Sword Immortal Shao has nothing to do with us. The only reason why I
chose the Spring Banner Inn as the meeting place for everyone is for its
scenery, and I\'ve paid Sword Immortal Shao on behalf of the Sword Qi
Great Wall.\"

\"My humble Spring Banner Inn is very honored to be able to play host to
so many sword immortals, so I did give some discount,\" Shao Yunyan
added with a smile.

Chen Ping\'an heaved a forlorn sigh as he turned to Jiang Gaotai and
said, \"Those are some very heavy accusations you\'ve made,
Administrator Jiang, ones that I must disagree with. It would pain me to
no end if the Sword Qi Great Wall\'s business dealings with the Southern
Winnowing Basket fall through, but I would have no one to blame but
myself for not being able to convince you to stay on as a business
partner.

\"However, right now, I haven\'t even had the chance to state my price
yet, and it seems like you have no interest in hearing what I have to
offer at all. The old saying is correct: A man\'s word is respected only
as much as the man himself. My mistake was trying to speak before I
earned everyone\'s respect, and all I\'ve accomplished is making a fool
out of myself.

\"I won\'t blame you for your lack of patience, Administrator Jiang. All
that I ask in return is that you don\'t falsely believe that I\'m
lacking in sincerity and throw unwarranted accusations my way. Even if
we are to part ways, we should do so on amicable terms.\"

[]{#chapter-155.xhtml}

# Chapter 634: (2): Moving Mountains and Turning Seas

Sword of Coming

Chen Ping\'an turned his gaze away from Jiang Gaotai, then glanced over
Wu Qiu, Tang Feiqian, and Bai Xi one after another as he continued,
\"Rest assured, our Sword Qi Great Wall is very earnest in its desire to
do business with you all. Dai Hao has spoken, as has Jiang Gaotai, and I
can allow one more person among all of you to speak to the Sword Qi
Great Wall on everyone\'s behalf.

\"After that, we can begin discussing business. I can promise you this:
If you\'re going to make less money than you have in the past, then not
only will that be an undesirable outcome for all of you, the Sword Qi
Great Wall and I will also find that unacceptable.\"

Chen Ping\'an then turned his gaze to the lineup of sword immortals and
asked, \"Sword Immortal Xie, you\'re not going to keep Administrator
Jiang company alongside Sword Immortal Shao?\"

Xie Songhua rose to her feet, and a rare look of guilt appeared on her
face. She hated owing favors to others, and the fact that she was unable
to repay Chen Ping\'an for the two major battlefield accolades that he
had helped her accumulate was very vexing for her.

Chen Ping\'an shook his head with a smile, indicating that she had
nothing to feel guilty over, and she didn\'t dwell on those emotions.

Instead, she turned to Jiang Gaotai and said, \"Once I step out of this
room, I will only be Xie Songhua of the Pure White Continent, and I will
no longer have any ties to the Sword Qi Great Wall. What do you say Shao
Yunyan and I accompany you on a tour of the Spring Banner Inn?\"

Jiang Gaotai\'s mind was racing, and he asked, \"Lord Hidden Official,
were you being sincere when you said that you\'ll make sure none of us
lose money today?\"

Chen Ping\'an remained silent with a faint smile on his face.

Meanwhile, Shao Yunyan had already walked out of the main hall, and the
sword in the bamboo sword case on Xie Songhua's back was buzzing in a
menacing fashion.

Tang Feiqian stood up from his chair, then cupped his fist in a salute
toward Chen Ping\'an and implored, \"Please allow Administrator Jiang to
stay, Lord Hidden Official. It\'s never good to part ways on hostile
terms. Instead, wouldn\'t it be much better to salvage the business
relationship between the Southern Winnowing Basket and the Sword Qi
Great Wall?\"

Tang Feiqian wasn\'t saying this to save Jiang Gaotai. Instead, he was
doing this for himself and all of the intercontinental ship
administrators in the room. For now, they had to hide their gripes and
frustrations, and they would be free to vent as they pleased once they
left the Spring Banner Inn and were far away from Stalactite Mountain.

\"You\'re all familiar with the intricacies of the cultivation world of
the Majestic World, and the same applies to me as well,\" Chen Ping\'an
said. \"Do you really expect me to believe that you don\'t know what
fate awaits Administrator Jiang after he walks out of this room, or do
you think that Administrator Jiang is oblivious to this himself? How do
I allow him to stay? Why *should* I allow him to stay?

\"You are the third person to speak to me, so I\'ll listen to what you
have to say, but you better present some compelling points to make it
worth my time. We\'re all here to do business in this room, and if we
want to do business, then there are certain rules that we must follow,
rules that override any authority I may have as Hidden Official.

"At the end of the day, it\'s all about money. Once you\'ve known me for
a while, you\'ll come to realize that I am at least one of, if not *the*
fairest businessman on the entire Sword Qi Great Wall.\"

\"That I can definitely agree with,\" Sword Immortal Xie Zhi chimed in
with a smile.

\"No one\'s going to believe it if you\'re on my side to begin with,\"
Chen Ping\'an chuckled.

\"That\'s a completely unreasonable statement, Lord Hidden Official!\"
Xie Zhi protested. \"I\'m from the Circling Ascension Continent, so my
allegiance lies with these people instead of you or the Sword Qi Great
Wall.\"

Wei Jin had been sitting expressionlessly with his eyes closed this
entire time, but he couldn\'t help but feel a little amused upon hearing
this. Surely Chen Ping\'an hadn\'t taught Xie Zhi to say this in
advance, so these words had most likely come directly from the heart.

After taking a moment to collect his thoughts, Tang Feiqian said in a
cautious manner, \"As long as you\'re willing to allow Administrator
Jiang to stay, I can give the Sword Qi Great Wall a ten percent discount
the next time my ship returns to Stalactite Mountain.\"

Chen Ping\'an picked up the jade tablet on the table, then attached it
to his belt before sitting down on his chair as he scoffed. \"Why should
I allow an insolent fool like him to stay and continue to serve as an
eyesore for me? Do you really think that my title as Hidden Official
isn\'t even as valuable as the Southern Winnowing Basket, whose true
objective is to steal Dragon Qi from the Flood Dragon Trench? Ten
percent?

\"You think I don\'t know that the Liu Clan of the Pure White Continent
is selling Dragon Qi to your backers in secret? Is that Dragon Qi only
worth ten percent to you? Not only are you insulting me, but you\'re
also making a mockery of Jiang Gaotai\'s life!\"

Tang Feiqian\'s brows furrowed slightly upon hearing this. How did the
Sword Qi Great Wall know about the secret Dragon Qi trade?

\"Sword Immortal Ku Xia,\" Chen Ping\'an called out.

\"I\'m here,\" Ku Xia replied as he rose to his feet.

Compared with Xie Songhua, he owed Chen Ping\'an an even bigger favor.
As a future pillar of the Shaoyuan Empire, Lin Junbi had an incredibly
bright future ahead, and it was all thanks to Chen Ping\'an. Ku Xia was
a very simple man. He owed Chen Ping\'an a favor, and he was determined
to return it. That was all.

If he couldn\'t return the favor, then he would make a request to Zhou
Shenzhi to return the favor in his stead. He had never asked Zhou
Shenzhi for anything in his life, but he wouldn\'t be opposed to having
Lin Junbi make the request for him once he returned to the Middle Earth
Divine Continent. As for whether that would be enough for Zhou Shenzhi
to do something, that was not something for Ku Xia to think about.

Bai Xi knew that Ku Xia was the most easygoing one of all of the sword
immortals present, so if even he were to start making threats, then that
would undoubtedly be a very daunting prospect for everyone present.

Thus, he knew that he couldn\'t allow Ku Xia to speak, even if he had to
put his life on the line. He had come to realize that when it came to
doing business with Chen Ping\'an, trickery and deception were not the
way to go.

With that in mind, Bai Xi rose to his feet, then declared with a look of
resolve in his eyes, \"If you insist on making Administrator Jiang
leave, then allow me to go with him.\"

A mocking sneer then appeared on his face as he continued, \"My only
hope is that Sword Immortal Xie and Sword Immortal Shao don\'t think
that someone of my paltry cultivation base is unworthy of accompanying
them.\"

\"You\'re definitely not worthy, but it\'s fine; there\'s plenty of
sword qi in my sword case to go around,\" Xie Songhua said in a casual
manner.

Shao Yunyan was still standing at the entrance of the main hall, while
Ku Xia turned his gaze to Chen Ping\'an.

In response, Chen Ping\'an smiled and made a calming hand gesture,
indicating that there was no need to get worked up.

With Bai Xi unexpectedly stepping up to oppose Chen Ping\'an, the
intercontinental ship administrators were suddenly nowhere near as
passive as they had been just a moment ago, and it didn\'t take long
before other cultivators from the same continent as Bai Xi stood up to
join him in a united front.

Even the Nascent Tier administrators that had been tossed out of the
Spring Banner Inn by Pu He earlier, the one who was forced to grovel and
apologize to Pu He like a dog, had stood up with a determined expression
to join Bai Xi.

\"Administrator Liu Yu of the Temple Bell would also like to enjoy a
tour of the Spring Banner Inn, and I would be honored to see Sword
Immortal Xie\'s sword qi for myself.\"

Not only that, but there was also a female Golden Core Tier cultivator
who was the administrator of a rather insignificant intercontinental
ship.

Her chair was very far back, so she wasn\'t far away from Shao Yunyan,
and she also stood up and said, \"Administrator Liu Shen of the Rainbow
Raiment would also be honored to go on a tour of the Spring Banner Inn
with Sword Immortal Xie and Sword Immortal Shao.\"

Not only was she a female cultivator, but her cultivation base was also
the lowest of everyone present, so killing her would make the sword
immortals appear very depraved and inhumane.

The final one to stand was the Nascent Tier female cultivator from the
Middle Earth Divine Continent who had spoken to Mi Yu through her
mind\'s lake earlier.

As she stood up from her chair, she turned to Mi Yu with a smile and
greeted, \"Long time no see, Sword Immortal Mi. I wonder if your
swordsmanship has improved since we last met.\"

\"Even if it has, I couldn\'t bring myself to raise my sword against
you.\" Mi Yu sighed.

The woman merely looked back at him with a cold sneer.

Wu Qiu had remained seated this entire time, but he was extremely
pleased with this outcome. In the face of a common enemy, all of the
administrators had set aside their differences to form a united front.

If these sword immortals wanted bloodshed, then that was exactly what
they were going to get! Right now, all of the administrators were openly
challenging the sword immortals to kill them, confident that the sword
immortals wouldn\'t dare to take them up on their challenge.

\"Thank you, everyone!\" Jiang Gaotai said as he cupped his fist in a
grateful salute.

Tang Feiqian was also still seated in his chair, but he was feeling just
as pleased as Wu Qiu with the way things were going.

Did this young Hidden Official really think that having these sword
immortals on his side and that jade tablet in his grasp would allow him
to impose his will on everyone as he pleased? What an insolent little
brat!

Li Cai\'s lips curled up slightly at the corners, and she was very much
tempted to just kill everyone here and be done with it.

However, Chen Ping\'an\'s voice rang out in her mind\'s lake, and once
again, he was telling her to stand down. Only then did she reluctantly
suppress her killing intent.

Wei Jin had already opened his eyes, and the two administrators from Old
Dragon City were just about to stand up as well, but they immediately
decided against it in the face of Wei Jin\'s hostile gaze.

The administrators from the Southern Whirl Continent were still sitting
on the fence, while the administrators from the Northern Complete Reed
Continent had no intention of getting involved at all.

The administrators who had stood up were feeling so excited and
triumphant that they were only just beginning to realize that Chen
Ping\'an\'s reaction to this turn of events wasn\'t what they had
expected at all. They had anticipated that Chen Ping\'an would become
extremely agitated and be at a complete loss for what to do, but
instead, he remained as composed as ever, casually watching everyone
with a smile on his face as if he were watching an amusing performance.

The Northern Complete Reed Continent, the Eastern Treasured Vial
Continent, and the Southern Whirl Continent were the easiest ones to
deal with.

The first one had always had an eye for the bigger picture, the second
one didn\'t really have any speaking rights, and the third one was too
close to Stalactite Mountain, and it was also home to the Pure Confucian
Chen Clan. It was important to remember that Chen Chun\'an had only left
the Sword Qi Great Wall not long ago.

On the flip side, the Middle Earth Divine Continent, the Pure White
Continent, and the Circling Ascension Continent were the most difficult
ones to deal with.

The first was extremely arrogant and looked down on all eight of the
other continents, the second valued money above all else, while the
third was very familiar with doing business with Stalactite Mountain and
knew how to maximize profits.

As for the Golden Armor Continent and the Flowing Dawn Continent,
whether they were easy to deal with or not was dependent on the
situation, and in the current situation, they were not going to be so
easy to deal with.

Finally, Chen Ping\'an\'s gaze settled momentarily on the two
intercontinental ship administrators from Old Dragon City.

All of the intercontinental ships on the Eastern Treasured Vial
Continent belonged to Old Dragon City, and they consisted of the Fu
Clan\'s Treasure Swallowing Whale and the floating mountain known as
miniature Stalactite Mountain, the Sun Clan\'s Mountain and Sea Turtle,
the Fan Clan\'s Osmanthus Island, and the Ding Clan also had an
intercontinental ship.

Of the two administrators present in the Spring Banner Inn, one was the
administrator of the Fu Clan\'s Treasure Swallowing Whale, while the
other oversaw the Ding Clan\'s intercontinental ship.

Chen Ping\'an had visited Old Dragon City on several occasions without
ever running into these two, and even if the two administrators had
heard of him, they were most likely of the opinion that it had to be
someone else of the same name.

\"What\'s going on all of a sudden?\" Chen Ping\'an asked with a lazy
smile. \"We\'re all here to do business, are we not? Why are you
suddenly all up in arms? There\'s no need to get so worked up and
defensive.\"

\"How can we *not* get worked up when you\'re threatening our lives and
assembling all these sword immortals to intimidate us?\" Tang Feiqian
sneered.

\"I\'m just an inconsiderate young man who let a bit of power get to his
head,\" Chen Ping\'an said. \"If you feel threatened by anything I\'ve
done or said, I assure you that was not my intention.\"

Wu Qiu took a sip of tea, then set down his teacup with a smile and
said, \"In terms of status and future potential, none of us can even
begin to compare with you, but that doesn\'t give you the right to push
us around as you please. Sometimes, if it\'s not meant to be, then it\'s
simply not meant to be. All of us work very hard and have to regularly
put our lives on the line, all for the sake of money.

\"How about this? Let\'s continue this discussion another time at some
other place? Next time, there\'s no need to trouble all of these sword
immortals to come here from the Sword Qi Great Wall. As a matter of
fact, even being in the presence of the Hidden Official is too much of
an honor for us. Instead, you can simply have Clan Leader Yan or Sword
Immortal Nalan attend to us next time. For a bunch of nobodies like us,
they will more than suffice.\"

\"I told you all earlier that there are rules to everything,\" Chen
Ping\'an said with a smile. \"There are rules that you have to follow if
you choose to leave this place, just as there are rules that must be
followed while you\'re sitting here. At the end of the day, everything
can be resolved through money. To tell you all the truth, I came here on
this occasion fully intending to kill a bunch of you and have you
replaced. For example\...\"

Chen Ping\'an turned his gaze to the female Golden Core Tier cultivator
sitting near the back and continued, \"Liu Shen, if I recall correctly,
you are the administrator of the Rainbow Raiment. I am willing to spend
two hundred grain rain coins or resources from the alchemical pill
market equivalent to that price to have your junior sister take over the
Rainbow Raiment. It may not be a fair price, but if you\'re already
dead, then what can they do?

\"Are they just going to stop coming to Stalactite Mountain and give up
on all the profits that they could make here? Even if you\'re gone, the
ship is still unharmed, and at the very least, they\'ll be making two
hundred grain rain coins for your head. Why am I picking you first?
It\'s very simple; because you\'re the weakest link here. Even if I kill
you, your sect and your seniors wouldn\'t even dare to so much as bat an
eyelid in my direction.\"

Liu Shen\'s complexion instantly turned deathly pale.

\"How many grain rain coins is my head worth in your eyes, Lord Hidden
Official?\" Jiang Gaotai asked with a smile.

\"Your fate is already sealed, so I won\'t bother to spend even a single
snowflake coin for your head,\" Chen Ping\'an replied with a shake of
his head. \"If the Liu Clan of the Pure White Continent tries to seek
justice for you, Sword Immortal Xie will answer to them in my stead, and
Sword Immortal Ku Xia will put in a request with Zhou Shenzhi to smooth
things over with Tang Feiqian and his backers.

\"You\'re all businessmen, so I\'m sure you\'re aware that everything
has a price, even the lives of Upper Five Tiers immortals. Sword
Immortal Xie, don\'t bother going anywhere. Just stay here and keep an
eye on Administrator Jiang. Another word from him, and it\'s off with
his head. Otherwise, everyone will think that I don\'t even dare to kill
anyone to set an example.\"

This was what Xie Songhua had been waiting for this entire time.
Finally, it was time to start killing.

Chen Ping\'an turned his gaze to Bai Xi of the Mountain and Water Cave,
then continued, \"The patriarch of your clan has a long-standing
vendetta against our Sword Qi Great Wall. The past Hidden Official never
did anything about that, so I\'ll do her job for her.

"I must regrettably tell you that you won\'t be leaving this room
tonight. I\'ll get Sword Immortal Xie Zhi to make a trip to the Circling
Ascension Continent to deliver the Clay Pot back to the Mountain and
Water Cave, and he\'ll explain the situation to your patriarch.

\"Once you\'re dead, all of the past differences between the Sword Qi
Great Wall and the Mountain and Water Cave will have been settled. From
there, it\'s up to the Mountain and Water Cave whether they want to
continue doing business with our Sword Qi Great Wall, and if they choose
not to, then they\'ll have to bear the consequences.\"

Sword Immortal Xie Zhi stood up from his chair with an eager smile and
mused, \"Finally! It\'s been a long time since I last killed an official
immortal.\"

[]{#chapter-156.xhtml}

# Chapter 634: (3): Moving Mountains and Turning Seas

Sword of Coming

\"All of you who haven\'t stood up to try and rebuke me tonight, from
now on, you are all esteemed guests of the Sword Qi Great Wall,\" Chen
Ping\'an continued. \"When it comes to doing business, I think
information transparency is very important, and I\'m willing to put my
money where my mouth is. Unless I dredge up everyone\'s dirty secrets
for everyone to see, I don\'t think it\'s possible to establish a long
and productive business relationship. Mi Yu!\"

Mi Yu stood up from his chair, then cast a cold gaze toward the female
Nascent Tier cultivator and said, \"I\'m sorry, I lied to you one last
time just now. The truth is that I would have no qualms at all about
killing.\"

The female Nascent Tier cultivator\'s heart instantly shattered into a
million pieces.

Mi Yu then pulled a book out of his sleeve, and after looking around the
room momentarily, he picked an administrator who didn\'t stand up, but
had almost done so, then rattled off an extremely comprehensive personal
profile about them, including his origins, the names of his direct
disciples and which one he thought the most highly of, a list of names
of all of his descendants, the locations of all of his private
residences, not just on Stalactite Mountain, but on his home continent,
and even on other continents.

All of this information was casually laid bare by Mi Yu, and he even
revealed the names of the celestial maidens who weren\'t the
administrator\'s Dao partner, but had had romantic entanglements with
him, nevertheless.

After that, Mi Yu did the same thing to two other administrators before
Chen Ping\'an finally raised a hand to stop him.

\"That\'s enough. Three is a good number to end off on for now.\"

Mi Yu nodded in response.

Chen Ping\'an then turned his gaze to another sword immortal and called
out, \"Pu He.\"

Pu He stood up with his gaze fixed on the Nascent Tier cultivator who
had apologized to him earlier, and he sneered. \"Sometimes, I really
don\'t understand you people at all. Earlier, you were almost a dead
man, and you had to beg and grovel on your knees for me to spare you,
yet here you are now, throwing your life away again. Once I board your
ship, I\'m going to make sure that Leng Ran also grovels at my feet like
a dog, just like you did!\"

Chen Ping\'an cast his gaze toward Wu Qiu and Tang Feiqian, who were
clearly the unofficial leaders of all of the administrators present, and
he said, \"You two have properties even on Temper Mountain of the
Northern Complete Reed Continent, yet you tell me about how
insignificant you are and how difficult money is to come by for you.\"

Li Cai immediately rose to her feet and declared, \"I\'m not leaving
Stalactite Mountain, but I can send a messenger flying sword to Duckweed
Sword Lake and the Great Emblem Sword Sect and tell them there are some
rumors going around on Stalactite Mountain, stating that Wu Qiu and Tang
Feiqian have been colluding with the demon tribe.

"By the way, Yu Juanfu and Zhu Mei are still around, aren\'t they? Sword
Immortal Ku Xia, can I trouble you to tell them to spread the word as
well when they return to the Middle Earth Divine Continent?\"

\"Sure, that\'s not a problem at all,\" Ku Xia replied as he also stood
up from his chair.

\"You think I\'m doing all of this to make enemies out of your sects and
backers?\" Chen Ping\'an asked. \"If that\'s what you think, then
you\'re wrong. The fact of the matter is that I simply do not like the
look of all of you.

"However, rest assured, I\'m very measured in everything that I do, and
I\'m going to kill off a select few of you who must be killed, and I\'ll
be offering apologies and compensation to all of your sects and backers,
so from a long-term perspective, no one loses out.

\"You really think I gathered all of these sword immortals just to keep
you all company? They have much better things to do than waste their
time with a bunch of worthless leeches like all of you.\"

Sun Juyuan also stood up with a smile and said, \"I\'m on decent terms
with the sects and backers of just about everyone here, so I\'ll
personally be making the rounds and delivering apologies in Lord Hidden
Official\'s stead.\"

Yan Ming stood up and said, \"As for compensation, our Yan Clan will
take care of that, and I\'m prepared to dole out compensation until our
Yan Clan goes completely bankrupt.\"

Nalan Caihuan remained seated in her chair. This was not how she had
expected things to go at all.

Chen Ping\'an turned his gaze to her and said, \"Don\'t embarrass us in
front of all of these people. Don\'t forget that you\'re representing
not just the Sword Qi Great Wall, but also Nalan Shaowei and the Nalan
Clan.\"

Nalan Caihuan could only reluctantly stand.

At this point, Chen Ping\'an\'s smile had already completely faded, and
he was staring intently at Nalan Caihuan, while the latter remained
stoically silent.

\"Has your chair been misplaced? I think you should be sitting further
back so you\'re not such an eyesore to everyone, Nalan Caihuan,\" Chen
Ping\'an said.

A furious look appeared in Nalan Caihuan\'s eyes, and she was just about
to deliver a rebuke when Gao Kui rose to his feet and pinned her with a
threatening gaze, forcing her to swallow the insults that were about to
fly out of her mouth.

All of the administrators were completely dumbstruck. It seemed like
Chen Ping\'an was not just prepared to kill all of the administrators in
the room, but even the likes of Nalan Caihuan if she refused to
cooperate with him!

At this point, it had become abundantly clear to everyone that they were
dealing with someone extremely ruthless, and that his threats were far
from empty bluffs.

Finally, Wu Qiu stood up from his chair, then cupped his fist in a
salute and said, \"There\'s no need for this, Lord Hidden Official. At
the end of the day, this is just business. Let\'s all take a step back
for our mutual benefit. I\'m sure there\'s a happy middle ground that we
can reach.\"

Chen Ping\'an paid no heed to Wu Qiu as he looked out at the falling
snow, and it seemed as if he were talking to himself as he murmured,
\"Do all of you really think that the Sword Qi Great Wall doesn\'t have
any connections and goodwill in the Majestic World? Just because the
sword immortals of the Sword Qi Great Wall don\'t want to stoop as low
as filthy roaches like all of you doesn\'t mean that they\'re all fools
with no business acumen.

\"Do you know why all of you who have chosen to stand up are still alive
right now? To answer that question, let\'s take a trip back through
history. The first-ever intercontinental ship to visit Stalactite
Mountain was a ship by the name of Water Pillow from the Southern Whirl
Continent, and if I recall correctly, the second ship was from the
Circling Ascension Continent, but the sect that owned that ship no
longer exists. The third ship came from the Parasol Leaf Continent,
which no longer has any intercontinental ships.

\"That ship was the Paper Umbrella, and it eventually capsized out at
sea, killing everyone onboard. After the news traveled to the Sword Qi
Great Wall, all of the sword immortals collectively raised their swords
in a silent vigil. This happened so long ago that even many of the
native sword immortals of the Sword Qi Great Wall most likely aren\'t
familiar with this event.

\"In the beginning, the intercontinental ships that traveled to
Stalactite Mountain didn\'t aim to make profits at all, and they were
practically giving money to the Sword Qi Great Wall. Since then, a lot
has changed, but our Sword Qi Great Wall will still remember everything
that all of the intercontinental ships from the Majestic World have done
for us. Why is it that even though Nalan Shaowei was so furious at the
time, he still didn\'t go on a rampage in the Rain Dragon Sect? Do you
know the reason now?

\"It\'s not because the patriarch of the Rain Dragon Sect was so smart,
or that he was able to unite everyone to protect him. All of it
would\'ve taken was a single slash of Nalan Shaowei\'s sword, and he
would\'ve been no more. While it\'s true that all of you are making
money, that still doesn\'t change the fact that you\'re transporting
shipload after shipload of resources to Stalactite Mountain and, by
extension, the Sword Qi Great Wall.

"Without all of you, the Sword Qi Great Wall would\'ve fallen long ago.
That is a fact that we have to acknowledge, and something that we *do*
acknowledge.\"

All of a sudden, Chen Ping\'an stood up with an amicable smile, then
made a friendly hand gesture and continued, \"Take a seat! What\'re all
of you standing up for? I was just kidding about all of the threats that
I made earlier! Surely you didn\'t actually believe me? Sit,
Administrator Jiang, and you too, Liu Shen. Everyone, take a seat. Peace
and prosperity come hand in hand. There\'s no room for violence in the
field of business.\"

Mi Yu didn\'t sit, and no one else dared to sit.

Despite what Chen Ping\'an had just said, the killing intent emanating
from all of the sword immortals present hadn\'t waned in the slightest.

Chen Ping\'an casually strolled over to behind Nalan Caihuan\'s chair,
then gently laid a hand on her shoulder and threatened through his
mind\'s lake, \"Set an example and sit down, or you can go die. You\'ve
overstepped your authority so many times and made so many bad deals, and
you thought you could just get away with it? Every single deal that
you\'ve made is clearly recorded in the secret files of the Hidden
Official\'s branch.

\"You thought you were sneaky, but you\'re nothing more than a clumsy
fool. You really thought Nalan Shaowei is an inferior businessman to
you? When it comes to doing business, you\'re not even fit to lick the
bottom of his shoe! Nalan Shaowei has already saved you once, but he
won\'t be able to save you a second time.\"

Nalan Caihuan\'s complexion instantly turned deathly pale, and she all
but collapsed onto her chair.

Chen Ping\'an remained standing behind Nalan Caihuan\'s chair, looking
at all of the hapless intercontinental ship administrators in the room,
and a look of exasperation appeared on his face as he asked, \"What is
it that you all want from me? I\'ve already said and done everything
that I can, yet you still insist on opposing me at every turn. I ask you
to sit, yet you still stand in defiance. Maybe I really *do* need to
kill a few of you to set an example, is that it?\"

Everyone finally sat down.

They had no idea where this young Hidden Official had come from, but he
was incredibly ruthless, calculating, and more than a little bit
deranged!

Chen Ping\'an returned to his seat, but didn\'t sit down, and he
declared, \"I can\'t guarantee that you\'ll all make more money than you
did in the past, but what I *can* promise you is that you\'ll be making
good profits. Whether you believe me or not is up to you, but the final
numbers won\'t lie.\"

Mi Yu rose to his feet, and a series of books came flying out of his
sleeve, one each for all of the intercontinental ship administrators
present.

\"All of the resources that the Sword Qi Great Wall requires are listed
in those books,\" Chen Ping\'an said. \"They are all arranged into
categories based on urgency and importance, and all of them have prices
attached to them as well, but it\'s all up for negotiation. I understand
that there are many intercontinental ships that aren\'t currently
present on Stalactite Mountain, so I\'ll have to trouble you all to
spread the word to your peers when you return to your home continents.

\"There are many resources that the Sword Qi Great Wall won\'t be
purchasing more of, but there are also some resources that the Sword Qi
Great Wall has a near-insatiable demand for, and the prices for those
resources will only increase over time. The eight continents each excel
in producing different resources, so there\'s money to be made for
everyone.

\"As for whether you allow our Sword Qi Great Wall to make purchases on
credit, you can each come to discuss that with me in private, and we can
even discuss things like whether the Sword Qi Great Wall can provide you
benefits in other areas as compensation for the right to be able to make
purchases on credit.\"

All of the intercontinental ship administrators immediately began poring
over the books.

Chen Ping\'an turned a smiling gaze to Bai Xi and asked, \"You must be
really surprised, right? Out of all of your secret plans, one of them
was to have everyone unload their ship\'s cargo and reload everything
before arriving on Stalactite Mountain. That way, each intercontinental
ship would only have a few types of resources onboard, and that would
avoid competition between ships, thereby allowing everyone to charge
higher prices.

\"Well, you won\'t have to worry about that now because our Sword Qi
Great Wall has done the work for you. Our Sword Qi Great Wall has always
been very open and fair with its business dealings, yet here you are,
pulling all these sneaky moves with nothing to show for it. Was it all
worth it in the end? As for who exposed your ploy to me, don\'t even
bother to try and find out.

\"Given the abundance of resources on the Circling Ascension Continent
and the abilities of your Mountain and Water Cave, you\'ll be making
money hand over fist, so why fret over something so trivial?\"

Bai Xi\'s expression instantly stiffened upon seeing a certain entry in
the book before him.

*The Sword Qi Great Wall is looking to purchase large quantities of
snowflake coins? Why?!*

The administrator from the Fu Clan of Old Dragon City had also taken a
particular interest in a different entry in the book. The Fu Clan had a
long-running alliance with Dawn Cloud Mountain, which specialized in
producing Cloud Root Stone, which was a resource that had increased in
price!

Even the intercontinental ship administrators of the Northern Complete
Reed Continent, who were the most reluctant of the bunch to make money,
were very bemused by what they saw. It seemed that they would have to
sit down and have a good chat with the Flax Robe Sect once they returned
to the Northern Complete Reed Continent.

\"You can make as much money as you want as long as you have the
resources that our Sword Qi Great Wall requires,\" Chen Ping\'an said.
\"If you decide to throw a tantrum like a child and insist on not
selling to our Sword Qi Great Wall, then that\'s fine. If you change
your mind in the future, you can always come back, but the terms may not
be as favorable for you then. Also, outside of just doing business, all
of you should start thinking about your Great Daos as well.

\"If there\'s anything you want from the alchemical pill market or any
immortal treasures that you desire, you can put in a request with us,
and if we can satisfy your request, then we\'d be willing to provide
what you desire in exchange for resources or immortal coins. I can
promise you all that our Sword Qi Great Wall won\'t overcharge for
anything. Take that as a gesture of goodwill from us.\"

Jiang Gaotai was flipping through the pages of the book as he asked
through his mind\'s lake, \"You\'re really not going to kill anyone,
Lord Hidden Official? You\'re just going to focus solely on business?\"

\"I only look at the outcome, not the process,\" Chen Ping\'an replied
with a smile. \"From that perspective, I should be grateful to you,
should I not? Someday, when we no longer share a business relationship,
I\'ll get my payback, but rest assured, as long as we\'re still doing
business, I will approach everything in a fair and unbiased fashion.

\"The prices are all clearly stated, and if you cooperate well, perhaps
I can even let bygones be bygones and let you off the hook altogether.
After all, the world is a massive place, and once you leave Stalactite
Mountain, I\'m not even sure we\'ll ever meet each other again.\"

Jiang Gaotai remained skeptical.

Chen Ping\'an was busy answering questions directed to him through his
mind\'s lake, and on top of that, he was also actively speaking to
others.

\"What\'s Fu Nanhua\'s cultivation base right now?\"

\"I was just spouting nonsense earlier, Celestial Maiden Liu. That
junior sister of yours is very loyal and devoted to you, and there\'s no
way she would take your place even if we had made her such an offer.\"

\"Please don\'t resent Sword Immortal Mi. There\'s no way he could bear
to kill you; he was just saying that because I forced him to. If you\'re
going to resent him for saying that, then you\'re going to break his
heart. His feelings for you remain as true as ever, and it would be a
huge shame if you chose not to reciprocate his feelings over a
misunderstanding.\"

The entire time, he spoke in a very casual and conversational tone, as
if he were chatting with friends.

However, all of the intercontinental ship administrators were carefully
latching onto his every word, turning them over back and forth in their
heads to make sure that they weren\'t missing any subtle hints that Chen
Ping\'an may have been dropping them.

Even though none of the administrators were communicating with one
another, there was one harrowing fact that they were all convinced of,
and that was that for a moment in time, Chen Ping\'an had fully intended
to kill them all.

Perhaps it was true, perhaps it wasn\'t, but what if it was true?

Chen Ping\'an continued to look out at the falling snow, thinking to
himself that by now, Liu Xianyang\'s intercontinental ship was most
likely almost back to the Southern Whirl Continent.

At this moment, Liu Xianyang was sitting in his room on the ship beside
a lamp, and there was a seal placed on the table in front of him.

The inscription on the side of the seal read: \"From Great Sword
Immortal Chen Ping\'an, to Brother Liu Xianyang.\"

The inscription on the seal read: \"Moving mountains, turning seas.\"

An amused smile appeared on Liu Xianyang\'s face, remarking internally
that it seemed that Chen Ping\'an had taken after him in the bragging
department.
