# Chapter 635: (1): Improve with Each Passing Day

Sword of Coming

All of a sudden, the room had gone completely silent with the exception
of the sound of rustling pages. Doing business was the forte of all of
the intercontinental ship administrators, and it was finally time for
them to put their skills to use.

With the approval of Chen Ping\'an, most of the sword immortals
departed.

Li Cai, Ku Xia, Yuan Qingshu, Xie Zhi, Song Pin, and Pu He had all
already returned to the Sword Qi Great Wall, but Mi Yu and Gao Kui
stayed behind, while Shao Yunyan remained seated at the entrance.

Xie Songhua still had to personally \"escort\" an intercontinental ship
back to the Pure White Continent, so she was naturally also still
around.

Of course, Yan Ming and Nalan Caihuan had to stay as well. They were the
ones who were going to have to deal with all of the business proceedings
going forward, working with Shao Yunyan to do business with the
intercontinental ships from the eight continents.

This was truly quite a significant deal for the Spring Banner Inn, and
the outcome of the discussion that was about to take place would have an
impact on hundreds of empires, sects, and other immortal powers across
the eight continents of the Majestic World.

Chen Ping\'an remained seated on the main chair, sipping on some wine
brought to him by Mi Yu while patiently waiting for all of the
administrators to read through the catalogs that had been presented to
them.

In this moment, Nalan Caihuan was most likely the one in the room who
harbored the deepest resentment toward Chen Ping\'an.

Gao Kui had come here for only one purpose, and that was to kill her!

While she sorely resented Chen Ping\'an, she couldn\'t do anything, and
her fear outweighed her resentment.

She felt as if she were sitting on a bed of nails, and her heart was
filled with agitation and trepidation. Right at this moment, Chen
Ping\'an began communicating with her through her mind\'s lake.

\"Don\'t worry so much. I can even tolerate doing business with all
these outsiders, so I can certainly tolerate you. While it\'s true that
you\'ve overstepped your authority on many occasions to make some rather
shady deals, your contributions to the Sword Qi Great Wall cannot be
denied. I promise you that the Nalan Clan won\'t lose out on too much,
and if luck goes your way, perhaps you could even reap some profits, but
I can\'t make any guarantees on that.\"

Nalan Caihuan also made some promises to Chen Ping\'an, and she felt
like she had been very open and honest with Chen Ping\'an, putting her
sincerity on full display.

However, not only did that not change her situation, but her fears were
only deepened because Gao Kui still hadn\'t left the Spring Banner Inn.
Instead, he remained seated nearby, sipping on some wine, namely some
Bamboo Sea Small World wine as opposed to the immortal wine served in
the Spring Banner Inn.

Nalan Caihuan took a moment to compose herself, then began reflecting on
the events that had taken place thus far, closely scrutinizing every
single detail to try and get a better grasp on Chen Ping\'an.

Prior to this, she had never truly dealt with Chen Ping\'an before. It
was only after he became Hidden Official that the two of them made a
deal for the first time, and that had ended on a rather unsavory note as
Chen Ping\'an\'s deception had made her appear like a complete fool in
front of Nalan Shaowei.

By gathering all those sword immortals in the Spring Banner Inn, Chen
Ping\'an was telling all of the intercontinental ship administrators
that he could kill them all on a whim. However, that wasn\'t the most
potent threat that he had delivered. Instead, he had gone out of his way
to dig up as much information about every single administrator as he
could in order to tailor his threats to each administrator.

He was no longer even talking business or targeting the sects and
backers behind the administrators. Instead, he was directly targeting
the administrators themselves. For example, for Wu Qiu and Tang Feiqian,
he had threatened to destroy their reputations alongside their private
residences on Temper Mountain on the Northern Complete Reed Continent.

Killing them would be far too easy. Instead, his objective was to
subject them to fates worse than death.

However, that wasn\'t to say that death threats didn\'t work. For some,
like Jiang Gaotai of the Southern Winnowing Basket and Liu Shen of the
Rainbow Raiment, Chen Ping\'an had simply threatened them with death,
and he would\'ve been perfectly willing to follow through on his threat
had the earlier conflict escalated any further.

There was no point for the administrators in talking to Chen Ping\'an
about their backers or threatening to no longer do business with the
Sword Qi Great Wall. If anyone dared to stand up from their chairs, then
they would become the sole target of Chen Ping\'an, and he would do
everything in his power to make their lives as much of a living hell as
possible.

Perhaps threats of this nature wouldn\'t work on many of the official
immortals of the Majestic World. In fact, the more prideful ones may
even turn on him completely.

However, all of the administrators present were more businessmen than
they were cultivators, so these threats were very effective.

Of course, the true deciding factor was the books brought out by Mi Yu.

Without those, all of Chen Ping\'an\'s efforts would\'ve been completely
futile. Once all of the administrators left the Spring Banner Inn and
Stalactite Mountain, they would never return to do business again, and
Chen Ping\'an would\'ve accomplished nothing aside from ruining the
business reputation of the Sword Qi Great Wall. Perhaps he wouldn\'t be
removed from his post as Hidden Official, but Yan Ming and Nalan Caihuan
would be put in charge of the finances of the Sword Qi Great Wall again.

With that in mind, Nalan Caihuan was feeling a little better, and she
felt like she now knew how to deal with Chen Ping\'an.

In terms of looks and disposition, Nalan Caihuan was undeniably a fine
beauty.

Mi Yu took a glance at her, then shook his head with a hint of sympathy
and disdain in his eyes before closing his eyes again.

This did not escape the notice of the bitter and resentful female
Nascent Tier cultivator, and her mood was instantly lifted slightly.

After telling her that he had lied to her, Mi Yu seemed to have been
intentionally refraining from looking at her this entire time. Whenever
his gaze roamed over to the section of the room that she was in, he
would always make sure not to look at her.

Why would he go out of his way to do this unless she had a place in his
heart? Even Nalan Caihuan had once fallen for Mi Yu, yet despite her
close proximity to him on the Sword Qi Great Wall, she was still unable
to capture his heart.

Considering things from this perspective, the woman felt like she had
outdone Nalan Caihuan.

She turned her attention back to Mi Yu to discover that he was staring
out at the falling snow in silence with a hint of loneliness and
vulnerability in his eyes, completely different from the cold and
callous display that he had put on earlier.

The resentment in her heart instantly turned to sympathy. Her beloved Mi
Yu was already an Upper Five Tiers sword immortal, yet it seemed like he
was still being picked on by his peers in what was supposed to be his
hometown.

Chen Ping\'an had been closely observing everyone this entire time, and
he couldn\'t help but be impressed after noticing the extremely subtle
yet measured shift in emotion from Mi Yu. It seemed that he was a
natural womanizer. If his talents in attracting women could translate to
cultivation talent, then he would surely have already reached the
Ascension Tier long ago. Out of everyone that Chen Ping\'an knew,
perhaps only Jiang Shangzhen could compete with him in this regard.

Chen Ping\'an decided that he was going to find an opportunity to seek
justice for all of the poor women who were infatuated with Mi Yu. He
would do so by giving Mi Yu a solid beating, one in which he wouldn\'t
be allowed to retaliate.

Xie Songhua was feeling a little conflicted. She wanted to escort Jiang
Gaotai\'s Southern Winnowing Basket, but Dai Hao had really been asking
for it as well, and she couldn\'t decide which one she resented more.
Her gaze was flickering back and forth between the two, and the sword
case on her back had been buzzing with hostility this entire time. All
of a sudden, she found herself with too many personal vendettas to
settle at once!

The administrators from the Pure White Continent had embarrassed her at
every turn, and if she had permission from Chen Ping\'an, she would
gladly kill every single one of them. With that in mind, she couldn\'t
help but feel a little envious of Wei Jin and Yuan Qingshu. The
administrators of the Eastern Treasured Vial Continent and the Southern
Whirl Continent had been very cooperative thus far, giving the two sword
immortals no reason to go after them.

Dai Hao could feel Xie Songhua\'s murderous aura hanging over him like a
palpable miasma, and he knew that his days were numbered if he didn\'t
do anything.

Thus, he tentatively asked through his mind\'s lake, \"Lord Hidden
Official, can you put in a good word for me with Sword Immortal Xie?\"

Dai Hao didn\'t even dare to look up at Chen Ping\'an as he was speaking
to him. While that could be considered a rather rude gesture, he simply
didn\'t dare to take the risk. He felt like if he were to raise his head
now, then Xie Songhua would instantly separate it from the rest of his
body.

\"Do you still recall what Sword Immortal Xie said to all of you when
she first saw you tonight?\" Chen Ping\'an asked with a smile. \"Have a
good think about that.\"

She had declared that she would be personally escorting the poorest
intercontinental ship from the Pure White Continent back to its home
continent, and that if she failed to protect the ship in question, then
she would accept the full brunt of the blame.

Dai Hao heaved an internal sigh of relief at this recollection.

\"Thank you, Lord Hidden Official.\"

Wei Jin had perhaps somewhat intentionally chosen not to travel with Li
Cai and the others. Instead, he left on his own, and he was the last to
leave.

\"I\'m going to escort Sword Immortal Wei for a bit,\" Chen Ping\'an
declared as he rose to his feet. \"Mi Yu, you can answer any questions
raised by our guests while I\'m gone, and make sure to keep records of
any changes in prices and terms that you reach through negotiation. Once
again, I\'d like to reiterate that all those who are sitting here today
are businessmen, and that includes myself.

"When it comes to business, everything is open to negotiation, and your
business acumen will decide how much money you get to make. The rules of
doing business will also supersede my authority as Hidden Official.\"

Chen Ping\'an turned to the administrator of the Rainbow Raiment, Liu
Shen, then the administrator of the Temple Bell, Liu Yu, and after
calling out the two of them by name, he smiled and said, \"I\'ll have to
trouble the two of you to help keep records on your end as well.\"

Chen Ping\'an escorted Wei Jin all the way to the entrance of the Spring
Banner Inn.

\"I\'m not really one to stick my nose into business that has nothing to
do with me, but I have some questions that I\'d like to ask you,\" Wei
Jin said.

\"Sure, go ahead,\" Chen Ping\'an prompted with a smile. \"I\'m very
happy to be able to meet a sword immortal from my home continent on the
Sword Qi Great Wall, particularly one that isn\'t inferior to any of the
other sword immortals here. I am being perfectly sincere when I say
this; it\'s up to you whether you believe me or not.\"

\"I may have really believed you if you hadn\'t tacked on that extra
sentence at the end,\" Wei Jin chuckled.

\"What did you want to ask me?\" Chen Ping\'an asked.

\"None of the sword immortals from the Majestic World wanted to get
anything out of tonight, so why did you insist on having them meet up
individually with the administrators from their home continents? Isn\'t
that an unnecessary move?\" Wei Jin asked. \"Actually, forget it, I\'m
sure you have your reasons. Let me ask you another question instead.

"When you invited all of the sword immortals here, you told them that
you wouldn\'t make them come to the Spring Banner Inn and make enemies
out of all of the intercontinental ship administrators for nothing, but
you never clearly stated how you were going to compensate them. However,
you dared to promise all of the sword immortals that they definitely
wouldn\'t be disappointed. What exactly is the compensation that you
have planned?\"

Chen Ping\'an hesitated momentarily, then said, \"To answer your first
question, I just wanted to do my best to ensure that good karma comes to
good people, and I also didn\'t want to make the Sword Qi Great Wall owe
any further favors. In terms of my own selfish motivations, I wanted to
do a deal with the sword immortals that wouldn\'t weigh on my
conscience. As for the compensation that I\'m planning, that differs
depending on the person, and it concerns the private secrets of the
sword immortals, so I won\'t tell you the specifics.

"However, there\'s one piece of default compensation that I plan to give
to all of the sword immortals from the Majestic World that I invited to
the Spring Banner Inn, and that\'s that if they get the chance to return
to their home continents in the future, each of them can take with them
at least one Lower Five Tiers talent that has the makings of a sword
immortal.

"If they don\'t want to take anyone with them, then they\'ll receive
some other form of compensation. If they want to take one or two extra
prodigies with them, then they\'re free to do so as long as there are
that many suitable prodigies available on the Sword Qi Great Wall.\"

Wei Jin could only shake his head with a wry smile.

The sword immortals from the Majestic World, the intercontinental ships,
even the prodigies of the Sword Qi Great Wall that were still yet to
come into their own\... The past, the present, the future; everything
had been factored into Chen Ping\'an\'s calculations.

Wei Jin couldn\'t help but wonder what the young prodigies of the Sword
Qi Great Wall would be able to achieve if they were taken to the
Majestic World.

As for the sword immortals that were going to be taking those prodigies
to the Majestic World, regardless of what their personalities were like,
all of them had dared to come to the Sword Qi Great Wall and were
willing to lay down their lives here, so they would surely cherish these
disciples from the Sword Qi Great Wall and be willing to mentor them to
the best of their abilities.

Once these children grew up and began making names for themselves in the
Majestic World, they would surely band together as friends and allies,
and by extension, the sword immortals that mentored them would also band
together.

Even if, in the worst-case scenario, the Sword Qi Great Wall were to
fall, who was to say that these future sword immortals wouldn\'t be able
to erect a second Sword Qi Great Wall through their collective efforts?

With that in mind, an expectant smile appeared on Wei Jin\'s face. He
was very much looking forward to seeing that become a reality.

Looking at Chen Ping\'an, Wei Jin couldn\'t help but think back to when
they first met. At the time, he had been nothing more than a timid
little hillbilly who didn\'t seem all that smart. Back then, his eyes
had still been very clear and bright.

Wei Jin stopped in his tracks, then heaved a faint sigh before turning
to Chen Ping\'an with an inquisitive expression.

\"You\'re just an outsider; why do you feel inclined to do so much for
the Sword Qi Great Wall?\"

\"My wife lives here!\" Chen Ping\'an replied with a smile. \"You don\'t
have a wife, so of course you don\'t understand.\"

Wei Jin shook his head in dismay, not wanting to discuss this subject.
In fact, just the mention of the subject made him want to drown his
sorrows.

As for where he was going to be sent to in the future, this was
something that Chen Ping\'an had discussed with him, and the old great
sword immortal had also been present at the time.

Wei Jin didn\'t intend to refuse. However, before he set off for the
Circling Ascension Continent, he wanted to make some battlefield
contributions to the Sword Qi Great Wall on behalf of the Divine
Platform that were at least on par with Xie Songhua\'s. Wei Jin didn\'t
have much of an attachment to the Wind Snow Temple, and that had been
the case ever since his master left, but his master had passed the
Divine Platform down to him, so he had to do *something* for it.

The older generation of cultivators that his master belonged to were all
about keeping up appearances, so Wei Jin had to make sure not to
disappoint his master. That way, he would at least have something to
tell his master when he next visited his grave.

Wei Jin departed from the Spring Banner Inn, while Chen Ping\'an
returned the same way he had come from.

On the way back, he crouched down beside the skywell of a large
courtyard, then scooped up some snow from the ground. He rubbed the snow
haphazardly all over his face, then took a deep breath before making a
tightly compacted snowball.

Shao Yunyan appeared behind him with a smile on his face and remarked,
\"Sword immortals are renowned for their ability to kill without
shedding blood; what you did tonight is very similar, Lord Hidden
Official.\"

\"You\'re far too kind, Sword Immortal Shao,\" Chen Ping\'an replied
with a smile and a shake of his head. \"It\'s only thanks to the immense
foundation of the Sword Qi Great Wall that I was able to pull this off.
I do deserve some credit, but it\'s nowhere near as much as people
think. If either Yan Ming or Nalan Caihuan had been in my place, they
would\'ve been able to accomplish all of this as well. Neither of them
is lacking in business acumen and calculation ability; the only thing
that they lack compared with me is this jade tablet.\"

\"I disagree,\" Shao Yunyan said with a shake of his head.

\"If only everyone could distinguish between words spoken in earnest and
words spoken out of politeness as you can, Sword Immortal Shao,\" Chen
Ping\'an said with a smile. \"It would certainly save me a lot of
trouble.\"

\"If apologies need to be made, then Sun Juyuan and Mi Yu can take care
of that,\" Shao Yunyan said. \"As for monetary compensation, we can go
with Yan Ming first, then Nalan Caihuan, then my Spring Banner Inn, or
any other order; it really doesn\'t make much of a difference. The only
thing you need to consider is how the burden is shared. Are you going to
have one party pay until they lose everything before the other two have
to step in, or do you want the three parties to share the burden
evenly?\"

\"Let\'s share the burden evenly for now,\" Chen Ping\'an replied. \"If
worse comes to worst, and the Yan Clan and the Nalan Clan lose
everything, but the hole is still too deep to be filled, then you\'ll
have to sell the Spring Banner Inn.\"

\"That\'s fine,\" Shao Yunyan replied with a smile. \"I\'m not afraid of
losing the Spring Banner Inn; I\'m just afraid of doing things without a
plan.\"

\"What we have to do now is ensure that even after all of the
administrators leave the Spring Banner Inn, they still can\'t band
together to form an alliance,\" Chen Ping\'an said. \"We cannot allow
for a repeat of the situation where the patriarch of the Mountain and
Water Cave stepped up to unite everyone. In order to accomplish this, we
have to sow distrust and dissension among their ranks. We have to make
them distrustful of their former allies and turn their backs on one
another.

"Earlier, I was fairly vague with my threats, and I\'m sure many of the
sly old foxes inside are still not convinced that I\'ll actually follow
through on my threats. Unless I actually take action and hit them where
it hurts most, they\'ll likely continue to think that I\'m just
bluffing. Hence, I\'m going to be doing some rather shady things, and
I\'m likely going to require your services for much of it. If you need
the help of any sword immortals to carry out my instructions, then feel
free to ask.\"

\"Setting aside your goals and intentions, I can\'t believe the old
great sword immortal has such high hopes for someone as snide and
underhanded as you.\" Shao Yunyan chuckled.

Chen Ping\'an burst into laughter upon hearing this. \"Surely you
didn\'t need to be so blunt, Sword Immortal Shao.\"

\"I am only ever this blunt with those I consider my friends,\" Shao
Yunyan replied with a smile.

Chen Ping\'an scooped up another handful of snow, then gently clapped
his hands together to scatter it as he mused, \"Doing something and
doing it well is always going to be more difficult than preaching
principles and being a good person.\"

From an outside perspective, someone who was lacking in principles would
actually use many principles to justify their lack of principles, and
for someone who enjoyed making money and was able to make money, they
actually made a lot of sacrifices that they didn\'t perceive to be
sacrifices.

[]{#chapter-158.xhtml}

# Chapter 635: (2): Improve with Each Passing Day

Sword of Coming

None of the intercontinental ship administrators of the Northern
Complete Reed Continent raised any objections to the prices listed in
the catalog.

Compared with the administrators from the other continents, all of whom
were meticulously looking through every single entry in the catalog, the
cultivators of the Northern Complete Reed Continent barely even bothered
to read through the catalog at all. Instead, they were mostly drinking
wine or sipping tea without a care in the world.

They weren\'t really even aiming to make money to begin with, so they
were content to leave the negotiating and bartering to their peers.

The administrators of the Southern Whirl Continent had raised a few
minor objections, as had the two administrators from the Eastern
Treasured Vial Continent, while the administrators from the Middle Earth
Divine Continent, the Pure White Continent, and the Circling Ascension
Continent were yet to speak.

The Flowing Dawn Continent and the Golden Armor Continent were
neighboring continents that were on decent terms with one another, and
they shared many of the resources that they transported to Stalactite
Mountain, so they were already communicating through their mind\'s
lakes.

They planned to wait until Wu Qiu, Tang Feiqian, Jiang Gaotai, and Bai
Xi had spoken first before deciding what they were going to do.

For the catalog, Chen Ping\'an had determined the overall direction for
everything, while the other swordsmen of the Hidden Official\'s branch
had meticulously examined all of the finer details to determine the
final prices. Among them, Lin Junbi and the other swordsmen from the
Majestic World had made significant contributions. Many of the records
of the Hidden Official\'s branch weren\'t actually up to date with the
current situation in the Majestic World, so the prices for many
resources listed in those records were outdated and had to be adjusted.

The two administrators, Liu Yu and Liu Shen, had been tasked with
keeping records of the discussion taking place in the main hall, and
Shao Yunyan had arranged stationery for both of them before leaving the
main hall to search for Chen Ping\'an.

Just as Chen Ping\'an had said, the eight continents all had different
resources that they excelled at producing, and a great deal of thought
had to go into minimizing expenditures for the intercontinental ships.

At the very beginning of the catalog was a short prologue, in which Chen
Ping\'an encouraged the intercontinental ship administrators of the
eight continents to consult with their sects and backers, so the
discussion that was taking place in the Spring Banner Inn wasn\'t just a
simple matter of the intercontinental ships bartering with the Sword Qi
Great Wall.

Instead, this was a much more complex affair that concerned all of the
intercontinental ships and their suppliers, requiring them to
renegotiate terms and prices.

Nalan Caihuan had been observing the unfolding situation this entire
time, and the more she thought about it, the more she came to realize
just how complicated Chen Ping\'an\'s plot had been. There were so many
little things that he had done that appeared largely inconsequential on
their own, but when strung together, they formed a cohesive plot that
had allowed him to gain the upper hand over all of the administrators
present.

The personal threats that he had made to the administrators constituted
the first part of his plan, but once the administrators had been
sufficiently intimidated, he suddenly extended them an olive branch,
encouraging them to take this opportunity to try and further their own
cultivation.

He told them that not only was the Sword Qi Great Wall not averse to
this, but they would also be willing to help out the administrators in
the provision of certain cultivation resources and immortal treasures.

To top it all off, the icing on the cake was the promise that he had
made that all of the intercontinental ships would be making money in
their business dealings with the Sword Qi Great Wall.

He had planted the idea in everyone\'s mind that they were not here just
to represent the interests of their sects or backers, but they could
also stand to benefit themselves, and all of a sudden, everything had
taken on a completely different complexion.

However, it was still to be seen whether this plot hatched by Chen
Ping\'an would stand the test of time.

As he drew close to the main hall of the Spring Banner Inn, Chen
Ping\'an suddenly asked, \"Do you know of anyone with exceptional
talents in keeping accounts?\"

\"I once had a direct disciple who was really good at this stuff, and he
took care of all of the Spring Banner Inn\'s business matters,\" Shao
Yunyan replied with a slightly forlorn expression.

\"Is there any chance you can convince him to come back to the Spring
Banner Inn?\" Chen Ping\'an asked.

\"I can try and get him to come back,\" Shao Yunyan replied with a nod.
\"He really is very talented when it comes to calculation and doing
business. He seems to have an instinctive feel for numbers that are
mind-numbingly boring to others, and he really enjoys what he does. I
gave him a secret letter of recommendation for him to take to a
prominent business sect in the Pure White Continent, but if he can come
back and gain some work experience in the Spring Banner Inn first, then
that letter of recommendation most likely won\'t be necessary.\"

\"Make sure to bring him back to Stalactite Mountain, even if you have
to abduct him,\" Chen Ping\'an said.

Upon Chen Ping\'an\'s return to the main hall, a long and grueling
tug-of-war commenced. It was finally time for the price negotiations to
begin.

To Nalan Caihuan\'s surprise, Chen Ping\'an seemed to have been
intentionally discussing details and prices with everyone as
meticulously as possible, and it felt as if he was perfectly happy to
write up a new catalog altogether.

Even the administrators from the Northern Complete Reed Continent, who
had already made up their minds not to speak, were dragged into the
discussions by Chen Ping\'an, and he questioned them extensively about
whether the Northern Complete Reed Continent had close or equivalent
substitutes to some of the resources listed in the catalog.

Seeing as Chen Ping\'an was being very earnest in his intention to talk
business, the intercontinental ship administrators quickly settled into
their role, and the discussion quickly began flowing.

The administrators of the Northern Complete Reed Continent didn\'t have
much patience for all of this, and they quickly answered Chen
Ping\'an\'s questions, but spoke no further beyond that.

After they had their turn to speak, the administrators of the Southern
Whirl Continent also joined the discussion, and even the two
administrators from the Eastern Treasured Vial Continent were able to
muster up the courage to say something.

Whenever a new price was negotiated, Chen Ping\'an would instruct Mi Yu
to cross out the existing price on the catalog and replace it with the
new one.

Wu Qiu and Tang Feiqian were both relieved and pleased with the turn of
things, and they also joined in on the discussion.

Some of the administrators were able to negotiate higher prices, while
others inadvertently lowered the prices of certain items, and in
general, there were losses and victories for both sides.

Before long, Yan Ming had also broken his silence, and even Nalan
Caihuan had begun speaking again.

Doing business was what the administrators were most familiar with, and
they quickly regained their confidence and mojo.

Earlier, they had been completely at the mercy of the flying swords
wielded by the sword immortals assembled by Chen Ping\'an, but on this
new battlefield, where the weapons of choice were abacuses and account
books, they were much more confident in their chances.

Among the administrators of the Pure White Continent, Jiang Gaotai was
the one who spoke the most, and it seemed like he had become the
unofficial leader of the Pure White Continent.

The other administrators were very impressed with his courage. He had
come very close to death just a bit earlier, but it seemed that he was
completely unfazed.

On the surface, Jiang Gaotai was as composed and confident as ever, but
internally, he was cursing his current situation. The reality was that
Chen Ping\'an was speaking to him through his mind\'s lake, forcing him
to lead the charge in the bartering race. Otherwise, why would he be
putting his life on the line like an idiot like this?

Chen Ping\'an took a glance outside the main hall to discover that it
was already morning.

There had already been many changes to the prices and terms in the
catalog, but there were clearly still many more to be made.

To further muddy the waters, conflicts had begun to arise between the
administrators themselves with the passage of time. In the beginning,
everyone made an active effort to keep things cordial, but before long,
all pretenses and niceties had been thrown to the wayside, and there
were even administrators banging the table and hurling insults at one
another.

Chen Ping\'an didn\'t mind this at all. In fact, he was taking full
advantage of these conflicts, using them to aid him in his bartering
efforts, putting his shameless nature on full display once again.

Everyone in the main hall was a cultivator, so staying up for one night
didn\'t take much of a physical toll on them, but the mental toll was an
entirely different story.

However, all of the administrators knew that they couldn\'t rest now. If
they could secure even a tiny increase in price for a certain item on
the catalog, even if it were just a margin of one or two snowflake
coins, then that would equate to a massive increase in profits.

With that in mind, they were very much motivated to continue in spite of
their weariness.

At around noon, Chen Ping\'an proposed that everyone return to their
respective courtyards, where all of the administrators could have
another internal discussion with their peers from their home continents.

If they wanted to visit administrators from other continents as well,
then they were free to do so.

Everyone immediately departed.

Jiang Gaotai was one of the last administrators to leave, and he took a
subtle glance at Chen Ping\'an, while the latter gave him a smile and a
nod.

Yan Ming and Nalan Caihuan also had many things to discuss with each
other.

Chen Ping\'an turned to Gao Kui and said, \"Thank you for your hard
work, Sword Immortal Gao. You may return to the Sword Qi Great Wall
now.\"

\"Hard work?\" Gao Kui scoffed. \"All I did was sit around drinking
wine, stand up once, and glare at Nalan Caihuan a few times in between.
As opposed to hard work, I\'d say it\'s more appropriate to say I hardly
did any work!\"

\"I just wanted to be polite,\" Chen Ping\'an said with a chuckle.

\"Make sure to be more respectful when speaking to Lord Hidden Official,
Gao Kui,\" Mi Yu said with a smile.

In the past, Gao Kui had nothing but disdain for Mi Yu, and he didn\'t
even want to look at the latter, let alone speak to him.

After the events of the previous night, his impression of Mi Yu hadn\'t
improved by much, but at the very least, he was now willing to speak to
Mi Yu. Of course, he didn\'t have anything nice to say.

\"Stop weighing down those around you, Mi Yu. If it isn\'t because he
keeps insisting on looking out for you, your brother would already have
reached the Immortal Tier long ago. It used to be a widely accepted fact
that Yue Qing\'s aptitude was inferior to Mi Hu\'s, but because of you,
he hasn\'t been able to reach his full potential.\"

Gao Kui promptly departed after getting that off his chest, not
interested in hearing a response from Mi Yu.

\"What right does he have to criticize me?\" Mi Yu grumbled. \"I
sincerely love women with all my heart, and women reciprocate my
feelings. How is that wrong?\"

\"It\'s only thanks to Sword Immortal Mi Hu that you haven\'t already
been hacked to death by all of the single sword immortals on the Sword
Qi Great Wall!\" Chen Ping\'an scoffed.

Mi Yu turned to Xie Songhua, who was sitting on her own with a bored
expression, but before he even had a chance to speak, she smiled and
said, \"Please get out of my sight.\"

Mi Yu let loose a wail of despair as he stepped out of the main hall,
then went to a peaceful corner to build a snowman, or perhaps it was
more accurate to call it a snowwoman.

He had chosen a flowerbed in the Spring Banner Inn, and even with all
the falling snow, the plants in the flowerbed were still thriving.

Nalan Caihuan would never come to a place like this. She was undeniably
beautiful, but she was too fixated on making money. However, there was a
very good chance that the girl from the Middle Earth Divine Continent
would come here, and she would definitely be enraptured by these
immortal peonies that were still able to bloom even in the snow. Once
she came to the flowerbed and saw the flowers, she would soon catch
sight of the snowman that he had made for her as well, and that would be
enough to convey his feelings.

Whenever an outsider sword immortal left the Sword Qi Great Wall, the
native sword immortals would generally treat them to some wine.

For example, right before Huang Tong returned to the Great Emblem Sword
Sect, Dong Sangeng personally saw him off.

To keep the tradition alive, someone had to see Xie Songhua off as well,
so Chen Ping\'an escorted her to the entrance of the Spring Banner Inn.

Xie Songhua was rather unhappy, feeling like she still had unfinished
business on Stalactite Mountain.

Chen Ping\'an told her that she could wait at the Flood Dragon Trench if
she wanted, and that if she wanted something to do, then she could go
pay a visit to the Rain Dragon Sect as well.

This immediately piqued her interest, and she asked, \"Does that mean
you\'ve chosen Jiang Gaotai? What about Dai Hao? How about I just kill
them both? I owe you a favor, and given how calculating you are, I\'m
sure you\'re going to take full advantage. Just give me the word, and
I\'ll make sure both of them are dead before they even make it back to
the Pure White Continent.\"

\"Don\'t do anything for now,\" Chen Ping\'an said with a shake of his
head. \"I\'ll keep you updated.\"

\"Just make up your mind!\" Xie Songhua complained. \"I wouldn\'t even
be talking to you right now if I didn\'t owe you such a big favor.
Don\'t bother coming to see me if you ever visit the Pure White
Continent in the future; I don\'t want to have to deal with you
anymore.\"

\"The two girls from the Stork Inn will be in your care from now on,
Sword Immortal Xie,\" Chen Ping\'an said with a smile.

The thought of the two girls immediately lifted Xie Songhua\'s mood
significantly, and she said, \"Both of them have a lot of potential.
I\'ll be sure to mentor them well. It might be difficult to nurture them
into sword immortals like me, but I\'ll definitely at least nurture them
into earth immortals. You have my thanks, but this doesn\'t warrant
owing you another favor, so you\'ll just have to make do with my
gratitude.\"

As the two of them drew close to the entrance of the Spring Banner Inn,
Chen Ping\'an asked a rather strange question: \"Do you ever brew wine
yourself, Sword Immortal Xie?\"

\"Of course not,\" Xie Songhua replied. \"Why do you ask?\"

\"I have a friend who once told me that his only wish is to retire to
the mountains, sip tea brewed from spring water, and live out a life of
leisure,\" Chen Ping\'an replied with a smile.

\"Has Mi Yu been rubbing off on you, Chen Ping\'an?\" Xie Songhua asked
in a displeased voice. \"Are you trying to flirt with me?\"

Chen Ping\'an was rendered completely speechless.

He had never felt like he was good at dealing with women. In this
regard, he was far inferior to the likes of Mi Yu and Jiang Shangzhen,
and in all honesty, he couldn\'t even compare with Qi Jinglong.

\"Ha! You\'re still just a kid, after all.\" Xie Songhua chuckled. \"For
all your smarts and cunning, you still can\'t even take a joke!\"

Chen Ping\'an breathed a sigh of relief.

\"There\'s no need to escort me any further beyond this point, Lord
Hidden Official,\" Xie Songhua said as she cupped her fist in a parting
salute. \"I don\'t have a habit of taking strolls with men.\"

With that, Xie Songhua promptly departed, and after walking a few steps,
she gave Chen Ping\'an a dismissive wave and teased, \"Quit looking at
me! I don\'t have a big arse or a thin waist, so there\'s nothing for
you to look at. If you want someone to look at, go to Nalan Caihuan.
That Liu Shen wasn\'t half bad, either. Did you see the knockers on her?
I was worried her table would collapse under their weight!\"

Chen Ping\'an shook his head with a wry smile, then turned and made his
way back into the Spring Banner Inn, and his mind was soon occupied
again.

Zuo You had been sent to the Parasol Leaf Continent, where he would
visit Mountain Master Song Mao and the old Heavenly Lord on Peace and
Tranquility Mountain.

Wei Jin was going to the Southern Whirl Continent, while Shao Yunyan
would be traveling to the Circling Ascension Continent with another
sword immortal that was yet to be decided.

Given that Shao Yunyan was only an Unpolished Jade Tier sword immortal,
he couldn\'t shoulder the burden of going to the Circling Ascension
Continent on his own, and that was why Chen Ping\'an had to be very
selective about who he chose. It had to be a native sword immortal, and
they had to be at least at the Immortal Tier.

He had considered Lu Zhi, as well as one of either Chen Xi or Qi Tingji,
and they were naturally going to set off later than Zuo You and Wei Jin.

However, his choice was going to have very far-reaching consequences,
and it could spell disaster if he wasn\'t careful, so he wanted to wait
and see for a little longer.

Back on top of the city walls, the one who Chen Ping\'an truly didn\'t
trust wasn\'t actually the old deaf guy. Instead, it was Lu Zhi.

That wasn\'t to say that Lu Zhi was secretly colluding with the Savage
World. Instead, the problem with her was that she definitely wasn\'t
willing to die on the Sword Qi Great Wall. If she decided that the
battle was already lost, then she would immediately leave without any
hesitation.

Chen Qingdu didn\'t fault her for this, and Chen Ping\'an certainly
wasn\'t going to look down on her for her decision.

The fact that Chen Qingdu chose Lu Zhi to protect the Hidden Official\'s
branch had been a sign in itself. Even if it was one that Chen Ping\'an
wasn\'t able to figure out the meaning of, it didn\'t matter as it
wasn\'t going to change the final outcome. However, if he understood
what Chen Qingdu was trying to convey, then as the newly appointed
Hidden Official, he should do some things that the Hidden Official
should do.

For example, he should try to allow Lu Zhi to leave the Sword Qi Great
Wall with as clear a conscience as possible.

As far as Chen Qingdu was concerned, the only thing that was truly
unacceptable for him would be if she were to betray the Sword Qi Great
Wall and slay her comrades to appease the Savage World.

Throughout the history of the old sword immortal, there had been many
sword immortals who had died against their will. Their deaths could\'ve
been avoided, but they still died nevertheless, and the fundamental
reason for this was that Chen Qingdu wanted them dead.

Chen Ping\'an shuddered to imagine what it would\'ve been like to have
been in Chen Qingdu\'s shoes, not for a year or two, or even a century
or a millennium, but ten thousand years!

Chen Ping\'an felt like if he had been in the old great sword immortal's
place, his Dao Heart would\'ve been destroyed long ago, shattered into
so many pieces that he wouldn\'t even be able to pick up its remnants
from the ground. Either he went insane to avoid having to face reality,
or he went to another extreme.

One couldn\'t just not think about these things, but at the same time,
thinking too much about these things was of no benefit to anyone.

Chen Ping\'an had thought that Zuo You would be as cold and
unapproachable as ever when the two of them parted ways, but to his
surprise, Zuo You had been very pleasant and amicable prior to
departure.

In fact, he had even regarded Chen Ping\'an with a smile, and he had
spoken in a placid, almost joking tone as he said, \"Don\'t be like me
and focus on swordsmanship before you even become a competent scholar.
That\'s one thing that you definitely shouldn\'t learn from your senior
brother.\"

At this moment, Shao Yunyan was standing in his study behind his desk,
looking down at a piece of calligraphy that he had just created with a
very pleased expression.

The piece of calligraphy read: \"Improve with each passing day, and you
will eventually reach the light.\"

\*\*\*

Chen Ping\'an made his way back into the main hall, then sat down on the
main chair. However, there was nothing for him to do for now, so he
pressed a hand down on the surface of the eight immortals table before
him. The originally very tight and secure mortise and tenon joints of
the table had begun to loosen, causing the table to wobble ever so
slightly.

After Chen Ping\'an raised his hand, the table quickly fell still again.

Chen Ping\'an rose to his feet, then walked a few steps before turning
back and crouching down to observe the table.

To him, it appeared like the table was stable enough to remain standing
for at least ten thousand more years.

# Chapter 636: (1): Plot Unraveled

Sword of Coming

At this moment, the leader of the Jia Shen Tent, Mu Ji, was with Liu
Cha\'s only disciple, Bei Qie, and the closing disciple of Holding Moon
Mountain, Li Zhen. The three of them had appeared on the southernmost
point of the battlefield alongside Yu Si, Tun Tan, and the female sword
cultivator, Liu Bai.

Yu Si crouched down and pinched some soil between his middle and index
fingers, instantly crushing it into powder.

He then clapped his hands together and stood up before declaring, \"The
sword intent from both sides has been constantly whittling away at each
other, and the degree of conversion is about what we expected. That\'s
the only piece of good news.\"

\"Why are we jumping into this when we know that it\'s a trap?\" Liu Bai
asked with tightly furrowed brows. \"It\'s not like our Jia Shen Tent is
the only one that realizes that something isn\'t right; why do you think
it is that the Jia Zi Tent has been ignoring that side this entire time?
Clearly, our earth immortal sword cultivators are being targeted, and
quite a few of them have already perished in battle; nine over the
course of just two days, to be exact.

"Are we just going to keep offering them up to the Sword Qi Great Wall?
How can we just play right into our enemy\'s hands when we can already
clearly see what they\'re up to? What is going on, Mu Ji? You haven\'t
told us anything since you came back. If you\'ve been picked on by the
others over there, Li Zhen, Bei Qie, and I can all speak to our masters
for you.\"

\"Don\'t keep it all to yourself, Mu Ji,\" Yu Si chimed in. \"You can
tell us anything.\"

\"The Jia Zi Tent didn\'t give an exact reason; all they told me was
that after the battle, several seniors, including Yang Zhi and Huang
Luan, would carry the heads of all of the sword immortals that they slew
in the Savage World and hurl them at the Sword Qi Great Wall as a form
of retaliation,\" Mu Ji revealed.

\"How is that supposed to be retaliation?!\" Liu Bai snapped in an
enraged voice. \"Would we not have slain those sword immortals if our
earth immortal sword cultivators hadn\'t been killed? Those two things
have nothing to do with each other!\"

\"I don\'t get it, either.\" Mu Ji sighed. \"I don\'t understand why so
many of our sword cultivators are dying here, almost as if they *have*
to die for some reason.\"

\"At this point, there\'s not much we can do,\" Tun Tan said with a
smile. \"We\'ll just have to keep watching the situation unfold.\"

On the distant battlefield up ahead, a sword immortal of the Savage
World had revealed their enormous true form, and they were standing
alone on the battlefield with both hands resting on the hilt of their
sword, while the tip of their sword was plunged into the ground.

Several hundred bolts of bright red lightning instantly came raining
down from the sky above the sword formations of the Sword Qi Great Wall,
as if the lightning gods were displaying their wrath.

The sword immortals of the Sword Qi Great Wall immediately sprang into
action, using the cloud of sword qi to intercept the lightning and
shield all of the Middle Five Tiers sword cultivators below.

Elsewhere on the battlefield was a slender female sword immortal who
wasn\'t carrying a sword. However, as she swept her sleeves through the
air, thousands of flying swords formed by sword qi were conjured up
around her before hurtling toward the Sword Qi Great Wall\'s sword
formations.

She was opposed by Sword Immortal Yue Qing, who was wielding one of his
flying swords, namely Soaring Cloud Sparrow.

On the two battlefields, several cultivators from the Savage World that
had previously been completely unheard of had risen to prominence, as if
by the will of the heavens.

One of them was a demonic cultivator who wasn\'t even a sword
cultivator. Instead, he had only been an Abode Tier Qi refiner, and he
had previously been just another insignificant cog in the sword
formations of the Savage World. However, he inadvertently obtained two
bursts of ancient sword intent from the Sword Qi Great Wall, both of
which were of an extremely high caliber.

From there, he was destined to become an extremely formidable sword
immortal, and massive sums of cultivation resources were invested into
him. If he were to reach the Majestic World, then he had very good
chances of establishing his own sect or faction.

There was also a Golden Core Tier sword cultivator, whose bonded flying
sword had previously been considered to be largely useless, but had
somehow made some significant battlefield contributions on this
occasion.

Not only was he able to save two earth immortal sword cultivators from
all-out attacks unleashed by two enemy sword immortals, but he was also
somehow able to redirect their attacks to strike the sword formations of
the Sword Qi Great Wall. As a result, two Golden Core Tier sword
cultivators of the Sword Qi Great Wall instantly perished on the spot,
and there were many more casualties and injuries suffered by the Middle
Five Tiers sword cultivators as well.

The Golden Core Tier sword cultivator in question was immediately
ordered to leave the battlefield, following which an illusion was cast
onto him by an Ascension Tier senior. From there, he was sent back onto
the battlefield multiple times, specifically to oppose all-out attacks
unleashed by enemy sword immortals.

As for how a Golden Core Tier sword cultivator was able to anticipate
attacks from sword immortals, that was something known only to the Jia
Zi Tent, and none of the other tents were privy to this information.

Additionally, a pair of Nascent Tier sword cultivator Dao partners had
made breakthroughs to the Upper Five Tiers one after another in battle.

If it weren\'t for these unexpected bright spots, the challenge laid
down by the sword cultivators of the Savage World would\'ve been nothing
more than a joke because the rate at which the Sword Qi Great Wall\'s
sword cultivators were suffering casualties was far slower than the
tents had anticipated.

\"There are only two things that truly matter in a battle: personnel and
money,\" Mu Ji said. \"The enemy sword cultivators are suffering
casualties at a slower rate than expected, but that doesn\'t mean that
they\'re suffering *no* casualties. On top of that, we also have to look
at immortal coins, and that\'s actually an even more important factor
than the sword cultivators. Right now, most of the sword cultivators of
the Sword Qi Great Wall are beginning to run out of spiritual energy.

"The spiritual energy on the battlefield is extremely murky, so neither
side will be able to harness it. The difference is that we have the
entire Savage World behind us, and our two seniors are channeling two
almighty rivers of spiritual energy onto the battlefield from the Savage
World to constantly replenish our cultivators.

"In contrast, how much spiritual energy could there possibly be in a
comparatively tiny place like the Sword Qi Great Wall? How much longer
will they be able to last before they run out of spiritual energy? Our
tents have already carried out meticulous calculations, and as long as
there aren\'t any mishaps, all of the sword cultivators of the Sword Qi
Great Wall will eventually run out of spiritual energy. Once that
happens, we\'ll be able to cut them down in large swathes.\"

\"But as you said, that\'s only barring any mishaps,\" Liu Bai said in a
grim voice. \"We\'re assuming that the Sword Qi Great Wall won\'t have
any other sources of spiritual energy, but given how many surprises
they\'ve already given us over the course of this battle, I\'m not so
confident that they don\'t have any more tricks up their sleeves.\"

\"In that case, let\'s factor in the intercontinental ships from the
eight continents of the Majestic World,\" Mu Ji said. \"The Northern
Complete Reed Continent is likely going to be our main concern because I
think they\'d be willing to fork out just about everything they have to
support the Sword Qi Great Wall. Thankfully, the Northern Complete Reed
Continent is the only continent that would be so selfless.

"The Parasol Leaf Continent doesn\'t have any intercontinental ships, so
the nearest continents to the Sword Qi Great Wall are the Southern Whirl
Continent and the Circling Ascension Continent. The largest
intercontinental ship on the Circling Ascension Continent belongs to the
Mountain and Water Cave, which has some bad blood with the Sword Qi
Great Wall, so they won\'t be easy to do business with.

"In fact, perhaps they\'re even helping us out as we speak. As for the
Southern Whirl Continent, even if the intercontinental ship
administrators have a collective rush of blood to the head and are
willing to sacrifice everything to help the Sword Qi Great Wall,
they\'ll still need to secure approval from their sects and backers. The
good news for us is that the Sword Qi Great Wall has never been good at
dealing with the Majestic World.\"

\"What if things are different this time?\" Liu Bai asked. \"What if
someone on the Sword Qi Great Wall is able to convince the
intercontinental ships from the eight continents to give the Sword Qi
Great Wall their unreserved support?\"

\"And how would they do that? By getting their sword immortals to beg
the intercontinental ships for their support?\" Tun Tan sneered. \"Those
who can make money, but choose not to, would never have become
administrators of the intercontinental ships, and they certainly
wouldn\'t have been sent to do business with Stalactite Mountain.

"Is the Sword Qi Great Wall supposed to bribe the intercontinental ship
administrators with immortal coins? That\'s not going to help them
because immortal coins are precisely what they\'re in dire shortage of
right now!\"

\"If the opportunity arises, I would really like to meet that person and
have a chat with them on top of the city walls,\" Mu Ji mused.

\"That\'s assuming that he can survive until then,\" Li Zhen scoffed.

All of a sudden, an idea occurred to Liu Bai, and she was just about to
speak, but Mu Ji seemed to have gleaned her thoughts.

\"Mishaps can only be corrected through other mishaps,\" he said with a
shake of his head. \"There are some people on Stalactite Mountain who
are only passive observers for the moment, but that\'s not going to
remain the case forever.\"

\*\*\*

After making the snowwoman, Mi Yu plucked some leaves and flowers from
the flowerbed to dress it in some floral garments, the color and style
of which precisely matched what she had worn back when they first met.

Upon arriving at the main hall, Mi Yu spotted Chen Ping\'an inside,
squatting down to examine the eight immortals table.

He strode over the doorstep, then asked with a curious expression, \"Why
have you taken an interest in this table, Lord Hidden Official? Could it
be that it\'s a priceless treasure that you\'re planning to move to the
summer palace?\"

\"Let\'s take a walk together,\" Chen Ping\'an said as he rose to his
feet.

Mi Yu took a glance at the eight immortals table before leaving the main
hall with Chen Ping\'an. It appeared that the table wasn\'t worth much,
after all.

As one of the four most prominent private residences on Stalactite
Mountain, the Spring Banner Inn was enormous, and it was filled with
many scenic landmarks, both natural and artificial. Together, Chen
Ping\'an and Mi Yu made their way down a paved stone path, one that was
teeming with spiritual energy.

\"I\'m sure you know what you\'re doing, Lord Hidden Official, but I
still feel the need to issue you a warning,\" Mi Yu said. \"Right now,
the intercontinental ship administrators may appear very obedient and
cooperative, but if you don\'t do anything to keep them in check, then I
fear that they won\'t be cooperative for long.\"

\"Are you blaming me for assembling all of those sword immortals, only
to end up killing no one?\" Chen Ping\'an asked with a smile.

\"I wouldn\'t dare,\" Mi Yu replied.

\"The killing intent displayed by the sword immortals earlier wasn\'t
just an act,\" Chen Ping\'an said. \"However, in the end, they didn\'t
kill anyone. Do you believe that?\"

\"I don\'t,\" Mi Yu replied.

\"Wu Qiu, Bai Xi, and the others wouldn\'t have believed it, either,\"
Chen Ping\'an said. \"While it may seem like they were fully focused on
discussing business after I let them off the hook, the reality is that
all of them were still fearing for their lives. If you had paid closer
attention to them instead of ogling the female administrators, you
would\'ve realized this yourself.\"

A sheepish look appeared on Mi Yu\'s face. Old habits were hard to kill.

Chen Ping\'an stopped in his tracks, then turned to a nearby waterside
pavilion and said, \"One option is to really go all-out and set an
example. In that scenario, we\'ll kill Wu Qiu from the Middle Earth
Divine Continent, Jiang Gaotai, who\'s the most formidable cultivator of
all of the administrators present, Bai Xi, who has the most bad blood
with the Sword Qi Great Wall, and Liu Shen, who possesses the lowest
cultivation base and is the most worthless of all of the administrators.

"These are the people that all of the other administrators are convinced
will live, and only after killing them all can we drive them into a
corner with no path for retreat. Alternatively, I can spare them all and
have them speculate endlessly about who\'s going to be killed. As soon
as I display any sign of killing intent, there will be people who will
help me select who to kill.

"They\'ll tell me which administrators can be killed at the least cost,
where Yan Ming and Nalan Caihuan will have to issue the least
compensation, and perhaps we won\'t even need to send Sword Immortal Sun
Juyuan to issue any apologies. Honestly, killing people is not fun. If I
could have my way, then it would please me to no end to kill all of the
administrators in the Spring Banner Inn right now, but if you actually
stop to think about it, which of them actually deserve to die?

"Bai Xi? He\'s not the patriarch of the Mountain and Water Cave. Wu Qiu?
Why does he deserve to die? Jiang Gaotai? If it wasn\'t for my
intentional provocation and his desire to help the intercontinental
ships and himself gain as much leverage over the Sword Qi Great Wall as
possible, would he have ended up in the situation that he\'s in right
now?\"

Mi Yu was silent for a moment, then said in a solemn voice, \"All of
them are trying to profit as much as possible from the ongoing war,
essentially holding our Sword Qi Great Wall at ransom, and in my
opinion, that\'s more than enough reason to kill them all. If I were in
your place, they would all already be dead right now, but of course, my
actions would bring about some terrible consequences for the Sword Qi
Great Wall.\"

\"Sword immortals need only focus on what sword immortals should do,\"
Chen Ping\'an said. \"If I recall correctly, you were already a Golden
Core Tier sword cultivator at my age, and you reached the Nascent Tier
at sixty-four, then the Unpolished Jade Tier at 196. Out of all of the
sword immortals, your aptitude ranks far from the bottom. In fact, I\'d
say you\'re ranked much closer to the top than the bottom.

"Thanks to your exceptional aptitude, you were able to reach the Upper
Five Tiers, but in the process, your priorities shifted, and you began
to pursue something outside of swordsmanship, something that you truly
enjoyed. From the perspective of others, the outcome of this decision
was not a good one, but you don\'t think there\'s any issue with it. The
only drawback for you is that you feel guilty toward your brother, Mi
Hu.\"

\"There\'s no need to be so tactful about it, Lord Hidden Official,\" Mi
Yu said with a slightly awkward expression. \"I fully admit that I\'m
more interested in women and romance than swordsmanship, and I\'m also
just better at it.\"

\"Different environments give rise to different types of people,\" Chen
Ping\'an said with a smile. \"The Majestic World can\'t produce that
many swordsmen, but the Sword Qi Great Wall needs an outsider who\'s
familiar with the rules of the Majestic World to serve as Hidden
Official. However, this is also a double-edged sword for me. As Hidden
Official, I wield a lot of authority and can do many things for the
Sword Qi Great Wall, but performing my duties as Hidden Official also
tarnishes my Dao Heart.

"If I become too invested in hatching schemes and plotting against
others, then my future cultivation bottlenecks will become more and more
difficult to overcome. However, barring any major mishaps, I can promise
that I should still be able to surpass you in my pursuit of the Great
Dao, particularly when it comes to combat prowess.\"

\"Cultivation base isn\'t the answer to everything, but it can certainly
solve a lot of problems,\" Mi Yu replied with a nod.

\"Cultivation base can solve a lot of problems, but not all problems,\"
Chen Ping\'an countered.

\"There\'s a reason why you\'re the Hidden Official,\" Mi Yu praised.

Chen Ping\'an offered no response, instead smiling as he changed the
subject and said, \"I spoke to Shao Yunyan earlier, and he told me his
stance on the matter in a rather roundabout way. He holds the exact
opposite opinion to you, advising not to let my emotions get the better
of me and kill everyone on a whim.

"He was very tactful and delicate in the way that he spoke to me, but
the general gist of what he said was that if I don\'t heed his advice,
then we\'ll most likely have to move our future discussions to the Water
Essence Palace or the Ganoderma Inn. You think Shao Yunyan was really
content just to sit at the entrance and serve as a door god for our
Sword Qi Great Wall? All sword immortals have a certain degree of pride,
and he\'s no exception.\"

A displeased look appeared on Mi Yu\'s face upon hearing this.

\"There\'s no need to resent Shao Yunyan for this,\" Chen Ping\'an
continued. \"As long as his advice is sound, we should heed it. Besides,
he\'s not opposed to the idea of using some cruel methods to get back at
the administrators.

"I asked him his thoughts on the matter, and he was open to the idea.
Not only that, but he\'s even agreed to help find that business prodigy
who excels at fabricating fake accounts, so at the end of the day,
we\'ll ultimately still reach the outcome that I desire.\"

\"But it\'ll be a lot harder work for you,\" Mi Yu lamented.

\"We can\'t just keep making empty threats,\" Chen Ping\'an declared.
\"It\'s about time we actually made them suffer a little. Otherwise,
once they realize that I was just bluffing, they\'ll start to resort to
their little tricks again. I can deal with everything they have to throw
at me, but our Sword Qi Great Wall can\'t afford any delays.\"

By the time Chen Ping\'an and Mi Yu returned to the main hall of the
Spring Banner Inn, all of the administrators were already seated inside.

Chen Ping\'an sat down on the main chair with a smile and said, \"All
true friends have arguments once in a while. Now that we\'ve argued,
we\'re all friends now, and I have a little present for you all.\"

Not only were the administrators in the hall not enthused or relieved to
hear this, but all of them had also become extremely tense and
apprehensive. In fact, many of them had already concealed their hands up
their sleeves, preparing to flee for their lives at the first sign of
danger.

Was the Hidden Official finally going to begin killing now that the
sword immortals were no longer here? It sounded counterintuitive, but if
the administrators had learned anything about the Hidden Official, it
was that he was very unique in the way that he liked to do things, so
this was definitely a possibility!

\"There\'s no need to be so tense and anxious, everyone; it\'s just a
little gift, one for each of you,\" Chen Ping\'an reassured with a
smile.

Mi Yu rose to his feet, and some of the more fearful administrators
present reflexively began to stand up as well. However, as soon as their
bottoms left their chairs, they realized they were overreacting, and
they sat down again.

Mi Yu clasped one hand behind his back as he swept his other sleeve
through the air, releasing a series of strange jade tablets that were
enveloped in sword qi. The jade tablets were scattered throughout the
room, ultimately coming to a rest to hover in mid-air before the
fifty-four administrators.

The jade tablets hovered vertically in the air, slowly revolving so the
administrators could clearly see what was inscribed on both sides.

The jade tablets were fashioned in the style of the most ordinary safety
tablets from the Majestic World, and on one side was etched the words
\"Sword Qi Great Wall,\" while the other side read \"Majestic World.\"
However, the side that bore the inscription of \"Sword Qi Great Wall\"
also featured the words \"Hidden Official\" in smaller text, as well as
a number. As Wu Qiu closely inspected his jade tablet, he discovered
that his number was 9.

Wu Qiu quickly examined the jade tablets of Tang Feiqian and Jiang
Gaotai to discover that they bore the numbers of 12 and 16,
respectively, while the number on Bai Xi\'s jade tablet was 13.

The administrator of the Rainbow Raiment, Liu Shen, who was seated
nearest to the entrance, had the number 96 on her jade tablet.

\"Ignore the numbers on the tablets,\" Mi Yu said. \"All you need to
know is that your tablet is completely unique to yourself. These jade
tablets were personally engraved by Lord Hidden Official himself, and
each one contains the sword qi of two or three sword immortals. As for
which sword immortals have injected their sword qi into which tablets,
that is known only to Lord Hidden Official.

"If you think you can find out the answer, then you\'re free to go ahead
and try, but we can confidently say that no one in the entire Majestic
World is able to make convincing forgeries of these tablets. Strictly
speaking, they\'re not particularly valuable. All of you have been doing
business for a very long time, and I\'m sure you\'ve seen plenty of
things far more valuable than these tablets.

"However, their value lies in the fact that they\'re all completely
one-of-a-kind. If anyone else wants to secure one of these jade tablets
in the future, then it\'ll come down to whether they\'ll have a chance
to meet Lord Hidden Official and whether they\'ll have what it takes to
be welcomed as an esteemed guest of the Spring Banner Inn. What I can
tell you for certain is that those two conditions will be very difficult
to satisfy.

"Only ninety-nine of these tablets were created in total, and no more
will be made beyond that, so the largest number any of them can bear is
99. If any of you see a tablet with the number 100 on it in the future,
then just treat it as a joke.\"

\"I\'m a guest as well, so why am I the only one who hasn\'t received a
jade tablet?\" Shao Yunyan suddenly asked with a smile. \"It looks to me
like the smaller the number, the higher the status of the recipient, so
I\'ll just have the jade tablet with the number 99.\"

Mi Yu didn\'t dare to make the decision on his own, so he turned his
gaze to Chen Ping\'an.

All of a sudden, Jiang Gaotai stood up and cupped his fist in a salute
as he asked in a formal manner, \"Lord Hidden Official, would I be able
to exchange my jade tablet for the one with the number 99?\"

Chen Ping\'an hadn\'t said anything to him on this occasion. Instead, he
genuinely wanted to have the jade tablet with the highest number.

Call it a gamble or a whim, but Jiang Gaotai had always believed in his
own intuition, and his instincts had helped him at many key junctures on
his cultivation journey, playing a major role in the vast wealth that he
had been able to accumulate thus far.

\"Is this really something to be fighting over, Administrator Jiang?\"
Shao Yunyan asked with a smile. \"Isn\'t that a little unbecoming of a
sword immortal of your status? Besides, as I observed just now, it seems
like the smaller the number, the higher the status of the recipient, so
why would you want the jade tablet with the largest number?\"

\"Please let me have this one, Sword Immortal Shao,\" Jiang Gaotai
requested with a smile as he turned to Shao Yunyan and cupped his fist
in a salute.

\"Nope, this is not up for negotiation,\" Shao Yunyan refused with a
shake of his head.

\"These jade tablets are just a little gift for all of you, and you can
use them to play a little game,\" Chen Ping\'an said. \"You can make
bets on which sword immortals you think injected their sword qi into
your tablet, and it\'s up to you whether you try to exchange your tablet
for someone else\'s, or choose to believe that you have the tablet
that\'s best for you.

"You can discuss that in private on your own, but at the end of it all,
I have to keep records of which tablet you\'ve ended up with, so make
sure to inform Sword Immortal Mi before you leave the Spring Banner Inn.
As for what you choose to do with these tablets, whether it be to keep
them for yourselves, give them to others, or even sell them, that\'s up
to you to decide. For now, it\'s time to continue our business
discussions from earlier.\"

Mi Yu sat back down, as did Shao Yunyan and Jiang Gaotai.
